title: MInfoVisQA: A Multilingual Benchmark for Information-Rich Visual Question Answering
comment: Dataset: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel in vision-language tasks; yet, whether they maintain consistent understanding of information-rich visuals (InfoVis) when the surface language changes remains unclear. To quantify this capability, we introduce MInfoVisQA, a parallel benchmark with 8,960 QA configurations derived from 128 seed instances across 24 languages. We construct seed-matched, language-parallel visuals and QA pairs by disentangling numerical-structural data from text and programmatically synchronizing translated labels. We evaluate 25 MLLMs under two settings: Language-Aligned QA (LQA, matching visual-text languages) and Cross-Language QA (XQA, fixed QA language with varying visual languages). The results show that aggregate accuracy masks substantial robustness gaps: two models with comparable mean LQA accuracy (80.4\%) exhibit performance spreads of 7.8 and 20.3 percentage points across languages. Moreover, all 25 models score lower with non-English visuals under fixed English QA, underscoring the need for cross-language sensitivity metrics.

AI.tldr: MInfoVisQA：24种语言、128个种子实例、8960条QA配置的并行信息可视化基准，用于衡量MLLM在视觉语言变化下的跨语言一致性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在视觉语言任务上表现优异，但其对信息密集可视化（InfoVis）的理解是否在表层语言变化时保持一致尚不清楚，缺乏量化手段与跨语言敏感度指标。
AI.method: 将数值-结构数据与文本解耦，构建种子匹配、语言平行的可视化与QA对，并通过程序化同步翻译标签；设置Language-Aligned QA（LQA，图-文语言一致）与Cross-Language QA（XQA，固定QA语言、变化视觉语言）两种评测设定，评测25个MLLM。
AI.result: 聚合准确率掩盖了显著鲁棒性差异：两个LQA均值同为80.4%的模型，跨语言波动分别为7.8与20.3个百分点；固定英语QA下，全部25个模型在非英语可视化上得分更低。
AI.conclusion: 聚合指标不足以刻画多模态模型的语言鲁棒性，需引入跨语言敏感度指标；基准为多语言InfoVis理解提供可诊断的评测框架。

title: Depth-Aware Activation Steering via Attention Residuals
summary: Activation steering is a simple, training-free way to modulate LLM behavior, yet existing methods typically inject vectors at a single layer and lack mechanisms for depth-aware propagation or internal verification. We combine two recent ideas - Attention Residuals (AttnRes) providing learnable cross-layer pathways, and Jacobian-lens (J-space) concept readout - into a lightweight depth-aware steering pipeline. On two small open models (Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3.5-0.8B), distributing a persona vector according to AttnRes-style depth weights yields stronger internal alignment (deeper-layer concept cosine and rank, p<0.0001) and stronger behavioral shifts than single-layer injection. The effect is sign-specific: reverse vectors invert all six metrics, random directions degrade alignment (p<0.0001), and a short LoRA fine-tune erases the imprint. Injection rewires attention strictly downstream of the injection point (upstream JS = 0.00000). Three practical findings follow. First, a layer-wise geometric decomposition of cosine readouts: at the injection layer 123% of the increase is arithmetic, while 5-11 layers downstream 100% is dynamical. Second, an intensity window: effects are monotone over 0.3-0.7, then generation collapses (617 to 306 to 25 chars). Third, metric discipline: keyword-rule metrics fail LLM-judge validation (kappa <= 0.09), and two rule-based conclusions were retracted. Training the depth weights on a steering objective (200 steps, frozen backbone) raises final alignment 10x on held-out prompts. Cross-persona vectors retain 96-99% of the effect: specificity holds against random, not semantic, directions. We contribute a practical, low-overhead depth-aware steering method with a careful evaluation protocol. Code and data are released.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量、免训练的深度感知激活引导流程：将 AttnRes 式跨层深度权重与 Jacobian-lens 概念读出结合，按层分配 persona 向量以增强内部对齐与行为偏移。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导（activation steering）多在单层注入向量，缺乏深度感知的传播机制与内部验证手段，难以判断引导是否真正起作用及其作用机理。
AI.method: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 与 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上，将 AttnRes 的可学习跨层路径权重用于分配 persona 向量；用 J-space 概念余弦/秩做内部读出；做符号特异性、随机方向、LoRA 擦除、注意力下游重连（JS 散度）等对照；并提出逐层几何分解、强度窗口与指标纪律三项评估规范；仅以引导目标训练深度权重 200 步（主干冻结）。
AI.result: 深度加权分配在深层概念余弦/秩（p<0.0001）与行为偏移上均优于单层注入；反向向量反转全部六项指标，随机方向使对齐退化，LoRA 微调可抹除印记；注入仅改变下游注意力（上游 JS=0）。注入层 123% 的余弦增益来自算术效应，下游 5–11 层 100% 为动力学效应；效果在 0.3–0.7 单调，之后生成崩溃（617→306→25 字符）；关键词规则指标与 LLM 评判一致性差（kappa≤0.09），两则基于规则的结论已撤回；深度权重训练在留出提示上将对齐提升约 10 倍；跨 persona 向量保留 96–99% 效应。
AI.conclusion: 给出一种低开销、深度感知的引导方法及严谨评估协议，强调区分算术效应与动力学效应、设定强度窗口、慎用规则类指标；但效果针对随机方向而非语义方向具备特异性，泛化性有限。属 LLM 可解释性与控制方向，与物理 AI/机器人核心议题关联较弱。

title: Edge-Adaptive Hiera-Seg Model for Building-Integrated Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 1 table
summary: Building integrated photovoltaic power forecasting is challenging because facade orientation, rooftop geometry, nearby buildings, vegetation, cloud movement, module temperature, inverter status and edge device reliability jointly affect power generation. This paper proposes an edge-adaptive HieraSeg model for short term BIPV power forecasting with multi-orientation visual-irradiance fusion. RGB facade images, optional thermal cues, irradiance measurements, module temperature, facade orientation, rooftop masks, shading labels, sky condition, historical power and edge device state are aligned into synchronous forecasting windows. HieraSeg extracts hierarchical regions from facade, rooftop, sky, shadow and background images, while the edge-adaptive module changes feature weights under missing frames, latency shifts and local shading changes. The segmentation branch identifies occluded module areas and separates facade, rooftop, sky and background evidence before the forecasting head estimates future BIPV output. Experiments are designed on a simulated multibuilding BIPV dataset with unseen building and unseen orientation tests. The model reports predicted power, confidence interval, dominant evidence, occlusion contribution, orientation contribution and energy-management review priority. This output is intended to show whether the forecast is driven by irradiance change, visible shading, orientation response, stale edge information or recent power history. The framework supports local forecasting at edge controllers with limited communication delay and computing resources, linking visual occlusion, irradiance dynamics and power history to traceable forecasting results for building energy management, microgrid scheduling and BIPV operation planning.

AI.tldr: 提出边缘自适应的HieraSeg模型，融合多朝向RGB立面图像、辐照度、组件温度与历史功率，做短期BIPV光伏功率预测，并输出可追溯的证据归因。
AI.motivation: 建筑光伏（BIPV）功率受立面朝向、屋顶几何、邻近遮挡、植被、云移动、组件温度、逆变器状态与边缘设备可靠性等多因素耦合影响，短时预测困难；同时边缘控制器算力与通信受限，需要本地化、可解释的预测。
AI.method: 将RGB立面图像（可选热红外）、辐照度、组件温度、立面朝向、屋顶掩码、阴影标签、天空条件、历史功率与边缘设备状态对齐为同步预测窗口；HieraSeg进行层级区域分割（立面、屋顶、天空、阴影、背景）以识别遮挡模块区域，边缘自适应模块在丢帧、时延漂移与局部阴影变化下动态调整特征权重，再由预测头输出未来功率及置信区间、主导演证据、遮挡/朝向贡献与储能调度优先级。
AI.result: 在模拟多建筑BIPV数据集上设计未见建筑与未见朝向的泛化测试；摘要未给出具体量化误差指标，主要报告预测功率、置信区间及多源证据贡献等可解释输出。
AI.conclusion: 框架面向边缘控制器的本地短时预测，将视觉遮挡、辐照动态与功率历史关联为可追溯预测，服务于建筑能源管理、微电网调度与BIPV运维；但实验基于仿真数据，缺乏真实部署验证。

title: EgoLink: Egocentric Language-Vision Interactive Network Knowledge Challenge Summary
comment: Published in ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: The EgoLink Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026 benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence linking first-person perception, social reasoning, and interactive action. Unlike benchmarks centered on visible objects and activities, EgoLink evaluates whether models can interpret emotional and social cues, resolve visually grounded references, and convert user requests into verified tool-mediated actions. Its two tracks cover social reasoning in egocentric video and interactive agents that complete service tasks through dialogue, tool use, and closed-loop execution. Together, they test whether perception, reasoning, and decision-making remain coupled under both offline question answering and state-changing interaction. We highlight a multi-stage Track 1 data pipeline for multiple-choice question (MCQ) generation, chain-of-thought generation, automatic quality grading, and video-contribution filtering. We summarize the task design, evaluation metrics, rules, leaderboards, and representative solutions. The benchmark combines objective answer scoring with process- and result-based evaluation, enabling analysis of both final correctness and execution quality. The best Track 1 system achieved 0.9263 accuracy, while the best Track 2 system achieved 0.844 joint success and 0.916 micro accuracy. Participant reports reveal a shared principle: strong systems make intermediate evidence explicit through candidate verification, option-robust reasoning, scenario-aware planning, tool canonicalization, and state-aware correction before answering or acting. These findings highlight the importance of process verification and evidence-grounded reasoning for reliable egocentric multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: EgoLink Challenge（ACM MM 2026）第一人称多模态智能基准：Track 1 为自我中心视频社交推理（MCQ），Track 2 为通过对话与工具调用完成闭环服务任务的交互智能体；最佳系统分别为 0.9263 准确率与 0.844 联合成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心基准多聚焦可见物体与活动识别，缺乏对情感/社交线索理解、视觉指代消解、以及将用户请求转化为可验证工具动作的能力评测；需要一个统一考察感知—推理—决策在离线问答与状态改变式交互中是否保持耦合的基准。
AI.method: 构建双赛道挑战赛：Track 1 采用多阶段数据管线（MCQ 生成、思维链生成、自动质量打分、视频贡献度过滤）并做社交推理评测；Track 2 构建对话+工具使用+闭环执行的服务任务交互环境。评测结合客观答案打分与过程/结果导向评估，并要求参赛系统显式化中间证据（候选验证、选项鲁棒推理、场景感知规划、工具规范化、状态感知纠错）。
AI.result: Track 1 最佳系统准确率 0.9263；Track 2 最佳系统联合成功率 0.844、微平均准确率 0.916。参赛报告归纳出共同原则：强系统均通过显式中间证据与过程验证提升可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了过程验证与证据落地推理对可靠自我中心多模态智能的关键作用，并提供可复用的数据管线与评测协议；但属基准/竞赛总结性质，未提出可直接迁移的新方法。

title: Video recordings and play behaviour annotations of group-housed dairy calves on two Dutch farms
summary: Play is used as an indicator of positive welfare in dairy calves, but openly available video of group-housed calves with individual behaviour annotations is scarce. We describe video from four camera deployments of about one week each in group pens of dairy calves on two farms in the Netherlands: a research and teaching dairy farm (2024 and 2025) and a commercial dairy farm (2024). The recordings comprise 1,173 video files spanning 651 h. For eight observation days, trained observers coded calf behaviour continuously in Noldus The Observer XT with an 18-item ethogram of play and other behaviours, covering 104 h of video, 90 h of which have every calf in the pen coded. The release also contains 1.1 million decoded frames from seven annotated sessions, a per-frame timestamp read by optical character recognition from the camera clock burned into each frame, per-calf segmentation tracks and per-calf frame-level play labels. The data support studies of calf behaviour and welfare and the development and evaluation of automated behaviour recognition.

AI.tldr: 公开发布荷兰两个奶牛场群养犊牛的多摄像头视频数据集：1,173个视频文件共651小时，含8个观察日、104小时精细标注（18项行为谱，其中90小时为全栏逐头编码），以及110万解码帧、逐帧时间戳OCR、逐头分割轨迹与逐帧玩耍标签。
AI.motivation: 玩耍行为是犊牛正向福利的重要指标，但缺乏个体行为标注的公开群养犊牛视频，制约了行为学研究与自动化行为识别方法的开发与评测。
AI.method: 在两个农场四个摄像头部署（各约一周），采用瞬时/连续抽样由受训观察员在Noldus The Observer XT中按18项行为谱连续编码；对7个标注会话做逐帧解码，OCR读取画面内摄像机时钟生成逐帧时间戳，并结合逐头分割跟踪给出逐帧玩耍标签。
AI.result: 提供651小时原始视频、104小时连续标注（90小时覆盖栏内全部个体）及1.1百万带时间戳解码帧与逐头分割/标签，可直接支撑犊牛行为福利研究与自动行为识别模型的训练和评价。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为动物福利与自动化行为识别提供了高质量、多模态、个体级的公开资源，可作为动物行为理解与视频跟踪/分割方法的通用评测基准。

title: An Open-Source da Vinci X/Xi Instrument Module for Laparoscopic Surgery Research
comment: Submitted to the 2027 International Symposium on Medical Robotics (ISMR). † Equal contribution. ‡ Equal supervision
summary: Studying electrosurgical tasks on a research robot requires control of both instrument motion and energy activation, along with a record of when each action occurs. This paper presents an open-source module for da Vinci X/Xi instruments on a UR5/UR5e robotic arm. Five motors transmit torque through timing belts to spring-loaded drive discs. An electrosurgical interposer accepts software commands, gives the surgeon's foot pedals priority, and records the source of each activation request. In bench testing, the interposer recorded all 12 activation and deactivation events from six pedal presses. Ex vivo demonstrations included monopolar and bipolar coagulation of splenic tissue and monopolar cutting during gallbladder dissection. Optical tracking of the Fenestrated Bipolar Forceps showed that calibration brought pitch and yaw gains from 0.904 and 1.14 to 1.00 and 1.02, respectively. The module enables researchers to record instrument motion, video, and the timing and source of electrosurgical commands during laparoscopic tasks.

AI.tldr: 开源模块实现 da Vinci X/Xi 器械在 UR5/UR5e 上的运动控制与电外科激活控制，并记录激活时间与来源。
AI.motivation: 研究机器人在电外科任务中需同时控制器械运动与能量激活，并记录每步动作的发生时刻，现有平台缺乏此类开源支持。
AI.method: 五电机经同步带驱动弹簧加载驱动盘；设计电外科中间层(interposer)接受软件指令、以术者脚踏板优先并记录每个激活请求来源；对 Fenestrated Bipolar Forceps 进行光学跟踪标定。
AI.result: 台架测试中中间层完整记录六次踏板按压产生的全部12个激活/去激活事件；离体实验完成脾组织单极/双极凝血与胆囊剥离单极切割；标定使俯仰与偏航增益由0.904/1.14修正至1.00/1.02。
AI.conclusion: 该模块使研究者可在腹腔镜任务中同步记录器械运动、视频及电外科指令的时序与来源，属医疗机器人实验平台工具。

title: Every Camera Grows Up: Camera-Height Regression in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models serve as simulators for embodied agents: from a starting image and an action trajectory, they generate the views the agent would see. The starting image fixes how high the camera is, for example 0.15 m for a floor robot or 2.2 m for an overhead camera, and a faithful simulator must keep this height as the camera moves. We show that six recent open-weight models fail to do so: as motion replaces the starting view with generated content, they move the camera toward human eye level, a failure we call camera-height regression. Our benchmark, EyeHeight, pairs six rendered elevations (0.15 m to 2.2 m) and four calibrated real-world rig heights with scale-free multi-view height estimation. All six models lose their initial height during a $180^\circ$ turn-and-walk rollout: initialized at 0.15 m, only 0-20% of clips end within $1.3\times$ of the starting height as inferred viewpoints converge to human heights of 1.1 m to 1.5 m, whereas ground-truth renders remain within a few percent. In Matrix-Game models, homography-tracked floor motion stays consistent with constant elevation during rotation even as newly outpainted room geometry yields a higher reconstructed viewpoint. Regression grows with rotation angle, begins while the start frame remains in context, and largely reverses in SANA-WM when a $360^\circ$ turn restores the initial view. We trace this pull to human-centric video priors in which floor-level views are nearly absent: in SANA-WM, textual height cues and dense floor-disparity maps do not prevent it, whereas classifier-free text guidance during the first half of denoising strengthens it. Combining unguided sampling with height-balanced fine-tuning recovers more retention but costs 5 MUSIQ points, a loss fixed during those same early steps. Viewpoint drift alone shifts the paths predicted by visual navigation policies.

AI.tldr: 交互式视频世界模型存在"相机高度回归"：随运动推进，生成视角向人眼高度(1.1–1.5 m)漂移，无法保持初始相机高度。作者提出EyeHeight基准（6个渲染仰角0.15–2.2 m + 4个真实标定装置高度 + 尺度无关多视角高度估计），六个开源模型在180°转身行走后仅0–20%片段保持初始高度；并追溯到人类中心视频先验，提出无引导采样+高度平衡微调的缓解方案。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型被当作具身智能体的模拟器，起始图像固定了相机高度（地面机器人0.15 m、俯拍摄像机2.2 m），忠实模拟器必须在相机移动时保持该高度。作者发现现有模型在生成新内容时系统性丢失该几何约束，这会直接破坏下游导航策略的可靠性，因此需要量化并定位该失效。
AI.method: 构建EyeHeight基准：6个渲染仰角(0.15–2.2 m)与4个真实标定rig高度，采用尺度无关的多视角高度估计推理生成视点高度；对六个开源权重模型做180°/360°转身行走 rollout评估。诊断方面用homography跟踪地面运动、检查起始帧在context内的影响、测试文本高度提示与稠密地面视差图，以及CFG文本引导、无引导采样、高度平衡微调的组合消融。
AI.result: 六模型全部丢失初始高度：0.15 m初始化下仅0–20%片段落在1.3×初始高度内，推断视点收敛至1.1–1.5 m，而GT渲染保持在数个百分点内。Matrix-Game的homography地面运动在旋转时仍符合恒定仰角，说明失效来自新外绘几何而非已有像素。回归随旋转角增大，起始帧仍在context时即已出现；SANA-WM在360°回到初始视图时大部分可逆。文本高度提示与稠密地面视差图无效，前半程去噪的CFG文本引导反而加剧漂移；无引导采样+高度平衡微调提升保持率但损失5 MUSIQ点（同样可在早期步修复）。视点漂移单独即可改变视觉导航策略的预测路径。
AI.conclusion: 相机高度回归是当前视频世界模型的共性缺陷，根源是人类中心视频先验（地面视角数据近乎缺失），而非局部跟踪或接口问题；现有条件注入难以纠正，需在采样引导与数据分布层面干预。该问题对具身导航下游影响可测量，建议将高度保真作为世界模型评测的标配维度。

title: Better Calibrated, Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, Submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model's uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. We benchmark EDL, Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles against a GP in closed loop with five planners on physics-based oil spill simulations. Across 60 maps, the choice of model dominates the outcome, explaining 80\% of the variance of the final reconstruction error, against 1\% for the planner among the deep models. EDL achieves the lowest error and the highest IoU under every planner, is the best calibrated model and runs at 3.9 ms per step. With 50 cells per vehicle it reconstructs the spill better than MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles with 150. Deep Ensembles become more confident as their error grows, whereas EDL is unaffected. Robustness of the information model to the data its own planner collects is therefore a requirement of uncertainty-aware IPP.

AI.tldr: 本文在真实物理溢油仿真中闭环比较 Evidential Deep Learning (EDL)、MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles 与 GP 四种不确定性信息模型，配五种规划器与多 ASV 在线共享不确定性地图；结论是模型选择主导最终重建误差方差（80%），规划器仅占 1%，EDL 误差最低、IoU 最高、校准最好，单步 3.9 ms。
AI.motivation: 多 ASV 溢油监测需在有限时间与能量下从稀疏噪声测量中重建异质污染场。Informative Path Planning (IPP) 将重建模型与规划器耦合，但已有工作主要聚焦规划策略并默认使用 GP，对不确定性模型校准质量如何影响多车 IPP 闭环性能缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 提出以 EDL 作为校准良好的信息模型，与 MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles 及 GP 在闭环中对比；多车通过共享不确定性地图在线协调；在基于物理的溢油仿真中共评估 60 张地图、5 种规划器，以最终重建误差、IoU、校准质量与推理时延为指标。
AI.result: 模型选择解释最终重建误差方差的 80%，而深度模型间规划器仅解释 1%；EDL 在所有规划器下误差最低、IoU 最高且校准最佳，3.9 ms/步；每车 50 个采样单元即优于 MC Dropout 与 Deep Ensembles 的 150 个单元；Deep Ensembles 误差增大时置信度反而升高，EDL 无此退化。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知 IPP 的首要瓶颈是信息模型自身对规划器所采数据的鲁棒性与校准性，而非规划策略；EDL 可作为高效且校准良好的替代方案。这提示后续工作应把不确定性模型校准作为一等设计对象。

title: ASTRA: ASV Simulator for Transferable Realistic Autonomy
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, accepted to OCEANS 2026 Monterey
summary: Autonomy development for marine autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) remains challenging because field testing is costly and difficult to reproduce. Existing marine simulation tools provide mature capabilities in vessel dynamics, robotics integration, and visual rendering, but these strengths are emphasized differently across platforms. This paper presents ASTRA, an ASV simulation framework built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines marine vehicle dynamics, photorealistic perception, and Robot Operating System (ROS 2) autonomy interfaces within a common environment. ASTRA incorporates a Fossen-style marine dynamics model together with geometry-based buoyancy and programmable spectral wave disturbances, enabling non-planar hydrostatic and wave-induced motion. The simulator reproduces the sensor configuration of a physical BlueBoat testbed, including GPS, IMU, LiDAR, and RGB-D sensing exposed through ROS 2. This allows localization, perception, planning, and control software to be developed against interfaces consistent with the physical platform. The BlueBoat's existing ROS 2 localization and perception modules were ported directly into ASTRA, while targeted zero-propulsion experiments were used to verify the implemented wave-body coupling. The simulated roll response was consistent with the expected non-oscillatory hydrostatic behavior, and heave remained highly coherent with the generated wave field, with approximately unity gain at the dominant wave frequency in the tested sea states. ASTRA is intended as an open-source testbed for marine autonomy development, simulation-based benchmarking, and sim-to-real experimentation.

AI.tldr: ASTRA：基于 Isaac Sim 的无人水面艇仿真框架，融合 Fossen 水动力模型、几何浮力与可控谱波扰动，并复刻 BlueBoat 物理测试平台的 ROS 2 传感器配置，用于海事自主性开发与 sim-to-real 实验。
AI.motivation: 海上自主水面艇（ASV）的自主性开发受限于外场测试成本高、可复现性差；现有海事仿真工具在船体动力学、机器人集成和视觉渲染上各有侧重但未统一，缺乏同时具备高保真动力学、逼真感知与 ROS 2 自主性接口的公共仿真平台。
AI.method: 在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中构建 ASV 仿真框架：1) Fossen 风格海事动力学模型；2) 基于几何体的浮力计算与可编程谱波扰动，实现非平面静水与波浪诱导运动；3) 复刻 BlueBoat 的传感器配置（GPS、IMU、LiDAR、RGB-D）并通过 ROS 2 暴露；4) 将 BlueBoat 现有 ROS 2 定位与感知模块直接移植入仿真；5) 以零推进（zero-propulsion）实验验证波浪-船体耦合。
AI.result: 零推进实验中，仿真横摇响应符合预期的非振荡静水行为；垂荡与生成波场高度相干，在测试海况下主波频处增益约为 1，表明波浪-船体耦合实现合理。ROS 2 模块移植成功，接口与实船一致。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA 作为开源测试平台，面向海事自主性开发、基于仿真的基准评测与 sim-to-real 实验，提供动力学-感知-自主性接口一体化的统一仿真环境。

title: The Impact of Scenario Representation in Scenario-based Optimization Certification
summary: Scenario-based optimization provides finite-sample guarantees for decisions constructed from sampled uncertainty, but its certification procedures can be sensitive to how those samples are represented. We investigate this sensitivity under lossless scenario regrouping, which preserves the sampled information, feasible region, optimizer, and primitive violation probability. For an equal-allocation support-subsample certificate, we derive the distortion factor \(k^2(1-\epsilon)^{k-1}\), establish certification reversals between equivalent representations, and provide sufficient conditions for acceptance dominance under nested coarsening. We further apply nondegeneracy-free Wait-and-Judge theory to coordinatewise scenario envelopes, enabling stronger certification directly from the primitive observations. In paired scenario-MPC experiments, exact regrouping increases certification availability from 318 to 471 of 480 attempts without changing the samples, numerical proposals, or requiring any reduction in witness cardinality. Primitive Wait-and-Judge certification accepts the same 471 attempts without regrouping. These results demonstrate that apparent scenario sample-efficiency gains can arise from certificate accounting rather than additional information or reduced decision risk.

AI.tldr: 研究无损场景重分组（lossless scenario regrouping）对场景优化证书的影响：推导等分配支撑子采样证书的失真因子 k²(1−ε)^{k−1}，证明等价表示下存在认证反转，并给出嵌套粗化下的接受支配充分条件；进一步将无退化约束的 Wait-and-Judge 理论用于坐标方向场景包络。场景-MPC 实验中，精确重分组使认证可用次数从 318/480 提升至 471/480，而不改变样本、数值提案与见证基数。
AI.motivation: 场景优化虽提供有限样本保证，但其认证（certification）流程对不确定性的“表示方式”（即场景如何分组/聚合）敏感，而这一敏感性此前缺乏系统刻画，可能导致虚假的样本效率结论。
AI.method: 构造保持采样信息、可行域、优化器与原始违反概率不变的无损重分组；针对等分配支撑子采样证书推导失真因子与认证反转；给出嵌套粗化下接受支配的充分条件；引入无需非退化假设的 Wait-and-Judge 理论作用于坐标方向场景包络，直接从原始观测进行更强认证；在配对场景-MPC 实验中验证。
AI.result: 精确重分组将认证可用率由 318/480 提升至 471/480，样本、数值提案、见证基数均不变；原始 Wait-and-Judge 认证在无需重分组的情况下同样接受 471/480 次尝试。
AI.conclusion: 表观上的场景样本效率提升可源自证书记账（certificate accounting）而非额外信息或更低决策风险；建议在认证中转向基于原始观测的 Wait-and-Judge 形式以避免表示敏感性。

title: Data-Driven Variable-Length Compression of 3D Representations
summary: Compressing 3D shapes is important for the efficiency of many applications, yet existing methods either cannot leverage dataset-level statistics or use a fixed compression ratio for all shapes. We propose a learned variable-length compression method that exploits structure across a training dataset while adapting compressed representation size to individual shape complexity using only fast feed-forward inference. Our method operates on general latent representations and improves rate-distortion for both meshes and signed distance fields. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出一种学习式变长压缩方法，利用训练集跨样本结构，并通过快速前馈推理按单个形状复杂度自适应压缩表示大小，在网格与SDF上提升率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D形状压缩方法要么无法利用数据集的统计结构，要么对所有形状使用固定压缩率，忽略形状复杂度差异。
AI.method: 在通用潜在表示上操作的学习式变长压缩器：利用数据集级共享结构建模，并以前馈方式为每个形状预测自适应长度的压缩码，无需逐形状优化。
AI.result: 在三角网格与有符号距离场两类表示上均取得更优的率失真（rate-distortion）表现，且解码/推理为快速前馈过程。
AI.conclusion: 变长、数据驱动的潜在空间压缩是兼顾率失真效率与推理速度的有效方向，且具备跨表示的通用性。

title: A Probabilistic Lateral Motion Prediction Model with Improved Response Fidelity for Vehicle-in-the-Loop Simulation
summary: Vehicle-in-the-loop (VIL) simulation requires a lateral dynamics model that accurately reproduces vehicle responses and reliably generates horizontal lateral-position and heading commands through recursive integration. This paper presents a probabilistic lateral motion prediction model with improved response fidelity. A two-degree-of-freedom vehicle model provides the physical prior, while a recurrent neural network learns correlated residual corrections to lateral acceleration and yaw rate. To maintain prediction fidelity during recursive motion generation, multistep rollout training feeds corrected responses into subsequent states and histories and directly penalizes accumulated lateral-velocity error. A conditional Gaussian characterizes response uncertainty, which is propagated to lateral-response, position, and heading predictions through augmented-state linearization. Evaluation results demonstrate improved lateral-response and integrated-motion prediction. Compared with the Deep Dynamics lateral adaptation, the proposed model reduces mean lateral-position root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 0.596 m to 0.483 m, an improvement of 19.0%, while reducing mean lateral-velocity RMSE from 0.0469 m/s to 0.0441 m/s. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining physical priors, probabilistic residual learning, and multistep rollout training for response-faithful lateral motion prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出物理先验(2-DOF车辆模型)+概率残差学习(RNN校正侧向加速度与横摆角速度)+多步rollout训练的横向动力学预测模型，用于VIL仿真中路侧位置与航向的递推生成。
AI.motivation: VIL仿真需高保真横向动力学模型，且要在递推积分中稳定生成侧向位置与航向指令；纯数据驱动或纯物理模型在递归预测中误差累积明显。
AI.method: 以二自由度车辆模型作物理先验，用RNN学习侧向加速度与横摆角速度的相关残差修正；采用多步rollout训练将修正后响应回灌为状态与历史并直接惩罚累积侧向速度误差；以条件高斯建模响应不确定性，经增广状态线性化传播到响应、位置与航向预测。
AI.result: 与Deep Dynamics横向自适应相比，平均侧向位置RMSE由0.596 m降至0.483 m（提升19.0%），侧向速度RMSE由0.0469 m/s降至0.0441 m/s。
AI.conclusion: 物理先验、概率残差学习与多步rollout训练的组合对响应保真的横向运动预测有效，适配VIL递推仿真需求；但属车辆动力学专用方法，跨域泛化性未验证。

title: ARC-2: Continuous Compliance Through Delta Management
comment: 22 pages. Conceptual framework for continuous compliance monitoring, behavioral drift detection, and operational authorization of autonomous robotic systems. Extends ARC-1 ( arXiv:2609.12932 )
summary: ARC 1 introduced a three-layer governance architecture for autonomous systems comprising model safety validation, cognitive certification (CRAB), and operational authorization (LEA). However, it did not address how compliance should be maintained after deployment. This paper introduces Delta Management, a continuous governance framework that measures deviations between a system's current operational state and its certified baseline, defined as a region rather than a fixed point. Compliance is assessed through continuous monitoring instead of static certification. Four extensions are proposed. First, CRAB evaluation incorporates the worst verified behavioral deviations, with isolated outliers quarantined pending confirmation to prevent unjustified restrictions. Second, a layered trigger taxonomy distinguishes hard safety violations, critical single-dimension failures, correlated multi-system degradation, and risk-weighted composite indicators, each triggering proportionate responses. Third, a graduated safe transition protocol separates withdrawal of operational authorization from physical shutdown, consistent with established safety standards and EU AI Act requirements. Fourth, environmental delta is introduced as a distinct baseline validity condition: environmental drift beyond the certified Operational Design Domain (ODD) triggers recertification or ODD revision rather than automatic authority contraction. Together, these extensions transform ARC from a deployment-time certification architecture into a continuous framework for monitoring, evaluating, and enforcing compliance throughout the operational lifecycle of autonomous systems. The framework addresses the continuous compliance obligations established by EU AI Act Article 72(2).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Delta Management 持续治理框架，通过将认证基线定义为"区域"而非固定点，持续监测系统运行状态相对基线的偏差，实现部署后的合规维护。框架含四项扩展：CRAB 纳入最差已验证行为偏差并隔离离群点、分层触发分类学、分级安全过渡协议（授权撤回与物理关停分离）、环境偏差作为基线有效性条件。
AI.motivation: ARC 1 的三层治理架构（模型安全验证、认知认证 CRAB、运行授权 LEA）仅覆盖部署时认证，未回答部署后如何保持合规。EU AI Act 第 72(2) 条要求全生命周期持续合规，现有静态认证无法满足。
AI.method: 概念性框架设计：以“认证基线区域”替代固定点基线，用连续监测度量运行状态与基线的偏差；四项扩展——(1) CRAB 评估引入最差已验证行为偏差，孤立离群点隔离待确认以避免无据限制；(2) 分层触发分类学：硬安全违规、单维关键失效、多系统相关退化、风险加权复合指标，分别对应比例化响应；(3) 分级安全过渡协议，将授权撤回与物理关停解耦，对齐既有安全标准与 EU AI Act 要求；(4) 引入环境 delta 作为独立的基线有效性条件，ODD 外漂移触发重新认证或 ODD 修订而非自动收缩权限。
AI.result: 论文为架构与规范性论证，未提供实验或量化结果；仅声明框架覆盖欧盟 AI Act 第 72(2) 条的持续合规义务，并将 ARC 从部署时认证架构扩展为覆盖运行全生命周期的监测—评估—执行闭环。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于治理流程与概念分层，而非可验证算法；缺乏形式化定义、指标阈值与实证评估，对具身智能/物理 AI 系统的工程落地指导有限。

title: Sketch, Don't Paint: Allocating Test-Time Compute in Generative Visual Reasoning
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Multimodal models increasingly reason by synthesizing pixels, sketching maze paths within interleaved chains of thought or rolling out video solutions frame by frame. Each visual thought runs the full diffusion schedule inherited from photorealistic synthesis, so iterative denoising dominates inference cost. We study how to allocate test-time compute along two axes: when to render visual thoughts rather than thinking in text or answering directly, and how many denoising steps each thought requires. Controlled interventions that vary only how the thought is rendered uncover three regimes. Causal thoughts carry the plan and become legible early: an 8-step sketch nearly matches a 50-step render in accuracy, commits to the same plan as often as two independent full renders agree, and in video models mostly fails by stalling short of the goal, so the rollout abstains. Decorative thoughts can be omitted without loss, whereas harmful thoughts lower accuracy. Because the regime depends on both model and task, always drawing is suboptimal. Across 14 model-benchmark pairs of three interleaved reasoners, answering directly, without any thinking, wins 9 pairs, and choosing among direct, text-only, and visual tiers from ten labeled examples per pair raises mean accuracy from 60.7% (always drawing) to 65.1%. Where drawing pays, we propose sketch-and-vote, which samples 8-step sketches (a step count chosen without labels) from independent noises until one answer reaches three votes. With this one setting, sketch-and-vote beats full rendering with fewer denoising steps on an image reasoner and two video reasoners, by 8.6 points on VSP spatial planning and by 9.6 and 22.1 points on mazes.

AI.tldr: 研究多模态推理模型在测试时如何分配"视觉思考"的计算量：何时该画图/出视频而非纯文本或直接作答，以及每个视觉思考需要多少去噪步数；并提出8步"草图-投票"（sketch-and-vote）策略。
AI.motivation: 交错式思维链中的视觉思考（迷宫路径草图、逐帧视频解）沿用了生成逼真图像的全套扩散去噪日程，迭代去噪成为推理成本主导；但视觉思考并非总是有益，需要自适应地决定是否渲染、渲染多少步。
AI.method: 控制变量实验只改变思考的渲染方式，识别出三类机制：因果型思考（计划可早期读出）、装饰型思考（可省略）、有害型思考（降低准确率）。据此在"直接作答/纯文本/视觉"三档间做路由，每对模型-基准仅用10个标注样例选择档位；在绘制有益的场合提出 sketch-and-vote：从独立噪声采样8步草图直至某答案获得3票。
AI.result: 8步草图准确率接近50步渲染，并与两次独立全渲染的一致性相当；视频模型中失败多为未抵达目标的停滞，可据此弃权。14组模型-基准中，直接作答在9组胜出；三档路由将平均准确率从60.7%（总是绘制）提升至65.1%。sketch-and-vote在图像推理器与两个视频推理器上优于全渲染且总去噪步更少：VSP空间规划+8.6点，迷宫+9.6与+22.1点。
AI.conclusion: 视觉思考的价值取决于模型与任务，其信息量在极少去噪步时即饱和；应自适应选择思考模式并按低步数多采样投票，而非默认全量渲染。

title: Rethinking Perceptual Similarity for Remote Sensing: Multi-Layer Attention Scoring and Human Preference Benchmarking
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027). 9 pages
summary: Perceptual similarity metrics for natural images transfer poorly to remote sensing (RS), where severe geospatial and semantic failures can remain visually plausible while still being decisively wrong for downstream use. To address this, we develop a novel human-aligned perceptual quality metric for generated RS imagery and evaluate it across several generation tasks. We first conduct a controlled perturbation study where we progressively increase the severity of common synthetic perturbations. Using the layer-wise Aligned Attention Score (AAS) responses in RemoteCLIP, we find that different RS artifacts are best captured at different depths. Based on these findings, we introduce Remote Sensing Perceptual Distance (RSPD), a pairwise metric that averages seven independently calibrated layer distances without tuning on human-preference labels. To evaluate our metric on realistic RS generation tasks, we construct a blind, reference-conditioned two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) benchmark with five 300-triplet subsets spanning synthetic artifacts, airborne and spaceborne super-resolution, SAR-to-optical translation, and timeseries controls. We also construct a 300-triplet ordered misregistration benchmark with deterministic labels. Using the same RemoteCLIP checkpoint, RSPD substantially outperforms simple cosine distance with the final global embedding and is competitive with the strongest generic baselines across the realistic RS generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出RSPD，一种面向遥感生成图像、基于RemoteCLIP分层对齐注意力响应（AAS）的多层距离平均的成对感知度量，并构建2AFC与错位基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 通用自然图像的感知相似度指标迁移到遥感域效果差：严重的地理/语义错误在视觉上仍显得合理，却对下游任务决定性错误，缺乏与人类判断对齐的遥感专用质量度量。
AI.method: 先做受控扰动实验，逐级加重的合成扰动下观察RemoteCLIP各层AAS响应，发现不同遥感伪影在最佳响应深度上不同；据此提出RSPD——对7个独立校准的层距离取平均的成对度量，不依赖人类偏好标签调参。评估用盲测、参考条件2AFC基准（5个300三元组子集：合成伪影、机载与星载超分、SAR-to-optical翻译、时序对照）以及300三元组有序错位基准（确定性标签）。
AI.result: 同一RemoteCLIP权重下，RSPD显著优于最终全局嵌入的简单余弦距离，并在真实遥感生成任务上与最强通用基线具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 分层特征在遥感感知度量中优于单一全局嵌入，RSPD为遥感生成图像提供了可扩展、免人工标注调参的质量评估方案。

title: VisHead-Spec: Head-Routed Visual Attention for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.

AI.tldr: VisHead-Spec 通过分析多模态投机解码中目标模型到草稿模型的信息流，发现视觉注意的稀疏性（仅少数KV头需关注图像、且只需目标模型顶层视觉特征），据此固定少量KV头处理图像特征、其余仅处理文本，从而在高并发下提升VLM投机解码吞吐。
AI.motivation: 投机解码在批量增大、系统转为计算受限时加速比显著下降；多模态场景下prompt中长序列图像token使草稿预测计算成本更高。块扩散草稿器（DFlash、DSpark）虽一次前向预测多个草稿token，但高并发下对VLM的加速仍有限（<9%），需要弄清这一差距的成因。
AI.method: 考察目标模型到草稿模型跨模态的信息流动，识别出视觉注意的稀疏模式：草稿模型中仅少量KV头需要直接关注上下文中的视觉特征，且仅需目标模型顶层层的视觉特征。提出VisHead-Spec，选取固定的一小组KV头关注目标模型顶层图像特征，其余头仅处理文本特征。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B与MMSpec上，VisHead-Spec-8让草稿器40个KV头中的8个读取图像，接受长度与DSpark基线相差在0.3%以内；batch size 64时相对自回归解码的吞吐增益达16.0%（DSpark为9.5%），batch size 1时加速比与DSpark相当。
AI.conclusion: 利用跨模态视觉注意的稀疏结构可显著降低多模态投机解码在高并发下的计算开销，在不损失接受长度的前提下获得更优吞吐，为VLM高效部署提供了轻量、可插拔的草稿器改造方案。

title: Can a World Model Predict a Deepfake Video? A Consistency Margin Prior for Deepfake Detection
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
summary: Deepfake detectors often perform well on the dataset they are trained on, but their performance drops when tested on videos from different datasets. In this paper, we study whether a predictive video model can provide a signal that generalizes better across datasets. Instead of relying only on generator-specific artifacts, as many existing detectors do, we use a model trained to predict natural video and measure the difference between what it predicts and what it observes in a video. Using V-JEPA 2.1, we keep the encoder frozen and adapt the predictor using rank-16 LoRA. We define the difference between the predictor output and the frozen encoder target as the prediction residual. We hypothesize that manipulated clips produce, on average, larger prediction residuals than authentic clips, and use this as our consistency-margin prior. We process these residuals using a lightweight Latent Consistency Head (LCH), which separates residual magnitude from direction for training and classification. To test whether the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset generalization, we compare standard and reversed margin objectives while keeping the remaining training setup fixed. We match the two settings on FF++ validation performance before evaluating them on unseen data. The reversed-margin setting exhibits a larger cross dataset generalization gap on average, providing evidence that the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset transfer. Our complete model adds only 8.25M trainable parameters, which is 2.47% of the total 334M parameters. Trained only on FF++, it achieves an AUC of 90.5 on Celeb-DFv2 and performs well across several other cross-dataset benchmarks. Our ablations show that separating residual magnitude from direction, reducing dataset-specific variation, and using a low-rank projection improve cross-dataset generalization in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器+LoRA 微调预测器，以"预测残差"作为物理/时间一致性先验检测 deepfake，并发现残差方向的符号决定跨数据集泛化优劣。
AI.motivation: 现有 deepfake 检测器依赖生成器特定伪影，跨数据集泛化差；作者想验证"自然视频预测模型"能否提供更通用的信号。
AI.method: 冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器，rank-16 LoRA 适配 predictor；定义 predictor 输出与编码器目标之差为预测残差；用轻量 Latent Consistency Head 分离残差幅度与方向进行训练/分类；对比标准与反向 margin 目标（先在 FF++ 验证集上对齐性能）检验方向对跨域迁移的影响；可训练参数 8.25M（占 334M 的 2.47%）。
AI.result: 仅用 FF++ 训练，Celeb-DFv2 上 AUC 90.5，多个跨数据集基准表现良好；反向 margin 设置平均泛化 gap 更大，说明一致性 margin 方向影响跨域迁移；消融显示分离幅度/方向、降低数据集特异性变化、低秩投影均有助泛化。
AI.conclusion: 自然视频预测残差可作为跨数据集泛化的一致性先验，且其方向是关键的显式设计变量；参数开销小、迁移性好。

title: AR-WAM: efficient streaming world-action modeling for autonomous driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires anticipating how traffic will evolve while responding quickly to new observations. Video foundation models offer the first ability, but repeated history encoding and iterative video generation make them costly to use for driving. We present AR-WAM, an efficient streaming world-action model that combines autoregressive temporal modeling with single-pass future conditioning. Because its video backbone is causal, AR-WAM updates its visual context incrementally, reusing past computation and conditioning future prediction on observed motion. We further hypothesize that future features computed from recent observations can improve generalization in dynamic traffic without iterative video generation. AR-WAM therefore obtains these features in one forward pass and uses them to condition trajectory generation, and reinforcement learning then improves the policy through direct optimization of driving rewards. With a single front camera, AR-WAM achieves 91.5 PDMS after supervised training and 94.0 after reinforcement learning on NAVSIM-v1, outperforming the compared strong end-to-end world-action models. In a dynamic setting of continuous driving, supervised AR-WAM keeps its visual history across decisions and outperforms strong world-action baselines.

AI.tldr: AR-WAM：结合因果视频骨干的增量视觉上下文与单次前向预测未来特征，条件化轨迹生成，并用强化学习以驾驶奖励直接优化策略的流式世界-动作模型。
AI.motivation: 视频基础模型能预见交通演化，但重复历史编码与迭代视频生成导致推理开销大，难以满足自动驾驶的实时响应需求。
AI.method: 采用因果(causal)视频骨干，实现自回归时序建模与增量视觉上下文更新，复用历史计算；通过单次前向获得未来特征并用以条件化轨迹生成（无需迭代视频生成）；再以强化学习直接优化驾驶奖励。
AI.result: 单前视相机下，NAVSIM-v1 监督训练达 91.5 PDMS，强化学习后达 94.0 PDMS，优于对比的强端到端世界-动作模型；连续驾驶动态设定中跨决策保持视觉历史并优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 以因果流式架构替代迭代生成，可在保持未来条件能力的同时降低推理成本，跨决策历史复用对动态场景泛化有效。

title: PromptPack: Training-Free Augmentation of Diffusion Editors for Intent-Aligned Spatial and Semantic Control
comment: 32 pages, 21 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Many image-editing tasks require confining changes to intended spatial regions while exactly preserving user-designated source content. Instruction-driven editing pipelines often leave such user-intent underspecified, while inpainting editors condition generation on explicitly defined edit support but not on the spatial assignment of individual edit concepts. PromptPack addresses both limitations by equipping diffusion editors with two explicit 'Edit Guides': an edit-role partition that labels each pixel as 'Keep,' 'Permit,' or 'Modify' to specify where edits may occur, and a regional-prompt assignment that maps spatial regions to text prompts to specify which concepts apply where. These guides may be manually specified or, for source-object edits, automatically derived from a text-grounded SAM 3 mask. Without retraining, PromptPack injects independently embedded regional prompts into the editor's fixed-length text sequence and uses the Edit Guides to spatially mask attention, gate flow updates, and restore protected source pixels. We integrate PromptPack into FlowEdit FLUX, FlowEdit SD3, and FLUX Kontext and demonstrate improved requested-concept placement and protected-content preservation across all three integrations on PIE-Bench++. In a pairwise user study, PromptPack achieves an 87% preference rate over FlowEdit FLUX, establishing PromptPack as a practical, training-free interface for intent-aligned diffusion editing.

AI.tldr: PromptPack 为扩散图像编辑器引入两种显式“编辑引导”：像素级 Keep/Permit/Modify 角色划分与区域-提示词对应，无需重训练即可实现精准区域编辑与源内容精确保留。
AI.motivation: 指令驱动编辑对“改哪里”约束不足，inpainting 编辑器虽有显式编辑支撑区但缺乏概念级空间分配；用户意图（保留什么、何处放什么概念）在现有管线中被欠指定。
AI.method: 构造 edit-role 分区掩码（Keep/Permit/Modify）与区域提示词映射（源对象编辑可由文本定位的 SAM 3 掩码自动导出）；将独立编码的区域提示注入编辑器定长文本序列，并用引导对注意力做空间掩码、对 flow 更新做门控、对受保护像素做回填复原。集成于 FlowEdit FLUX、FlowEdit SD3 与 FLUX Kontext，训练-free。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench++ 上三个集成均提升请求概念的空间放置准确度与受保护内容保真度；成对用户研究中相对 FlowEdit FLUX 获 87% 偏好率。
AI.conclusion: PromptPack 提供了一个免训练、可直接接入的意图对齐扩散编辑接口，通过显式空间引导弥补指令编辑的原位约束缺失，具有实用性与可扩展性。

title: FaceRiff: Data-Efficient Unified Text-to-3D Face Asset Synthesis via Geometric Conditioning
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. 11 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables
summary: High-resolution facial datasets with consistent UV-mapped geometry, albedo, and physically based displacement are scarce, yet such assets are essential for photorealistic digital-human rendering. Existing 3D face generation methods are often slow, single-modality, or require large specialized datasets. Meanwhile, large image diffusion models encode strong facial priors but do not natively produce lighting-independent textures, pore-scale displacement, or UV-aligned geometry. We present FaceRiff, a unified, data- and parameter-efficient framework for generating complete 3D face assets (mesh, albedo, and displacement) directly from text in a shared UV space. FaceRiff adapts a pretrained SDXL backbone with task-specific LoRA adapters and uses UV normal maps as geometric conditioning: per-instance normals guide albedo and displacement synthesis, while a dataset-mean normal provides a canonical spatial anchor for mesh generation. Using only 2,049 scans from approximately 350 identities and training on a single GPU, FaceRiff updates less than 3% of the backbone parameters per task and produces render-ready 3D face assets without per-instance optimization. Compared with FaceG2E and DreamFace, FaceRiff produces greater per-prompt diversity while preserving prompt alignment and fixed-topology UV consistency, and additionally generates lighting-independent albedo suitable for PBR relighting and pore-scale displacement absent from prior text-driven baselines. A blind study with 45 industry professionals shows that FaceRiff achieves substantially higher perceived realism than DreamFace, approaching that of real captures. Overall, FaceRiff demonstrates that pretrained diffusion priors can be adapted to unified 3D face asset synthesis under limited data.

AI.tldr: FaceRiff：用冻结的 SDXL + 任务专属 LoRA（<3% 参数），以 UV 法线图为几何条件，从文本一次性生成共享 UV 空间内完整的 3D 人脸资产（网格、反照率、毛孔级位移），无需逐实例优化。
AI.motivation: 高质量、UV 对齐且含 PBR 位移的人脸资产稀缺；现有文本到 3D 人脸方法慢、单模态、依赖大规模专用数据集；图像扩散模型虽有强人脸先验，但不直接输出光照无关纹理、位移与 UV 对齐几何。
AI.method: 以预训练 SDXL 为骨干，每个任务挂接独立 LoRA 适配器；用 UV 法线图作为几何控制信号：逐实例法线引导反照率与位移生成，数据集平均法线作为规范化空间锚点引导网格生成；统一 UV 表示使三模态对齐。仅用约 350 个身份、2,049 次扫描，单卡训练，每任务更新参数量<3%。
AI.result: 相比 FaceG2E 与 DreamFace，逐提示多样性更高，同时保持提示对齐与固定拓扑 UV 一致性；额外生成可 PBR 重光照的光照无关反照率与毛孔级位移。45 位行业专家盲评显示真实感显著优于 DreamFace，接近真实扫描。
AI.conclusion: 证明有限数据下可通过 LoRA 将预训练扩散先验适配为统一的 3D 人脸资产合成器，实现数据与参数高效的前馈式生成。

title: Domain-Tuned Diffusion Super-Resolution for 4K Facial Asset Maps
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications. 4 pages
summary: Physically based facial assets require 4K albedo and displacement maps for cinematic close-ups, yet generative pipelines commonly produce them at only 1K. Naively applying photographic super-resolution is a poor fit: facial UV maps have domain-specific statistics, and displacement is a scalar height field whose errors directly distort geometry. We present a domain-tuned diffusion upscaler for 4x (1024 to 4096) facial asset super-resolution. Starting from a bilinearly upsampled map, we adapt a frozen SDXL backbone per modality with lightweight LoRA modules, while a Tile ControlNet preserves input structure as the diffusion prior restores pore- and wrinkle-scale detail. On held-out maps, our method produces sharper, more faithful detail than bilinear and off-the-shelf GAN and diffusion super-resolvers, reducing albedo LPIPS from 0.21 to 0.08 while avoiding misplaced or excessive displacement relief. These results show that lightweight domain adaptation can produce render-ready 4K facial asset maps without a custom super-resolution architecture.

AI.tldr: 用冻结SDXL+LoRA+Tile ControlNet对1024面部资产贴图(albedo/位移)做4倍扩散超分至4096。
AI.motivation: 影视级面部资产需4K albedo与displacement贴图，但生成管线通常只输出1K；照片级超分不匹配面部UV统计特性，且位移为标量高度场，误差会直接扭曲几何。
AI.method: 以双线性上采样图为起点，对每个模态在冻结SDXL主干上挂轻量LoRA做域适配，并用Tile ControlNet保持输入结构，由扩散先验恢复毛孔/皱纹级细节；无需定制超分架构。
AI.result: 在留出贴图上细节更锐利、更忠实，优于双线性、现成GAN与扩散超分器；albedo LPIPS由0.21降至0.08，位移浮雕无明显错位或过度增强。
AI.conclusion: 轻量域适配即可产出可直接渲染的4K面部资产贴图，证明无需专用超分网络结构。

title: Temporal Pseudo-RGB Encoding for Label-Free Detection of VEEV Infection in Human Brain Endothelial Cells
comment: 20 pages. Supplementary material is included as an ancillary file
summary: Label-free detection of viral infection is central to antiviral screening and pathogen surveillance. Most deep-learning methods analyze individual frames and do not model temporal progression. We evaluate temporal pseudo-RGB encoding, which stacks three time-offset brightfield frames ($t{-}6$ h, $t{-}3$ h, $t$) as the red, green, and blue channels of a single image so that morphological change becomes color and an ImageNet-pretrained convolutional neural network (CNN) can be trained on infection trajectories without architectural modification. In human brain microvascular endothelial cells (HBMVEC) infected with Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) TC-83, a multi-task network predicts infected-versus-mock status and time post-infection in one forward pass. Across three experimental runs under leave-one-row-out cross-validation, with all 36 wells scored out of fold, the encoding reaches 91.6% accuracy against 87.4% for the single-frame model (paired difference $+4.2$ percentage points, 95% CI $[+2.5, +6.1]$; sign-flip $p = 3\times10^{-5}$; well-level inference, conditional on three runs). At the late-phase endpoint (40-48 h), where floating cells and debris can make conventional brightfield images difficult to interpret, the advantage widens to $+23.9$ points (95% CI $[+19.2, +28.9]$). Time post-infection is recovered on the fixed row split with MAE = 1.31 h ($R^2 = 0.975$). Among the temporal models tested the encoding has the highest mean accuracy, at a fraction of the cost of the recurrent and 3D convolutional alternatives, though only its margin over the single-frame model is resolved; the tested ViT-B/16 backbone showed no corresponding gain, so the finding is limited to convolutional backbones and this virus-cell system.

AI.tldr: 将三个时间偏移（t−6 h, t−3 h, t）的明场帧堆叠为RGB三通道，使形态学变化“变为颜色”，从而可直接用ImageNet预训练CNN建模感染时序轨迹；在VEEV TC-83感染HBMVEC细胞上多任务预测感染/对照与感染后时间。
AI.motivation: 无标记病毒感染检测对抗病毒筛选与病原监测至关重要，但多数深度学习方法仅分析单帧、不建模时间演化过程；作者希望在不改动网络结构、复用ImageNet预训练权重的前提下引入时序信息。
AI.method: 提出时间伪RGB编码（temporal pseudo-RGB）：把t−6 h、t−3 h、t三帧灰度明场图像分别放入R/G/B通道，形成单张“彩色”图；用ImageNet预训练CNN做多任务学习，同时预测感染vs mock状态与感染后时间；采用留一行交叉验证（leave-one-row-out），三批次实验、36孔全部折外评分，并与单帧模型、循环网络、3D卷积及ViT-B/16骨干对比。
AI.result: 折外准确率91.6% vs 单帧87.4%（配对差+4.2个百分点，95% CI [+2.5, +6.1]，符号翻转检验p=3e-5）；晚期（40–48 h）浮细胞与碎片导致常规明场难判读时优势扩大至+23.9点（CI [+19.2, +28.9]）；固定行划分下感染后时间MAE=1.31 h（R²=0.975）。在测试的时序模型中平均准确率最高且成本远低于循环/3D卷积方案，但仅与单帧模型的差距被统计分辨；ViT-B/16骨干无相应增益。
AI.conclusion: 零架构改动的时间伪RGB编码是一种低成本、有效的明场显微时序建模手段，在晚期低可视条件下收益显著；但结论仅限卷积骨干与该病毒—细胞体系，时序模型间的相对优劣尚未被统计分辨。

title: Agile Monoped Hopping on Complex and Discrete Terrain via Kinodynamic Planning with Distilled MPPI Steering
comment: 8 pages,7 figures, project website this https URL
summary: This paper presents FlowRRT, a kinodynamic planner for agile monoped hopping on discrete terrain. Steering for kinodynamic RRT on complex dynamical systems currently relies on motion primitives or closed-loop policies, limiting the diversity of motions or the planning speed. Distilling a trajectory optimizer avoids both, but existing methods regress a single solution per query, which fails on monoped hopping, where the feasible action set is narrow and disconnected. Our key insight is to treat steering as set-valued and predict the distribution of feasible actions instead. A multi-start MPPI expert collects the entire feasible set of each query offline, and conditional flow matching distills it into a generative sampler. With this sampler, FlowRRT coordinates successive jumps over long horizons and finds non-greedy maneuvers that are hard for reactive policies to discover. Benchmarks across different terrains show higher success rates and substantially shorter planning times than sampling-based baselines. On terrains with inclined platforms, FlowRRT reaches $80\%$ success within $1$~s, versus $24$~s for RL-RRT and $77$~s for SST. Sim-to-sim tracking in MuJoCo confirms accurate execution under full-order dynamics.

AI.tldr: FlowRRT将单足跳跃的运动学动力学RRT转向问题视为集值预测，用多起点MPPI专家离线收集可行动作集，并以条件流匹配蒸馏为生成式采样器，实现长时域非贪婪敏捷跳跃规划。
AI.motivation: 运动学动力学RRT的转向依赖运动基元/闭环策略（多样性或速度受限），或单解回归蒸馏（无法处理可行动作集狭窄且不连通的单足跳跃问题）。
AI.method: 离线用多起点MPPI收集每个查询的完整可行动作集，条件流匹配训练生成式采样器预测可行动作分布；FlowRRT用该采样器协调连续跳跃，长时域搜索非贪婪动作。
AI.result: 多地形基准成功率更高、规划时间显著缩短；倾斜平台地形上1 s内达80%成功率，对比RL-RRT 24 s、SST 77 s；MuJoCo全阶动力学sim-to-sim跟踪验证执行准确。
AI.conclusion: 集值转向+流匹配蒸馏是放宽可行集狭窄/不连通难题的有效途径，可推广到其他强约束欠驱动系统的规划。

title: REEL: Brain-Guided Video Generation and Selection by Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear Decoding from fMRI data
summary: Visual brain decoding from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data has made remarkable progress in recent years, driven by increasingly powerful artificial intelligence (AI) models and the growing availability of large-scale public datasets. However, despite the impressive advances achieved in static image decoding, the reconstruction of videos from fMRI signals remains challenging due to the temporal mismatch between rapidly changing video stimuli and the slow dynamics of the blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) response. We evaluate a Bayesian-inspired proposal-and-rerank strategy on CC2017 and the BOLD Moments Dataset (BMD), using a linear semantic decoder, a pretrained video generator, and three neural encoding streams with ridge readouts and learned pooling in two streams. We refer to this framework as REEL (Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear decoding). Compared with a single generated candidate, reranking increases mean Video 50-way accuracy from 0.2359 to 0.2434 across three CC2017 participants and from 0.3653 to 0.3920 across ten BMD participants. These findings suggest an alternative and conceptually simpler strategy for improving video brain decoding, highlighting the potential of our approach as a complementary direction to increasingly complex pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出REEL框架：用线性语义解码器+预训练视频生成器产生多个候选视频，再做贝叶斯式重排序（rerank），以缓解fMRI BOLD响应慢动态与快速视频刺激之间的时间失配，从而提升视频脑解码精度。
AI.motivation: 静态图像脑解码已取得显著进展，但视频重建仍困难，核心瓶颈在于视频刺激变化快而BOLD信号响应慢，两者时间尺度不匹配；同时现有流程日趋复杂，需要更简洁有效的替代策略。
AI.method: 在CC2017与BOLD Moments Dataset (BMD)上进行评估。框架包含三部分：线性语义解码器；预训练视频生成器（用于proposal生成）；三条神经编码流（neural encoding streams），采用ridge readout，其中两条流使用可学习池化。整体为“候选生成—重排序”（proposal-and-rerank）的贝叶斯启发性策略。
AI.result: 相比单候选生成，重排序使Video 50-way准确率提升：CC2017三名被试从0.2359升至0.2434；BMD十名被试从0.3653升至0.3920。
AI.conclusion: 在无需复杂流水线的条件下，proposal-and-rerank是提升视频脑解码的有效且概念更简洁的途径，可作为日益复杂解码框架的互补方向。

title: From Human Videos to Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Data: Confidence-Guided RL Refinement of Video Priors
summary: Collecting demonstrations for bimanual dexterous manipulation is costly, motivating the use of human videos as a source of robot training data. However, uncertainty in video-derived motion estimates and differences between human and robot embodiments make direct motion transfer challenging. In this work, we introduce PriDex, a framework that transforms human-video Priors into executable robot Dexterous manipulation demonstrations through reinforcement learning in simulation. PriDex preserves task-relevant interaction structure while allowing embodiment-specific behavior to be regenerated for the robot. Human-object interactions provide affordance cues for selecting task-relevant, robot-specific grasps from geometry-based candidates. For motion refinement, object trajectories provide a task-level reference, while relative bimanual wrist trajectories offer complementary guidance for coordinated motion. Since object-motion estimates can become unreliable under occlusion or visual ambiguity, PriDex uses object-motion confidence to adaptively balance these two priors, emphasizing object-level guidance when confidence is high and increasing the contribution of wrist-level guidance as confidence decreases. Reinforcement learning refines these video-derived priors under the robot's kinematic and physical constraints, and the resulting policies are rolled out to generate robot demonstrations for training a vision-based diffusion policy. We evaluate PriDex on four bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, including pouring, sweeping into a dustpan, bottle-cap unscrewing, and plate cleaning, assessing both simulation-based robot data generation and downstream visuomotor policy learning.

AI.tldr: PriDex将人类视频先验经仿真强化学习转化为机器人双臂灵巧操作示范，用于训练视觉扩散策略。
AI.motivation: 双臂灵巧操作示范采集成本高，人类视频是廉价数据源，但视频动作估计不确定、人机具身差异大，直接动作迁移困难。
AI.method: 利用人-物交互提供的可供性线索，从几何候选中选择任务相关且机器人可行的抓取；以物体轨迹作为任务级参考、双臂腕相对轨迹作为协调性补充先验；用物体运动置信度自适应加权二者（高置信偏物体级、低置信偏腕级）；在机器人运动学与物理约束下用RL细化先验，rollout生成示范训练视觉扩散策略。
AI.result: 在倒水、扫入簸箕、拧瓶盖、擦盘四项双臂灵巧任务上，评估了仿真数据生成与下游视觉运动策略学习两方面。
AI.conclusion: 以RL为"具身重生成器"，在保留任务交互结构的同时生成机器人特定行为，是视频到机器人示范的可扩展路径；摘要未给出量化对比与实机验证。

title: ALOHA Lightning: Learning Fast and Precise Manipulation
comment: Project website: this https URL
summary: Learning from human demonstrations has enabled robots to acquire a wide range of manipulation skills, but learned policies typically execute far slower than ordinary humans. This speed gap is mainly due to lack of an interface for collecting demonstration data at high speed, and the difficulty in training policies that can robustly execute high-speed motions. In this paper, we present ALOHA Lightning (Flash ALOHA), a system for learning fast and precise robotic manipulation. Our system uses kinesthetic teaching to intuitively collect near-human-speed demonstrations on a backdrivable bimanual platform, yielding natural and fast trajectories. We also present a learning pipeline that enables smooth high-speed execution through test-time action smoothing and aligns the visual data distribution between data collection and deployment with masking. Given 50 demonstrations for each task, ALOHA Lightning autonomously completes bimanual tasks such as ball tossing and catching, folding shorts, battery insertion, and bussing tables for over 80% success rates while close to human speed. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: ALOHA Lightning 用可反驱双臂平台上的动觉示教采集接近人类速度的演示，配合测试时动作平滑与掩码对齐视觉分布，实现高速双臂操作。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习策略执行速度远慢于人类，主因是缺乏高速演示采集接口，以及难以训练能鲁棒执行高速动作的策略。
AI.method: 用可反驱双臂平台进行动觉示教（kinesthetic teaching），直观采集近人类速度的演示数据并获得自然快速轨迹；学习流程加入测试时动作平滑（test-time action smoothing），并用掩码使采集与部署阶段的视觉数据分布对齐。
AI.result: 每任务仅 50 条演示，即可自主完成抛接球、折短裤、电池插入、收拾餐桌等双臂任务，成功率超 80%，速度接近人类。
AI.conclusion: 高速精细操作的关键瓶颈在数据采集接口与执行鲁棒性；动觉示教加动作平滑与视觉掩码对齐可在少量演示下实现近人类速度的双臂操作。

title: Wrong Input, Wrong Threshold: Re-evaluating Adversarial Facial Privacy
comment: 10 pages main text and 15 pages supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Published face-privacy methods report protection above 90% against black-box recognition models. That number comes from an evaluation protocol with two independent defects, reported in a measure that cannot size either one. The input is wrong: methods published since 2022 feed the network the whole photograph, or a detector's box, where deployed systems detect, align to a landmark template and crop. Re-scoring the same files through a realistic front end costs a standard transfer attack 56% of its dodging protection and a budget-allocating attack 7%, with no image regenerated. The measure is wrong: that loss is a difference of success rates, so it saturates, moving by 8.2x over a budget sweep while the effect beneath it moves by 1.34x. We therefore report the paired cosine shift, in which both thresholds cancel algebraically, so the input defect holds without committing to a calibration. Measured that way it is 2.2x and 10.7x larger on three unseen recognizers, and at matched budget it reverses the L-infinity transfer ranking: the one surveyed method that aligns at evaluation gains 0.18 where MI-FGSM loses 0.05. The cause is a resampling mismatch, not perturbation lost outside the crop; optimising through a differentiable alignment operator largely removes it, adding +24 to +58 points on unseen recognizers and a commercial system, with a residual on one of them. The thresholds are wrong: the four constants inherited since 2021 hold the false-accept rate near its nominal 1% on aligned crops but admit 2.3-5.4% on whole images, with an opposite-signed bias across dodging and impersonation, the two tasks reported side by side. Differentiable alignment and gallery scoring are not new: the first generation of this literature used both, and we show what dropping them cost.

AI.tldr: 该文指出人脸隐私保护方法宣称>90%防护率的评估协议存在输入管线、度量与阈值三重缺陷（真实检测-对齐-裁剪前端、饱和的成功率差、继承自2021的四个阈值），并提出成对余弦位移这一两阈值相消的度量，揭示保护损失被严重低估，且可通过可微对齐优化大幅弥补。
AI.motivation: 已发表的人脸隐私（反识别）方法普遍报告90%以上黑盒防护率，但这些数字建立在与部署不一致的评估协议上：输入用整图或检测框而非检测-对齐-裁剪流程，度量用饱和的成功率差，阈值未经校准。作者希望量化这些缺陷对结论的影响，并给出不依赖校准的替代度量。
AI.method: 在不重新生成图像的前提下，用更真实的前端（检测+关键点模板对齐+裁剪）重评现有攻击；提出成对余弦位移度量（两阈值代数相消）；分析成因为重采样失配而非裁剪外扰动丢失；在可微对齐算子上进行端到端优化；考察四个继承阈值在不同输入下的虚警率偏置。
AI.result: 重新评分使标准迁移攻击损失56%的规避保护、预算分配攻击损失7%；成功率差在预算扫描中变动8.2倍而底层效应仅1.34倍；成对余弦位移在三个未见识别器上分别大2.2倍和10.7倍，并在等预算下反转L∞迁移排名；可微对齐带来未见识别器与商用系统上+24至+58点提升；阈值导致对齐裁剪下FAR≈1%而整图下2.3–5.4%，且规避与冒充任务偏置符号相反。
AI.conclusion: 现有面部隐私保护的量化结论被系统性高估，根源是评估管线的重采样失配与饱和度量；端到端可微对齐可恢复大部分防护，重拾第一代文献中对齐与底库评分的做法是必要的。

title: GridDriver: On-Board BEV-Based Language Planning and Reasoning
summary: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV)-conditioned large language models (LLMs) enable language-interactive driving, but onboard deployment requires efficient perception and continuous planning alongside autoregressive language generation. We present GridDriver, an efficient BEV-conditioned LLM framework combining trajectory prediction, structured driving indicators, natural-language navigation, driving explanations, and scene question answering. Lightweight spatio-temporal BEV perception and spatially structured tokens provide scene context to a shared LLM, while frame-wise scheduling interleaves trajectory prediction with asynchronous language generation. GridDriver achieves competitive performance on public benchmarks, reaching 87.9% PDMS on NAVSIM and 57.6% accuracy on nuScenes-QA with a shared planning and QA checkpoint. Spatial representation analyses demonstrate improved geometric information retention and trajectory prediction compared with Q-Former compression. The system achieves 32.7 ms standalone planning latency and 9.4 plans/s in an onboard ROS 2 pipeline. We further evaluate planning on our own data recordings and demonstrate open-loop onboard operation on a research vehicle. Across public benchmarks and real-world evaluations, we identify strengths and limitations of the BEV-based approach.

AI.tldr: GridDriver 是一个 BEV 条件化的高效 LLM 驾驶框架，将轨迹预测、结构化驾驶指标、自然语言导航、驾驶解释与场景问答统一到共享 LLM 中，配合轻量时空 BEV 感知与逐帧调度实现异步语言生成。
AI.motivation: BEV 条件化 LLM 支持语言交互式驾驶，但车载部署要求高效感知与连续规划，且需与自回归语言生成并行，现有方案难以兼顾。
AI.method: 采用轻量级时空 BEV 感知网络提取场景特征，以空间结构化的 token 作为场景上下文输入共享 LLM；通过逐帧调度（frame-wise scheduling）将轨迹预测与异步语言生成交错执行，实现规划与问答共享同一 checkpoint。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 上达到 87.9% PDMS，nuScenes-QA 上 57.6% 准确率；空间表征分析显示相较 Q-Former 压缩具有更好的几何信息保留与轨迹预测；ROS 2 车载流水线中独立规划延迟 32.7 ms、9.4 plans/s，并在研究车辆上完成开环车载运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了 BEV token 直接注入共享 LLM 的高效驱动范式在公开基准与实车上的可行性，并总结了 BEV 路线的优势与局限。

title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
comment: 22 pages, 18 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: this https URL
summary: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.

AI.tldr: HubEgo-100K v1.0：10,124 小时 1080p 第一人称人类工作视频数据集，含 100 Hz 同步 IMU，覆盖 12,227 名贡献者、15,548 个环境、11 类场景、30 个工作类别，83% 为工作场所场景，用于提升机器人策略的环境/物体泛化数据多样性。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习策略在训练环境与物体之外泛化差；数据规模化研究表明泛化随环境与物体多样性而非单环境演示数量增长，但机器人多环境数据采集成本高。现有人类第一人称视频虽可大规模获取，却以日常生活为主，缺少真实工作场所的技能性作业数据。
AI.method: 以"多样性优先"为采集原则构建数据集：单目头戴手机相机采集 1080p 视频并同步 100 Hz IMU，众包式由贡献者在自有场景中非脚本化记录工作过程；发布了 72,754 个 episode，附带机器生成的动作与语言标注，提供 LeRobot 与 MCAP 两种格式（CC BY 4.0）。论文沿各轴度量多样性（新贡献者与词汇持续出现），并将度量结果与已发表文献中六项与策略性能相关的数据属性（含手部可见性、惯性传感）关联，同时记录采集、清洗、隐私处理流程与 datasheet。
AI.result: v1.0 共 10,124 小时视频、12,227 名贡献者、15,548 个环境、11 类场景、30 工作类别、56 任务类型、35 动作族；随机顺序下未见饱和，新贡献者与新词持续出现，表明覆盖多样性的可扩展性；给出与六项策略性能相关数据属性的对应度量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以多样性为核心提供了规模可观、格式标准化的第一人称人类工作视频数据资源，为机器人策略的跨环境/跨物体泛化提供潜在补充训练信号；但 v1.0 尚无基准与策略训练实证，后续版本将补充 benchmark 并扩展至 10 万小时。

title: Does the Model Use What It Cites? Counterfactual Tests of Grounded Reasoning Chains in Small Video-Language Models
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 27 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: A grounded reasoning chain cites a frame span and a box for every step, so a reader can check where the model looked. Whether the answer depends on the cited region is a different question. We test it by intervention: the regions a model cited in its own chain are blacked out, and the share of correct answers that flip is compared with blacking out boxes of the same size elsewhere on the same frames. The paired difference, the cite gap, needs no annotation. We apply it to 2-3B video-language models trained on exact CLEVRER chains and on pseudo-labelled NExT-QA chains. With the same weights, the cite gap is 0.089 on CLEVRER and 0.003 on NExT-QA. Pooled over models, masking the cited boxes flips 2.2 times as many correct answers as the control on CLEVRER and 1.1 times as many on NExT-QA, also among the answers that depend on the video at all, while the boxes pass a grounding check on both. Masking the cited entity on every frame, instead of the cited box, flips 1.9 times as many answers as its control. The NExT-QA chains were supervised to cite two frames of entities that stay visible on most frames, so this outcome is what the supervision predicts; the point is that the usual check on grounded chains cannot see it. A citation can be verifiable and relevant without the answer depending on it, and a test of grounded reasoning should remove what a chain names, not only where it points.

AI.tldr: 提出"cite gap"成对干预指标检验视频语言模型推理链引用的区域是否真正决定答案，发现CLEVRER上为0.089而NExT-QA仅0.003，即引用可"可验证且相关"却与答案因果无关，且现有grounding检查无法察觉。
AI.motivation: 现有"grounded reasoning chain"只要求每步给出frame span与bbox以便核查模型"看向何处"，但可核查（boxing check通过）与相关性并不等于答案依赖于该区域；需要无需标注的度量来区分"引用可验证"与"引用具因果作用"。
AI.method: 以干预方式构造配对实验：将模型自身链中引用的区域black out，与同帧同尺寸的对照框black out，比较正确回答翻转比例之差（cite gap，无需人工标注）。在2-3B视频语言模型上测试，分别用精确CLEVRER链与伪标注NExT-QA链训练；并额外做"每帧遮掉被引用实体"的变体干预，同时用grounding check确认框合法。
AI.result: 同权重下cite gap在CLEVRER为0.089、NExT-QA为0.003；合并模型后遮掉引用框的翻转数为对照的2.2倍（CLEVRER）与1.1倍（NExT-QA），在"答案确实依赖视频"的子集上亦然，且两组框均通过grounding check；每帧遮掉引用实体的翻转数为对照的1.9倍。原因在于NExT-QA链被监督去引用在多数帧可见的实体的两帧。
AI.conclusion: 引用可验证且相关，但答案未必依赖它；常规grounded chain检查看不到这种"相关但非因果"的引用。评价grounded reasoning应干预链所指称的对象（实体/内容），而不仅干预其指向的位置（框）。

title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Wheelchair Configuration Classification in Accessible Automated Vehicle Applications
summary: Making automated vehicles accessible requires consideration of vulnerable road users, including wheelchair users. To offer a more tailored experience that supports independence for this group, vehicle design needs to accommodate the wide range of wheelchair configurations. However, wheelchairs are individualized, varying in frame geometry, propulsion, and visual appearance. Moreover, occupants or accessories may obscure visual cues. Existing mobility-aid datasets only label the presence of a wheelchair, rather than describing its specific configuration. To fill this gap, this paper introduces the Wheelchair Configuration Image Dataset (WCID), comprising 467 face-blurred images across 192 capture groups solely for evaluation. Each image is annotated with (i) a two-class label of manual or powered, (ii) a chair subtype, (iii) occupancy, viewpoint, setting, lighting, occlusion, propulsion, and control, with a 273-image validation split and 194-image test split. Three convolutional neural network backbones and a frozen vision-language probe are trained on an external image dataset and evaluated on WCID to measure cross-dataset generalization, while also testing robustness using Gaussian blur. Convolutional models do well on clean images, but performance drops under strong blur, leaving a gap before deployment. Code, split assignments, labels, trained weights, and the face-blurred images is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出WCID数据集（467张人脸模糊图像，192个采集组，273验证/194测试），标注轮椅类型、占用、视角、场景、光照、遮挡、驱动与控制方式，用于评测自动驾驶系统对轮椅使用者配置的识别。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶的可及性需照顾轮椅使用者等弱势道路使用者，但轮椅个体化差异大（车架几何、驱动方式、外观），且现有 mobility-aid 数据集仅标注"是否存在轮椅"，缺乏细粒度配置描述，无法支撑个性化交互与适配设计。
AI.method: 构建 WCID 数据集并采用按采集组划分（capture-group split）以避免数据泄漏；在外部图像数据集上训练三种 CNN 主干（手动/电动二分类）与一个冻结的视觉-语言探针，在 WCID 上做跨数据集泛化评测，并用高斯模糊测试鲁棒性。
AI.result: 卷积模型在清晰图像上表现良好，但在强模糊下性能明显下降，存在部署前需弥补的差距；跨数据集泛化可被有效度量。
AI.conclusion: WCID 填补了轮椅配置级标注的空白，可作为评测基准促进自动驾驶对轮椅使用者的细粒度感知；但现有模型鲁棒性不足，代码、权重与数据公开。

title: SCAN: Site-Aware Collaborative Privacy-Preserving Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Neurological Disease Classification
summary: Worldwide neuroimaging data could strengthen diagnostic foundation models, but privacy rules often prevent centralizing brain MRI scans. We present SCAN, a site-aware collaborative adaptation framework for Neurological Disease Classification that lets new sites adapt a 3D medical vision-language model (VLM) without retraining or sharing patient scans. Each site keeps exact class prototypes for local prediction and can share privacy-protected class summaries: norm-bounded sums and counts perturbed once with calibrated noise. Using 7,641 scans from 67 sites across 12 countries, covering Alzheimer's disease (AD), stroke, epilepsy and controls, we assess local adaptation, cross-site benefits, and effects on existing sites. At seven unseen sites, the frozen VLM's zero-shot AUCs were 0.833-0.945 for AD and stroke. Training-free local prototypes improved epilepsy AUC at three sites from 0.598/0.625/0.508 to 0.684/0.729/0.762 and AD AUC at one site from 0.833 to 0.863, nearly matching a classifier trained at each site (mean AUC 0.757 vs. 0.759). With differential privacy ($\epsilon$ = 4), new sites contributed without materially reducing accuracy at existing sites (AUC change $\leq$0.2%), although gains from sharing were limited, and membership attacks performed near chance. SCAN offers hospitals a worldwide framework to adapt and share brain MRI VLMs without exchanging scans or retraining.

AI.tldr: SCAN：面向脑MRI神经疾病分类的站点感知协作适配框架，各站点用冻结3D医学VLM+精确类原型本地预测，仅共享差分隐私保护的类摘要（范数有界和+计数），在67站点7,641例扫描上实现免重训、免传数据的跨站点增益。
AI.motivation: 全球脑MRI数据可强化诊断基础模型，但隐私法规阻碍数据集中化；同时新站点缺乏算力与数据去重训VLM。
AI.method: 以冻结的3D医学视觉-语言模型为骨干，各站点维护精确类原型做免训练本地预测；协作层面共享经范数裁剪并加校准噪声、一次性扰动的类求和与计数摘要，实现差分隐私（ε=4）下的站点无关聚合，无需重训或交换扫描。
AI.result: 7个未见站点上冻结VLM零样本AUC：AD与卒中0.833–0.945；本地原型将三个站点癫痫AUC从0.598/0.625/0.508提升至0.684/0.729/0.762，单站点AD由0.833升至0.863，接近站点本地训练分类器（均值0.757 vs 0.759）；ε=4下既有站点AUC变化≤0.2%，成员推断攻击接近随机，但共享带来的额外增益有限。
AI.conclusion: SCAN为医院提供无需交换扫描或重训即可适配与共享脑MRI VLM的跨境协作范式，隐私-效用权衡良好，但跨站点信息共享的实际收益仍有限。

title: Weight-space programming for tractor guidance controller: large language models natively write neural network weights that steer a real tractor
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables (1 in the appendices); includes a field test on a real tractor
summary: Weight-space programming is a process where a large language model reads and writes the weights of a neural network directly, guided by a natural language specification, without an optimiser or gradient descent. This study applies it to automatic tractor guidance, where a 253-parameter neural network steers along paths of lines and arcs and must be adapted when the machine changes, such as a slower steering actuator. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 (also 5.2) edited the network for our research tractor using a small budget of simulated evaluations to repair a network trained for another tractor and write a controller into a network with zero weights. We compared them with an evolution strategy, gradient descent and pure pursuit in simulation and on the real tractor. Both models read the network and analysed the closed loop with control theory correctly, and Fable's repair without simulation succeeded only occasionally. With simulated feedback, both models repaired the trained network in single sessions and wrote a working controller from zero weights, whereas from zero the evolution strategy found none. The controllers written from zero were sparse and in a classical cascaded structure; one model edited the trained network while the other replaced it. Gradient descent reached higher accuracy with far more simulation, and all language model controllers steered the real tractor without intervention, with errors of the same order as pure pursuit. Language models can program the weights of a neural controller directly, much as control engineers design one. We call this Weight-Space Engineering.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型（GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.x）通过"权重空间编程"直接读写小型神经网络（253参数拖拉机转向控制器）的权重，在少量仿真评估反馈下修复或从零写出可用的控制器，并成功在真实拖拉机上运行。
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络控制器适配依赖优化器与梯度下降，成本高且需大量数据；作者探索能否让 LLM 像控制工程师一样，基于自然语言规格与少量闭环评估直接"修改权重"完成控制器适配（如执行器变慢等硬件变化），并提出"权重空间工程"概念。
AI.method: 将权重张量以文本形式呈现给 LLM，令其直接编辑权重参数；设置两个任务：(1) 用少量仿真评估修复为另一台拖拉机训练的253参数网络；(2) 从零权重写入控制器。与进化策略、梯度下降、纯追踪（pure pursuit）在仿真和真实拖拉机上对比，并考察无仿真反馈时的成功率。
AI.result: 两模型均能正确解读网络结构并用控制理论分析闭环；无仿真反馈时仅偶尔成功。有仿真反馈时，两模型均可单次会话内完成修复与从零生成可用控制器，而进化策略从零未能找到解；从零生成的控制器稀疏且呈经典级联结构，一模型在训练网络上编辑、另一模型整体替换。梯度下降精度更高但需远多仿真量；所有 LLM 控制器均能在真实拖拉机上无干预行驶，误差与纯追踪同量级。
AI.conclusion: LLM 可直接编程神经控制器权重，实现类似人类控制工程师的设计流程，作者将其命名为"权重空间工程"；小规模网络 + 闭环评估反馈是当前可行路径，但精度与效率尚不及梯度下降。

title: How Many Persistent Features Does a Biometric Need? A Law Linking Equal Error Rate to Feature Count and Persistence
summary: A biometric designer controls the number of features and their temporal persistence. Earlier empirical work linked the equal error rate (EER) to persistence and to the required number of features by straight lines. We derive the law behind these regularities. For $N$ independent standardized Gaussian features with test-retest correlation $\rho$, scored by cosine similarity, Fisher's $z$-transform turns the genuine and impostor scores into two normals, giving $\mathrm{EER}=\Phi(-\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{N}\,\operatorname{atanh}\rho)$ and, inversely, $N=(2q/\operatorname{atanh}\rho)^2$ with $q=\Phi^{-1}(1-\mathrm{EER})$; intercorrelated features enter through an effective count $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$. The central extension lets persistence vary across comparisons with spread $\tau$ on Fisher's scale: $\mathrm{EER}=\Phi(-m/(\sqrt{\tau^2+v}+\sqrt{v}))$ with $v=1/(N_{\mathrm{eff}}-2)$, which for a normal spread has a floor $\Phi(-m/\tau)$ that no number of features can lower. With no fitted parameter the simple law reproduces published simulations and the EER-ICC line, and predicts the KCC-EER relation of eye-movement embeddings on GazeBase ($R^2=0.88$), though less well on GazeBaseVR ($0.63$). Read from the genuine and impostor scores, the general form matches the EER of eye movements, keystroke dynamics, the ECG and face embeddings over 101 conditions with $R^2=0.98$ and a median error of $0.6$ points, against $0.87$ and $1.9$ points for the simple law. The 61 eye-movement, keystroke and ECG conditions check consistency on the same scores; the 40 face conditions use held-out subjects, with the same accuracy. The product $\tau\sqrt{N_{\mathrm{eff}}-2}$ gives a design rule: adding or decorrelating features pays fully while it is well below one and little once it exceeds about three, where only higher or more uniform persistence helps.

AI.tldr: 该文从理论上推导出生物特征EER与特征数N、重测相关ρ的解析关系：EER=Φ(-½√N·atanhρ)，并将其推广到持久性在Fisher尺度上有离散度τ的情形，得出EER下限Φ(-m/τ)与设计规则τ√(N_eff-2)。
AI.motivation: 既有实证研究只发现EER与持久性、所需特征数呈线性关系，缺乏背后的规律性解释；作者希望给出闭式定律，并解释为何特征数增加到一定程度后EER不再下降。
AI.method: 设N个独立标准化高斯特征、重测相关ρ、余弦相似度打分，用Fisher z变换把真实/冒充分数转化为两个正态分布，推出EER闭式解与反解N；用有效特征数N_eff处理特征间相关；进一步令持久性在各次比较间服从Fisher尺度上标准差为τ的分布，得到V=τ²+v的合成方差形式并导出EER下限；在GazeBase、GazeBaseVR、眼动、击键、ECG与人脸嵌入共101个条件上验证（人脸用留出受试者）。
AI.result: 无拟合参数的简单定律复现了已发表仿真与EER-ICC直线关系；对GazeBase眼动嵌入KCC-EER关系R²=0.88（GazeBaseVR为0.63）；一般式在101个条件下R²=0.98、中位误差0.6个百分点，而简单律为0.87、1.9个百分点；61个同分数条件用于一致性检验，40个人脸条件用留出受试者，精度相同。
AI.conclusion: 持久性的离散度τ给EER设定了不可通过增加特征数突破的下限；乘积τ√(N_eff-2)可作为设计规则——该值远小于1时增加或去相关特征收益充分，超过约3后收益甚微，此时只能通过提高持久性或使其更均匀来改善，为生物特征系统设计提供了定量依据。

title: Pathology Randomization for Synthetic Priors and Zero-Shot Detection
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables (8-page main text with appendices). Code: this https URL
summary: Hospital brain imaging archives hold a diverse array of pathology at sample sizes beyond prospective studies, particularly for underrepresented populations and diseases. To unlock uncurated clinical data and scale analysis, methods are needed to detect abnormalities across contrasts and resolutions. Synthetic data has provided robust, contrast-agnostic models for a variety of human neuroimaging tasks in healthy anatomy, but pathology detection and other tasks in clinical settings still require real patient data, contrast-specific models, or disease-specific generators. We propose PathoDraw, a generative model of brain MRI with pathology. A conditional distribution of lesions given the healthy anatomy is drawn into the label map before contrast-agnostic rendering, and a single network estimates healthy anatomy with exact signed intensity deviation of any input scan. The contrast-agnostic 3D UNet learns the healthy labels under the lesion and the signed deviation directly and identifies pathology via robust tissue statistics and learned features, despite no training on real pathology. We show zero-shot detection on public stroke, tumor, and white matter hyperintensity datasets as well as archived clinical data, spanning $T_1$w, FLAIR and $T_2$w at various resolutions under a recent unsupervised anomaly detection benchmark protocol. Our single model exceeds or performs comparably to contrast-specific anomaly detectors trained on real scans and keeps healthy anatomy intact. The same generator trains networks for super-resolution and for registration in the presence of pathology. Our model, robust across acquisition and disease, enables the use of uncurated, archived data for clinical analysis. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PathoDraw利用合成病理的生成模型训练单一对比度无关3D UNet，直接学习病灶下健康解剖标签及精确带符号强度偏差，在无真实病理训练下实现T1w/FLAIR/T2w多分辨率脑MRI的零样本异常检测。
AI.motivation: 医院脑影像档案含大量少见病变与人群样本，但缺乏标注；现有合成数据方法多针对健康解剖，临床病变检测仍依赖真实患者数据、对比度专用模型或疾病专用生成器，难以跨对比度、跨分辨率扩展。
AI.method: 提出PathoDraw：先将病灶条件分布（给定健康解剖）绘制进标签图，再做对比度无关渲染以合成带病理影像；用单个对比度无关3D UNet同时估计健康标签（位于病灶之下）与输入扫描的精确带符号强度偏差，并借稳健组织统计与学习特征识别病灶；同一生成器亦可训练超分与病理性配准网络。
AI.result: 在公开卒中、肿瘤、白质高信号数据集及归档临床数据上，按近期无监督异常检测基准协议完成零样本检测，覆盖多分辨率T1w/FLAIR/T2w。单模型超过或媲美在真实扫描上训练的对比度专用异常检测器，同时保持健康解剖完好。
AI.conclusion: 对比度与疾病均鲁棒的合成训练范式可在零真实病理样本条件下实现临床级异常检测，使非精选归档数据可用于临床分析，并可推广到病理条件下的超分与配准任务。

title: DEFTS: Data-Efficient, Training-Free Few-Shot Learning for CLIP in the Text Subspace
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) achieves impressive zero-shot image classification performance by comparing image embeddings against class-specific text embeddings. While recent few-shot methods leverage labeled training samples to improve upon this zero-shot baseline, they often predominantly rely on image embeddings and underutilize the semantic structure of the text embeddings. In this paper, we introduce DEFTS, a data-efficient, training-free few-shot classification method strictly in the text subspace. We first demonstrate empirically that while raw text embeddings can be suboptimal as direct classifiers, the linear subspace they span remains highly discriminative. DEFTS therefore proposes to reduce the image-text modality gap by projecting estimated image prototypes directly into this subspace.
