Importantly, by expressing these prototypes as linear combinations of text embeddings, DEFTS reduces a high-dimensional estimation problem to the derivation of just a few coefficients. These coefficients are then computed via a Bayesian posterior mean, using a prior naturally centered on the original text embedding coordinates. Extensive experiments across 12 image classification benchmarks demonstrate that DEFTS significantly improves upon existing training-free methods.

AI.tldr: DEFTS：一种仅在文本子空间内进行的、无需训练的数据高效 few-shot 图像分类方法，通过将图像原型投影到文本嵌入张成的子空间，用贝叶斯后验均值求少量组合系数。
AI.motivation: 现有 few-shot 方法主要依赖图像嵌入，未充分利用 CLIP 文本嵌入的语义结构；且原始文本嵌入直接用作分类器并不最优。
AI.method: 先实证发现原始文本嵌入虽次优，但其张成的线性子空间仍具强判别性；DEFTS 将估计的图像原型投影到该文本子空间以缩小模态鸿沟，把高维估计问题化简为求少量线性组合系数，并用中心位于原始文本嵌入坐标的先验做贝叶斯后验均值求解。
AI.result: 在 12 个图像分类基准上，DEFTS 显著优于现有 training-free few-shot 方法。
AI.conclusion: 在文本子空间中进行轻量贝叶斯系数估计即可高效提升 CLIP few-shot 分类，无需训练与额外参数学习。

title: Deciding Without Pointing: A Case Study of Whether a Decision Model Localizes the Anomalies It Detects
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Preprint of the technical part of an MSc thesis (Politecnico di Milano). Code and pre-registrations are held privately until venue submission
summary: Decision models can answer a typed question about an image with a probability per option, without generating text. In our case study of Clef-flash (post-trained Qwen3.5-9B backbone) on industrial inspection benchmarks, we ask whether it localizes the anomalies it detects. We obtained uneven results with zero-shot detection: per-category image AUROC 0.924 on MVTec AD and 0.668 on MVTec AD 2. On the former, the decision head's routing attention produces 0.391 mean per-image pixel AUROC, and hiding the image tokens from it leaves detection unchanged. The multimodal LLM's backbone attention does point at the defect, however it falls below a center prior when we change question. It falls below chance if we remove textual context in the question, partly due to backbone attention leaving the object, while the head's map hardly changes. The backbone's states carry the location when probed with normal images, on the test-split images, however, the decision depends on the defect region. A larger model, Clef, that comes with a post-trained Qwen3.8-27B backbone, gives no useful map in the decision head either. We found that it's possible to recover anomaly location by asking question specifically on an image region, retraining the head or reading the backbone, but none matches dedicated few-shot localizers.

AI.tldr: 工业异常检测中决策型VLM（Clef-flash，Qwen3.5-9B）的"检测-定位"解耦现象分析：AUROC检测尚可（MVTec AD 0.924），但决策头路由注意力的像素AUROC仅0.391，且主干注意力在问题/上下文改变时劣于中心先验。
AI.motivation: 决策模型能以逐选项概率回答关于图像的"类型化问题"而不生成文本，但其概率是否对应真实空间定位（即"检测到的是否就是看到的"）缺乏检验；作者想在推理透明度/可解释性层面揭示决策头与主干注意力的定位能力差异。
AI.method: 以Clef-flash（后训练Qwen3.5-9B主干）与更大模型Clef（Qwen3.8-27B主干）为对象，在MVTec AD/AD 2工业检测基准上做零样本检测与定位探针：按类图像AUROC评估检测；将决策头路由注意力导出为逐图像素AUROC热图；通过遮蔽图像token做消融；改变问题措辞、去除文本上下文以测试对中心先验的敏感性；用正常图像做线性/探针读取主干隐状态中的位置信息。
AI.result: MVTec AD 每类图像AUROC 0.924，MVTec AD 2 仅0.668；前者上决策头路由注意力平均逐图像素AUROC 0.391，遮蔽图像token后检测不变（说明决策头几乎不依赖视觉空间证据）。主干注意力确实指向缺陷，但改变提问方式即低于中心先验，去除问题中文本上下文则低于随机，并伴随主干注意力离开目标、而决策头热图几乎不变。正常图像上主干隐状态可线性解码位置，但测试分割图上决策依赖缺陷区域。27B规模的Clef在决策头同样给不出有效热图。
AI.conclusion: 概率式决策头与主干注意力存在显著"定位-决策"解耦，决策头热图不可信；可通过区域化提问、重训决策头或读取主干隐状态恢复异常位置，但均不及专用少样本定位器，提示决策式VLM用于视觉证据时需专门校准或重训。

title: Beyond Appearance: Where Forest Visual Place Recognition Actually Fails
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, accepted to the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA)
summary: Visual place recognition (VPR) in forest environments remains challenging because repetitive vegetation, and changes in illumination, season, and viewpoint can make distinct places appear similar and revisited places appear substantially different. In this paper, we investigate whether temporal, linguistic, structural, and geometric context can improve on an appearance-only descriptor, and what limits each representation when it does not. Using MegaLoc as the appearance-based baseline on the WildCross benchmark, we evaluate score-space and descriptor-space sequence matching, vision-language captions and reranking, scene-graph representations, and depth-derived stem graphs across same-direction revisits, extended routes, and reverse traversals. On a same-direction revisit, both sequence matching strategies reach similar Recall@1 (94.1% vs. 91.5%), but recall at 100% precision rises from 50.9% (single-frame MegaLoc) to 71.6% in score space and falls to 36.5% in descriptor space. The remaining context representations provide no consistent improvement over the appearance-based baseline. Same-place captions show limited place-specific discrimination, reranking is constrained by the initial candidate shortlist, and stem-graph matching remains weak even with LiDAR depth.

AI.tldr: 该论文在森林环境视觉位置识别（VPR）任务上，以MegaLoc外观描述子为基线，在WildCross基准上系统评估了序列匹配、视觉-语言描述与重排、场景图、深度茎干图等多种上下文表征的增益与局限。
AI.motivation: 森林植被重复、光照/季节/视角变化导致不同地点外观相似、同一地点外观差异大，纯外观描述子难以鲁棒识别，作者想验证时间、语言、结构、几何四类上下文能否带来改进，以及各自失效原因。
AI.method: 在WildCross基准上以MegaLoc为外观基线，分别在分数空间与描述子空间做序列匹配，并测试视觉-语言caption与候选重排、场景图表示、LiDAR深度导出的茎干图（stem graph）；评测覆盖同向重访、扩展路线与反向穿越三种场景。
AI.result: 同向重访下两种序列匹配Recall@1接近（94.1% vs 91.5%），但100%精度下的召回从单帧MegaLoc的50.9%提升到分数空间的71.6%，描述子空间则降至36.5%；其余上下文表征相对外观基线无稳定提升：caption地点区分性弱、重排受初始候选集限制、茎干图即便用LiDAR深度仍表现差。
AI.conclusion: 时序上下文（尤其分数空间序列匹配）是当前最有效的增益来源，语言、结构、几何上下文在森林VPR中收益有限且各有瓶颈，提示未来需改进上下文表征的判别性与候选检索策略。

title: DreamFAR: Real-Time and Long-Horizon Interaction with Diverse Objects
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: World models have shown great potential in serving as a simulator for robot manipulation. However, existing models are either fit to a single environment or lack ability to simulate long-horizon contact-rich events. We present DreamFAR, a world model whose dynamics model is trained from scratch on a large robot-native teleoperation dataset, with no internet-video pretraining. We present an architecture and learning recipe designed for training on robot-native data. DreamFAR is significantly smaller than the high-performance video generation models, yet shows better understanding of contact and causality, and runs 10 FPS on a commercial GPU. Experimentally, DreamFAR significantly outperforms existing models in predicting the long-horizon future. We further demonstrate various applications where DreamFAR can be used, including policy evaluation and mixed-data co-training. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: DreamFAR 是纯用机器人原生遥操作数据从零训练的世界模型，无需互联网视频预训练，模型规模远小于视频生成大模型但更懂接触与因果，商用 GPU 上 10 FPS，长时程预测显著优于现有模型，并可用于策略评估与混合数据协同训练。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型要么只适配单一环境，要么无法模拟长时程、富接触事件；而高性能视频生成模型依赖互联网视频预训练、体积大、推理慢，难以胜任机器人操作仿真器的角色。
AI.method: 构建大规模机器人原生遥操作数据集，从零训练动力学模型（无视频预训练）；针对机器人原生数据设计专用架构与训练配方，强调接触与因果建模，控制模型规模以换取实时性。
AI.result: 模型体量显著小于高性能视频生成模型，却展现更强的接触与因果理解；商用 GPU 上达 10 FPS；长时程未来预测显著超越现有模型。
AI.conclusion: 机器人原生数据足以从零训练出小型高效的世界模型，可作为策略评估与混合数据协同训练的通用仿真器；摘要未量化基线差距，具体指标需查阅正文。

title: Where Should the Lamp Go? Ambient-Aware Lamp Placement for Portraits
comment: 15 pages, 12 figures
summary: Portraits shape first impressions, and lighting is an important factor. Prior work, such as lighting estimation and portrait relighting, edits lighting after capture but does not guide where to place a light before the shot. This leaves an open question: where should a light go to best light a face? Therefore, we propose LightMatch, a preference-grounded inverse lighting framework that disentangles the controllable light from ambient illumination and optimizes its placement. We first learn a Bradley-Terry quality model from pairwise human judgments. A perception head then regresses spherical-harmonic lighting from frozen self-supervised features via cross-attention. Finally, a placement solver isolates the light via spherical-harmonic linearity and optimizes its reachable position. On held-out environments, LightMatch attains 87.8% of the oracle improvement, outperforming the conventional solver that ignores ambient light by a relative 28.4% and the same pipeline with the widely used DPR estimator by a relative 70.5%. It reaches 73.2% on real OLAT faces of unseen identities and, on our real captures, cuts lamp-direction error by 37.7%.

AI.tldr: LightMatch：以人类成对偏好训练的Bradley-Terry质量模型驱动逆光照优化，先解耦环境光，再求解补光灯的最优可放置位置。
AI.motivation: 已有光照估计与肖像重打光只能在拍摄后编辑光照，无法在拍摄前指导灯具应放在哪里；且现有求解器普遍忽略环境光，导致补光位置次优。
AI.method: (1) 用成对人工判断学习Bradley-Terry质量模型作为偏好代理；(2) 感知头通过交叉注意力从冻结的自监督特征回归球谐光照；(3) 利用球谐线性可加性分离可控灯与环境光，并对可达位置做优化求解。
AI.result: 留出环境下达到oracle改进的87.8%，相对忽略环境光的传统求解器提升28.4%，相对使用DPR估计器的同管线提升70.5%；未见身份的真实OLAT人脸达73.2%；实拍中将灯方向误差降低37.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将人偏好作为目标函数、把可控光源从环境光中分离，可有效实现拍摄前的补光位置推荐，并在仿真与真实数据上均验证有效。

title: BATMoS: Budget-Aware Guidance Allocation for Efficient Video Diffusion
summary: The effectiveness of a video diffusion model's inference budget depends on where computation is spent along the denoising trajectory. Across eight equal-budget inference configurations, VBench total scores span 4.80 points, highlighting the importance of explicit allocation design. Our key insight is that guidance evaluations are not equally valuable across diffusion time: retaining the sampling updates while selectively reusing guidance can preserve generation quality with fewer denoiser evaluations. We introduce BATMoS (Budget Aware Temporal Mixture of Strategies), which routes between fresh classifier-free guidance and cached guidance using a single pretrained denoiser. A magnitude-based temporal rule assigns guidance reuse to low-magnitude blocks and reserves fresh guidance for the remaining blocks, with a single integer controlling the computation budget. The resulting schedule requires no additional router training or per-budget threshold search. Evaluated on CogVideoX-2B with 4,720 videos per configuration across all sixteen official VBench dimensions, BATMoS achieves the highest total score among the eight allocation policies and comes within 0.10 points of full classifier-free guidance using 20\% fewer branch evaluations. BATMoS also composes with feature reuse, reducing computation from 80 to 62 effective branch evaluations with a 0.11-point decrease in total score. These findings make temporal guidance allocation a practical mechanism for extracting more generation quality from a fixed inference budget.

AI.tldr: BATMoS 提出按扩散时间与引导幅值分配计算预算：低幅值块复用缓存引导、其余块用新鲜 CFG，单一整数控制预算，无需路由训练或阈值搜索。CogVideoX-2B 上在八种等预算策略中总分最高，比完整 CFG 少 20% 分支评估仅差 0.10 分。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型的推理预算效果取决于去噪轨迹上计算花费的位置：八种等预算配置的 VBench 总分相差 4.80 分，说明需显式设计分配策略；且引导评估在不同扩散时刻价值不等，保留采样更新而选择性复用引导有望在减少去噪评估的同时保持质量。
AI.method: BATMoS（预算感知时间混合策略）：仅用单一预训练去噪器，在新鲜 CFG 与缓存引导间路由。基于幅值的时间规则把引导复用分配到低幅值块，其余块保留新鲜引导；一个整数控制预算。无需额外 router 训练，也无需逐预算阈值搜索。可与特征复用叠加。
AI.result: CogVideoX-2B 上每配置 4,720 个视频、覆盖全部 16 个官方 VBench 维度；八种分配策略中总分最高，比完整 CFG 少 20% 分支评估、总分仅低 0.10 分；与特征复用组合时有效分支评估由 80 降至 62，总分下降 0.11 分。
AI.conclusion: 按扩散时间分配引导计算是从固定推理预算中提取更多生成质量的实用机制，且可与特征复用等正交加速手段叠加。

title: SE(3)-LIVOM: Adaptive Multi-LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry and Mapping
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge, IROS 2026 Workshop on Data in Field Robotics. Code: this https URL
summary: This paper presents SE(3)-LIVOM, the overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026. The challenge asks for the trajectory of a legged robot in the GrandTour dataset, whose scenes include collapsed buildings, construction sites and snowfields. SE(3)-LIVOM runs in real time on two LiDARs, one camera and an IMU. Its frontend extends SE(3)-LIO to multiple LiDARs and a camera. Adaptive downsampling keeps the time per scan near 35 ms within and across scenes. An online backend corrects drift with a plane bundle adjustment over submaps and an incremental pose graph. With a single configuration for all scenes, the system reaches an average ATE of 1.40 cm on the six test scenes. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SE(3)-LIVOM：IROS 2026 COMFORT 挑战赛总冠军方案，将SE(3)-LIO前端扩展至多LiDAR+相机，配合自适应降采样与在线平面BA+增量位姿图后端，在GrandTour六场景上平均ATE达1.40 cm。
AI.motivation: 挑战赛要求在灾后坍塌建筑、施工现场、雪地等复杂室外场景中估计足式机器人轨迹，需要多传感器、多场景统一配置的实时、无漂移里程计方案。
AI.method: 前端将SE(3)-LIO扩展为双LiDAR+单相机+IMU融合；采用自适应降采样将单帧处理时间稳定在约35 ms；后端在子地图上做平面束调整（plane BA）并结合增量式位姿图实现漂移在线校正；全场景共用单一参数配置。
AI.result: 六个测试场景平均ATE为1.40 cm，实时运行，单配置跨场景泛化；获IROS 2026 COMFORT Challenge总冠军；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 表明将SE(3)等变LiDAR惯性里程计扩展为多模态并对齐平面结构约束，可在极端退化室外场景下实现厘米级实时定位，具备较强的工程可复现性。

title: RiDEx: Reward-Informed Directional Exploration for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reward-based diffusion post-training updates model parameters from task rewards. While existing approaches improve sampling and policy optimization, they still rely largely on isotropic random perturbations in a high-dimensional latent space for exploration. Such variation often spends the perturbation budget on changes with little influence on the target reward, making exploration inefficient. We study where diffusion models should explore and how to learn from that exploration. We introduce Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx), which concentrates local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. Conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients propose the subspace, and equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state measure its terminal reward response. The reward difference supplies signed local supervision in the explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute to global DiffusionNFT learning. RiDEx thereby couples exploration-space selection with feedback about the changes it produces. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, RiDEx attains the highest peak rewards among the evaluated methods on four alignment and preference tasks. Its gradient-direction instantiation achieves 15x and 29x target-attainment speedups over DiffusionNFT on HPSv2 and PickScore, measured in H200 GPU hours. Controlled experiments confirm that reward-aligned directions elicit stronger responses at equal perturbation magnitude, and that applying their measured credit improves curve-average reward across all four tasks.

AI.tldr: RiDEx将扩散模型后训练的探索限制在与奖励相关的去噪速度场子空间中，用条件残差或可微奖励梯度提出方向，通过同状态等量反向扰动测量奖励响应，实现有符号的局部监督并与DiffusionNFT全局学习耦合。
AI.motivation: 现有基于奖励的扩散后训练在高维潜空间中主要依赖各向同性随机扰动进行探索，扰动预算大量消耗在几乎不影响目标奖励的方向上，探索效率低。作者希望回答"扩散模型应在何处探索"以及"如何从该探索中学习"。
AI.method: 提出RiDEx：在去噪速度场上构造奖励相关子空间，由条件残差或可微奖励梯度提出候选方向；在同一生成状态施加等量反向扰动，以终末奖励差作为该坐标上的有符号局部信用；局部监督与所有生成样本上的全局DiffusionNFT学习联合优化。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium上，于四项对齐与偏好任务中取得所评估方法中最高的峰值奖励；梯度方向实例在HPSv2与PickScore上相比DiffusionNFT分别实现15倍和29倍的目标达成加速（H200 GPU小时计）。对照实验表明奖励对齐方向在同等扰动幅度下引发更强响应，且使用其测量信用可提升四项任务的平均奖励。
AI.conclusion: 将探索子空间选择与对探索所产生变化的反馈信号相耦合，可在相同扰动预算下显著提升扩散后训练的奖励优化效率，说明探索方向的结构性先验是提升样本效率的关键因素。

title: FM-Mamba: An Efficient Native 2D Selective State Space Model with Stability-Aware Discretization
summary: When applied to two-dimensional features such as images, Mamba-based methods either flatten the feature map into 1D sequences and fuse multiple scans, which breaks spatial adjacency and multiplies computation, or recurse directly on the 2D grid but rescale the recurrence with a fixed input-independent factor and aggregate only the predecessors on a single anti-diagonal, leaving the discrete step unconstrained by 2D stability theory. We propose \textbf{FM-Mamba}, a native 2D selective state space model built on the general Fornasini--Marchesini (FM) model. Its coupled recurrence evolves along both spatial axes; cross-axis coupling induces a discrete diagonal-predecessor term $\tilde A_0$, and two independent input-dependent step sizes $\Delta_1(i,j)$, $\Delta_2(i,j)$ govern propagation along the two axes, so that the coefficients adapt per position and per direction. A normalized ratio $r_k=a_{0,k}/(a_{1,k}a_{2,k})$ yields a closed-form piecewise bound on the two step sizes; when a configuration falls outside the stable interval the steps are projected onto this bound, and the criterion is re-verified per position after training, which suppresses systematic local amplification without global damping. The recurrence is executed by a dual-diagonal wavefront scan: each update gathers information from two anti-diagonals, and the input enters the current state through a single projection, so that neither training nor inference flattens the feature map. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出FM-Mamba，一种基于Fornasini–Marchesini二维状态空间模型的原生2D选择性SSM，用双轴耦合递推、输入依赖的双步长与稳定性投影替代1D展平或多扫描融合。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉Mamba要么把图像展平为1D序列并做多方向扫描，破坏空间邻接且计算量成倍增长；要么直接在2D网格上递推，但用与输入无关的固定尺度缩放，且仅聚合单条反对角线上的前驱，离散步长缺乏2D稳定性约束。
AI.method: 以一般FM模型构建耦合递推，沿两个空间轴同时演化；跨轴耦合引入对角前驱项Ã₀，两个独立输入依赖步长Δ₁(i,j)、Δ₂(i,j)按位置与方向自适应。由归一化比值r_k=a_{0,k}/(a_{1,k}a_{2,k})给出步长的闭式分段上界，越界配置投影回稳定区间，训练后逐位置复核判据，避免全局阻尼。执行采用双对角波前扫描，每次更新聚合两条反对角线信息，输入经单一投影进入当前状态，训练与推理均不展平特征图。
AI.result: 给出步长的闭式分段稳定性界与逐位置后验校验机制，可在抑制系统性局部放大的同时不引入全局阻尼；递推保持二维网格结构，避免展平带来的邻接破坏与多扫描计算倍增。（摘要未给出具体指标。）
AI.conclusion: 将2D状态空间递推从启发式的固定缩放推进到有稳定性理论约束的原生二维选择性模型，为视觉骨干网络提供了一种不破坏空间结构的高效替代方案。

title: Data-Efficient Algal Bloom Segmentation in Freshwater Bodies Using a Three-Stage Transfer Learning Pipeline with Attention-Enhanced Decoding
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: Harmful algal blooms threaten water quality and public health, yet automated segmentation of bloom regions in freshwater imagery is limited by scarce pixel-level annotations. We present a transfer-learning pipeline that adapts a Swin Transformer U-Net with SCSE decoder attention from ImageNet-1K to water-body segmentation (RIWA, LaRS) and then to algal blooms, together with a model-assisted annotation protocol that expands the labelled algae corpus from 145 to 655 images. In a single-seed ablation on a 41-image validation split (checkpoint S2-A4 and its variants), corpus expansion is the dominant factor (+11 mIoU points); water-body pretraining helps only on the expanded corpus (+1.1 points over ImageNet initialization); SCSE attention adds 0.3 points; and a learnable positional encoding lowers mIoU by 0.6 points and is omitted. Adding 476 images, 188 of them algae-free, reduces false-positive area on non-water scenes from 22.6% to 4.9%. Against nine baselines on a 256-image test split, a separately trained checkpoint of the same architecture (S2-A13) reaches mIoU 0.919 and the highest algae IoU (0.902); a near-duplicate audit indicates train/test overlap in this split, so these scores are likely optimistic.

AI.tldr: 用Swin Transformer U-Net+SCSE注意力，经水体分割预训练迁移到淡水藻华分割，并以模型辅助标注将藻类语料从145扩到655张；语料扩充是mIoU提升主因（+11），水体预训练仅在扩充语料上有效（+1.1），SCSE+0.3，可学习位置编码反而-0.6故弃用。
AI.motivation: 有害藻华威胁水质与公共健康，但淡水影像中藻华区域的自动分割受限于像素级标注稀缺。
AI.method: 构建迁移学习流水线：ImageNet-1K→水体分割(RIWA、LaRS)→藻华，采用Swin Transformer U-Net与SCSE解码器注意力；提出模型辅助标注协议扩充语料；在41张验证集上做单种子消融（S2-A4及变体），并在256张测试集上与九个基线比较，另做近重复审计。
AI.result: 语料扩充贡献+11 mIoU（主导因素）；水体预训练在扩充语料上较ImageNet初始化+1.1；SCSE +0.3；可学习位置编码−0.6（舍弃）。新增476张（含188张无藻）使非水体场景误报面积从22.6%降至4.9%。S2-A13在测试集达mIoU 0.919、藻类IoU 0.902，但近重复审计显示该划分存在训练/测试重叠，指标可能偏乐观。
AI.conclusion: 标签扩充与语料多样性比架构微调更关键；域间迁移收益依赖目标数据规模；近重复污染使报告指标偏乐观，需更严格的数据划分评估。

title: Segmentation-Guided Direct Capacity Estimation of Rooftop Photovoltaics from Aerial Imagery
summary: Distribution planners need installation-level inventories of rooftop photovoltaic (PV) capacity, but interconnection records may be incomplete or spatially aggregated. Conventional image-based estimators segment PV arrays, convert the mask to physical area, and multiply by an estimated power density, coupling capacity prediction to mask-derived area. We propose Direct Head, a segmentation-guided architecture that retains U-Net segmentation and soft-mask pooling while directly regressing nonnegative capacity from PV-region features and area descriptors. We evaluate three independent runs on 7,590 French rooftop installations under the original split and a department-based holdout. Relative to a parameter-matched area-density neural model, Direct Head reduces mean absolute error by 8.7% and 12.5%, and symmetric mean absolute percentage error by 14.0% and 20.7%, respectively. Comparisons with conventional estimators, controlled architecture variants, auxiliary-loss ablations, and representative cases show that segmentation provides useful spatial evidence without requiring capacity to be determined by an area-density product.

AI.tldr: 提出 Direct Head：保留 U-Net 分割与软掩码池化，但直接从 PV 区域特征与面积描述子回归非负容量，避免了“掩膜面积×功率密度”的耦合式估计。
AI.motivation: 配电网规划需要安装级屋顶光伏容量清单，但并网记录常缺失或空间聚合；传统图像方法先分割阵列、再由掩膜折算物理面积并乘功率密度，使容量预测被掩膜面积误差所绑定。
AI.method: 分割引导架构：U-Net 分割 + 软掩码池化提取 PV 区域特征，结合面积描述子，以非负约束直接回归容量；在 7,590 个法国屋顶装置上做三次独立运行，采用原始划分与基于省份（department）的 holdout，并与参数匹配的面积-密度神经模型、传统估计器、受控结构变体、辅助损失消融进行对比。
AI.result: 相对参数匹配的面积-密度模型，MAE 分别降低 8.7% 与 12.5%，sMAPE 降低 14.0% 与 20.7%；消融与代表性案例分析表明分割提供有用空间证据，但容量无需由面积-密度乘积决定。
AI.conclusion: 解耦“面积推算”与“容量回归”可提升容量估计精度，对空间泛化更稳健，适用于遥感/能源资产清查类回归任务；与 Physical AI/机器人/3D 重建核心方向关联较弱。

title: ReLAP: Latent Action Pretraining through Recurrent Video Prediction in JEPA Space
summary: Videos provide a rich source of physical interaction for learning robot behavior without action annotations, yet effective latent actions must capture not only local transitions but also how those transitions evolve over time. We introduce ReLAP, a latent-action pretraining framework that couples local transition learning with recurrent multi-step prediction in a frozen JEPA representation space. A shared inverse dynamics model infers compact continuous latent actions from adjacent observations, while a latent world model recurrently predicts the future JEPA features. Because each predicted feature becomes the context for the next transition, errors at later steps backpropagate through the rollout to earlier latent actions, encouraging temporally coherent dynamics beyond pairwise reconstruction. We transfer this representation to a vision-language model using two complementary objectives: latent distillation from the frozen inverse teacher and recurrent future-feature prediction through the frozen latent world model. The resulting policy is then adapted to robot demonstrations with action flow matching. At deployment, the explicit latent-action and world-model branches are removed, and the fine-tuned VLM predicts physical actions directly, reducing inference complexity. With only 11M pretraining samples and 1.06B trainable parameters, ReLAP achieves 97.9% on standard LIBERO and 70.0% over zero-shot LIBERO-Plus perturbations. On the LARY latent-action benchmark, ReLAP ranks second in both mean regression error and mean classification accuracy among the compared methods. These results demonstrate that recurrent action-free latent action pretraining can learn compact, temporally structured, and transferable representations for downstream robot control.

AI.tldr: ReLAP：在冻结 JEPA 特征空间中结合“局部转移学习”与“循环多步预测”的无动作视频潜在动作预训练框架，将表征蒸馏进 VLM 并用动作流匹配适配机器人演示。
AI.motivation: 无动作标注视频是机器人行为学习的丰富来源，但有效的潜在动作不仅要刻画相邻帧的局部转移，还需捕捉这些转移在时间上的演化；仅靠成对重建的目标缺乏时间一致性约束。
AI.method: (1) 共享逆动力学模型从相邻观测推断紧凑连续潜在动作；(2) 潜在世界模型在冻结 JEPA 表征空间中循环预测未来特征，每步预测特征作为下一步上下文，使后续步误差沿 rollout 反传至早期潜在动作，形成时间一致动力学；(3) 用两目标迁移到 VLM：从冻结逆动力学教师做潜在蒸馏 + 通过冻结世界模型做循环未来特征预测；(4) 用 action flow matching 适配机器人演示；(5) 部署时移除潜在动作与世界模型分支，VLM 直接输出物理动作，降低推理复杂度。
AI.result: 仅 11M 预训练样本、1.06B 可训练参数，LIBERO 达 97.9%，零样本 LIBERO-Plus 扰动下 70.0%；LARY 潜在动作基准上平均回归误差与平均分类精度在对比方法中均排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 循环式无动作潜在动作预训练可学得紧凑、时间结构化且可迁移的表征，用于下游机器人控制，并支持部署时无额外分支的高效推理。

title: CRA: Continuous Risk Assessment for Safety-critical Visual Navigation
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: Traditional safety-critical control methods often rely on predefined constraints that separate states into safe and unsafe regions. While recent studies have extended geometric safety toward semantic safety, real-world safety is rarely purely binary. The risk associated with an object or human can vary continuously with its physical properties, like motion, and interaction context; for example, a person carrying a heavy object or a hot object moving at high speed may require a different safety response from an ordinary static obstacle. In this paper, we propose a vision-based continuous risk assessment framework for safety-critical visual navigation. Our method uses RGB and LiDAR observations to estimate four risk factors (kinetic, potential, contact-severity, and thermal) and combines them into a continuous risk score for each assessed object or person. These estimates are integrated into a Poisson safety function with a Laplace guidance field as a safety filter, enabling online monitoring and intervention in open-world robot navigation. We demonstrate the proposed method in a simulated restaurant scene.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉的连续风险评估框架，用RGB+LiDAR估计动能、势能、接触严重度、热风险四因子并融合为连续风险分数，嵌入Poisson安全函数与Laplace引导场安全滤波器，在仿真餐厅场景中验证。
AI.motivation: 传统安全关键控制依赖将状态二分为安全/不安全区域的预定义约束；已有工作虽将几何安全扩展到语义安全，但真实风险是随物体运动、交互上下文连续变化的（如搬运重物或高温物体高速移动的人）。
AI.method: RGB与LiDAR观测联合估计每个物体/人的四个风险因子（kinetic、potential、contact-severity、thermal），融合为连续风险分数；将估计值集成到带Laplace引导场的Poisson安全函数作为安全滤波器，实现开放世界机器人导航的在线监控与干预。
AI.result: 仅在仿真餐厅场景中演示，无实机验证、无定量指标描述。
AI.conclusion: 提出从二值安全向连续风险评估的转变思路，具备一定概念价值，但证据强度弱（仅仿真），缺乏可操作的方法细节。

title: When Lower Harm Misleads: Auditing Concept Corrections
summary: An expert who corrects a concept prediction, such as a BI-RADS descriptor in breast ultrasound, expects the diagnosis to improve. Objectives that reduce the harm of such corrections are judged by harm and accuracy, yet harm also falls when a model responds less to every correction or starts from a worse uncorrected prediction, the reference for harm. We propose a correction audit, a reproducible evaluation protocol that separates these explanations: it splits each correction into harm and useful gain on identical events, separates the starting prediction from the correction response, and compares objectives with amplitude baselines matched in source harm. On three breast-ultrasound sources, worst-case correction training, evaluated from the mean-case model's start, lowers harm but gives up more useful gain in all 21 source comparisons pooled over six seeds, raising the corrected negative log-likelihood (NLL); from the same start, selecting between the objectives by harm picks the less helpful model on all three sources. On CUB, a monotonic harm penalty at its reported weight lowers path-level harm in all 80 concept sets while raising the NLL in all 80, almost entirely before any correction. At a fixed start, rescaling both responses to the same source harm reproduces the penalty's mean harm, useful gain and NLL on single-concept corrections within a prespecified margin of 0.0005 nat, although the two responses point in different directions. Lower harm therefore signals better corrections only when it is read together with useful gain, absolute risk and the start it is measured from.

AI.tldr: 提出"纠错审计"(correction audit)评估协议，将模型对人类纠错（如乳腺超声BI-RADS描述符）的响应拆分为"危害降低"与"有效增益"，并以同源危害的幅度基线对照，证明单纯降低危害指标会误导模型选择。
AI.motivation: 现有用于减少"专家纠错带来的潜在危害"的目标常用危害(harm)与准确率来衡量，但危害下降可能仅因为模型对任何纠错都响应变弱，或起点本身更差（危害的参照点更低），从而混淆了"纠错真的更有用"与"其他解释"。作者希望区分这些解释。
AI.method: 提出可复现的纠错审计协议：(1) 在同一事件上把每次纠错拆分为危害部分与有用增益；(2) 分离初始预测（起点）与纠错响应本身；(3) 在源危害匹配的幅度基线下比较不同训练目标。在三个乳腺超声数据源（6个随机种子，共21组源内比较）及CUB概念的80个概念集上进行实验，并用固定起点下的响应重缩放做对照。
AI.result: 乳腺超声上，从均值情形模型的起点评估，最坏情形纠错训练在所有21组比较中降低危害，但同时牺牲更多有用增益，并抬高纠错后NLL；若仅按危害挑选目标，三个数据源都会选出较不有用的模型。CUB上，报告权重下的单调危害惩罚在全部80个概念集降低路径级危害，同时在全部80个集抬高NLL，且抬高几乎发生在任何纠错之前。固定起点下将两种响应重缩放到相同源危害，可在0.0005 nat预设容差内复现该惩罚的均值危害、有用增益与NLL，尽管两者响应方向相反。
AI.conclusion: 更低的危害只有与有用增益、绝对风险以及测量起点一起解读时，才意味着更好的纠错；单一危害指标会产生误导性的模型选择结论。

title: When AUC Meets Generative Reconstruction: A Unified Principle for Balanced Visual Representation Learning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require visual encoders that extract fine-grained visual features while constructing semantically disentangled and discriminative representations. Conventional methodologies encounter a fundamental trade-off: contrastive learning enhances inter-class discrimination by suppressing intra-class variability, whereas generative reconstruction emphasizes perceptual fidelity but lacks explicit comparative supervision. The naive aggregation of these objectives via composite loss functions often induces optimization conflicts and instability due to gradient interference within the shared latent space. To resolve this, we introduce a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem within the generative output manifold. Our approach maintains perceptual reconstruction as a supervisory signal and integrates a ranking-based discriminative constraint by systematically ordering matched and mismatched reconstruction outputs. This formulation embeds discriminative information seamlessly into the generative process, alleviating the risk of loss competition. Specifically, we propose AUC Generative Reconstruction (AUCGR), which optimizes the area under the ROC curve (AUC) by ensuring higher scores for matched pairs than for mismatched pairs, and Partial AUC Generative Reconstruction (pAUCGR), which addresses supervision bias by focusing on mismatched comparisons within reliable feature subspaces. The proposed objectives are designed to be plug-and-play, requiring no architectural modifications to existing generative reconstruction frameworks. Theoretical analysis establishes rigorous connections to AUC/pAUC optimization and provides generalization guarantees. Extensive experiments validate that our method advances both discriminative accuracy and fine-grained perceptual representation.

AI.tldr: 提出将生成式重建重构为生成输出流形内的判别排序问题：AUCGR 通过优化匹配/不匹配重建对的 AUC 融入判别监督，pAUCGR 聚焦可靠子空间以缓解监督偏差；即插即用，无需改动架构。
AI.motivation: MLLM 需要兼具细粒度与判别性的视觉编码器。对比学习抑制类内变化换取类间判别，生成式重建强调感知保真但缺乏显式比较监督；直接用复合损失聚合两类目标会在共享潜空间产生梯度干扰、优化冲突与不稳定。
AI.method: 把生成重建改写为生成输出流形上的判别排序：保留感知重建作为监督信号，并对匹配/不匹配的重建输出进行系统排序以施加基于排序的判别约束。具体给出 AUCGR（确保匹配对得分高于不匹配对，优化 ROC 曲线下面积）与 pAUCGR（聚焦可靠特征子空间内的不匹配比较，缓解监督偏差）。目标函数即插即用，无需架构修改。
AI.result: 理论分析建立了与 AUC/pAUC 优化的严格联系并给出泛化保证；大量实验表明方法同时提升了判别准确性与细粒度感知表征质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将判别信息嵌入生成过程而非用复合损失叠加，规避了损失竞争问题，为 MLLM 视觉编码器提供了一种可复用的一致性表征学习方案。

title: CueSplat: Learning to Schedule Sparse Deformation for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting on Edge Devices
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Main paper only
summary: Deformation-based 4D Gaussian splatting (4DGS) enables dynamic scene rendering. However, evaluating deformation networks for all Gaussians at every frame is compute-intensive on edge devices. We find that Gaussian trajectories are often locally predictable, yet prediction reliability varies across Gaussians and time. Thus, we propose CueSplat, a post-training framework that exploits local temporal regularity while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen and retaining its Gaussian set. Specifically, CueSplat predicts Gaussian attributes from recent history and uses a lightweight learned router to select exact deformation updates within a scene-specific budget calibrated offline. Selection accounts for prediction reliability and rendering contribution. Selected indices are reused across nearby frames to reduce routing overhead, while selected Gaussians still receive exact updates each frame. To control accumulated prediction error, we use drift signals to schedule three consecutive full-deformation frames that rebuild the prediction history. Evaluated across four mainstream 4DGS algorithms, CueSplat achieves up to $6.74\times$ and $8.15\times$ speedups on Jetson AGX Orin and Orin NX, respectively, with a negligible quality drop (at most $0.16$ dB in dataset-average PSNR).

AI.tldr: CueSplat：免训练后处理框架，冻结4DGS骨干，利用高斯轨迹局部可预测性——用历史外推预测属性，轻量路由器在离线校准的场景预算内按预测可靠性与渲染贡献选择需精确形变更新的高斯，索引跨帧复用，并用漂移信号触发连续三帧全量形变重建预测历史，在Jetson Orin上实现最高6.74×/8.15×加速，PSNR仅降≤0.16 dB。
AI.motivation: 4DGS对每帧所有高斯执行形变网络计算，边缘设备开销过大；作者观察到高斯轨迹存在局部时间规律性，但可预测性随高斯与时间变化，因此需要自适应地只对关键高斯做精确计算。
AI.method: 后训练（post-training）框架：骨干与高斯集保持冻结；用近期历史预测高斯属性；轻量学习路由器在离线校准的场景级预算下，综合预测可靠性与渲染贡献选择精确形变更新的子集；选中索引在邻近帧复用以降低路由开销，但选中高斯每帧仍获精确更新；以漂移信号调度三帧连续全量形变以重置预测历史、抑制误差累积。
AI.result: 在四种主流4DGS算法上评测：Jetson AGX Orin与Orin NX分别最高6.74×和8.15×加速，数据集平均PSNR最多下降0.16 dB，质量损失可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过"局部预测+预算内自适应精确更新+定期全量重同步"的混合策略，可在不改动预训练模型的前提下显著降低4DGS边缘推理成本，具备与多种4DGS算法即插即用的兼容性。

title: Diagnosing and Correcting Skin-Tone Color Casts in Ultra-Lightweight Photo Retouching Networks
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 32 pages including supplementary material
summary: Color casts are expected to come from the scene or camera, and a retouching model removes them. We report a case where the model leaves one: an ultra-lightweight retouching network renders human skin greener than the original because it under-restores the skin chroma that a degradation removes and, even on clean inputs, adds a small hue shift of its own. A common paired-data-free recipe, synthetic self-supervision (degrade high-quality images, learn to restore them), silently produces this cast while whole-frame PSNR/SSIM stay essentially unchanged. In a representative 6,825-parameter histogram-conditioned network, the cast appears in 52 of 70 portraits under a ground-truth-anchored, white-balance-free protocol. Both a histogram-conditioned and a CNN-conditioned network develop the cast under synthetic self-supervision, yet both are near-neutral in-domain when trained on MIT-Adobe FiveK expert pairs. Image-level objectives miss it: a global-mean green loss worsens the cast (52/70 to 57/70). With zero added parameters, our per-pixel, skin-masked, asymmetric green-excess loss reduces the cast to 1/70 across stratified skin tones (68.1% to 2.2% over the 70,000-image FFHQ corpus; 64.4% to 0.8% on held-out CelebA-HQ photos). In-domain FiveK PSNR/SSIM are unchanged (+0.13 dB, +0.004), at the cost of a small whole-frame CIEDE2000 increase (8.77 to 9.69) and a magenta over-correction where skin is nearly neutral (skin Delta a* -1.5 to +4.4 and CIEDE2000 5.6 to 6.4 on clean inputs): the loss targets the signed green-magenta axis, not total skin-color fidelity. The same loss suppresses the cast across three ultra-light architectures. A whole-frame green metric correlates with skin-region CIEDE2000 at the method level (Spearman rho = 0.89). The final network exports to a 35 KB TFLite model.

AI.tldr: 超轻量修图网络在无配对数据的合成自监督训练下会在皮肤区域残留偏绿偏色，整帧PSNR/SSIM无法察觉；作者提出零参数增量的逐像素、皮肤掩膜、非对称绿偏损失，将偏色从52/70降至1/70。
AI.motivation: 偏色本应来自场景或相机并由修图模型去除，但作者发现超轻量修图网络反而在肤色区域引入绿色偏移：既对退化所移除的肤色色度恢复不足，且在干净输入上也会自行加入轻微色相漂移。常用的"合成退化+自监督复原"无配对数据范式会静默产生该偏色，而整帧PSNR/SSIM几乎不变，因此需要定位并修正这一被整帧指标掩盖的失败模式。
AI.method: 在具有代表性的6,825参数、直方图条件网络及CNN条件网络上验证现象；采用以真值为锚、不做白平衡的评估协议量化肤色偏色。提出零参数增量的逐像素、皮肤掩膜、非对称绿偏（green-excess）损失：仅沿带符号的绿-品红轴惩罚皮肤区域的绿色过量，而非约束总体肤色保真。同时在FFHQ（70,000图）与留出CelebA-HQ上做分层肤色测评，并与整帧green损失对比；在三种超轻量架构上验证迁移性；最终导出35 KB TFLite模型。
AI.result: 直方图条件网络在70张人像中52张出现偏色；合成自监督下直方图条件与CNN条件网络均产生偏色，而在MIT-Adobe FiveK专家配对数据上域内接近中性。全局平均绿色损失反而使偏色从52/70恶化到57/70。所提损失将其降至1/70（FFHQ上68.1%→2.2%，留出CelebA-HQ上64.4%→0.8%）；域内FiveK PSNR +0.13 dB、SSIM +0.004基本不变，代价是整帧CIEDE2000由8.77升至9.69，并在近中性肤色处出现品红过校正（skin Δa* 从-1.5到+4.4，CIEDE2000 5.6→6.4，干净输入）。整帧绿色指标与皮肤区CIEDE2000在方法层面相关（Spearman ρ=0.89）。
AI.conclusion: 整帧图像级目标会系统性掩盖局部肤色偏色，需用区域感知、带符号的针对性损失；该非对称绿偏损失零参数开销、跨架构有效且几乎不损伤全局复原质量，但并不保证整体肤色保真，存在品红过校正风险。本质属于图像复原/色彩一致性的细粒度失败分析与修补工作。

title: VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models
comment: 8 pages
summary: Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%. Physical-feature analysis links powertrain recognition to deceleration behaviour and size recognition to steering response. Errors near size-class boundaries and limited gains from longer observations highlight the importance of label resolution and training-fleet coverage for cross-model generalisation.

AI.tldr: VTT: 从运动与CAN信号识别未见车型的尺寸类别与动力类型的数据集与基准（9,062段、1,431车、174车型），引入物理辅助目标与数据增强提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 车辆尺寸与动力总成信息可丰富轨迹数据以支撑交通分析与仿真，但现有轨迹数据缺乏此类属性，且需在未见车型上具备泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建9,062次行驶、约3,950小时、1,431辆车、174车型的数据集，提供三类footprint尺寸标签与动力类型标签；以60秒窗口比较四种序列架构、统计特征及LLM提出的物理特征；采用物理辅助任务多目标训练、数据增强与任务特定加权。
AI.result: 纯电vs燃油驱动级macro-F1达92.6–93.0%；尺寸分类由62.9%提升至67.1%。在4,061名外部驾驶员公开日志上，全输入模型对88车型中86个正确判别动力类型；尺寸准确率63.2%，接近内部车级63.5%。物理特征分析将动力识别关联到减速行为、尺寸识别关联到转向响应；尺寸类边界附近误差大，更长观测收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 跨车型泛化受标签分辨率与训练车队覆盖度制约；物理先验与多任务训练有效，但尺寸细分任务仍是瓶颈。

title: RetiDual-Select: Reliability-Aware Specialist-Generalist Routing for Retinal OCT under Image-Quality Shift
comment: 4 figures, 4 tables, 42 references. Submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Main article only; the separate Supplementary Information is not included
summary: Adaptive fusion can repair a static ensemble's errors, but can also overturn correct decisions. RetiDual-Select combines retinal specialist RETFound with the image encoder of the medical vision-language model MedSigLIP, separating candidate fusion, routing safety and predictive review. Calibrated product-of-experts (PoE) fusion is the static reference, a small gate proposes an alternative for each image, a validation-frozen harm guard decides whether that candidate may replace the reference, and a separate score prioritizes review. Static PoE reached the highest or joint-highest clean accuracy on all three datasets. At a clean 2% accepted-error target the review policy accepted 94.3% of Kermany-4 images at 99.89% selective accuracy, and 92.4% of OCT-C8 at 98.65%. Both branches were correct on 95.0% and 91.8% of clean images; only 4.4% and 6.2% had exactly one correct branch. Across 15 prespecified synthetic conditions, adaptive gains were concentrated in severe contrast reduction, where this routing opportunity widened roughly ninefold; percentile rescaling largely removed the effect, linking it to compressed dynamic range. In post-hoc validation-only analyses, gain was higher when the gate followed the more reliable branch, and a frozen guard cut the worst-condition OCT-C8 loss from 1.39 to 0.36 percentage points. Adaptive routing was useful when image quality created a reliability opportunity and the gate followed it; otherwise the system retained Static PoE or deferred for review. The findings are bounded by the synthetic perturbations evaluated and do not establish robustness to natural acquisition or scanner shift.

AI.tldr: 提出 RetiDual-Select：将视网膜专科模型 RETFound 与 MedSigLIP 图像编码器组合，把“候选融合、安全路由、预测复核”三类决策分离，并以静态 PoE 融合为参照，仅在门控提议且门卫放行时启用自适应融合。
AI.motivation: 自适应融合虽能修正静态集成的错误，却也可能推翻原本正确的决策，因此需要一种机制在“保留静态基线”与“利用自适应收益”之间做安全取舍。
AI.method: 以校准的专家乘积（PoE）融合作为静态参考；小型门控网络对每张图像提议一个替代融合；由在验证集上冻结的伤害门卫判断该候选能否替换参考；另设独立分数对需人工复核的样本排序。共在3个数据集、15种预设合成扰动条件下评测。
AI.result: 静态 PoE 在三个数据集上的干净准确率均为最高或并列最高。干净条件下 2% 接受错误目标时，复核策略在 Kermany-4 上接受 94.3% 图像（选择性准确率 99.89%），OCT-C8 接受 92.4%（98.65%）。两分支同时正确的比例为95.0%和91.8%，仅一支正确的仅4.4%和6.2%。自适应收益集中于严重对比度下降（路由机会约扩大9倍），百分位重标定基本消除该效应，说明与动态范围压缩相关。事后验证集分析显示门控跟随更可靠分支时收益更高；冻结门卫将 OCT-C8 最差条件损失从1.39降至0.36个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自适应路由仅在图像质量造成可靠性机会且门控能识别该机会时有用，否则系统回退到静态 PoE 或转人工复核；结论受限于合成扰动，未证明对真实采集或扫描仪漂移的鲁棒性。

title: Low-speed Limit Cycle Walking of Planar X-shaped Bipedal Robot with Special Properties
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. Published in the Proceedings of IEEE ICARM 2023. This author version corrects bibliographic information and minor typographical errors in a table and figure labels; the scientific content remains unchanged
summary: This paper proposes a novel planar semicircular-footed X-shaped bipedal robot in which the center of mass of each leg link is at the same position as the hip joint, and discusses a method for generating a stable limit cycle gait on level ground. First, we outline the assumptions of the robot model with four degrees of freedom, and develop the mathematical equations of motion and collision. Second, we set the relative hip-joint angle as a control output and design a control system to follow it to the desired trajectory specified as a fifth-order function of time. Third, we mathematically show that there are special properties: the angular velocity of the swing leg does not change before and after the collision, and the time-integral of the control input becomes zero in a steady gait. We also mathematically show that the model has the feature that approximate linearization is effective and the antigravity effect of semicircular feet can be utilized. Through numerical simulations, we verify the validity of the theoretical results, and analyze some fundamental gait properties such as convergence speed and mechanical energy restoration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种平面半圆足X形双足机器人，各腿杆质心与髋关节重合，通过将相对髋关节角作为控制输出跟踪五阶时间多项式期望轨迹，实现水平地面稳定极限环步态。
AI.motivation: 简化欠驱动双足模型的分析与稳定性证明，利用半圆足的抗重力效应和质心-髋关节重合的结构特性，使控制器设计与极限环存在性可被解析刻画。
AI.method: 建立四自由度平面机器人模型并推导运动与碰撞方程；采用相对髋关节角作为控制输出，设计跟踪五阶多项式期望轨迹的反馈控制器；解析证明摆动腿角速度在碰撞前后不变、稳态步态中控制输入时间积分为零，并说明近似线性化的有效性与半圆足抗重力作用；通过数值仿真验证理论结论。
AI.result: 数学证明揭示了碰撞不变的摆动腿角速度、零净控制输入等特殊性质，并确认近似线性化在该模型下适用；数值仿真验证了理论结果，并给出了收敛速度与机械能恢复等基本步态特性的分析。
AI.conclusion: 该模型凭借结构简化使非线性双足系统的极限环步态可获得解析性的性质刻画，为欠驱动双足步行控制与能耗机理分析提供了一条可理论验证的研究路径；但结论限于平面、四自由度与理想化假设，尚缺实物实验验证。

title: FrameSeg3D: Learned Local Frames for Segmenting Small Parts on High-Resolution 3D Scans
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables
summary: Segmenting small parts on high-resolution 3D scans, such as nails on hand scans and teeth on intraoral scans, poses three challenges: 1) each part covers a tiny fraction of the scan, 2) its boundary is only a subtle change of height and curvature, and 3) it faces its own direction. Existing methods fall into two groups, and both fall short. The first group processes the whole scan at once and sees each part too coarsely. Point and mesh networks must shrink the scan to fit in memory, so a small part keeps only a few of its points. Multi-view methods render images of the whole object, so each part fills only a few pixels and a tilted part is seen from the side. The second group first finds each part and then segments it up close. But these methods find the parts with knowledge about one kind of part, for example the shape of the dental arch for teeth. Such knowledge does not carry over to other kinds of parts. We find that accuracy is limited by how a part is seen, from which direction and at what scale, not by how many points land on it. We therefore present FrameSeg3D. It first predicts a local frame for every part, its center and the direction it faces, from a low-resolution view of the whole scan. It then segments the part in views around its frame normal at the scanner's resolution, so covering the whole scan no longer costs resolution. Because every part arrives centered, facing the camera, and at a fixed scale, one segmentation network can serve different kinds of parts and learn from few labeled masks. We test FrameSeg3D on two kinds of parts, nails and teeth. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on hand scans (mean Dice 0.970 on nails) and on the Teeth3DS+ test fold (per-tooth IoU 96.5), with the most accurate tooth boundaries (boundary IoU 70.5).

AI.tldr: FrameSeg3D：先从低分辨率全局视图预测每个小部件的局部坐标系（中心+朝向），再沿法向在该朝向周围以扫描仪原始分辨率逐个部件分割，使小部件居中、正面、定尺度呈现，从而用单一分割网络处理不同种类部件（指甲、牙齿），在手部扫描与Teeth3DS+上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D扫描上的小部件分割（手扫指甲、口内扫描牙齿）存在三大难点：部件仅占扫描极小比例；其边界只是细微的高度/曲率变化；每个部件有各自朝向。现有方法分两类且都失效：整扫描一次性处理（点/网格网络需降采样导致小部件只剩极少点，多视图渲染则部件仅占少量像素且倾斜部件被侧视），或先定位再近距离分割（依赖特定部件的先验知识，如牙弓形状，无法迁移）。作者指出精度瓶颈在于"部件被如何观察"（方向与尺度），而非落在其上的点数。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 在整扫描的低分辨率视图上预测每个部件的局部坐标系（中心与朝向法向）——一种类别无关的部件定位；(2) 以该法向为中心，在扫描仪原始分辨率的局部视图中进行分割，部件被居中对齐、面向相机并固定在统一尺度，因此一个分割网络即可服务多类部件，并能在少量标注掩码上学习。
AI.result: 在指甲与牙齿两类部件上验证：手部扫描指甲平均Dice 0.970；Teeth3DS+测试折上逐牙IoU 96.5，边界IoU 70.5（边界最准），均优于SOTA。摘要未披露推理时延、开源情况与失败案例分析。
AI.conclusion: 以"主动选择观察视角与尺度"替代"提高点密度/增加视图"的思路对小部件3D分割有效，并通过部件无关的局部坐标系实现跨类别网络复用与少样本迁移。局限在于依赖第一阶段定位精度、需针对扫描仪分辨率设计局部视图渲染，属领域专用分割而非具身/操作任务。

title: Text-Guided Modality Correction for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) is essential for detecting objects beyond the categories seen during training. Establishing vision-language associations is crucial for recognizing unseen categories, while integrating complementary visual features across levels supports detection at different scales. However, existing methods often provide insufficient textual guidance for object regions, rely on limited cross-modal alignment strategies, and underuse complementary features across levels, limiting their ability to detect unseen categories and objects of varying scales. To address these limitations, we propose a Text-Guided Modality Correction Network (TMCNet) that incorporates textual guidance into region feature extraction, cross-modal alignment, and multi-scale decoding to strengthen region-category semantic correspondence and promote complementary feature fusion across levels. First, a text-guided modality encoder incorporates textual semantics into queries to guide regional feature aggregation, reducing semantic ambiguity in object representations. Second, a cross-modal alignment module strengthens the correspondence between region representations and category semantics through interactions between visual and textual features. Finally, a progressive text correction decoder combines a top-down pathway with lateral connections to progressively fuse text-guided deep semantic features with shallow visual features at the corresponding scales, preserving both semantic information and spatial detail for objects of different sizes. Experiments on two public datasets, COCO-OVD and LVIS-OVD, demonstrate that TMCNet achieves strong performance in open-vocabulary object detection using simple text queries as guidance. Extending TMCNet to open-vocabulary segmentation also yields performance gains, demonstrating its cross-task applicability and extensibility.

AI.tldr: TMCNet通过文本引导的模态编码器、跨模态对齐模块和渐进式文本校正解码器，将文本语义注入区域特征提取、对齐与多尺度解码全过程，提升开放词汇目标检测对未见类别与多尺度目标的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇检测方法存在三点不足：对目标区域的文本引导不足、跨模态对齐策略有限、未充分利用跨层级互补视觉特征，从而限制了未见类别检测与多尺度目标检测性能。
AI.method: 提出Text-Guided Modality Correction Network (TMCNet)：(1) 文本引导模态编码器将文本语义注入query以引导区域特征聚合，缓解表示歧义；(2) 跨模态对齐模块通过视觉-文本特征交互强化区域表示与类别语义的对应；(3) 渐进式文本校正解码器采用自顶向下路径加横向连接，逐尺度融合文本引导的深层语义特征与浅层视觉特征，兼顾语义与空间细节。
AI.result: 在COCO-OVD与LVIS-OVD两个公开数据集上以简单文本查询为引导取得较强性能；扩展至开放词汇分割任务同样获得性能提升，体现跨任务适用性。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导贯穿区域特征提取、跨模态对齐与多尺度解码是提升开放词汇检测的有效设计，且方法具备向开放词汇分割等任务迁移的可扩展性。

title: LoCaR: Localized Canvas Retrieval With Frozen Vision-Language Model
comment: Zero-shot retrieval , Local Retrieval
summary: Whole image embeddings can under represent small objects and local attributes that distinguish relevant images for localized queries. We present LoCaR, a training free framework for localized text to image retrieval with frozen vision language models. LoCaR constructs and utilizes independent proposals (SAM2) focusing on the object so as to get a more localized representation that independently encodes each region using the frozen visual encoder. We further study paired-support adaptation as an optional residual that uses matched text region exemplars without updating the underlying encoders. We also introduce LOCFG, a Visual Genome derived benchmark designed to evaluate localized retrieval for smaller and more challenging referents. Across several vision language backbones, our results show that improving the region representation itself is the main source of gain.

AI.tldr: LoCaR：训练无关的局部化文本-图像检索框架，用SAM2独立提案+冻结VLM区域编码，并提出LOCFG基准。
AI.motivation: 整图嵌入会低估小目标与局部属性，导致局部化查询（localized queries）的图文检索效果差；且不希望重新训练编码器。
AI.method: 冻结视觉语言模型下，利用SAM2围绕目标生成独立提案，对每个区域分别用冻结视觉编码器编码，获得局部化表示；可选paired-support adaptation作为残差，用匹配的文本-区域示例进行无参数更新的适配；另引入基于Visual Genome的LOCFG基准评估小尺寸/困难指代目标的局部化检索。
AI.result: 在多个视觉语言骨干上，性能提升主要来自区域表示本身的改进（而非适配残差）；在LOCFG等基准上局部化检索效果提升。
AI.conclusion: 区域级表示是局部化图文检索的核心增益来源；无需训练、可插拔于冻结VLM的方案有效。

title: DailyBrick: Language-Guided Synthesis of Brick Assembly Instructions
summary: Generating a LEGO model from a user request is more than a plausible 3D shape generation. LEGO models require physical support per brick, and each brick should be placed unblocked. Current methods address this issue by training an expert large language model. We reduce the problem of generating extremely long context on all brick connections to that of writing a program that builds LEGO models like a human, considering each intermediate step could be executed. We introduce DailyBrick , a multi-stage agentic system that produces a LEGO model together with a brick-by-brick assembly instruction for human building and robot assembly. We design a multi-stage harness with roles to help LLMs generate more effectively. A versioned construction SDK compiles multi-level decisions, from semantic subparts to individual bricks, into canonical operations. An external Meta-Reviewer agent replays and inspects the generated package, verifies the model and its construction process, identifies failures, traces them to the responsible stage, and routes them to bounded repairs or to editable candidates for later skill or tool updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DailyBrick generates LEGO models based on simple user requests better than recent agentic systems, and show its utility in downstream applications such as robot manipulations on model assembly from instructions and brick sets ( this https URL ).

AI.tldr: DailyBrick：多阶段智能体系统，通过"写程序式"逐步构建 LEGO 模型，输出积木模型与逐块装配指令，并用元评审代理回放校验。
AI.motivation: 从用户请求生成 LEGO 模型不只是合理的三维形状生成：每块积木需物理支撑、放置过程不被遮挡，是长程、约束耦合的序列决策问题；直接让专家大模型处理全连接长上下文代价高、易出错。
AI.method: 将"全积木连接的长上下文生成"降维为"像人一样写构建程序"：多阶段 harness 为 LLM 分配角色，分语义子部件→单体砖块多层级决策；版本化 Construction SDK 将决策编译为规范化操作；外部 Meta-Reviewer 代理回放并检查生成的模型与装配包，定位失败环节并路由到有界修复或可编辑候选，供后续技能/工具更新。
AI.result: 实验显示在简单用户请求下生成质量优于近期智能体系统；并验证其在机器人按指令与积木集执行装配等下游任务中的可用性。
AI.conclusion: 提出"程序化构建 + 可执行中间步骤 + 失败回溯修复"的智能体框架，可产出物理可行、可被人与机器人复现的装配方案，为可执行装配生成与机器人装配下游应用提供工具化路径。

title: RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time
comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, 10 tables, including appendix
summary: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.

AI.tldr: RoboTeam：4–16 机械臂、仅摄像头输入、实时不停帧的多臂长程任务仿真基准；用自适应（动态 fork 委派）与单一/分层/去中心化三种固定多智能体系统对比，发现尚无模型或系统能同时做到快、便宜、可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人多模态智能体基准存在三点不足：多数只测 1–2 条臂且任务短；智能体思考时暂停世界（非实时）；直接提供物体真值位姿。缺少贴近真实部署的长程、多臂协作、纯视觉、实时评测环境。
AI.method: 构建仿真基准 RoboTeam：智能体仅从相机图像控制 4–16 条机械臂，36 个需协作完成的长程任务（传木料、用数百个方块拼图等）。先考察最灵活的自适应系统（由智能体决定何时 fork 子委派），再与单一智能体、分层、去中心化三种固定多智能体架构在完成数、耗时、token 消耗上对比。
AI.result: 自适应系统下 gpt-6.1-sol 与 opus-5.5 分别完成 28 和 27 个任务，其余四个模型最多 3 个；但典型任务耗 3.5 小时、2.18 亿输入 token，约三分之一步骤至少失败一次需重试。四种系统完成任务数相近：分层与去中心化更快但 token 最多多 1.9 倍，单智能体 token 更少但耗时 1.6 倍，自适应居中。
AI.conclusion: RoboTeam 在早期基准无法覆盖的维度（多臂长程协作、仅视觉输入、世界永不暂停）上量化了当前多模态智能体与多智能体编排的实际上限；结论是没有任何模型或系统同时具备快速、低成本与高可靠性。

title: CEVA: Complementary Evidence Verification via Frame-Level Reorganization for Short-Video Fake News Detection
summary: Short-video platforms are now a common way for the public to follow unfolding events. Their rapid, visually persuasive format also makes fake news easier to spread. Unlike text-image posts, short-video news interleaves multiple modalities and changing scenes, making it difficult to identify which frames verify a claim. Existing detectors either pool sampled frames homogeneously or select them by text-frame similarity. Both overlook that aligned frames may repeat a misleading claim, whereas less dominant context may challenge it. We present CEVA (Complementary Evidence Verification Approach), to our knowledge the first short-video fake news detection framework to explicitly organize frames by their evidential roles before multimodal fusion. Its Dual-Branch Complementary Reorganization (DBCR) module separates explicit-alignment frames from candidate complementary-context frames, and cross-modal fusion with bidirectional contrastive regularization operates on the reorganized evidence. On FakeSV and FakeTT, CEVA achieves the best overall results among the compared methods. Under fixed frame budgets and backbones, DBCR outperforms uniform, random, and similarity-based selection and improves two structurally different detectors. Together, these results establish pre-fusion evidence organization as an effective and transferable component of short-video fake news detection.

AI.tldr: CEVA是首个在跨模态融合前按"证据角色"组织短视频帧的假新闻检测框架，用双分支互补重组模块区分显式对齐帧与互补上下文帧。
AI.motivation: 短视频新闻多模态交织、场景切换频繁，现有检测器要么均匀采样帧，要么按文本-帧相似度选帧，忽视了"对齐帧可能重复误导性主张、而弱势上下文帧才具挑战性"这一点。
AI.method: 提出Dual-Branch Complementary Reorganization（DBCR）模块，将显式对齐帧与候选互补上下文帧分离，并在重组后的证据上做带双向对比正则化的跨模态融合。
AI.result: 在FakeSV与FakeTT上取得对比方法中最优总体结果；固定帧预算与骨干下，DBCR优于均匀、随机、相似度选帧，并使两种结构不同的检测器获得提升。
AI.conclusion: 融合前的证据组织是短视频假新闻检测中有效且可迁移的组件。

title: HandUMI: A Modular Hand-Worn Parallel-Jaw Interface for Robot-Free Bimanual Data Capture
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures
summary: HandUMI captures robot-free bimanual demonstrations with a hand-worn parallel-jaw interface. Swappable fingertips match the robot's installed gripper; Quest/PICO controllers track hands and encoders measure aperture. Robot-agnostic recordings are retargeted by inverse kinematics to seven simulated bimanual arms (median position error $\leq 1.2$ mm; $\leq 4.7$% of episodes rejected). On bimanual towel folding, 562 robot-free demonstrations train policies on real PiPER arms: ACT succeeds in 12/20 attempts and fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ in 7/20; ACT on the first 101 and base $\pi_{0.5}$ each succeed in 0/20. Hardware and software are open source (Apache-2.0), and a pair costs USD 557 with Quest 3S, excluding the optional ZED Mini and host computer. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: HandUMI：手戴式平行夹爪接口 + VR 控制器追踪的无机器双臂示教采集系统，采集的数据经 IK 跨机器人重定向，仅用无机器人示教即可在真实 PiPER 双臂上训练折叠毛巾策略。
AI.motivation: 双臂真实机器人示教采集成本高、与具体机器人绑定；现有手持 UMI 类设备多为单臂，缺乏与机器人夹爪几何一致、可跨本体迁移的双臂无机器人示教方案。
AI.method: 可更换指尖与机器人夹爪几何匹配；Quest/PICO 控制器追踪手部位姿，编码器测量开口；记录与机器人无关的数据，再用逆运动学重定向到 7 种仿真双臂（中位位置误差 ≤1.2 mm，≤4.7% episode 被拒）。
AI.result: 562 条无机器人示教训练真实 PiPER 双臂：ACT 成功 12/20，微调 π0.5 成功 7/20；仅用前 101 条数据的 ACT 与 base π0.5 均 0/20。硬件软件开源（Apache-2.0），含 Quest 3S 一套成本 557 美元。
AI.conclusion: 低成本、开源、机器人无关的双臂示教接口可作为 VLA/模仿学习数据采集基础设施，数据量对策略成功率的提升显著。

title: EgoHandWAM: Probing the Role of Hand Motion in Egocentric World Action Modeling
summary: How much does hand motion tell us about what a first-person camera will see next? EgoHandWAM forecasts three-dimensional wrist and fingertip trajectories and a future visual feature from the current image and recent hand states. We train on 751,065 EgoDex windows using a frozen DINOv2 encoder. On held-out development sessions, the action-only model reduces two-second wrist endpoint error from 60.26 to 56.48~mm relative to a stationary forecast. It still underestimates long reaches. Adding future-feature supervision gives nearly identical trajectory accuracy. With the recorded hand history, the visual head reduces smooth L1 error by 1.32\% relative to copying the current feature. Shuffling histories across sessions erases this gain. In a separate four-task probe, adding recorded future displacements to observed context and future tracking-validity masks reduces visual-feature error by 3.93\%. Masks alone give little improvement. A trajectory predicted from the same observations adds little. On two simulated RoboTwin tasks, substituting aligned human examples for an auxiliary batch of robot examples gives no consistent increase in task success across three training seeds.

AI.tldr: 使用冻结DINOv2编码器与EgoDex数据，联合预测三维手腕/指尖轨迹与未来视觉特征，并检验动作信号对未来视觉预测及机器人任务迁移的有效性。
AI.motivation: 探究第一人称视角下"手部动作"能在多大程度上预测未来视觉内容，并检验人类示范数据辅助机器人学习是否真的有效。
AI.method: 在751,065个EgoDex窗口上训练；冻结DINOv2图像编码器；动作头回归3D手腕与指尖轨迹，视觉头预测未来特征；设置特征拷贝基线、跨session打乱历史消融、四任务探针（加入未来位移与跟踪有效性掩码）、以及RoboTwin两个仿真任务上用对齐人类样本替换机器人辅助批次的训练对比（3个种子）。
AI.result: 仅动作模型将2秒手腕终点误差从60.26 mm降至56.48 mm，但长距离伸展仍被低估；加入未来特征监督几乎不改变轨迹精度。视觉头相对"复制当前特征"降低平滑L1 1.32%，打乱历史后增益消失；探针中加入记录的未来位移与有效性掩码使视觉特征误差降低3.93%，仅掩码提升很小，预测轨迹增益也小。人类样本替换机器人辅助批次在三随机种子下未带来一致的RoboTwin成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 手部动作对未来视觉的增益有限且依赖真实历史动态信息；人类示范对人类自身的动作预测有价值，但对机器人策略训练的迁移收益不稳定，属于偏负面的证据性研究。

title: Unsupervised Multi-modal Medical Image Registration via Invertible Translation
summary: In medical imaging, the alignment of multi-modal images plays a critical role in providing comprehensive information for image-guided therapies. Despite its importance, multi-modal image registration poses significant challenges due to the complex and often unknown spatial relationships between different image modalities. To address this, we introduce a novel unsupervised translation-based multi-modal registration method, termed Invertible Neural Network-based Registration (INNReg). INNReg consists of an image-to-image translation network that converts multi-modal images into mono-modal counterparts and a registration network that uses the translated mono-modal images to align the multi-modal images. Specifically, to ensure the preservation of geometric consistency after image translation, we introduce an Invertible Neural Network (INN) that leverages a dynamic depthwise convolution-based local attention mechanism. Additionally, we design a novel barrier loss function based on Normalized Mutual Information to impose constraints on the registration network, which enhances the registration accuracy. The superior performance of INNReg is demonstrated through experiments on two public multi-modal medical image datasets, including MRI T1/T2 and MRI/CT pairs. The code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: INNReg 用可逆神经网络做多模态图像到单模态的转换，再用转换后的单模态图像做配准，并用基于归一化互信息的 barrier 损失提升精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态医学图像配准中不同模态间的空间关系复杂且未知，难以直接对齐，因此希望借助模态转换简化配准问题。
AI.method: 无监督的翻译-配准联合框架：翻译网络把多模态图像转为单模态；为保持转换前后几何一致性，采用含动态深度可分离卷积局部注意力机制的可逆神经网络（INN）；配准网络基于转换后图像对齐原始多模态图像，并设计基于 NMI 的 barrier 损失约束配准网络。
AI.result: 在 MRI T1/T2 与 MRI/CT 两个公开多模态数据集上取得优于对比方法的配准性能，代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 可逆结构保障的几何一致性转换加 NMI barrier 约束，是多模态配准的有效组合；但方法面向医学图像域，属于域内专用方案。

title: Centroid Spectral Coupling: Implicit Alignment and Representation Diversity in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) aims to align augmented views while preserving representation diversity and preventing collapse. Existing non-contrastive methods often address these goals using multiple weighted loss terms. We introduce Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC), a single-term SSL objective that implicitly couples view alignment, representation diversity, and collapse resistance. CSC constructs centroids from independently normalized augmented-view pairs and applies a ridge-based spectral objective to their uncentered second-moment matrix. Preserving centroid magnitudes encodes view agreement while encouraging balanced representation energy across spectral directions. We establish an exact decomposition into nonnegative alignment and spectral-imbalance components, characterize the geometry of global optima, and derive finite-loss guarantees for alignment and diversity. We also show that complete constant-output collapse is a strict saddle in normalized representation space. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Imagenette show that CSC achieves the highest linear Top-1 accuracy among the evaluated non-contrastive methods on all three benchmarks, and the highest kNN Top-1 accuracy on both CIFAR datasets. A ridge-parameter sensitivity study reveals an empirical alignment--diversity trade-off: increasing $\kappa$ strengthens view alignment but reduces representation effective rank. These results show that a unified spectral objective yields competitive visual representations without explicit contrastive negatives or separately weighted alignment and diversity penalties.

AI.tldr: CSC（Centroid Spectral Coupling）：单一损失项的自监督学习目标，通过归一化增广视图对构建质心并对无中心二阶矩矩阵施加岭正则谱目标，隐式耦合视图对齐、表示多样性与防坍缩。
AI.motivation: 现有非对比式SSL方法通常依赖多个加权损失项分别处理视图对齐、表示多样性与防坍缩，需繁琐的超参平衡。作者希望用一个单一目标同时实现三者。
AI.method: 由独立归一化的增广视图对构造质心；对质心无中心二阶矩矩阵C施加岭正则谱目标（ridge-based spectral objective）。保留质心模长编码视图一致性，同时鼓励各谱方向上表示能量均衡。理论上给出非负对齐项+谱不平衡项的精确分解、全局最优几何刻画、对齐与多样性的有限损失保证，并证明常数输出坍缩为归一化表示空间中的严格鞍点。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Imagenette上，CSC在所评估的非对比方法中线性Top-1最高（三数据集全部），CIFAR两数据集上kNN Top-1也最高。岭参数敏感性研究表明κ增大增强视图对齐但降低表示有效秩，体现经验性对齐—多样性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 统一谱目标可在无显式对比负样本、无单独加权的对齐/多样性惩罚的情况下获得有竞争力的视觉表示，并提供理论保障。

title: HandRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Hand Pose Estimation
comment: Technical report. 25 pages, 17 figures, 18 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Egocentric 3D hand pose estimators still miss hands at the image border, misplace occluded hands and jitter. Such failures are usually fixed by hand-written inference refinements and by fine-tuning, two interdependent steps that are tuned separately. We present HandRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework for a hand pose system that consists of a video estimator and its executable inference harness. In each round, coding agents refine the harness, and a change is accepted only if it improves a composite of all ten benchmark metrics on held-out data without significantly regressing any of them. The accepted harness then guides the estimator through selective distillation, which supervises hand presence and temporal consistency on frames without ground truth, while ground truth supervises pose. Since the updated estimator may change which refinements remain useful, the harness is re-validated on it. Starting from the released ACE-Ego-Hand model, five rounds reduce MPJPE-p by 35% on HOT3D and 11% on ARCTIC and roughly halve jitter. On HOT3D, HandRSI's MPJPE-p is 16% lower than that of ACE-Ego-Hand fine-tuned on the same ground truth. Under a unified protocol, it outperforms nine re-run published methods on all ten metrics of both benchmarks. Hypervolume selection on the accuracy-speed front yields Lite, Medium and Heavy systems running at 20.7 to 41.1 FPS. This report gives the full method, every stage of every round and the complete protocol. Code, evaluator, harnesses and weights are public.

AI.tldr: HandRSI：用编码智能体自动迭代改写"推理后处理harness"，被接受的改动再指导学生模型选择性蒸馏，五轮迭代将HOT3D MPJPE-p降低35%并把抖动减半。
AI.motivation: 第一人称3D手部位姿估计仍存在画面边缘漏检、遮挡手错位与时间抖动；现有做法依赖手工写死的推理修正与模型微调，两步相互耦合却被分别调优，效率与上限都受限。
AI.method: 构建"视频估计器 + 可执行推理harness"的递归自我改进框架。每轮由编码智能体修改harness，仅在留出集上十项指标复合得分提升且无单项显著回退时接受；被接受的harness再通过选择性蒸馏指导估计器（无GT帧上监督手存在性与时间一致性，有GT帧监督位姿），随后在新估计器上复验harness，形成闭环。
AI.result: 以ACE-Ego-Hand为起点，五轮将MPJPE-p在HOT3D降35%、ARCTIC降11%，抖动约减半；HOT3D上比同GT微调的ACE-Ego-Hand低16%；统一协议下在两项基准全部十项指标上优于九个复现方法；精度-速度前沿给出20.7–41.1 FPS的Lite/Medium/Heavy三档。
AI.conclusion: 验证了"智能体自动精化推理管线 + 蒸馏闭环保一致性"对第一人称手部位姿估计的有效性，且性能与延迟可按需配置；但harness需求随模型更新变化，需持续复验，同时对比基线均在自建统一协议下复现，需谨慎看待外部可比性。

title: Not All Evidence Is Admissible: Evidence Governance for Tool-Augmented Medical Agents
comment: 11 pages
summary: Tool-augmented medical agents treat whatever their tools return as evidence. We show that this default is costly: medical tools fail silently, and a frozen reasoner cannot ignore what enters its context, so many cases it would have answered correctly are flipped to wrong once tool outputs are added. We call this evidence hijacking. $\mathcal{V}$-information explains the phenomenon: the reasoner has lost the option to ignore, so a tool output can carry negative usable information, and moving the decision of what to keep outside the reasoner restores that option. The theory further shows that part of any filtering gain comes merely from letting the reasoner see less, and only selection by content lets it see better. Building on this, we recast tool-augmented reasoning as evidence governance, which separates deciding what counts as evidence from the reasoner that answers, and propose context-independent evidence governance (CIEG), the first medical agent framework that rules, after acquisition, on whether each individual tool output may enter as evidence. Every tool output is written as a card that can be checked against the raw input; an independent checker that sees only the input and the cards decides which cards become evidence; and the reasoner answers from the admitted cards alone, with no training anywhere. On medical question answering, fundus glaucoma screening, and chest X-ray pneumonia classification, it achieves the highest accuracy among models of comparable scale, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art tool-using agents and multi-agent systems built on the same backbone at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 提出"证据劫持"现象：冻结的推理器无法忽略工具输出，有害工具输出会使其从正确翻转为错误；据此将工具增强推理重构为"证据治理"，提出无需训练的CIEG框架，由独立检查器裁决每条工具输出能否作为证据进入推理上下文，在医学QA、眼底青光眼筛查、胸片肺炎分类上以更低成本优于同类规模模型与SOTA工具智能体。
AI.motivation: 工具增强医学智能体默认把工具返回当作证据，但医学工具会"静默失败"，而冻结的推理器无法忽略已进入上下文的错误输出，导致原本可答对的样本被翻转成错误，需要把"什么算证据"的判断移出推理器。
AI.method: 以V-information给出理论解释（失去"忽略"选项使工具输出可携带负可用信息）；将推理重构为证据治理，分离证据裁决与作答；每条工具输出写成可与原始输入核对的"卡片"，由仅见输入+卡片的独立检查器裁定准入，推理器仅基于准入卡片作答，全程无训练。
AI.result: 在医学问答、眼底青光眼筛查、胸片肺炎分类三类任务上，同等规模模型中精度最高，并以更低成本显著优于同骨干的SOTA工具使用智能体与多智能体系统；理论还指出过滤收益部分仅来自"让推理器看得更少"，只有基于内容的选择才实现"看得更好"。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强智能体的瓶颈在于证据准入而非推理能力，将"证据裁决"与"作答"解耦、以内容为依据做上下文无关的准入过滤，可在零训练下稳定提升准确率并降低成本。

title: CueClash: Frontier Vision-Language Models Judge 3-D Relations Close to the Picture Plane
summary: A vision-language model (VLM) can judge 3-D relations from the picture or from the ground layout. In photographs the two usually agree. We separate them with CueClash, rendered scenes in which the 2-D cue for each of five relations is right on exactly half the statements. The shortcut gap is accuracy when the cue is right minus accuracy when it is wrong. For Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.6 Flash at low reasoning effort it is +18 to +37 percentage points. It is +7 to +29 without two relations whose cue-wrong items are confounded with borderline cases or occlusion. Given ground coordinates and each relation's definition, they answer 99 to 100% correctly. Pixel measurements with camera depths remove most of the gap for objects fitting through openings. The failure lies in the step from the picture to the layout. The maps that the models draw of the scene from above mostly keep the depth order but, like the picture, shorten depth. GPT-5.5's maps stay close to a copy of the picture. Opus 5.5's and Gemini's maps undo about 0.6 of this shortening. Gemini's then shrink all depths by a further uniform factor. Opus 5.5 follows the picture mainly on fits, and its maps correct depth about as much as human observers of real scenes do. The three models also lose accuracy on CV-Bench photographs where a reliable 2-D cue misleads. In two open models the layout information reaches the language model, but their maps lose much of it.

AI.tldr: 提出CueClash诊断基准，解耦VLM中"2D图像线索"与"地平面布局"两类证据，发现三大模型在五类3D关系中存在+18~+37pp的捷径差距，且给定真实坐标后准确率达99~100%。
AI.motivation: 照片中2D线索与地平面布局通常一致，导致无法判断VLM的3D关系判断究竟依赖哪一路证据；需要可控地制造两者冲突以量化捷径依赖，并定位失败环节（感知→布局推理）。
AI.method: 构建CueClash渲染场景，对五种3D关系中每条的2D线索恰好在半数语句上正确；定义"捷径差距"=线索正确时准确率−线索错误时准确率。在Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.6 Flash上评测，并辅以给定地面坐标的对照、带相机深度的像素测量、俯视地图重建分析及真实照片CV-Bench验证，另对两个开源模型做内部表征探测。
AI.result: 低推理努力下捷径差距+18~+37pp（排除两类混淆关系后+7~+29pp）；给定坐标与关系定义则99~100%正确；像素+深度测量对可穿洞口物体基本消除差距；俯视地图多保留深度序但压缩深度，GPT-5.5近似照抄图像，Opus与Gemini恢复约0.6的压缩量，Gemini再施加全局均匀缩放；在CV-Bench真实照片上同样因可靠2D线索误导而掉分；开源模型中布局信息能到达语言层但地图已大量丢失。
AI.conclusion: 失败点不在3D关系推理本身，而在"图像→布局"的几何建构这一步：模型过度依赖2D捷径，自生成俯视图被图像先验污染，导致深度压缩与系统性误差。

title: SRED: Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation Across Magnifications in Whole-Slide Imaging
comment: CVPR 2027 submission
summary: In computational pathology, high-magnification whole-slide image analysis preserves tissue detail but requires encoding many patches, whereas lower magnification reduces computation by covering a higher field of view per patch while sacrificing detail. Existing cross-magnification distillation matches features that often encode detail unreachable by low-magnification input, sometimes requiring slide-level labels that limit scalability. To address those issues, we introduce Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation (SRED), which transfers regional event occurrences that encode reachable high-level interactions between details without slide-level labels. We use a sparse autoencoder (SAE) to learn an event dictionary from 20x teacher features. Logical OR pooling records whether each event is detected in any spatially aligned patch, retaining both localized and shared evidence within the corresponding 5x region. A pretrained 5x encoder is fine-tuned to predict these regional targets without slide-level labels. Visual analysis identifies dictionary components responsive to recognizable histological patterns, supporting target interpretation. Compared with native 5x features, SRED improves average macro-F1 by 1.1 points across seven classification and grading cohorts and average C-index by 1.7 points across five survival cohorts. Runtime matches native 5x, with an average 11.58x speedup over 20x.

AI.tldr: SRED 用稀疏自编码器从 20x 教师特征中学习"事件字典"，通过逻辑 OR 池化得到区域级二值目标，让 5x 学生编码器在无需切片级标签的情况下对齐可达到的高层区域证据，从而提升低倍率分类/生存预测性能并保持与原生 5x 相同的推理开销。
AI.motivation: 高倍率全切片图像细节丰富但patch数量巨大、计算昂贵；低倍率单patch覆盖视野大但细节损失。现有跨倍率蒸馏直接匹配特征，而高倍特征的细节在低倍输入中根本不可达，属于"不可达目标"；部分方法依赖切片级标签，限制可扩展性。
AI.method: 1) 用预训练20x编码器提取patch特征；2) 训练稀疏自编码器(SAE)学习过完备事件字典，将特征分解为稀疏"事件是否发生"表示；3) 对空间对齐到同一5x区域的多个20x patch的事件激活做逻辑OR池化，得到区域级出现判定，保留局部与共享证据；4) 以该区域目标微调预训练5x编码器，无需切片标签；5) 用可视化验证字典分量的组织学可解释性。
AI.result: 在7个分类/分级队列上macro-F1平均提升1.1点；5个生存队列上C-index平均提升1.7点（相对原生5x特征）；运行时与原生5x相当，相比20x平均加速11.58倍。可视化显示部分字典分量对应可识别的组织学模式。
AI.conclusion: 将跨倍率蒸馏从"特征匹配"重构为"区域级可达到证据的事件发生迁移"，在无标签、低倍率低算力约束下获得稳定性能增益，并保持可解释性与部署友好性。

title: Haptic Probing for Subsurface-Aware Force Distribution on Layered Soft Tissue
summary: Force-regulated contact with layered soft tissue fails most often where the subsurface composition changes: controllers infer the substrate from the loading signal alone, so the estimate guiding them lags the change---more acutely, we argue, over compliant than over bone-backed tissue. We remove that lag with a separate haptic channel. Under a light preload, a brief low-amplitude excitation lets the local dynamic admittance discriminate muscle from bone-backed tissue relative to a per-subject baseline, before task force is applied---active haptic sensing used to commit a control decision rather than to characterise tissue. A force- and tactile-driven distribution law then consumes that regime throughout execution: an instantaneous allocation equalises pressure across the engaged fingertips, while the regime sets the admissible pressure and hence the area the hand must recruit to deliver the target force---making patch area a controlled variable rather than a by-product. Probing, switches and recruitment are priced in a partitioned passivity budget, so safety monitoring cannot suppress the probe and a refused recruitment forfeits force tracking rather than the pressure bound. We report force tracking and pressure uniformity over curved, migrating contact on three human subjects, with regime labels from anatomical landmarks.

AI.tldr: 利用轻预载下的短时低幅主动触觉激励，通过局部动态导纳与个体基线对比，在施加任务力之前判别“肌肉”与“骨支撑”软组织；随后用“力-触觉驱动”的分配律实现指端压力均衡与接触面积作为受控变量，并以分区无源性预算为探测/切换/招募定价以保证安全性。
AI.motivation: 力调控接触分层软组织时，失效多发生在亚表面成分改变处；仅凭加载信号推断基质的估计滞后于实际变化，且在柔软组织上比骨支撑组织更严重。作者试图在施加任务力前消除该滞后，使“组织状态”成为控制决策的先验而非事后估计。
AI.method: (1) 独立的触觉通道：轻预载下施加短暂低幅激励，以局部动态导纳相对个体基线做二分类（柔软/骨支撑），属主动触觉感知但用于提交控制决策；(2) 力-触觉驱动的分配律：瞬时分配使已接触指端压力均衡，同时由组织状态决定允许压力上限，从而决定需招募的接触面积，使接触面积成为受控变量；(3) 分区无源性预算：对探测、模式切换与指端招募分别计价，保证安全监控不会抑制探测，且拒绝招募时优先放弃力跟踪而非突破压力界。
AI.result: 在三个受试者上、曲面且迁移的接触条件下报告了力跟踪与压力均匀性结果；组织状态标签由解剖标志给出。
AI.conclusion: 将“基质判别”从加载信号的事后推断转为预载期的主动单次探测，并把接触面积提升为受控量，配合分区无源性预算，可在分层软组织上兼顾力跟踪精度、压力上限与安全约束。

title: MIRAGE: Motion Identity Reduction via Autoregressive Generative Encoding for Privacy-Preserving Skeleton-based Motion Data
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables
summary: Skeleton motion identifies people through body proportions and movement style, and skeleton streams are increasingly passed to third-party analytics that run action classifiers trained on raw data. A prior adversarial anonymizer adds a per-frame residual in the raw coordinate space but sees one frame at a time; motion retargeting needs a target skeleton and complete sequences, which rules out online use. We present MIRAGE, a target-free, causal anonymizer that adds an identity-reducing residual to each incoming frame in the raw coordinate space, computed by attention over past frames. One causal, optionally windowed mask governs every attention in a rotary-position encoder-decoder, and key/value caches let the trained function run frame by frame; on all 56,578 NTU 60 sequences, batched and streaming outputs differ by at most 7.2e-6 m. Reported results use an unbounded window, so per-stream state grows with stream length. We evaluate against a passive adversary that applies raw-trained identity models and an adaptive adversary that trains on the anonymizer's output, treating the adaptive adversary as the headline, on NTU RGB+D 60 over five generator seeds, alongside the per-frame residual anonymizer of Moon et al. trained identically. When consumers retrain on the released data, MIRAGE keeps 83.9% action recognition (raw 89.1%; Moon et al. 88.7%) while a retrained identity classifier reaches 43.4% re-identification (RI) over 40 subjects, against 69.4% for Moon et al. and 75.4% on raw data. The strongest adaptive attacker still reaches 49.3% (chance 2.5%), so MIRAGE reduces identity leakage; it does not anonymize. Against raw-trained (frozen) classifiers, MIRAGE lowers RI below the strongest retargeting baseline (10.36% vs. 22.09%), but frozen action recognition falls to 37.04% (vs. 75.82%), so at full residual scale it is not a drop-in replacement for raw input to existing frozen models.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE：面向骨架运动流的无目标、因果（逐帧、可流式）匿名化器，用带单一因果掩码的 RoPE 编码-解码注意力对历史帧建模，逐帧加残差以削弱身份信息。
AI.motivation: 骨架流常被上传给第三方分析（其动作分类器在原始数据上训练），而骨架本身可通过体型比例与运动风格识别身份。已有工作的不足：Moon et al. 的对抗匿名器在原始坐标空间逐帧加残差但只看单帧；motion retargeting 需要目标骨架与完整序列，无法在线使用。
AI.method: 在原始坐标空间对每个到来帧加身份削减残差，残差由对历史帧的注意力计算得到；采用带旋转位置编码的编码器-解码器，所有注意力共享同一因果（可选加窗）掩码；用 KV 缓存实现训练所得函数的逐帧流式推理（批式与流式输出误差 ≤7.2e-6 m，覆盖 NTU 60 全部 56,578 条序列）。在 NTU RGB+D 60、5 个生成器种子下，与同等训练的 Moon et al. 逐帧残差匿名器对比，评估被动攻击者（冻结的原始训练身份模型）与自适应攻击者（在匿名输出上重训，作为主要设置）。
AI.result: 消费者在发布数据上重训时：动作识别保持 83.9%（原始 89.1%、Moon et al. 88.7%）；重训身份分类器在 40 个受试者上的重识别率（RI）为 43.4%，对比 Moon et al. 69.4%、原始 75.4%；最强自适应攻击者仍达 49.3%（随机 2.5%）。对冻结的原始训练分类器，RI 降至 10.36%（优于最强 retargeting 基线 22.09%），但冻结动作识别跌至 37.04%（基线 75.82%），全残差强度下不能直接替换现有模型的原始输入。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE 首次实现无目标、因果、逐帧流式的骨架匿名化，显著降低身份泄漏（RI 从 75.4%/69.4% 降至 43.4%，冻结模型设置下 10.36%），但并非真正匿名（最强自适应攻击仍 49.3%，远高于随机 2.5%）；且全残差强度下破坏冻结模型的动作识别性能，仅在消费者重训场景下可用。局限在于无界窗口下每流状态随流长增长，需研究加窗版本。

title: ARG-Avatar: Animation-Rendering Guidance for Efficient Feedforward Avatar Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing animatable 3D human avatars from images is important for applications such as gaming and augmented reality. Feedforward methods make avatar reconstruction accessible by reducing inference time to a few seconds, but recent approaches rely heavily on scaling model capacity, training data, and computation. We ask whether such scaling is necessary. To this end, we introduce ARG-Avatar, an efficient feedforward framework with only 68M trainable parameters that achieves SOTA reconstruction quality. Our key insight is that 3D animation and rendering already provide strong geometric correspondences that existing methods largely attempt to learn from data. In light of this, we design the Foreground Avatar Coordinate RoPE attention (FACRoPE) and Intermediate Token Rendering (ITR) pipeline to guide avatar tokens to attend to their corresponding patches. Experiments across multiple datasets show that ARG-Avatar consistently outperforms prior methods when using two or more input images. Compared with LHM++, ARG-Avatar uses approximately 9$\times$ fewer trainable parameters, 4.8$\times$ fewer training sequences, and 14$\times$ less training compute, while running 6$\times$ faster and achieving a 2.7 dB PSNR improvement on the out-of-distribution NeuMan benchmark.

AI.tldr: ARG-Avatar: 68M参数的轻量前馈可动画3D人体头像重建框架，利用3D动画与渲染提供的几何对应先验设计FACRoPE注意力与ITR管线，达到SOTA并大幅降低训练/推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈人体头像重建方法依赖模型容量、数据与算力的规模化扩张，本文质疑这种scaling的必要性，指出3D动画与渲染本身已提供强几何对应关系，而现有方法却试图从数据中重新学习。
AI.method: 提出ARG-Avatar前馈框架（仅68M可训练参数）：Foreground Avatar Coordinate RoPE注意力（FACRoPE）将前景头像坐标编码进RoPE以引导avatar token关注对应图像patch；Intermediate Token Rendering（ITR）管线在中间层进行token级渲染，强化token与patch的对应约束。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，输入≥2张图像时一致优于先前方法；相比LHM++，可训练参数少约9倍、训练序列少4.8倍、训练算力少14倍，推理快6倍，在分布外NeuMan基准上PSNR提升2.7 dB。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入3D动画/渲染的几何对应先验可替代大规模scaling，实现高效且泛化性更强的可动画人体头像前馈重建。

title: Joint-ID: Transformer-based Joint Image Enhancement and Depth Estimation for Underwater Environments

summary: Underwater imaging is a challenging task due to factors such as scattering, absorption, and turbulence, which degrade image quality and limit visibility. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for enhancing underwater images that leverages the benefits of joint learning for simultaneous image enhancement and depth estimation. We introduce Joint-ID, a transformer-based neural network that can obtain high-perceptual image quality and depth information from raw underwater images. Our approach formulates a multi-modal objective function that addresses invalid depth, lack of sharpness, and image degradation based on color and local texture. We design an end-to-end training pipeline that enables joint restoration and depth estimation in a shared hierarchical feature space. Additionally, we propose a synthetic dataset with various distortions and scene depths for multi-task learning. We evaluate Joint-ID on synthetic and standard datasets, as well as real underwater images with diverse spectra and harsh turbidity, demonstrating its effectiveness for underwater image enhancement and depth estimation. Furthermore, we demonstrate the ability of Joint-ID to perform feature matching and saliency detection for visually guided underwater robots. Our proposed method has the potential to improve the visual perception of underwater environments and benefit applications such as oceanography and underwater robotics. AI.tldr: Joint-ID：基于Transformer的水下图像增强与深度估计联合学习框架，配套多模态目标函数、端到端分层共享特征训练流程与合成数据集。
