AI.motivation: 水下成像受散射、吸收与湍流影响，图像质量退化、可见度低，单一增强或单深度估计难以相互促进；作者希望利用图像增强与深度估计的互补性提升水下视觉感知。
AI.method: 提出Joint-ID（Transformer网络），从原始水下图像同时输出高感知质量图像与深度；设计涵盖无效深度、清晰度缺失、颜色与局部纹理退化的多模态联合目标函数；在共享分层特征空间中端到端联合训练；并构建含多种退化与场景深度的合成数据集用于多任务学习。
AI.result: 在合成数据集、标准数据集及多光谱、高浑浊度真实水下图像上验证了增强与深度估计有效性；并展示其支持特征匹配与显著性检测，可用于水下机器人视觉引导。
AI.conclusion: 联合增强—深度估计的共享特征学习可提升水下视觉感知，具备服务海洋学与水下机器人应用的潜力；但主要在合成与标准数据集评测，缺乏实机部署与开源代码证据。

title: ExplicitIR: Explicit Spatial Policy Fields for All-in-One Image Restoration
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables
summary: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover clean images blindly from inputs with various degradation types and levels using a single model. However, the adaptation policy in most existing methods remains implicitly encoded in feature representations, leaving the restoration decision neither explicitly represented nor independently controllable. Since real-world degradations vary spatially, applying uniform updates across the entire image leads to over-smoothing of clean areas and under-correction of localized degradations. To address these limitations, we present ExplicitIR, which represents the restoration policy as two explicit per-pixel fields: Budget, which determines where and how strongly to update, and Style, which selects between narrow and wide context windows. Specifically, ExplicitIR incorporates a Spatial Policy Estimator (SPE) to predict these fields, explicitly representing the restoration policy and capturing spatially-varying degradations, which are then applied by Policy-Adaptive Decoder Blocks (PADB) through adaptive fusion of narrow- and wide-window responses, enabling independent control and precise local modulation. This design enables spatially-adaptive restoration in a single forward pass, without requiring task labels, prompts, or test-time degradation estimators. Extensive experiments on three-task and five-task benchmarks demonstrate that ExplicitIR achieves performance competitive with the strongest all-in-one baselines.

AI.tldr: ExplicitIR 将一体化图像复原策略显式表示为逐像素的 Budget（更新位置与强度）和 Style（窄/宽上下文窗口选择）两个场，由空间策略估计器预测、策略自适应解码块执行，无需任务标签与测试时退化估计。
AI.motivation: 现有一体化复原方法的自适应策略隐含在特征表示中，决策既不可显式表示也无法独立控制；且真实退化具有空间异质性，全图统一更新会导致干净区域过度平滑、局部退化欠校正。
AI.method: 提出 ExplicitIR：用 Spatial Policy Estimator (SPE) 预测两个显式逐像素场——Budget 场决定更新位置与强度，Style 场在窄窗口与宽窗口上下文之间选择；再由 Policy-Adaptive Decoder Blocks (PADB) 对窄/宽窗口响应进行自适应融合并施加局部调制，可在单次前向中实现空间自适应复原，且不依赖任务标签、提示或测试时退化估计器。
AI.result: 在三任务与五任务基准上的大量实验表明，ExplicitIR 性能与最强的 all-in-one 基线相当（competitive）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式化并解耦复原策略的空间决策，可在单一模型、单次前向中实现可控的空间自适应复原，为一体化图像复原提供了可解释、可局部调控的策略表示范式。

title: TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception
comment: 13 pages. (c) 2024 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization. In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出轻量多任务水下视觉系统 TRIDENT：共享 backbone + 三个并行解码器，联合完成图像增强、深度估计与不确定性建模，兼顾效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 水下光传播导致纹理模糊、色彩对比度低，严重削弱机器人稳定作业时的视觉感知，而现有方法多为单任务、难以在内存与推理时间上满足实时三维视觉需求。
AI.method: 设计端到端学习式感知系统：单一 backbone 共享特征，接三个并行解码器分别输出增强图像、深度与不确定性；采用轻量化、快速结构并支持复杂参数化训练；以联合学习方式从 2D 扩展至 3D 视觉任务。
AI.result: 在多个标准数据集上，图像增强与深度估计均显著优于现有方法；尽管同时执行三项任务，内存占用与推理时间仍优于对比方法；联合学习提升了特征匹配鲁棒性，并验证了从 2D 向 3D 视觉任务的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 多任务共享特征的轻量设计可在水下场景中以更低算力成本获得更优的增强、深度与不确定性输出，为水下机器人三维感知提供可行方案；但摘要未给出实机水下作业验证，泛化性仍需实测确认。

title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables
summary: Weight-space programming (WSP) lets a language model construct executable weight updates for another network. We study diffusion concept editing through an interface in which programs define training contexts, preservation constraints and update directions, while a shared numerical fitter selects their coefficients. We compare generated programs with published editors, a shared-panel hand-written baseline and budget-matched search over conventional edits on 24 TIMED test edits for Stable Diffusion 1.4. The preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over the strong baseline. In an exploratory comparison, one-shot Astra programs improve fresh-scene VLM joint success, which requires subject presence together with whole-image target matching, by +10.0 points over the shared-panel baseline, while CLIP relative match shows no detectable change. These programs organise adjustable directions around protected text-state subspaces. Probing and rewriting the Astra programs then raises CLIP by +6.2 points while joint success changes by -9.7. On a fixed 144-image sample, five additional evaluators give point estimates in the same directions under whole-image target matching; checks of subject-local change give less decisive differences. Together, these results identify useful behaviour in complete generated programs and show that score-guided revision need not preserve it: program construction and revision should be evaluated as distinct stages of a WSP pipeline.

AI.tldr: 用"程序+共享数值拟合器"的权重空间编程(WSP)接口做扩散模型概念编辑，发现预注册改写流程无优势，但一次性生成程序在全新场景VLM联合成功上+10.0，且分数引导的改写会破坏该优势。
AI.motivation: 检验权重空间编程是否能为扩散模型生成可执行的概念编辑程序，并区分"程序构造"与"程序改写"两个阶段各自的效果。
AI.method: 构建WSP接口：程序定义训练上下文、保持约束与更新方向，共享数值拟合器求解系数；在Stable Diffusion 1.4的24个TIMED测试编辑上对比生成程序、已发表编辑器、共享面板手写基线与等预算搜索；并做程序探测/改写实验与5名额外评测者复核（144图固定样本）。
AI.result: 预注册改写流程相对强基线无优势；探索性比较中Astra一次性程序在全新场景VLM联合成功上+10.0点（CLIP相对匹配无显著变化）；对Astra程序探测改写后CLIP +6.2点但联合成功-9.7点；其余评测者点估计方向一致，主体局部变化结论较弱。
AI.conclusion: 完整生成程序内部存在有用行为，但分数引导的改写未必保留它；WSP流水线应将程序构造与程序改写作为两个独立阶段分别评测。

title: From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary video in the ancillary files. Dataset: this https URL
summary: On legged robots, sustained locomotion often ends in thermal shutdown rather than battery depletion: the heat of walking concentrates in a few joint motors, which overheat long before the battery is empty. We train thermally aware locomotion policies by reinforcement learning without ever observing temperature, and demonstrate this on a Unitree Go2 quadruped. We first identify a coupled 13-node lumped RC thermal network, fitted on two runs of a single robot and calibrated against the measured electrical power, that predicts all twelve motor temperatures with a mean RMSE below 1 $^\circ$C across different robot instances, gaits, payloads, and speeds. Under a sustained gait, the temperatures the motors will settle at follow directly from the gait-averaged squared torques and joint speeds. Our core contribution is a reward that drives down the hottest predicted asymptotes: thermal time constants exceed the credit-assignment horizon of reinforcement learning by orders of magnitude, but predicted asymptotes respond to torque and joint speed within a single gait cycle, so the policy learns to lower and spread heat with no temperature input. On the robot, the policy turns sustained locomotion from temperature-limited to battery-limited: with a 5 kg payload at 1 m/s, a learned baseline reaches thermal shutdown after 19 minutes (1.1 km), whereas our policy runs the battery down after 174 minutes (10.0 km) with its hottest motor 14 $^\circ$C below the shutdown threshold in a 26 $^\circ$C room; on an unloaded factory circuit with stairs and ramps, the baseline overheats after 25 laps (6.2 km), while our policy completes 47 (11.2 km) on one battery with 22 $^\circ$C of margin.

AI.tldr: 训练足式机器人热感知运动策略，无需温度输入，通过预测稳态温度渐近值的奖励分散关节热负荷，将Go2持续行走从热关机限制(19min/1.1km)提升为电池限制(174min/10.0km)。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人持续行走的真正瓶颈是少数关节电机过热导致热关机，而非电池耗尽；但热时间常数远超强化学习的信用分配视野，且温度难以实时观测，难以直接优化。
AI.method: 在Unitree Go2上：1) 用两次单机器人运行拟合13节点集总RC热网络，并以实测电功率校准，跨机器人个体、步态、负载、速度均预测12个电机温度，平均RMSE<1℃；2) 推导稳态温度由步态平均的力矩平方与关节速度决定，将其作为RL奖励项驱动最热渐近温度下降并分散热负荷，策略无需温度输入，在单个步态周期内即可获得梯度响应。
AI.result: 5kg负载1m/s下，基线19分钟(1.1km)热关机，本策略174分钟(10.0km)耗尽电池，最热电机低于阈值14℃(26℃室温)；带楼梯斜坡的无载环路，基线25圈(6.2km)过热，本策略单电池47圈(11.2km)且余量22℃。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理热模型的稳态渐近近似重构奖励信号，可在无温度观测条件下学到热感知运动策略，将足式机器人的持续作业能力从热限制转为电池限制，且模型具有跨个体跨工况泛化能力。

title: CoSphere-SLAM: Multi-Agent Panoramic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Spherical Loop Closure
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project website: this https URL
summary: Dense collaborative mapping is essential for search and rescue, building inspection, and warehouse automation, where panoramic cameras capture the entire surroundings in a single frame. Unlike pinhole agents that share views only at similar headings, panoramic agents observe overlapping scenes at any 3D orientation, yet searching full rotations also produces mutually consistent false loop closures across distinct symmetric rooms. Moreover, continuous monocular scale drift splits rigidly merged maps at revisited surfaces, while depth noise at short baselines distorts loop translation directions. To address these challenges, we propose CoSphere-SLAM, the first multi-agent Gaussian splatting SLAM framework for panoramic cameras, whose spherical loop closure aligns spherical features over $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ via fast Fourier correlation across arbitrary orientations and rejects symmetric false closures through global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ consensus. Building on these closures, directional global optimization solves a per-keyframe $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ pose graph with log-scale regularization to correct scale drift while separating optical-flow translation directions from depth-based magnitudes. Finally, omnidirectional Gaussian fusion transforms each Gaussian with its keyframe similarity and renders Gaussians at their maximum ray response to jointly refine poses and maps. Experiments on indoor and cross-session multi-agent panoramic benchmarks demonstrate that CoSphere-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art trajectory accuracy and rendering quality among single-agent and multi-agent methods. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: CoSphere-SLAM 是首个面向全景相机的多智能体 Gaussian Splatting SLAM 框架，通过 SO(3) 球面特征 FFT 相关做回环、Sim(3) 全局一致性剔除对称假回环，并用方向性全局优化与全向高斯融合联合优化位姿与地图。
AI.motivation: 全景相机的多智能体稠密协同建图对搜救、建筑巡检与仓储自动化有重要价值。但全景智能体可在任意 3D 朝向下观测重叠区域，若穷举全旋转搜索会产生跨对称房间的互相一致假回环；同时单目连续尺度漂移会导致重访表面处刚性合并地图断裂，短基线下的深度噪声又扭曲回环平移方向。
AI.method: 1) 球面回环：在 SO(3) 上用快速傅里叶相关对齐球面特征，支持任意朝向；并用全局 Sim(3) 一致性投票剔除对称性导致的假回环。2) 方向性全局优化：求解带对数尺度正则化的逐关键帧 Sim(3) 位姿图，纠正尺度漂移，并将光流估计的平移方向与深度估计的平移模长解耦。3) 全向高斯融合：用各关键帧的相似变换变换高斯，并按最大射线响应渲染高斯，联合精化位姿与地图。
AI.result: 在室内与跨会话多智能体全景基准上，CoSphere-SLAM 在单智能体与多智能体方法中均取得领先（SOTA）的轨迹精度与渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将全景多智能体协同、Gaussian Splatting 稠密建图与鲁棒回环/尺度一致性优化统一在一个框架内，为全景多机器人稠密 SLAM 提供了可行范式。

title: Cross3DGS: Unified Vulkan-Based 3D Gaussian Splatting Training from Workstations to Mobile Devices
comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027 Workshop on Eyes of the Future (EOF). 19 pages including appendix
summary: Scenes captured with handheld and wearable cameras are still shipped to a CUDA workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) training. Training on the device that captured them, or on its companion phone or laptop, requires more than translating kernels: GPUs and drivers differ in parallel features, memory limits, and command submission, and these differences decide whether a training schedule executes and returns the correct update. We present Cross3DGS, a cross-vendor, cross-platform Vulkan trainer that keeps one optimizer and chooses its execution schedule per device in two steps: rules on device limits, workload size, and observed driver failures exclude the schedules known not to run correctly, and a fixed preference order selects one of the remaining feasible schedules. The same core completes standard-quality training (30k updates, one million Gaussians) on every configuration we measured, spanning NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD, and Apple GPUs and including Android devices and an iPhone, whereas the existing portable trainers VkSplat and Brush do not run on some of the mobile GPUs. Averaged over 11 scenes on a workstation, Cross3DGS has higher quality than VkSplat with no significant difference in training time, and Brush reports about three times the training time at comparable quality. The final quality of Cross3DGS is nearly identical across devices. A mobile application turns a handheld capture into a viewable model entirely on the device.

AI.tldr: 提出 Cross3DGS，一个跨厂商、跨平台的 Vulkan 3DGS 训练器：同一优化器，按设备限制、负载规模与观测到的驱动失败以规则筛选调度，再按固定偏好序选择可行调度，从而在 NVIDIA/Intel/Arm/Qualcomm/AMD/Apple 等 GPU（含 Android 与 iPhone）上完成标准质量训练。
AI.motivation: 手持/可穿戴相机采集的场景仍需回传 CUDA 工作站做 3DGS 训练。要在采集设备或其配套手机/笔记本上训练，不能只做 kernel 移植：GPU 与驱动在并行特性、内存上限、命令提交上存在差异，决定训练调度能否正确执行并返回正确更新。
AI.method: Cross3DGS：跨厂商、跨平台 Vulkan 训练器，单一优化器 + 按设备自适应调度选择。两步法：(1) 基于设备限制、负载规模与已观测驱动失败的规则，排除已知不能正确运行的调度；(2) 在剩余可行调度中按固定偏好序选一个。此外提供端侧移动应用，把手持采集直接转为可查看的模型。
AI.result: 在所有实测配置（NVIDIA、Intel、Arm、Qualcomm、AMD、Apple GPU，含 Android 与 iPhone）上完成 30k 次更新、百万高斯的标准质量训练；对比可移植训练器 VkSplat 与 Brush：后者部分移动 GPU 无法运行。工作站 11 个场景平均质量高于 VkSplat 且训练时间无显著差异；Brush 在可比质量下训练时间约为 3 倍。跨设备最终质量几乎一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过调度层的设备自适应而非 kernel 移植，可在异构 GPU 与移动端实现与 CUDA 工作站相当质量的 3DGS 训练，并支持完全端侧的手持采集到可视模型流程，为端侧/跨平台 3DGS 训练提供可用路径。

title: PhyVGGT: Feed-Forward Articulated Object Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Reconstructing an articulated object with its 3D movable parts, joint parameters and unseen articulation states from an uncalibrated monocular video is essential for robot manipulation and interactive digital twins. Existing per-scene optimisation methods require minutes to hours and external depth or camera poses, whereas feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct dense point maps in one pass without segmenting movable parts or inferring joints. Even on these monocular point maps, regressing or fitting continuous joints directly fails on casual videos, since cross-frame attention blurs moving part boundaries in deep layers, underestimates motion along the viewing ray and leaves continuous axes ill-conditioned under small opening angles. To address these challenges, we propose PhyVGGT, a single-pass framework on a frozen 3D foundation model that anchors moving-part matching and closed-form joint estimation to the undistorted geometry of the stationary base. First, our Part and Motion Decoder fuses intermediate per-frame tokens with global tokens and references part queries to a static-base query to segment 3D parts, align point maps on the static base and predict learned Bingham priors. Second, our Kinematic Inference Layer fits an orthogonal Manhattan frame to static surface normals, selects the joint axis in closed form under a Bingham posterior combining pairwise motion scatter with the learned priors, and solves a linear system for the hinge pivot to drive unseen states. Trained solely on synthetic data, PhyVGGT achieves state-of-the-art monocular performance across five benchmarks, outperforming FAMOS and monocular ArtiPoint, surpassing posed RGB-D ArtiPoint in median error, and running in 6.8 s per 48-frame video against hours of per-scene optimisation in Articulat3D. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: PhyVGGT：在冻结的3D基础模型上单次前向重建关节物体，通过部件/运动解码器加闭式运动学推断（Manhattan框架+Bingham先验轴选择+线性求铰链枢轴），仅用合成数据训练，5个基准达SOTA，48帧视频6.8秒。
AI.motivation: 从无标定单目视频重建关节物体的可动部件、关节参数与未见关节状态，对机器人操作和交互式数字孪生很重要。但现有逐场景优化需数分钟到数小时且依赖外部深度或相机位姿；前馈3D基础模型虽一次生成稠密点图，却不分割可动部件、不推断关节。即便在其点图上直接回归/拟合连续关节在随手拍视频上也失败：跨帧注意力在深层模糊运动部件边界、低估沿视线方向的运动、小开角下连续轴病态。
AI.method: 单次前向框架，建立在冻结的3D基础模型上，将运动部件匹配与闭式关节估计锚定在静止基座的无畸变几何上。①Part and Motion Decoder：融合中间逐帧token与全局token，把部件query参照静态基座query，分割3D部件、在静态基座上对齐点图并预测学习到的Bingham先验。②Kinematic Inference Layer：对静态表面法向拟合正交Manhattan框架，在Bingham后验（成对运动散度+学习先验）下闭式选择关节轴，并解线性系统求铰链枢轴以驱动未见状态。
AI.result: 仅在合成数据上训练，在五个基准上取得单目方法SOTA，优于FAMOS与单目ArtiPoint，中位误差超过带位姿的RGB-D ArtiPoint；48帧视频6.8秒，而Articulat3D逐场景优化需数小时。
AI.conclusion: 以静态基座为锚的部件级前馈重建+几何闭式运动学推断，可在合成数据训练下实现快速、免标定、跨数据集的单目关节物体重建，并支持未见关节状态合成。

title: Multispectral-Polarization-Infrared Multi-Aperture Camouflaged Vehicle Detection
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures
summary: Camouflaged vehicle detection is challenging because camouflage suppresses discriminative cues across sensing modalities. Existing multimodal methods often require precise pixel-level registration and feature-level fusion, creating a trade-off between accuracy and latency. We propose a spectral-polarization-infrared tri-modal detection framework co-designed with a multi-aperture imaging setup to exploit complementary imaging physics. A consensus-guided decision-level fusion strategy combines cross-modal detections within bounded registration tolerances, reducing dependence on precise alignment while maintaining accuracy and real-time performance. We construct a tri-modal camouflaged vehicle dataset containing infrared, polarization, and spectral data. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves 82.7% mean Average Precision (mAP) with an end-to-end latency of 16 ms, outperforming representative feature-level fusion approaches. On the public MID-1K dataset, the framework generalizes to RGB-Depth-Infrared modalities without architectural modification and improves mAP@0.5 by 5.7% over state-of-the-art methods. These results demonstrate the potential of decision-level consensus fusion and multi-aperture sensing for robust and deployable camouflaged vehicle detection.

AI.tldr: 提出光谱-偏振-红外三模态检测框架，配多孔径成像装置，用共识引导的决策级融合替代像素级配准与特征级融合，构建三模态伪装车辆数据集，82.7% mAP、16 ms 延迟，并在 MID-1K 上迁移至 RGB-D-IR。
AI.motivation: 伪装抑制各传感模态的判别线索；现有多模态方法依赖精确像素级配准与特征级融合，在精度与延迟之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出光谱-偏振-红外三模态检测框架，与多孔径成像硬件协同设计以利用互补成像物理；采用共识引导的决策级融合，在有界配准容差内合并跨模态检测结果，降低对精确对齐的依赖；自建含红外、偏振、光谱数据的伪装车辆数据集。
AI.result: 自建数据集上 82.7% mAP，端到端 16 ms，优于代表性特征级融合方法；在公开 MID-1K 上无需改架构即可泛化到 RGB-Depth-Infrared，mAP@0.5 较 SOTA 提升 5.7%。
AI.conclusion: 决策级共识融合与多孔径感知可用于鲁棒且可部署的伪装车辆检测，但属于特定领域多模态目标检测，与物理 AI/机器人核心议题关联有限。

title: ALERT: Extending Humanoid Motion Trackers with a General and Lightweight Human Avoidance Pipeline
summary: Whole-body motion tracking has enabled humanoid dancing, athletic motions, and teleoperation, providing a foundation for capability demonstrations and manipulation data collection. However, existing tracking policies lack awareness of nearby humans and proactive avoidance capabilities, while motion substitution and local constraint-based corrections may compromise reference motion integrity and tracking continuity. We propose ALERT, a general lightweight pipeline for extending motion tracking to shared human-robot environments. Through lightweight adaptation, it integrates human perception and proactive avoidance into pretrained tracking policies, balancing avoidance demands with reference motion tracking while preserving existing motion capabilities. Simulation and real-world experiments across tracking backbones demonstrate reliable collision-free execution through localized human avoidance, preserving whole-body coordination and enabling rapid recovery of reference tracking, while retaining the ability of pretrained policies to track unseen motions.

AI.tldr: ALERT：轻量适配流程，把人类感知与主动避障注入预训练全身运动跟踪策略，在共享人机环境中实现局部避让同时保持参考动作完整性与跟踪连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有全身运动跟踪策略（用于人形舞蹈、竞技动作、遥操作）缺乏对邻近人类的感知与主动避障；而运动替换、局部约束修正等做法会破坏参考运动完整性和跟踪连续性。
AI.method: 提出 ALERT 通用轻量流程：通过轻量适配（lightweight adaptation）将人体感知模块与主动避障能力集成进预训练跟踪策略，在避障需求与参考动作跟踪之间做平衡，并保留原有动作跟踪能力；在多种跟踪骨干（backbones）上做仿真与真机实验验证。
AI.result: 仿真与真机实验显示可在多种跟踪骨干上实现可靠无碰撞执行，通过局部人体避让保持全身协调、快速恢复参考跟踪，并保留对未见动作的跟踪能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量适配可在不牺牲预训练策略原有运动能力的前提下，为全身运动跟踪增添主动人机共享空间避障，具备较好的通用性与可迁移性。

title: SARVIA: Fast-Adapting the Strong SAR Foundation Models That Are Already in Your MLLMs
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) foundation models provide transferable representations for diverse perception tasks in all-weather Earth observation. However, their development often relies on costly large-scale SAR pretraining, raising the question of whether such extensive domain-specific pretraining is necessary. We find that modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) already provide visual encoders that can outperform dedicated SAR foundation models as downstream initializations. This motivates a new paradigm: reuse general visual capabilities and devote domain training to brief specialization. We therefore introduce SARVIA, an adaptive post-pretraining method that specializes modern MLLMs using self-supervised visual questions with computable answers. These questions are constructed from unlabeled observations through general image tasks that capture spatial relations and SAR-specific tasks that exploit native measurements and SAR--optical correspondence. A shared answer-prediction objective jointly trains low-rank adapters across visual and language components, with loss-driven task sampling. We then export the adapted visual encoder as a standalone backbone. With 600 adaptation steps and 2 GPU-hours, SARVIA outperforms the compared foundation models on all six SAR detection and segmentation benchmarks. Compared with dedicated SAR pretraining, SARVIA reduces domain-training costs by orders of magnitude while improving visual transfer across architectures and scales. This new paradigm shifts the emphasis from repeated, costly pretraining to a reusable specialization process that can benefit from advances in open MLLMs. Dataset and code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: SARVIA：不再做大规模SAR预训练，而是用自监督"可计算答案的视觉问答"对现成MLLM做600步轻量后训练，导出视觉编码器作为SAR下游骨干，6个SAR检测/分割基准全面超过专用SAR基础模型。
AI.motivation: SAR基础模型通常依赖昂贵的大规模SAR域内预训练。作者发现现代多模态大模型的视觉编码器作为下游初始化已优于专用SAR基础模型，因此质疑"大规模域内预训练是否必要"，主张复用通用视觉能力、只做短程特化。
AI.method: 构建自监督视觉问答：由无标注SAR图像通过通用图像任务（空间关系）与SAR专属任务（利用原生测量量、SAR-光学对应关系）生成有确定答案的问题；用统一答案预测目标联合训练视觉与语言侧的LoRA适配器，并以损失驱动的任务采样；最后将适配后的视觉编码器导出为独立骨干。
AI.result: 仅600步适配、2 GPU·小时，在全部6个SAR检测/分割基准上优于对比的基础模型；域训练成本相比专用SAR预训练降低数个数量级，并跨架构与规模提升视觉迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出"可复用特化"新范式，将重点从重复昂贵预训练转向利用开放MLLM进展的轻量域特化；适配所得编码器可直接替代SAR专用预训练骨干。

title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

AI.tldr: Heave-Ho：去中心化长时程多机器人人形全身移动操作框架，底层用多智能体后训练适配人形基础跟踪模型实现物理耦合协作，高层用VLM规划器+语音领导-跟随机制实现无通信同步；两机训练可扩展至10机并泛化到异构队形，提出HH-Bench（12任务，2-10机）。
AI.motivation: 单体人形能力有限，协作可拓展能力边界，但需全身协调交互、长时程一致规划与跨机器人精确同步；现有方法难以在无网络通信下实现去中心化长时程协作。
AI.method: 低层：多智能体后训练框架，将人形基础tracking模型适配到机器人间物理耦合交互，仅凭局部观测实现去中心化协调控制。高层：训练视觉-语言规划器，并设计基于语音的leader-follower协调机制，在无网络通信条件下同步去中心化执行。提出HH-Bench基准（12个任务，2至10台人形，含异构队形）。
AI.result: 仅在两台相同人形上训练，可扩展到最多10台并泛化到异构团队而无需重训练；系统评测中持续优于基线方法，真实世界实验在多项困难任务上展示鲁棒的��中心化协作。
AI.conclusion: 具备层次化"基础模型后训练+高层VLM规划+语音同步"设计的多人形长时程协作系统，兼具真机验证与可扩展性，但摘要未给出量化指标与开源信息。

title: Decoding Without a Decoder: Direct Pixel Prediction from Diffusion Transformers
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: Latent diffusion models rely on a decoder to map denoised latents to pixels, adding complexity and inference cost. We introduce Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD), which lets a finetuned diffusion transformer produce final pixels directly through a linear head. Unlike previous methods, where the denoising output leads to final pixels, DWD separates the two roles: the original denoising head continues to drive sampling, then the new DWD head predicts the pixels at the final step. We extend pretrained latent models with DWD efficiently by finetuning only the last few transformer blocks, training the DWD head with pixel quality losses while anchoring the denoising head to the pretrained model to preserve the sample trajectory. Across latent image and video generators, DWD removes the decoder and reduces inference cost while maintaining or even improving pixel quality. On Wan video generation, it visibly reduces detail distortion and flickering, lowering warping error by 23%. Remarkably, the same separation also improves pixel diffusion models that do not even use a decoder: a final-step DWD head produces substantially better texture detail in text-to-image generation, and improves ImageNet FID from 1.55 to 1.43, a new state of the art among pixel flow models.

AI.tldr: DWD 让扩散 Transformer 在最后一步用线性头直接输出像素，可去掉 VAE 解码器，降低推理成本并提升细节质量。
AI.motivation: 潜空间扩散模型依赖解码器把去噪后的 latent 映射到像素，带来额外复杂度与推理开销；且解码器与去噪头耦合，限制了像素级质量优化。
AI.method: 将去噪与解码两个角色分离：保留原始去噪头驱动采样轨迹，新增 DWD 线性头仅在最后一步预测像素。高效微调策略为只训练最后几个 transformer block，DWD 头用像素质量损失训练，去噪头锚定到预训练模型以保持采样轨迹。
AI.result: 在潜空间图像与视频生成器上去掉解码器并降低推理成本，像素质量持平或提升。Wan 视频生成中细节畸变与闪烁减少，warping error 降低 23%。对无解码器的像素扩散模型同样有效：文生图纹理细节明显更优，ImageNet FID 从 1.55 降至 1.43，为像素流模型新 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 最后一步替换解码路径、分离去噪与像素预测是轻量且通用的改进范式，可同时加速推理并提升生成质量。

title: When the World Is the Test Suite: Agentic Intelligence for the Physical World
comment: 83 pages. Project page: this https URL . GitHub: this https URL
summary: Coding agents built to repair software now write, test, and repair programs for robots, laboratories, and industrial controllers. Unlike in software engineering, no test suite comes with the code. Whether a program works must be established by running it on a robot, in a physics simulator, or through the policies it helps to train, and such evidence is costly to obtain and can itself be wrong. As these agents take on more physical tasks, how their programs are judged matters as much as how they are written. This paper examines this emerging area, agentic intelligence for the physical world, by treating the world as the program's test suite. We organize the discussion around three questions: how agents write programs for the physical world, how these programs are tested, and how agents learn from the results. We first trace how language models for robots and software engineering agents came together, ask which software testing practices carry over to physical tests, and describe each program by where it sits relative to the actuator and by what judges it. For writing, we cover programs that act as robot policies and programs that support policy learning by producing rewards, tasks, and training worlds. For testing, we examine what physical trials cost, what traces, learned judges, simulators, and formal checks can establish in their place, and what safety requires beyond task success. For learning, we discuss how tested programs are retained as experience, in skill libraries and in model weights. Finally, we turn to benchmarks and evaluation practice and outline open challenges. Writing programs is becoming cheap, while trustworthy evidence about what they do remains costly. Progress will therefore depend on a physical counterpart of continuous integration: verification cheap enough to run often, reliable enough to trust under search, and maintained alongside the experience it validates.

AI.tldr: 论文将物理世界视为程序测试集，围绕"如何为物理世界写程序、如何测试、如何从结果学习"三问，综述编码智能体在机器人、实验室与工业控制器中的应用，并呼吁建立"物理版持续集成"。
AI.motivation: 软件工程中的编码智能体已能自动写、测、修程序，但物理世界任务没有现成测试套件；验证必须在真机、物理仿真或策略训练中进行，代价高昂且证据本身可能出错。因此程序如何被判定与如何被编写同样重要。
AI.method: 综述性分析：梳理语言模型用于机器人 与 SWE 智能体的汇流；按"相对执行器的位置"与"由谁评判"对程序分类。写作方面覆盖机器人策略程序以及生成奖励、任务与训练世界的支撑程序；测试方面讨论物理试验成本、执行轨迹、学习型评判器、仿真器与形式化检查的替代作用及安全性；学习方面讨论经验如何沉淀为技能库与模型权重，并总结基准与评测实践。
AI.result: 提出以"世界即测试集"为组织框架的三问结构，刻画各类物理程序的评判机制与证据来源，指出现有评测在成本、可靠性与安全性上的缺口，并给出基准与开放挑战的轮廓。
AI.conclusion: 程序编写的成本正迅速下降，而可信的物理证据仍然昂贵。进展取决于建立持续集成的物理对应物：足够廉价以高频运行、足够可靠以支撑搜索、并与所验证的经验共同维护。

title: Perception into Imagination: Executable Memory for World Models
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables
summary: Physical agents must use what they previously saw or touched after visibility or contact is lost. Their actions change the implications of these remembered facts. We introduce executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination. Its evolving read-out informs reward prediction, value estimation and policy learning. We align reward inputs with the transitions that produced them and supervise the reward head on open-loop rollouts of recorded actions. On Memory Maze $13\times13$, EPM reaches 30.37 return at 1M interactions, compared with 23.37 when the same evolving read-out informs only policy and value on a common perceptual front end: a gain of 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]. The complete method also improves control on $9\times9$ and in MiniWorld. Probes of remembered, out-of-view arrivals show stronger reward anticipation in both visual implementations. Concentration, tactile recovery and real tactile frames demonstrate complementary roles of remembered facts in imagined-policy training, motion-dependent decisions and sensory-content retention. EPM connects persistent perception to the predicted consequences and learning signals of a world model for Physical AI.

AI.tldr: 提出"可执行感知记忆"(EPM)世界模型框架，在想象/开环推演中同时演化显式感知状态与神经隐变量动力学，并以演化读出驱动奖励预测、价值估计与策略学习。
AI.motivation: 物理智能体在视野或接触丢失后必须使用此前看到/触摸过的信息，且自身动作会改变这些记忆事实的含义；现有世界模型缺乏对持久感知状态的显式维护。
AI.method: 在世界模型中加入显式可更新的感知记忆状态，与神经隐动力学并行演化；其读出结果输入奖励头、价值头与策略；将奖励输入与其对应的状态转移对齐，并在记录动作的开环 rollout 上监督奖励头。
AI.result: Memory Maze 13x13 在 1M 交互下回报 30.37，对比同感知前端下仅用读出驱动策略与价值的 23.37，提升 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]；9x9 与 MiniWorld 控制性能亦有提升；视觉两种实现中对"出视野到达"的奖励预期更强；消融/探针展示记忆事实在想象策略训练、运动相关决策与触觉内容保持中的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: EPM 将持久感知与世界模型的预测后果和学习信号相连，为 Physical AI 提供可执行感知记忆范式；但证据以仿真导航与探针为主，缺乏真实机器人闭环验证。

title: FIRE-Drive: Feasibility-Informed Risk Evaluation for End-to-End Diffusion Planning
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures
summary: Diffusion-based end-to-end autonomous driving models have shown strong potential in generating multimodal planning trajectories. However, their performance still depends heavily on trajectory initialization, mode evaluation, and supervision quality. Weakly constrained noisy initialization may introduce infeasible proposals and increase the burden of denoising. Moreover, selecting the optimal mode remains challenging when candidate trajectories are geometrically similar but differ in safety, interaction risk, and progress. To address these issues, we propose FIRE-Drive, a feasibility-informed risk evaluation framework for end-to-end autonomous driving. FIRE-Drive improves diffusion-based planning through dynamic feasible anchor initialization, candidate-specific bird's-eye-view risk evidence, and compact high-quality candidate supervision with lightweight refinement. This design aligns the initial support, risk-aware scoring, and multimodal supervision of trajectory modes under a unified planning objective. It enables the diffusion decoder to focus on refining plausible trajectories while the scorer distinguishes modes using local risk evidence. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 show that FIRE-Drive achieves a Predictive Driver Model Score of 91.5 with a ResNet34 backbone. Additional closed-loop evaluation on 220 Bench2Drive routes yields a Driving Score of 71.43 and a Success Rate of 42.73%. Component ablations and a scorer comparison under matched candidate inputs support the contributions of feasible initialization, auxiliary supervision, and risk-informed selection. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FIRE-Drive：面向扩散式端到端自动驾驶的"可行性引导风险评估"框架，通过动态可行锚点初始化、候选专属BEV风险证据与紧凑高质量候选监督+轻量精修，统一初始支撑、风险打分与多模态监督。
AI.motivation: 扩散式端到端规划存在三个瓶颈：(1) 弱约束的噪声初始化会引入不可行轨迹，加重去噪负担；(2) 多模态候选在几何上相近但在安全性、交互风险与通行效率上差异显著，最优模式选择困难；(3) 监督质量不足，候选集合冗余。
AI.method: 三点设计：①动态可行锚点初始化，让扩散起点落在可行轨迹流形附近；②候选专属的BEV风险证据作为打分器输入，实现风险感知的模式选择；③紧凑高质量候选监督配合轻量精修模块，在统一规划目标下对齐初始化、打分与多模态监督，使扩散解码器专注精修合理轨迹。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1 上 ResNet34 骨干取得 PDMS 91.5；Bench2Drive 220 条闭环路线取得 Driving Score 71.43、Success Rate 42.73%；消融与匹配输入下的打分器对比验证了可行初始化、辅助监督与风险引导选择的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明：为扩散规划器提供可行先验支撑与风险感知的模式判别，可在轻量骨干下同时提升开环打分与闭环成功率，属于自动驾驶规划端的结构化改进而非通用生成模型创新。

title: Where Do Human-to-Robot Transfer Gains Come From?
summary: Human data can support robot policy pretraining, but gains attributed to a data recipe may also reflect subset size, training variability, or downstream adaptation. In an HPT implementation on a 20-task MetaWorld suite with three training blocks, a constrained random 5,000-recording subset matches most of the task-informed subset's gain over the 40,000-recording pool at 20,000 updates (3.69 of 4.29 percentage points), leaving equal-size selection differences of 0.60 points at 5,000 recordings and 0.45 points at 1,250 recordings, with wide paired intervals. Across 12 comparisons, task orderings repeat across seeds for several contrasts, but a fixed predictor built from the other two seeds trails the mean or difficulty reference in at least one held-out fold for every comparison. Neither mechanism probe shows its predicted positive interaction: task-slot mismatch yields an interaction of $-0.0347$ points after adaptation, and in a six-task observation experiment the observation-by-pretraining interaction changes sign between seeds ($-18.29$ and $+1.04$ points) while full-state pretraining gains are positive in both ($+6.37$ and $+2.31$ points). This retrospective study shows how equal-size and capacity controls, seed-level reporting, and targeted interventions change the interpretation of apparent transfer gains.

AI.tldr: 该论文对“人类数据提升机器人策略预训练”的归因进行回顾性审计：在20任务MetaWorld上，等规模随机子集可复现大部分“任务知情”子集的收益，任务排序随种子不稳，且两个机制探针均未显示预测的正向交互，说明表观迁移增益多由规模、训练变异和下游适应解释。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域普遍报告“人类数据+某种数据配方”带来预训练增益，但这些增益可能混淆了子集规模、训练随机性与下游适应等混杂因素，缺乏等规模与容量对照、种子级报告和机制性干预，因此需要系统性地检验增益的真实来源。
AI.method: 在HPT实现上构建20任务MetaWorld套件、三个训练块；用等规模随机子集（5,000与1,250条录制）对照任务知情子集，报告配对区间；做12组对比并跨种子重复，检验基于其他两个种子的固定预测器在留出折上的表现；设置两个机制探针：任务槽不匹配干预，以及六任务观测实验（观测×预训练交互）。
AI.result: 随机5,000条子集在20,000次更新下复现了任务知情子集相对40,000条池的增益4.29个百分点中的3.69；等规模差异仅0.60（5,000条）与0.45（1,250条）个百分点，且配对区间宽。多个对比的任务排序跨种子重复，但固定预测器在每个对比的至少一个留出折中落后于均值或难度基线。任务槽不匹配交互为−0.0347个百分点；观测×预训练交互跨种子变号（−18.29与+1.04），而全状态预训练增益两个种子均为正（+6.37与+2.31）。
AI.conclusion: 表观迁移增益在很大程度上可由子集规模、训练变异与下游适应解释，而非特定数据配方或所假设机制；等规模/容量对照、种子级报告与定向干预是重新解释机器人预训练数据结论的必要手段。

title: Cross-Modal StateKV Injection for Communication in Multi-LLM Systems across Temporal Segments
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Equal contribution: Xiaoqian Zhang and Zhihao Zhang
summary: Video understanding with multiple multimodal language models requires a communication interface that can transfer complementary visual observations. Text-based communication is interpretable, but introduces an intermediate generation stage and can omit information relevant to subsequent reasoning. We study Cross-Modal StateKV Injection, a provider--carrier framework that communicates through key--value (KV) states at visual-token positions. Provider models observe complementary video frames; their visual KV states are aligned and projected into the carrier representation space and integrated through gated residual updates. Injection preserves the carrier KV-cache sequence length, while retaining the additional computation required by the providers and the communication module. The reported experiments on MLVU and Video-MME compare carrier-only inference, text-based communication, and StateKV with two provider architectures. Results show modest, task-dependent accuracy gains and lower reported latency than the evaluated text-communication baseline, with some categories remaining unchanged or decreasing. Increasing provider-side frame coverage offers additional gains on selected tasks without extending the carrier cache. These findings motivate further study of visual KV communication under explicitly controlled observation and computation budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 Cross-Modal StateKV Injection：提供方模型将视觉 token 位置的 KV 状态对齐投影到承载方（carrier）表示空间，经门控残差更新注入，实现多模型互补视觉观测的通信而不增加 carrier KV-cache 长度。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型协同视频理解时，文本通信虽可解释但需中间生成阶段且会丢失与后续推理相关的视觉信息，需要更直接的通信接口。
AI.method: provider–carrier 框架：多个 provider 观察互补帧，其视觉 KV 状态经对齐与投影映射到 carrier 空间，通过门控残差更新注入 carrier 的 KV 序列；保持 carrier 缓存长度不变，额外计算开销来自 provider 与通信模块。在 MLVU 与 Video-MME 上与纯 carrier 推理、文本通信对比，两种 provider 架构。
AI.result: 准确率提升幅度有限且随任务类别而异，部分类别持平或下降；报告的时延低于文本通信基线；增大 provider 帧覆盖可在部分任务上带来额外收益而不扩展 carrier 缓存。
AI.conclusion: 视觉 KV 状态通信是有前景的多模型协作方向，但需在显式控制观测与计算预算的条件下进一步研究。

title: Inertial Video World Models
summary: The physical world has inertia: it evolves from what already exists rather than being recreated at every instant. However, many existing video world models lack an explicit mechanism for inertial state evolution, leaving the continuity of motion and structure implicit in video prediction. During autoregressive rollouts, repeated reconstruction can accumulate errors and destabilize the predicted dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce InertialWorld, an Inertial Video World Model that makes inertia a structural prior for autoregressive prediction: existing scene evidence is carried across time rather than reconstructed at every step. Central to this formulation is Inertial Memory, which turns memory from passive predictive context into an evolving video state with two complementary views: a dense Eulerian grid preserves scene-aligned evidence, while persistent Lagrangian carriers bind local content to learned canonical coordinates. At each step, the model transports the carrier content according to action-conditioned motion, predicts the complete next video state from the transported carriers and dense grid, and uses a learned gate to combine transported and newly predicted content into the memory for the next step. Extensive experiments across multiple domains, including robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation, demonstrate that InertialWorld achieves competitive autoregressive prediction performance against strong video world model baselines. Codes link: this https URL

AI.tldr: InertialWorld 将"惯性"作为视频世界模型的结构先验：用 Inertial Memory（稠密欧拉网格 + 持久拉格朗日载体）在自回归预测中传递而非重建场景状态，缓解误差累积。在机器人操作、3D游戏模拟、开放世界导航上取得有竞争力的自回归预测表现。
AI.motivation: 物理世界具有惯性——状态随时间连续演化而非每步重建；但现有视频世界模型缺少显式的惯性状态演化机制，运动与结构连续性只能隐含在视频预测中，自回归展开时反复重建会累积误差、破坏动力学稳定性。
AI.method: 提出 InertialWorld。核心是 Inertial Memory，将记忆从被动的预测上下文转变为演化的视频状态，含两种互补表示：稠密欧拉网格保存场景对齐证据，持久拉格朗日载体将局部内容绑定到学习得到的规范坐标。每步按动作条件运动传输载体内容，由传输后的载体与稠密网格预测下一完整视频状态，并用学习门控将传输内容与新预测内容融合写入下一步记忆。
AI.result: 在机器人操作、3D 游戏模拟、开放世界导航等多个领域的广泛实验中，InertialWorld 的自回归预测性能与强视频世界模型基线相当（competitive），并提供代码链接。
AI.conclusion: 以惯性作为结构先验、用欧拉-拉格朗日双表示承载跨时间状态，是提升自回归视频世界模型长时稳定性的有效途径；摘要仅给出"competitive"级别的结果，缺少明确的量化提升与真实机器人部署证据。

title: SIDUMN: Self-Supervised Image Denoising Under Symmetric Multiplicative Noise
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters
summary: Self-supervised denoising is challenging when the corruption is multiplicative and signal-dependent. In this letter, we propose SIDUMN, a symmetric noisier framework for self-supervised denoising under mean-one symmetric multiplicative noise. Given noisy observations and the noise law, the method samples an independent synthetic noise factor from the same law and constructs two complementary noisier images by applying the factor and its reflection about one. The denoising network is trained to predict one noisier image from the other, and at inference the reconstructions of $K$ such antithetic pairs are averaged. We show that the population target of the training loss is the clean conditional mean minus a multiplicative cross-term. We further prove that, for any trained network, antithetic averaging never increases the expected squared error of a single noisier-input reconstruction. Numerical results validate the theoretical findings and the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出SIDUMN：针对均值一对称乘性噪声的对称"更噪"自监督去噪框架——从同分布采样噪声因子及其关于1的反射，构造互补更噪图像对，网络互预测，推理时对K对反演配对重建取平均。
AI.motivation: 乘性、信号相关噪声（如散斑、泊松类）下的自监督去噪困难：常规Noise2Noise/Noisier2Noise假设加性高斯或噪声独立于信号，难以直接用于均值一对称乘性噪声场景。
AI.method: 给定观测与噪声分布，采样独立乘性因子f，并用其关于1的反射2-f构造两张互补更噪图像；训练网络由其中一张预测另一张；理论上分析总体目标为干净条件均值减乘性交叉项，并证明反演配对平均不增加单次更噪输入重建的期望平方误差；推理对K对配对重建取平均。
AI.result: 推导出训练损失的总体目标形式（干净条件均值减乘性交叉项），证明反演平均的误差非增性质；数值实验验证理论结论与方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 为乘性对称噪声提供了有理论保证的自监督去噪方案：反演配对平均可作为免费方差缩减手段，代价为偏差（交叉项）；本质是低层图像复原方法，与具身/3D/世界模型主线无直接关联。

title: Breaking Visual Conventions: Spectrally Coupled Weight Perturbation for Creative Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models often produce high-quality images that follow familiar visual conventions, even in response to open-ended prompts such as ``a creative [CLS]''. Existing methods encourage novelty by exploring semantic conditions or modifying features and guidance during denoising. Pretrained weights offer a complementary source of creative variation, but unstructured perturbations can have little visual effect or degrade image quality. We introduce Coupled Spectral Perturbation (CosPert), a training-free method that targets attention projections in layers identified by a one-time sensitivity analysis. For each projection, CosPert uses a shared random transformation and its transpose to couple updates to the singular-vector factors while perturbing the spectral gains. A common relative budget calibrates the magnitude of weight changes across projections, and a sigmoid schedule concentrates their influence in early denoising and gradually attenuates them during refinement. CosPert provides plug-and-play creativity enhancement at inference time. Once the perturbations are prepared, sampling requires no auxiliary networks or additional model evaluations. On both FLUX.1 and Stable Diffusion 3.5, CosPert enhances visual creativity, producing more varied object structures while preserving category identity. Across 50 object categories, CosPert achieves the highest mean CREward among the evaluated methods while maintaining strong prompt alignment.

AI.tldr: CosPert: 无需训练的T2I创意增强方法，通过对敏感注意力投影的奇异值增益做耦合谱扰动（共享随机变换+转置），并配相对预算与sigmoid调度，在去噪早期注入创意、后期衰减；在FLUX.1与SD3.5上提升结构多样性且保持类别一致与提示对齐。
AI.motivation: T2I模型对开放式提示（如"a creative [CLS]"）往往仍生成符合常规视觉惯例的图像，创意不足。现有方法依赖语义条件探索或修改特征/引导，而未结构化地扰动预训练权重则效果弱或损害画质，缺少一种可控、有效的权重空间创意注入方式。
AI.method: (1) 一次性敏感度分析定位注意力投影层；(2) 对每个投影用共享随机变换及其转置耦合更新奇异向量因子，同时扰动谱增益（Coupled Spectral Perturbation）；(3) 统一相对预算标定各投影权重改动幅度；(4) sigmoid调度使扰动集中于去噪早期并逐渐衰减；(5) 训练-free，扰动预计算后采样过程无需辅助网络或额外模型评估。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1与Stable Diffusion 3.5上提升视觉创意，产生更多样的物体结构并保持类别身份；在50个物体类别上取得评估方法中最高的平均CREward，同时维持较强的提示对齐。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间的谱结构扰动是语义/特征层创意增强的可行补充，且可通过奇异值耦合与时间调度实现可控、低成本、即插即用的推理期创意提升。

title: Beyond Episodic Recall: Experience-to-Knowledge Evolution for Lifelong Embodied Navigation
summary: Lifelong embodied navigation requires agents to accumulate experience through continuous interaction and reuse it for subsequent goal searches. Existing memory-enhanced methods typically retain historical observations or construct structured scene representations. However, storing observations or high-dimensional semantic embeddings incurs growing storage costs. Meanwhile, structured representations support retrieval and semantic reasoning but do not explicitly evolve accumulated experience into environment-specific knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose Experience-Evolving Memory (EvoNav), a novel two-timescale memory framework. It organizes semantic observations, spatial relations, and task-feedback cues into sparse experience atoms. During online operation, experience atoms continually consolidate repeated observations and form dynamic links based on transitions. At the slower timescale, EvoNav distills accumulated category co-occurrences and feedback signals into environment-specific structural knowledge without relying on predefined object--room relations. For each new goal, EvoNav combines direct goal evidence from experience atoms with learned structural knowledge to guide goal-directed search on the current traversability map. Experiments on single-goal, sequential multi-floor, and multimodal navigation demonstrate effective experience reuse and improved path efficiency with compact persistent memory, together with successful transfer to a real robot.

AI.tldr: EvoNav: a two-timescale memory for lifelong embodied navigation that stores sparse "experience atoms" (semantic observations, spatial relations, task feedback), fast consolidation/linking online, and slow-timescale distillation into environment-specific structural knowledge (category co-occurrence + feedback), used to guide goal search.
AI.motivation: Existing memory-enhanced navigation either stores raw observations/high-dim semantic embeddings (growing storage) or builds structured scene representations that support retrieval but never evolve accumulated experience into environment-specific knowledge. Goal: compact persistent memory that both reuses and generalizes experience.
AI.method: Two-timescale framework. Fast timescale: online consolidation of repeated observations into sparse experience atoms with dynamic transition-based links. Slow timescale: distill accumulated category co-occurrences and task-feedback cues into environment-specific structural knowledge without predefined object–room priors. At each new goal, fuse direct goal evidence from atoms with learned structural knowledge to score goal-directed search on the current traversability map.
AI.result: Experiments on single-goal, sequential multi-floor, and multimodal navigation show effective experience reuse and improved path efficiency with compact persistent memory; transfer demonstrated on a real robot.
AI.conclusion: Explicitly evolving experience into environment-specific structure (rather than storing observations or static semantics) yields compact, reusable, transferable lifelong navigation memory.

title: M$^3$-Test: Coverage Gaps in Joint-Perturbation Testing of Visual Question Answering
summary: A visual question answering (VQA) model can pass every image-only and question-only test yet fail when the same changes occur together. Standard robustness reports average over conditions and therefore cannot say which accepted requests remain vulnerable. We introduce M3-Test, a coverage audit that aligns each clean input with its single-modality variants and a complete 5x5 family, 4x4 strength joint library, so that any reduced test suite can be replayed on the same requests. Across 2.6 million responses from four vision-language models, joint failures affect 26-29% of the Qwen questions that pass all 40 single-modality tests, although fewer than 0.6% of their joint records fail. Passing the 25 maximum-strength corners does not close this gap: 11-14% of the accepted questions still fail elsewhere in the library. Re-executing the archived failures reproduces about 90% of them, against a 0.3-0.6% flip rate among matched passing controls, and re-checking the most fragile failure records supports 80-89% of them. On the evidence examined, neither execution noise nor grading error can fully account for the gap. The same aligned grids make previous evaluations reusable. On held-out images, a risk order learned from other models discovers about 80% of affected Qwen questions within 25 additional queries, compared with 65-68% for maximum-first and 53-57% for pairwise covering arrays. M3-Test thus turns a passing robustness suite into a request-level account of what remains untested, supporting acceptance, regression review and test allocation.

AI.tldr: M3-Test：面向VQA的覆盖率审计框架，将干净输入与单模态变体及完整联合扰动库对齐，可在同一请求集上回放任意缩减测试套件，揭示大量"通过单模态测试但联合失效"的隐蔽脆弱请求。
AI.motivation: 标准鲁棒性报告对条件取平均，无法指出哪些已通过的请求仍存在风险；单模态测试通过不蕴含联合扰动下的稳健性。
AI.method: 构建M3-Test：每个干净输入对齐图像-only、问题-only变体及完整5×5联合族与4×4强度联合库，形成可重放的请求级对齐网格；在四个视觉语言模型共260万条响应上审计，并对归档失败重执行、复核最脆弱记录以排除噪声与评分误差。
AI.result: 通过全部40项单模态测试的Qwen问题中26–29%存在联合失效（联合记录失败率<0.6%）；仅通过25个最大强度角点仍有11–14%失败；失败重执行复现率约90%（对照翻转率0.3–0.6%），脆弱记录复核支持率80–89%；对齐网格上学习的风险排序在25次额外查询内发现约80%受影响问题，优于最大优先（65–68%）与成对覆盖阵列（53–57%）。
AI.conclusion: M3-Test将"通过"的鲁棒性套件转化为请求级的剩余风险账本，可支撑准入判定、回归审查与测试预算分配，并使已有评测结果可复用。

title: DAP-MR: Degradation-Aware Prompt-Magnitude Routing for Real-World Ultrasound Super-Resolution
summary: When super-resolution models designed for natural images are used on ultrasound scans, relying on semantic text prompts can lead to unreliable results. The tags these models generate often do not match the actual restoration needs, and specialized medical terms may be misunderstood by general-purpose text encoders. Instead, prompts focused on common image degradations are more directly useful for guiding restoration. However, using a single prompt to describe both the type and severity of image degradation can entangle these factors, making it hard for the model to know how strong the degradation is. To address this limitation, we introduce Degradation-Aware Prompt--Magnitude Routing (DAP-MR). Each degradation type is represented by a dedicated token initialized from the contextualized EOS embedding of a degradation-oriented prompt and subsequently adapted during ultrasound SR training. A separate magnitude router predicts a continuous, input-dependent magnitude that modulates the corresponding token. Thus, language provides a degradation-aware initialization for what should be restored, while magnitude routing supplies an explicit signal for how strongly it should influence restoration. DAP-MR can be added to both one-step and multi-step diffusion super-resolution frameworks without changing their core structures. Our experiments--on synthetic datasets with both in-domain and under anatomical-domain shift, as well as unpaired real-world ultrasound data--show that DAP-MR delivers better restoration quality and generalizes more consistently across different domains.

AI.tldr: DAP-MR 用"退化类型专用 token + 连续幅值路由"解耦语言提示中的退化类型与强度，用于超声图像超分。
AI.motivation: 自然图像 SR 模型迁移到超声时，语义文本提示不可靠：生成的 tag 与实际修复需求不符，通用文本编码器也难理解专业医学术语。改用描述常见退化的提示更直接，但单一提示同时编码退化类型与严重程度会使二者纠缠，模型难以判断退化强度。
AI.method: 为每类退化分配专用 token，由面向退化提示的上下文 EOS embedding 初始化，并在超声 SR 训练中自适应调整；另设 magnitude router 预测输入相关的连续幅值来调制对应 token。语言提供"修什么"的退化感知初始化，幅值路由提供"修多强"的显式信号。可插入单步与多步扩散 SR 框架且不改动核心结构。
AI.result: 在合成数据集（域内与解剖域偏移）及非配对真实超声数据上，恢复质量更好，跨域泛化更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 将退化类型与强度解耦的提示调制机制是一种轻量、可移植的扩散 SR 条件化改进，主要价值局限于医学超声影像领域。

title: PURE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multi-Granularity Multimodal Identity Matching
summary: Identity matching asks whether two records denote the same identity, yet the answer depends on the target granularity. Two records may match at the base level but not at the variant level: they share an underlying design while differing in attributes such as color or size. Final matching accuracy does not separately characterize the capabilities involved. To study this problem, we use e-commerce as a challenging real-world domain. We introduce PURE, a diagnostic benchmark for multi-granularity multimodal identity matching covering four capability dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Reasoning, and Evidence-grounded Judgment. The benchmark comprises 1,457 multiple-choice questions across 14 tasks, derived from real-world matching pairs and verified by two domain experts. Across ten recent MLLMs, overall scores range from 47.1% to 86.0%. Understanding receives the highest mean score and Judgment the lowest, with weaknesses in visual difference localization and variant-level rule judgment. Modality ablations show that models benefit from multimodal evidence but can incorrectly identify conflicts between matching records. In direct matching, most models recognize matching pairs more reliably than non-matching pairs at the base level, whereas the reverse holds at the variant level. PURE therefore reveals what aggregate matching accuracy hides: not only whether models judge a pair correctly, but where they struggle to interpret evidence and apply matching criteria.

AI.tldr: PURE: a 1,457-question, 14-task diagnostic benchmark for multi-granularity multimodal identity matching (base vs. variant level) in e-commerce, scored across Perception/Understanding/Reasoning/Judgment; ten MLLMs score 47.1%–86.0%, with weakest performance in visual-difference localization and variant-level rule judgment.
AI.motivation: Aggregate matching accuracy conflates distinct capabilities and ignores that correctness depends on target granularity: two records may share a design (base-level match) yet differ in color/size (variant-level non-match). The authors aim to disentangle what a model can do—perceive, understand, reason, ground judgment in evidence—rather than only whether the final answer is right.
AI.method: Construct a diagnostic benchmark from real e-commerce matching pairs, curated into 1,457 multiple-choice questions over 14 tasks spanning four capability dimensions (Perception, Understanding, Reasoning, Evidence-grounded Judgment) and two granularities (base/variant). Expert verification by two domain annotators. Evaluation of ten recent MLLMs, plus modality ablations (text-only/vision-only vs. multimodal) and a direct matching protocol comparing recognition of matching vs. non-matching pairs at both granularities.
AI.result: Overall scores 47.1%–86.0%; Understanding highest mean, Judgment lowest; notable failures in visual difference localization and variant-level rule application. Modality ablation: multimodal evidence helps, but models also spuriously report conflicts between matching records. Direct matching: at base level most models detect matching pairs more reliably than non-matching pairs; the pattern reverses at variant level.
AI.conclusion: Aggregate accuracy masks heterogeneous capability profiles—models can be right for the wrong reasons and vice versa. Fine-grained, evidence-grounded, granularity-aware diagnostics are needed; the reported base/variant asymmetry points to a systematic bias toward over-merging at variant level (and conservatism at base level).

title: TetherMark: Instance-Level Watermark Authentication Against Cross-Instance Transplantation
summary: Robust watermarking is commonly verified by asking whether a hidden payload remains decodable after compression, geometric distortion, or generative editing. Localized and semantic extensions may additionally check whether an expected region or category is still present. These tests establish evidence validity or content consistency, but not whether the evidence still belongs to the particular visual instance registered by its owner. We expose cross-instance transplantation: an attacker extracts or estimates valid watermark evidence from one registered image and transfers it to a different image of the same category. The message can still decode, the expected content can remain present, and the result can look natural, even though the evidence has been reassigned to the wrong instance. To enable instance-level watermark authentication, we introduce TetherMark, a post-hoc watermark that combines two complementary checks. The message check verifies an edit-robust payload, while the relation check uses secret patch-pair selection, a registered response, natural correspondence transport, and enrollment normalization to test consistency with the registered instance. The verifier accepts only when both checks pass. Across 240 test subjects, TetherMark attains 92.08% legitimate true acceptance with 9.17% and 16.25% attack success under WmForger and WMCopier, respectively, yielding the highest instance-binding balanced accuracy under both attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出TetherMark后处理水印，通过消息校验+基于秘密补丁对选取的关系校验，实现"实例级"水印认证，可抵御跨实例移植攻击（WmForger/WMCopier）。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒水印仅验证证据有效性与内容一致性，无法确认证据是否仍属于被注册的特定图像实例；攻击者可将某张注册图的有效水印证据移植到同类别的另一张图上，消息仍可解码、语义仍匹配，却已属错误实例。
AI.method: 后验水印框架，含两重互补校验：消息校验验证抗编辑载荷；关系校验利用秘密补丁对选取、注册响应、自然对应传输与注册归一化，检验证据与注册实例的一致性；仅当两校验均通过才接受。
AI.result: 240个测试对象上，合法真接受率92.08%；WmForger与WMCopier攻击成功率分别为9.17%与16.25%，两种攻击下实例绑定平衡准确率均为最优。
AI.conclusion: 揭示跨实例移植这一新威胁，并以实例绑定关系校验作为补充维度，为生成式编辑场景下的水印版权认证提供更严格的实例级保障。

title: Scaling Laws for Vision-Language Fusion
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as central foundation models combining multimodal perception with text comprehension. While VLMs are traditionally built via late fusion by continued pre-training an off-the-shelf language model on multimodal (image-text) data, mixing modalities from the start of pre-training (early fusion) has recently gained traction. However, the fundamental trade-offs between these paradigms remain poorly understood, resulting in expensive and heuristic-driven training recipes. In this paper, we systematically analyze the learning dynamics of these multimodal pre-training processes, showing that validation losses during vision-language fusion can be modeled by separating the base learning trajectory, where different data types contribute at distinct rates, from a distribution shift driven by the competition between modalities. We derive a scaling law that unifiedly describes these dynamics, enabling accurate loss predictions across mixture ratios, training steps, and model sizes. Crucially, our law characterizes the trade-off between early and late fusion: under a fixed data budget, early fusion preserves text performance while late fusion favors vision performance, yielding a trade-off that increasingly tilts toward early fusion as model size scales. Extensive experiments confirm that our scaling law reliably captures multimodal learning dynamics and governs fusion decisions.

AI.tldr: 该文系统分析视觉-语言模型多模态预训练的学习动力学，提出统一缩放定律描述"早融合 vs 晚融合"的权衡。
AI.motivation: 早融合与晚融合各有取舍，但缺少理论理解，导致训练配方昂贵且依赖启发式经验，因此需要可预测的定量模型来指导融合决策。
AI.method: 将验证损失分解为基础学习轨迹（不同数据类型以不同速率贡献）与模态竞争引起的分布偏移，推导统一缩放定律，可跨混合比例、训练步数与模型规模预测损失。
AI.result: 缩放定律能准确预测各混合比例、步数、模型规模下的损失；固定数据预算下早融合保持文本性能、晚融合偏向视觉性能，且随模型规模增大权衡逐渐倾向早融合。
AI.conclusion: 该定律可靠刻画多模态学习动力学并可指导融合范式选择，为VLM预训练配方提供可预测的定量依据而非启发式试错。

title: SandBAR: A Band-Asymmetric Architecture for Underwater Image Restoration with Removable Frequency Scaffolding
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Camera-ready version. 9 pages, 6 figures
summary: Light scattering, absorption and turbidity degrade underwater imagery through complementary frequency tendencies: large-scale, channel-dependent appearance distortions and local high-frequency detail loss. This band asymmetry motivates different forms of restoration for global colour and local structure. Our primary contribution is SandBAR, a novel unified band-asymmetric architecture for underwater image restoration. Rather than treating frequency processing as an isolated module, SandBAR organises the restoration pipeline around band asymmetry at the block, encoder and objective levels. Within this architecture, we introduce a novel band-asymmetric sandwich block with a reserved post-attention repair slot and the Split-band Parallel Asymmetric Repair Kernel (SPARK), a novel module that applies channel-aware large-support correction to the low band, which predominantly carries large-scale appearance distortions, and lightweight local refinement to the detail-bearing high band, thereby restoring global colour while preserving fine structure. To deliver the global cast to the depth at which the network represents global structure, a learnable low-frequency guidance path injects a low-pass view of the input into the deep encoder, and a three-scale spatial-frequency objective supervises the same axis throughout the decoder. Building on the reserved post-attention slot, we further introduce Post-attention Scaffold Training (PaST), a novel removable nonlinear scaffolding scheme that trains the permanent SandBAR graph under band-specific capacity and runs it at inference without that capacity. SandBAR reaches 29.89 / 28.92 / 22.77 dB on EUVP / LSUI / UIEB and establishes a new three-domain mean state of the art on the benchmark family, exceeding the strongest published result by approximately 1.0 dB. PaST adds no parameters or FLOPs at inference and preserves matched latency.

AI.tldr: SandBAR：以频带非对称性组织水下图像复原流程（块/编码器/目标三层），含 SPARK 频带并行非对称修复核、低频引导路径与三尺度空频监督，并提出可拆卸的 PaST 训练脚手架；EUVP/LSUI/UIEB 达 29.89/28.92/22.77 dB。
AI.motivation: 水下散射、吸收与浑浊使退化呈现互补的频带倾向：低频承载大幅度的、通道相关的全局色偏，高频丢失局部细节。这种频带非对称性意味着全局颜色与局部结构需要不同形式的修复，而现有方法多将频率处理当作孤立模块。
AI.method: 提出统一的频带非对称架构 SandBAR，在 block、encoder、objective 三个层面围绕频带非对称组织复原管线：设计带保留式 post-attention 修复槽的 sandwich block；SPARK 模块对低频带施加通道感知的大感受野校正、对高频带做轻量局部细化；以可学习低频引导路径把输入的低通视图注入深层编码器；用三尺度空间-频率目标在解码器全程监督同一频带轴；并在预留槽上引入 PaST（带特定容量训练、推理时移除的非线性脚手架）。
AI.result: 在 EUVP/LSUI/UIEB 上分别取得 29.89/28.92/22.77 dB，建立该基准族的三域平均新 SOTA，超出最强已发表结果约 1.0 dB；PaST 推理阶段不增加参数与 FLOPs，延迟保持匹配。
AI.conclusion: 将频带非对称作为架构级设计原则（而非单一频率模块）是水下复原的有效路径；可拆卸训练脚手架可在零推理开销下带来增益。

title: SR-VLA: Stall-Reduced VLA Execution via Predicted-Input Lookahead and Selective KV Cache Repair
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies incur control stalls when inference blocks the next action chunk. Asynchronous early inference can hide latency, but its results may be inconsistent with the arriving actual inputs. Unconditional reuse risks acting on mismatched inputs, whereas full recomputation discards useful precomputation. We propose SR-VLA, combining predicted-input lookahead with selective KV cache repair. During current chunk execution, a lightweight action-conditioned predictor generates next-boundary visual observations and proprioceptive state. These predictions, together with the task instruction, drive the frozen VLA to precompute a speculative KV cache and action chunk. After real inputs are available to VLA, predicted--real differences and task conditions determine whether to accept the action chunk or trigger selective KV repair. On LIBERO, SR-VLA achieves $2.67\times$ and $1.27\times$ query speedups over the respective synchronous $\pi_{0.5}$ and OpenVLA-OFT baselines, while maintaining competitive average task success rates. Under target-motion perturbation, success remains baseline-comparable, with $1.52\times$--$1.93\times$ query speedup.

AI.tldr: SR-VLA通过“预测输入前瞻+选择性KV缓存修复”实现VLA策略的异步推理加速：在执行当前chunk时用轻量动作条件预测器生成下一时刻视觉与本体状态，驱动冻结VLA预计算投机KV缓存与动作chunk，再依据预测-真实差异与任务条件决定直接采纳或选择性KV修复。
AI.motivation: VLA策略的推理阻塞导致下一动作chunk的控制停顿。异步早启动推理可隐藏延迟，但投机结果与随后到达的真实输入不一致：无条件复用会在错配输入上执行动作，而完整重算又浪费了已完成的预计算。
AI.method: SR-VLA框架：(1) 轻量动作条件预测器在当前chunk执行期间预测下一决策边界的视觉观测与本体状态；(2) 以预测输入+任务指令驱动冻结VLA，预计算投机KV缓存与动作chunk；(3) 真实输入到位后，用预测-真实差异与任务条件做门控，接受投机动作或仅对受影响部分触发选择性KV缓存修复，避免全量重算。
AI.result: LIBERO上相对同步π0.5与OpenVLA-OFT基线分别取得2.67×与1.27×查询加速，平均任务成功率保持竞争力；在目标运动扰动下成功率与基线相当，查询加速1.52×–1.93×。
AI.conclusion: 以“预测-校验-局部修复”替代“无条件复用或全量重算”的二元取舍，是降低VLA推理延迟的有效且鲁棒路径；但证据目前限于仿真基准成功率与查询级加速，缺真实机器人部署与端到端wall-clock延迟验证。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Truly Understand Images? A Benchmark Beyond Commonsense Bias
comment: 10 pages
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks. However, it remains unclear whether their predictions are grounded in the visual content itself or are largely driven by statistical co-occurrence patterns and commonsense correlations learned from large-scale image-text corpora. Existing vision-language benchmarks predominantly consist of samples that conform to human commonsense, allowing models to achieve strong performance by exploiting dataset priors rather than genuinely understanding image content. To address this limitation, we present ContraSense, a systematically constructed benchmark for evaluating faithful vision-language understanding. ContraSense consists of carefully curated counter-intuitive image-text pairs that deliberately violate common expectations, substantially reducing the effectiveness of statistical biases and requiring models to rely on visual evidence for reasoning. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on a diverse set of representative open- and closed-source MLLMs. The results reveal a substantial performance gap between current MLLMs and humans: even the strongest closed-source model achieves only about 60\% accuracy, compared with 96.04\% for human participants. These findings demonstrate that current MLLMs still struggle with faithful visual understanding and highlight the need for more robust multimodal reasoning grounded in image content. The ContraSense benchmark is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ContraSense 是一个由反直觉图文对构成的基准，用于检验多模态大模型是否真正依赖视觉证据而非统计先验。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言基准的样本大多符合人类常识，模型可借数据集先验与统计共现获得高分，难以判断其预测是否真正基于图像内容。
AI.method: 系统化构建 ContraSense：人工筛选并构造刻意违背常识预期的反直觉图文对，削弱统计偏置的作用，迫使模型依赖视觉证据推理；随后对多种代表性开源与闭源 MLLM 进行评测并与人类对比。
AI.result: 当前 MLLM 与人类存在显著差距：最强闭源模型仅约 60% 准确率，人类参与者达 96.04%。
AI.conclusion: 现有 MLLM 在忠实视觉理解上仍明显不足，需要更鲁棒、真正以图像内容为基础的多模态推理；基准已公开。

title: FailureGen: Scalable Robot Failure Data Generation with World Models
summary: Robot failures are difficult to collect at scale, limiting the range of failure scenarios represented in robot learning datasets. We present FailureGen, a method for generating synthetic videos with temporal event annotations by reusing action trajectories from recorded failures. The method comprises four stages: (1) fine-tuning an action-conditioned Cosmos world model on successful and failed real executions; (2) annotating source recordings to identify failure-associated donor segments and compatible successful hosts; (3) transferring donor motion into host contexts, with optional spatial offsets, to generate continuous video rollouts; and (4) annotating and filtering the generated samples according to observed events and visual quality. We study two implementations with different tasks and robot configurations, with visual failure detection serving as one downstream application. In a preliminary comparison, a detector trained on real and generated data achieves an average precision of 0.51, compared with 0.41 using real data alone, and detects 33 of 36 failure intervals, compared with 28 of 36. By reusing observed failures in additional contexts, FailureGen expands the data available for studying robot failures and developing downstream learning methods.

AI.tldr: FailureGen 通过在宿主轨迹中复用真实失败片段，利用微调的 Cosmos 世界模型生成带时序事件标注的合成失败视频，从而扩充机器人失败数据；下游失败检测器 AP 从 0.41 提升到 0.51。
AI.motivation: 机器人失败样本难以规模化采集，导致学习数据集中失败场景覆盖不足，限制了失败检测等下游方法的训练。
AI.method: 四阶段流程：(1) 在成功与失败的真实执行上微调动作条件 Cosmos 世界模型；(2) 标注源录像，定位与失败相关的供体片段及可兼容的成功宿主片段；(3) 将供体运动（可选空间偏移）迁移到宿主情境，生成连续视频 rollout；(4) 依据观测事件与视觉质量进行标注和过滤。在两个任务与机器人配置上验证。
AI.result: 初步对比中，真实+生成数据训练的失败检测器平均精度 0.51，仅真实数据为 0.41；检出失败区间 33/36，仅真实数据为 28/36。
AI.conclusion: 通过在其他情境中复用已观测失败，FailureGen 扩大了可用于研究机器人失败与训练下游学习模型的数据规模，属于数据增强型世界模型方法，尚需更大规模与真机部署验证。

title: Seeing What Still Holds: How Waiting Control Changes Cooperative Recovery
comment: 8 pages, 3figures
summary: Changing the holding reference during a fixed-duration wait can reverse the ranking of visual recovery methods. We introduce AuditEmbodied, a paired execution and trajectory evaluation framework that independently varies holding references and waiting duration while keeping recovery executors frozen. A 960-execution factorial on 20 initialization seeds compares CAD-feedback and landmark-based recovery from identical post-wait physical states within each holding and waiting condition. Protected completion requires successful recovery under the declared execution constraints. At a 1 s wait with registered wrist references, their protected completion counts change from 6/40 versus 19/40 under registered holding to 34/40 versus 22/40 under position-only holding. Trajectory analysis localizes the main separation to grasp formation: small observation-time target residuals precede large tracking errors. Joint diagnostics and controlled interventions characterize persistent tracking constraints. On fresh seeds, gradual position reanchoring improves CAD recovery's long-wait completion by 42.5 percentage points and reduces mean complete recovery time by 6.06 s relative to registered holding. Additional evaluations with pretrained policies, handover, and a mass-matched geometry characterize holding-reference sensitivity across executors and physical regimes. These findings establish holding reference as an explicit evaluation condition for comparing visual recovery performance.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 AuditEmbodied 配对执行-轨迹评估框架，独立操控"保持参考系"与"等待时长"，在冻结恢复执行器的前提下发现：1 s 等待下，仅用位置保持会使 CAD 反馈恢复从 6/40 反超至 34/40，主要失效发生在抓取成形阶段。
AI.motivation: 视觉伺服/恢复方法的性能比较通常忽略仿真或执行环境中的"保持参考系"设定（注册腕部位姿 vs 仅位置），导致结论不可复现、排名可被环境配置反转。作者希望把 holding reference 确立为显式评估条件。
AI.method: 配对式因子实验（AuditEmbodied）：20 个初始化种子 × 960 次执行，交叉 holding reference（registered wrist / position-only）与等待时长（如 1 s 与长等待）；在相同等待后物理状态下比较 CAD-feedback 与 landmark-based 两类恢复执行器（执行器固定）；以"声明的执行约束下成功恢复"定义 protected completion；辅以轨迹分解、联合诊断与受控干预，并在新种子上测试渐进式位置重锚定；另用预训练策略、交接任务与质量匹配几何做外部验证。
AI.result: 1 s 等待下，registered holding 时 protected completion 为 6/40 vs 19/40，position-only holding 时变为 34/40 vs 22/40（排名反转）。轨迹分析将差异定位在抓取成形：先出现小的观测时刻目标残差，随后放大为跟踪误差。新种子下，渐进位置重锚定使 CAD 恢复的长等待完成率提升 42.5 个百分点，平均完整恢复时间减少 6.06 s。
AI.conclusion: 保持参考系是可比性评估中不可忽视的显式条件，会系统性改变视觉恢复方法的排名；建议将 holding reference 与等待时长一并纳入协议，并用重锚定等干预缓解持续性跟踪约束（该结论基于仿真/受控设定，真实机器人泛化性尚待验证）。

title: AutoE2E: Don't speak - Language free end-to-end autonomy A Real-Time Driving Model for L2++ ADAS and L4 Robotaxis
comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 6 tables. Code, model checkpoints and evaluation pipeline released at this https URL tag, Apache-2.0)
summary: AutoE2E is an open-source end-to-end driving model developed by the Autoware Foundation Robotaxi Working Group. It introduces a temporal bird's-eye-view (BEV) architecture that combines multi-camera perception, HD-map information and route conditioning to predict future vehicle motion. The evaluated model uses a pretrained camera-BEV backbone, temporal feature fusion and a lightweight recurrent trajectory planner. It contains approximately 79.9 million parameters, of which approximately 1.45 million are trainable in the evaluated configuration. The v1.0 release provides model checkpoints, training and evaluation code, and DataModelConsole, a dashboard for visualizing and inspecting model experiments. On the KITScenes validation benchmark, the fine-tuned checkpoint achieves an average displacement error (ADE) of 0.745 m and a final displacement error (FDE) of 2.020 m at a three-second prediction horizon. The paper also reports preliminary real-vehicle research conducted with the Technical University of Munich's EDGAR platform, alongside ongoing collaboration with the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. AutoE2E v1.0 is an early open research release. Its quantitative evaluation is open-loop, and the model has not yet demonstrated validated closed-loop autonomous driving. The release is intended to provide the autonomous-driving community with an inspectable baseline for further research, experimentation and collaborative development.

AI.tldr: AutoE2E v1.0：Autoware 基金会 Robotaxi 工作组开源的端到端驾驶模型，采用时序 BEV 架构（多相机 + HD 地图 + 路线条件）预测未来轨迹，约 7990 万参数（仅 145 万可训练），KITScenes 验证集 3 秒 ADE 0.745 m、FDE 2.020 m，为早期开源研究基线。
AI.motivation: 为自动驾驶社区提供一个可检查（inspectable）、可复现的开源端到端驾驶基线，配套检查点、训练/评估代码与可视化仪表盘，便于后续研究与协作开发，弥补端到端驾驶模型多为闭源、难以审计的缺口。
AI.method: 时序 BEV 架构：多相机感知 + HD 地图信息 + 路线条件输入；使用预训练相机-BEV 主干、时序特征融合与轻量循环（recurrent）轨迹规划头；仅对约 1.45 M 参数进行微调（主体主干冻结）。
AI.result: KITScenes 验证集 3 s 时域 ADE 0.745 m / FDE 2.020 m；报告了与 TUM EDGAR 平台的初步实车研究，及与 KIT 的持续合作；发布 v1.0 检查点、代码及 DataModelConsole 实验可视化面板。
AI.conclusion: 仅为开放环（open-loop）定量评估的早期开源研究发布，尚未验证闭环自动驾驶能力；定位为社区可审计基线而非成熟系统。

title: Leveraging Segmentation Representations for Efficient Classification: A Self-Configuring Framework Based on nnU-Net
summary: We propose a self-configuring framework that extends the nnU-Net workflow to both segmentation and classification in 3D medical imaging. Building on nnU-Net's self-configuring method, the framework reuses representations learned by a segmentation model for image-level classification. Its encoder features and predicted segmentation probabilities are used by a lightweight classifier. Two information-sharing strategies are investigated. In the frozen-backbone branch, features are augmented with region-of-interest information, predicted foreground volume, and segmentation confidence. In the adaptation branch, the final encoder stage is partially fine-tuned for classification, with an auxiliary segmentation loss to preserve segmentation-related information. Additional five-fold experiments showed that more complex configurations did not consistently improve classification performance. On the public validation leaderboard, our selected framework achieved an Overall score of 0.8056. In the official FLARE 2026 Task 2 final evaluation, our framework ranked first overall, achieving the highest DSC, NSD, and AUROC across all four testing tasks, including two hidden testing tasks. Local inference measurements also remained below the challenge limits of $60 \mathrm{s}$ per case and $4 \mathrm{GB}$ GPU memory. These results demonstrate the practical value of reusing segmentation representations for classification while maintaining a simple and efficient framework.

AI.tldr: 提出自配置框架将 nnU-Net 流程扩展到 3D 医学影像的分割+分类联合任务：复用分割模型编码器特征与预测概率驱动轻量分类器，并比较冻结骨干（引入ROI信息、前景体积、分割置信度）与部分微调+辅助分割损失两种信息共享策略；在 FLARE 2026 Task 2 最终评测中排名第一，四项任务均为最高 DSC/NSD/AUROC，推理<60s/例、<4GB 显存。
AI.motivation: 3D 医学影像中分割与分类通常分头建模，需重复训练与推理开销；希望验证分割学到的表征能否被直接复用于图像级分类，同时保持 nnU-Net 式免调参、轻量高效的工程特性。
AI.method: 以 nnU-Net 为基座做多任务扩展：编码器特征与分割概率图送入轻量分类头；分支 A（冻结骨干）将特征与 ROI 区域信息、预测前景体积、分割置信度拼接；分支 B（适配）部分微调编码器末段并用辅助分割损失保留分割信息；做了五折消融比较不同配置复杂度。
AI.result: 公开验证榜 Overall 0.8056；FLARE 2026 Task 2 官方终评总排名第一，含两个隐藏测试任务在内的四项任务 DSC、NSD、AUROC 均最优；本地推理低于 60s/例与 4GB 显存限制。复杂配置未带来稳定的分类提升。
AI.conclusion: 多任务表征复用对 3D 医学分割-分类是可行且高效的，简单配置即达到竞赛最优；但属医学影像专用流水线，未涉及具身/机器人或 3D 重建通用性，对核心 Physical AI 方向仅为方法论背景。

title: DGV-DLIVO: Degeneracy-Guided Visual Fusion for Direct LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry in Degenerate Tunnel Environments
summary: Reliable localization in long underground infrastructures remains a major challenge for autonomous inspection robots. In hydropower spillway tunnels and drainage galleries, repetitive geometric structures provide insufficient constraints along the tunnel axis, while weak texture and illumination variations further degrade visual estimation. Under this coupled degradation, existing LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial odometry systems may lose the ability to recover continuous longitudinal motion. This paper presents DGV-DLIVO, a degeneracy-guided visual fusion for direct LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry for extreme tunnel environments. Instead of treating vision as a general complementary sensor, the proposed method exploits the LiDAR-degenerate direction as an active guidance signal to determine informative visual regions, establish LiDAR-anchored visual associations, and perform subspace-selective fusion. The visual constraints are introduced only into the deficient motion subspace, while unreliable LiDAR information in the same direction is adaptively suppressed and reliable geometric constraints are preserved. Real-world experiments in hydropower tunnels demonstrate that representative state-of-the-art LIO, LIVO, and VIO methods suffer from stagnation, oscillation, severe under-travel, curved drift, or divergence, whereas DGV-DLIVO maintains continuous and directionally consistent tunnel-axis motion estimation under both cart-mounted and handheld acquisition. It achieves a 91.4% progress ratio over the 40m tunnel sequence and significantly improves longitudinal recovery and trajectory stability. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of degeneracy-guided adaptive fusion for robotic inspection in severely degraded underground environments. The source code and a supplementary video are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出DGV-DLIVO：以LiDAR退化方向作为主动引导信号，选择有信息量的视觉区域并在退化子空间内做选择性融合的LiDAR-惯性-视觉直接里程计，实现水电站隧洞等极端退化环境下的连续纵向定位。
AI.motivation: 长距离地下基础设施中，重复几何结构导致沿隧道轴向约束不足，弱纹理与光照变化进一步削弱视觉估计；LIO因几何退化、VIO因视觉失效同时崩溃，现有系统可能失去恢复连续纵向运动的能力。
AI.method: 不把视觉当作通用互补传感器，而是用LiDAR退化方向（退化子空间）指导：(1) 定位有信息量的视觉区域；(2) 建立以LiDAR为锚的视觉关联；(3) 仅在缺失的运动子空间内注入视觉约束，同时自适应抑制同方向不可靠的LiDAR信息、保留可靠几何约束，形成子空间选择性的紧耦合直接法融合。
AI.result: 水电站隧洞实测中，代表性SOTA的LIO/LIVO/VIO方法出现停滞、振荡、严重行程不足、弯曲漂移或发散；DGV-DLIVO在推车与手持采集下均保持连续且方向一致的隧洞轴向运动估计，40m序列进度比达91.4%，纵向恢复与轨迹稳定性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 退化引导的自适应融合可有效解决极端地下环境中的机器人巡检定位问题，开源代码与视频已公开。

title: Hidden Variables Behind Real-Robot Data Quality: Lessons from Hundreds of Thousands of Hours
comment: Technical report. Project page: this https URL
summary: As real-robot data collection scales, collection-system design shapes both operator efficiency and the behaviors learned by robot policies. Workspace limitations, control-interface friction, and latency can introduce pauses, detours, and corrective motions into otherwise successful demonstrations. We investigate these effects across embodiment, teleoperation control, and data consistency, combining a kinematic study of 25 dual-arm robots, controlled teleoperation experiments, and real-robot evaluation of fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ policies. The embodiment study shows that positional reachability overstates orientation-aware task coverage and that modest shoulder motion can substantially expand the effective workspace. Teleoperation experiments show that parallelizing body-part control reduces task completion time by 43-53%, while compliant control improves success and reduces peak contact forces on constrained and contact-rich tasks. Policy-learning experiments show that demonstrations must capture the visual information underlying action choices: active-search demonstrations improve arm-selection accuracy from chance (50%) to 100%. Calibration experiments reveal that mixed-calibration training data remain usable in our tested configurations when an inference-aligned subset is retained, whereas inference-time miscalibration causes all 30 trials to fail. Policies also retain approximately 90% of the extra path length in detour-contaminated demonstrations, showing how inefficient operator motions persist in learned behavior. Together, these findings connect collection-system design to demonstration quality and downstream policy execution. They motivate evaluating effective workspace, control efficiency, observation completeness, calibration alignment, and motion quality before scaling collection, and addressing system-induced compensations at their source.
