AI.tldr: 机器人数据采集系统设计（本体可达性、遥操作接口、观测与标定一致性）会系统性地把停顿、绕行、修正动作注入示范数据，而这些低效动作约90%会被策略继承。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人数据规模扩大时，采集系统设计同时决定操作员效率与策略学到的行为；工作空间限制、控制接口摩擦、时延会在成功示范中引入停顿、绕行和修正动作，需要量化这些效应并追溯到系统源头。
AI.method: 三类研究结合：25台双臂机器人的运动学分析；受控遥操作实验（部位并行控制、柔顺控制）；微调π0.5策略的真实机器人评测；以及标定混合训练与推理时误标定实验。
AI.result: 位置可达性高估了考虑姿态的任务覆盖率，适度肩部运动可显著扩大有效工作空间；部位并行控制缩短任务时间43-53%，柔顺控制提升成功率并降低峰值接触力；主动搜索示范将臂选择准确率从随机50%提升至100%；保留与推理一致子集时混合标定数据可用，推理时误标定导致30次试验全部失败；策略保留约90%的绕行额外路径长度。
AI.conclusion: 采集系统设计直接决定示范质量与下游策略执行，应在规模化采集前评估有效工作空间、控制效率、观测完整性、标定对齐与运动质量，并从源头消除系统诱导的补偿动作。

title: CoBoVLA: Decoupling Language from Action with Discrete Codes for Robust and Interpretable Robot Manipulation
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, and supplemental material included
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve high success rates on the LIBERO benchmark but remain sensitive to paraphrasing. Existing VLAs ranging from 0.6B to 7.5B parameters experience a 22-52 point performance drop on LIBERO-Para while SmolVLA exhibits an even larger decline, from 83\% to 8\%. Because most VLAs jointly learn language understanding and action generation, it is difficult to determine whether a failure originates from misunderstanding an instruction or executing it incorrectly. To address these challenges, we introduce CoBoVLA, or CodeBookVLA, a 250M-parameter VLA that decouples language understanding, planning, and control through learned discrete interpretable codes. A text encoder maps the instructions to shared step codes, which a visual planner then converts into action code sequences executed by a language-independent actor. This design improves robustness to instruction paraphrasing while allowing failures to be traced to individual stages. It also enables efficient real-time control on resource-constrained hardware by encoding instructions only once and using compact discrete representations to keep each component lightweight. CoBoVLA achieves 91.4\% success on LIBERO-Goal, compared with 82.8\% for SmolVLA, under a matched protocol, with 17 ms per control step latency. On LIBERO-Para, it achieves 81.1\% across 4,092 unseen paraphrases and 78.5\% on matched episodes, compared with 36.5\% for SmolVLA LoRA fine-tuned on paraphrases. Without two-step demonstrations, CoBoVLA completes 48.8\% of 160 free-form two-step tasks. Finally, success reaches 91\% when instructions are correctly encoded but falls to 27.2\% otherwise, identifying language understanding as the main source of remaining failures. Together, these results demonstrate that decoupling language understanding and control can improve instruction robustness while making VLA failures easier to diagnose.

AI.tldr: 提出 250M 参数 CoBoVLA（CodeBookVLA），通过学习到的离散可解释码将语言理解、规划与控制解耦：文本编码器将指令映射为共享步骤码，视觉规划器转为动作码序列，由与语言无关的执行器执行，显著提升对指令改写的鲁棒性并实现 17ms/步实时控制。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA（0.6B–7.5B）在 LIBERO 上成功率高，但对释义（paraphrasing）敏感，LIBERO-Para 上掉点 22–52；SmolVLA 甚至从 83% 跌至 8%。联合学习语言理解与动作生成使得无法定位失败来源（理解错 vs 执行错）。
AI.method: 三段式解耦架构 + 共享离散码本：文本编码器→步骤码（step code）；视觉规划器将步骤码与视觉观测转为动作码（action code）序列；语言无关的执行器（actor）将动作码解码为控制量。指令仅需编码一次，各模块轻量化，适合资源受限硬件的实时控制；失败可归因到单个阶段。
AI.result: LIBERO-Goal 91.4%（SmolVLA 82.8%，同协议）；LIBERO-Para 上 4,092 条未见释义 81.1%、匹配回合 78.5%（释义 LoRA 微调的 SmolVLA 仅 36.5%）；无两步演示情况下完成 160 个自由形式两步任务的 48.8%；控制延迟 17 ms/步；指令正确编码时成功率 91%，否则 27.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将语言理解与控制解耦可同时提升指令鲁棒性与失败可诊断性；剩余失败主要源于语言理解阶段。实验限于 LIBERO 仿真基准，缺少真机验证。

title: SkiNet-Sim: Simulating Petri Nets with Data for the Verification and Validation of Controllers for Autonomous Systems
comment: In Proceedings FMAS 2026, arXiv:2611.21375
summary: A large amount of high-level Petri net formalisms has been investigated and deployed in academic settings over the past decades, but these deployments fail to reach practical applications, despite the strong guarantees they can bring to stakeholders. In particular, the lack of direct benefits from end-users reduces the appeal of Petri nets, both due to the overly simple classical Petri net formalism, and the overly specialized high-level formalisms, on top of state-space explosion issues. In this work, we investigate how a middle-ground could be reached, by separating the implementation-specific aspects of software or hardware behaviors, from the classical Petri net semantics. The goal is to benefit from the sought-after aspects of Petri nets, namely their simple firing semantic and model-checking capabilities, while still being able to augment their behavior to best reflect the modelled system. We present a formal model of Interpreted Petri nets with data-aware transitions and tokens. We illustrate this formalism by modelling the executive layer of a robotic system, and provide a lightweight tool to augment classical Petri nets for general purpose applications, as well as data-aware state-space exploration for model-checking. Their specialization in the context of autonomous robotics is showcased, with a complete industrial inspection mission use-case, to compare simulation and model-checking results between the classical and the new data-aware Petri net semantic.

AI.tldr: 提出带数据感知变迁与托肯的“解释Petri网”（Interpreted Petri nets）形式化模型，将实现相关细节与经典Petri网语义分离，并提供轻量工具支持建模、仿真与数据感知状态空间探索，最后以自主机器人工业巡检任务对比新旧语义。
AI.motivation: 高层Petri网形式化方法虽保证性强，但因终端用户无直接收益（经典Petri网过于简单、高层形式化过于专门化、状态空间爆炸）而难以落地实际应用，作者希望找到折中方案。
AI.method: 把软件/硬件行为中与实现相关的部分从经典Petri网语义中分离出去；定义带数据感知变迁和托肯的解释Petri网形式模型；实现轻量级工具，将经典Petri网扩展为通用应用可用，并提供数据感知的状态空间探索以支持模型检验；用机器人系统执行层建模与工业巡检案例进行验证。
AI.result: 在自主机器人执行层建模与完整工业巡检任务中成功演示了该形式化方法，并比较了经典Petri网与数据感知语义下的仿真与模型检验结果（摘要未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 数据感知的解释Petri网可在保留简单点火语义与模型检验能力的同时增强表达力，是Petri网走向实用应用的一种可行折中路线，但证据局限于单一案例研究。

title: Plenty to FRET About: From Hazard Analysis to Formal Requirements for Robot-Assisted Dressing
comment: In Proceedings FMAS 2026, arXiv:2611.21375
summary: Understanding requirements for systems involving humans and robots is essential for providing robust evidence that such systems behave correctly. Requirements formalisation approaches such as the Formal Requirements Elicitation Tool (FRET) can support the transition from unstructured natural language to formal representations suitable for verification. In this paper, we formalise 146 hazard-derived natural-language requirements for a Robot-Assisted Dressing (RAD) case study, previously classified using a taxonomy of Human-Robot Teamwork (HRT) requirements. Through an iterative process involving domain-expert clarification, these were represented by 117 unique FRETISH requirements. Formalisation exposed ambiguities, temporal and probabilistic assumptions, and cases where source requirements needed to be decomposed or could be consolidated because they expressed the same formal behaviour. Temporal analysis showed that 70.1% of the unique FRETISH requirements use either immediate-response or ordering constraints (immediately or before), while formalisation also exposed relationships between requirements across HRT taxonomy categories. We further analyse the formal semantics and realisability of the resulting requirements. The results show that HRT classification and formalisation provide complementary views: the taxonomy captures the teamwork concern represented by a requirement, while FRETISH makes the required behaviour explicit. We report practical lessons and limitations of applying FRET to HRT requirements and identify directions for further work.

AI.tldr: 将146条人机协作穿衣(RAD)场景的危害衍生自然语言需求，经领域专家澄清后形式化为117条唯一FRETISH需求，并分析其时序语义与可实现性。
AI.motivation: 人机协作系统需要可验证的证据来证明行为正确，但需求多为非结构化自然语言；FRET等需求形式化工具可桥接自然语言与可验证形式表示，但尚缺乏在HRT需求上的系统实践与经验。
AI.method: 以Robot-Assisted Dressing为案例，对已用HRT分类法标注的146条危害衍生需求进行迭代式形式化（含专家澄清、分解与合并），得到117条唯一FRETISH需求；统计时序模式（immediate-response与ordering约束占70.1%），并分析形式语义与可实现性（realisability）。
AI.result: 形式化过程暴露出歧义、时序与概率性假设，以及需分解或可合并（等价形式行为）的需求；70.1%的唯一需求使用immediate/before类时序约束；并发现跨HRT类别的需求间关系。HRT分类（团队协作关切）与FRETISH（显式行为）构成互补视图。
AI.conclusion: HRT分类法与需求形式化互补而非替代；给出了FRET应用于HRT需求的实践教训与局限，并指出后续工作方向（如概率/时序假设的建模与可实现性检验的自动化）。

title: BehaVerify: A Formal Verification Tool for Behavior Trees
comment: In Proceedings FMAS 2026, arXiv:2611.21375
summary: This paper presents BehaVerify, a verification toolbox for behavior trees (BTs) and Neuro-Symbolic BTs. BTs are a graphical language for planning and sequencing behaviors - similar to extended state machines - and are increasingly used in safety-critical domains. BehaVerify enables users to specify a BT using a Domain Specific Language (DSL) with formal syntax and semantics. This language further includes Linear Temporal Logic and Computation Tree Logic specifications. BehaVerify uses an efficient encoding into nuXmv, called fastforwarding, to quickly verify if a specification holds over the BT. Additionally, BehaVerify can generate implementations of the BT in Python and Haskell. Through Python, BehaVerify has been integrated with PyTrees and Robot Operating System (ROS) and has been deployed to several autonomous robotic systems, including for verifying runtime monitors. While prior works have developed the underlying theory, this manuscript focuses on the toolbox usage, functionality and implementation. BehaVerify is open source: this https URL

AI.tldr: BehaVerify：面向行为树（BT）与神经符号BT的运行时验证工具箱，提供带形式化语法语义的DSL、LTL/CTL规范表达、经"fastforwarding"编码到nuXmv的高效模型检验，并可自动生成Python与Haskell实现，已集成py_trees与ROS并部署于多个自主机器人系统。
AI.motivation: 行为树在安全关键领域（机器人）中广泛使用，但缺乏可追溯的形式化语义与可自动化的验证流程；已有理论工作难以被工程师直接使用，因此需要一个可落地的工具箱，把BT设计、形式化规范与模型检验、以及代码生成打通。
AI.method: 1) 设计带形式语法与语义的BT领域专用语言（DSL），支持LTL与CTL规范；2) 提出"fastforwarding"编码，将BT高效翻译为nuXmv的有限状态模型，以便模型检验；3) 自动生成Python/Haskell实现，Python端对接py_trees与ROS，实现仿真与实机一致、可作为运行时监视器；4) 开源发布，面向工具箱用法、功能与实现进行说明。
AI.result: 在多个自主机器人系统上完成部署，用于验证运行时监视器；具备BT到nuXmv的快速编码能力与多目标代码生成能力；提供开源工具箱。论文侧重工程实现与使用接口，未给出系统的定量规模/性能对照实验。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把行为树的形式化验证从理论推进到可用的工程工具链，DSL + 模型检验 + 代码生成的一体化设计便于在真实机器人栈中做设计期验证与运行时监视；可作为安全关键机器人感知—决策系统的验证基础设施，但其价值在验证/工程侧，而非感知或重建方法论。

title: ROSMonitoring in Action: Runtime Monitoring and Enforcement for ROS 2 Actions
comment: In Proceedings FMAS 2026, arXiv:2611.21375
summary: Robotic applications often rely on long-running operations, such as navigation, manipulation, and inspection, which in ROS~2 are commonly implemented as actions. Unlike topics and services, actions involve a structured lifecycle comprising goal submission and acceptance, feedback, status updates, result retrieval, and cancellation. Existing versions of ROSMonitoring support topics and services, but do not reconstruct this lifecycle or expose action-level events to a runtime-verification oracle. In this paper, we extend ROSMonitoring with runtime monitoring and enforcement for ROS~2 actions. Actions are declared directly in the monitoring configuration and automatically instrumented through the underlying ROS~2 communication endpoints. The generated monitor reconstructs action-level events, correlates them through goal identifiers, maintains the state of active goals, and translates violations into protocol-aware enforcement operations. These include goal rejection, cancellation, message suppression, and protocol-compliant responses generated directly by the monitor when the original communication cannot be forwarded. We evaluate the implementation through controlled stress tests that vary the number of action invocations, workload size, and clientâ€“server topology. The results show approximately linear growth in monitoring cost with repeated action invocations under a fixed workload, while larger action workloads and a greater number of configured clientâ€“server pairs introduce additional overhead. These results characterise the scaling behaviour of the current implementation under the tested sequential workloads while highlighting the main performance limitations of the current synchronous implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文扩展 ROSMonitoring，使其支持 ROS 2 action 的运行时监控与干预：在监控配置中声明 action，自动在底层通信端点插桩，重建 action 生命周期事件、按 goal ID 关联并维护活跃目标状态，并将违规转换为协议感知的拒绝、取消、消息抑制等干预操作；通过压力测试揭示了监控开销的线性及超线性增长特征。
AI.motivation: ROS 2 中的长时操作（导航、操作、巡检）通常以 action 实现，其具有 goal 提交/接受、反馈、状态更新、结果获取与取消的结构化生命周期。现有 ROSMonitoring 仅支持 topic 与 service，无法重建该生命周期，也无法向运行时验证 oracle 暴露 action 级事件。
AI.method: 在 ROSMonitoring 中加入 action 级运行时监控与强制执行：从监控配置中声明 action，基于底层 ROS 2 通信端点自动插桩；生成的监视器重建 action 级事件，利用 goal identifier 关联事件、维护活跃 goal 状态，并把违规映射为协议感知的强制操作——goal 拒绝、取消、消息抑制，以及当原始通信无法转发时由监视器直接生成符合协议规范的响应。
AI.result: 受控压力测试（变化 action 调用次数、工作负载规模、client–server 拓扑）显示：固定工作负载下，监控开销随重复 action 调用近似线性增长；更大的 action 工作负载与更多客户端–服务器对会带来额外开销。结果刻画了当前同步实现在顺序工作负载下的扩展行为，并指出其主要性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ROSMonitoring 现已覆盖 ROS 2 action 生命周期的运行时验证与强制干预，具备协议级干预能力；但当前同步实现存在性能限制，后续需优化并发与开销扩展性。该工作属于机器人中间件/运行时安全验证工具链。

title: SignAligner: Dual-Granularity Span Generation for Sign Language Alignment
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures
summary: Large sign-language corpora benefit from temporal labels at two scales: subtitle spans for subtitle alignment and word spans for sign spotting. Sign spottings already locate words in time at corpus scale, but training subtitle alignment jointly on subtitle and word spans remains underexplored. We present SignAligner, a prompt-conditioned visual-language span generator that maps a sign-language video and a subtitle-sentence or target-word query to a textual start/end frame interval. It is first trained jointly on subtitle spans and word spans from sign spottings, then refined with overlap-based rewards while retaining auxiliary word examples. On the subtitle test set of the British Broadcasting Corporation-Oxford British Sign Language (BOBSL) corpus, the refined model reaches 66.68 F1@0.50 (F1 with a temporal intersection-over-union threshold of one half), the best among compared systems without external sign-video resources. This overlap-reward refinement outperforms cross-entropy continuation from the same jointly trained model. Joint training with word spans improves subtitle alignment in a pair of our generators matched in code, labels and maximum update budget. The advantage remains after both models of the pair are refined with overlap rewards. For word queries, the refined model follows the queried word, not a fixed position in the video: when the word's sign lies away from the video centre, it is far more accurate than predictions that use position alone. Together, these findings support one shared span generator refined with overlap rewards, aligning subtitles and producing word spans for human review.

AI.tldr: 提出 SignAligner：以提示（字幕句或查询词）为条件的视觉-语言时间跨度生成器，将手语视频+文本查询映射为起止帧区间；先联合训练字幕跨度与词级 spotting 跨度，再用重叠度奖励精修。BOBSL 字幕对齐达 66.68 F1@0.50。
AI.motivation: 大规模手语语料需要两个尺度的时间标签（字幕跨度用于字幕对齐、词跨度用于手语词定位）；word spotting 已在语料级提供词级时间标注，但二者联合训练字幕对齐仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 统一的提示条件跨度生成器：输入手语视频与字幕句/目标词查询，输出文本形式的起止帧。两阶段训练：(1) 在字幕跨度与 spotting 词跨度上联合训练；(2) 用基于时间 IoU 重叠的奖励（配合保留辅助词样本）进行精修，并与同源模型的交叉熵继续训练作对照。
AI.result: BOBSL 字幕测试集 66.68 F1@0.50，为无外部手语视频资源的对比系统最佳；重叠奖励精修优于交叉熵续训；代码、标签、更新预算匹配的成对模型显示词跨度联合训练提升字幕对齐，且精修后优势保留；对词查询，模型跟随即查询词而非视频固定位置，词位于偏离中心处时显著优于仅用位置先验的预测。
AI.conclusion: 一个共享跨度生成器+重叠奖励精修即可同时完成字幕对齐与词级跨度预测（供人工复核），验证了跨尺度标签联合训练的有效性。

title: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Includes supplementary material. Code available at this https URL
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SpatialMind提出任务自适应多层级几何特征融合框架，用指令+视觉+几何联合门控动态调制LLM解码器各层几何粒度，VSI-Bench达72.3 SOTA。
AI.motivation: MLLM在3D空间推理上受限；将3D重建模型接入MLLM的现有做法或只用单一几何粒度，或采用固定多层级融合，无法匹配不同认知层级空间任务（如距离估计vs路径规划）对几何粒度的差异化需求。
AI.method: 系统实验验证不同空间任务的粒度需求→提出任务自适应框架SpatialMind；核心为GeoFus多层几何融合模块：门控网络以文本指令、视觉语义、几何表示为联合条件，逐层调制浅/中/深几何特征在LLM解码器各层的贡献；引入负熵正则损失防止门控坍缩。
AI.result: 门控可视化显示GeoFus能按任务自适应选择几何粒度；在多个空间基准上取得有竞争力表现，VSI-Bench得分72.3（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: 固定粒度/固定融合是3D空间推理的主要瓶颈，任务自适应门控融合是有效且可解释的解法；代码开源，可作为3D感知与LLM结合的可复用范式。

title: CutAgent: Creative-Gene-Driven Planning and Experience-Guided Self-Refinement for High-CTR E-commerce Advertising Video Creation
summary: E-commerce advertising video creation requires both high-level creative planning and reliable multi-modal production. However, existing methods often map product attributes directly to scripts or editing decisions without explicitly modeling advertising strategies, narrative structures, and production styles. They also have limited ability to reuse past production failures. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{CutAgent}$, a dual-agent framework that formulates advertising video creation as a Plan--Execute--Self-Evolve process. CutAgent comprises two collaborative agents, $\textbf{GeneAgent}$ and $\textbf{VideoAgent}$, connected by a structured creative gene that bridges product understanding and video production. GeneAgent maps multi-modal product inputs---textual attributes together with product images---to creative genes that specify narrative units and production rules. To train GeneAgent, we construct $\textbf{CutAgent-70K}$ with approximately 70K samples of product attributes/images, reverse-extracted creative genes, cleaned clip pools, and real-world CTR, and apply high-CTR supervised fine-tuning followed by CTR-guided GRPO. Guided by the generated gene, VideoAgent retrieves category-then-gene failure--correction experiences from a long-term memory as constraints for shot-script planning, then coordinates material retrieval, narration, subtitles, music, and timeline rendering. Independently, a reflection loop diagnoses quality defects, revises deficient production decisions, and writes verified corrections back to memory for later retrieval. Experiments on $\textbf{CutAgent-Eval}$ show that CutAgent outperforms representative baselines in e-commerce advertising video creation, achieving the highest online CTR of $\textbf{2.21\%}$.

AI.tldr: CutAgent：双智能体（GeneAgent+VideoAgent）框架，将电商广告视频创作建模为 Plan–Execute–Self-Evolve 流程，用"创意基因"连接商品理解与视频生产，并通过长期记忆复用失败–修正经验。
AI.motivation: 现有电商广告视频生成方法将商品属性直接映射到脚本或剪辑，缺乏对广告策略、叙事结构与制作风格的显式建模，也无法复用既往的制作失败经验。
AI.method: GeneAgent 将文本属性与商品图像映射为含叙事单元与制作规则的"创意基因"；构建 CutAgent-70K（约7万样本，含反向提取的创意基因、清洗片段库、真实 CTR），先高 CTR 监督微调再做 CTR 引导的 GRPO。VideoAgent 依据基因，从长期记忆中检索"类别→基因"级失败–修正经验作为镜头脚本规划约束，协调素材检索、旁白、字幕、音乐与时间线渲染；独立的反思回路诊断质量缺陷、修正决策并将经验写回记忆。
AI.result: 在 CutAgent-Eval 上优于代表性基线，线上 CTR 达 2.21%，为最高。
AI.conclusion: 显式创意基因建模加可演化的记忆机制，可在多模态视频生产中有效结合策略规划与执行质量，并获得真实业务指标提升。

title: Do Diffusion Models Learn to Generalize Basic Visual Skills?
comment: NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Diffusion models generate high-quality images, but how well they generalize is hard to measure. Current evaluations rely on human preference and prompt-following benchmarks for text-to-image models and on distribution-level metrics such as Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and Inception Score (IS) for class-conditional models, but these cannot tell whether models learn basic visual skills or largely match training patterns. To address this gap, we introduce the Visual Generative Lab (VGL), a controlled experimental framework for studying how diffusion models learn and generalize basic visual skills, including size, position, rotation, count, color, shape, and their compositions. By generating synthetic training data for each skill from explicit rules, VGL allows precise measurement of generalization with task-specific, rule-based metrics. Training models from scratch on these data reveals three patterns in this controlled setting: (1) with our default design, extrapolation is limited: size and position degrade within a few pixels of the training range, count reaches only about 50% accuracy on out-of-range counts, and rotation extrapolation accuracy varies widely across seeds; (2) for compositional generalization, the number of distinct basic visual skill combinations matters more than dataset size; (3) skills mostly fail independently, except position. Code and data-generation scripts: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 VGL 受控实验框架，用规则生成的合成数据系统评测扩散模型在尺寸、位置、旋转、计数、颜色、形状及其组合等基础视觉技能上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有评测依赖人类偏好、提示遵循基准或 FID/IS 等分布级指标，无法判断模型是学到了基础视觉技能，还是仅在匹配训练模式，缺少对泛化性的精确度量。
AI.method: 以显式规则为每项视觉技能合成训练数据，并从零训练扩散模型，用任务特定、基于规则的指标精确测量分布外与组合泛化。
AI.result: （1）外推能力有限：尺寸与位置在超出训练范围几个像素内即退化，超范围计数准确率仅约 50%，旋转外推随随机种子波动大；（2）组合泛化中，基础技能组合的多样性比数据规模更重要；（3）各技能基本独立失效，位置除外。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型在受控环境下基础视觉技能泛化弱且组合性差，数据组合多样性比规模更关键，为诊断生成模型泛化提供了可复用的规则化评测范式。

title: When Neural Collapse Fails to Route: Routing Drift in Continual Learning
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. 36 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Progressive neural-collapse classifiers can learn strong task-local decision boundaries while failing the global Class-IL decision. We identify the failure as routing drift: under an expanding equiangular tight frame (ETF) classifier, a held-out sample can remain separable within its true task block, yet receive its largest global score from another block. This produces high Task-IL accuracy but low Class-IL accuracy, and small replay buffers can mask the problem because stored samples are optimized repeatedly and often remain well routed. We formalize route accuracy directly from the global class argmax and use it to separate within-task discrimination from cross-task score comparability. This decomposition suggests a classifier-level correction: preserve the global ETF frame, but add class-local reliability evidence when transported class measures deviate from the neural-collapse ideal. We develop Reliability-Calibrated Routing (RCR), a lightweight post-hoc classifier that composes standardized ETF alignment with radial plausibility around transported, NC-shrunk class representatives. Across three datasets and two fixed replay-buffer budgets, this NC-consistent correction gives the best Class-IL FAA on five of six settings and reduces Class-IL forgetting on all six. The largest gains occur in harder routing regimes: up to $+6.75$ FAA over the reported reference, and up to $+8.03$ FAA and $+8.62$ final route accuracy in paired evaluations, while preserving Task-IL performance. These results position routing drift as a measurable failure mode of ETF-based continual learning and show that reliability-calibrated class evidence can repair part of the lost global routing without retraining the representation. Code and evaluation artifacts are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该文把渐进式神经坍缩分类器在Class-IL上的失效归结为"路由漂移"：样本在真实任务块内可分，但全局argmax落在其他块；据此提出后置的可靠性校准路由(RCR)修正，在六个设置中的五个取得最佳Class-IL FAA并全面降低遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有基于等角紧框架(ETF)神经坍缩的持续学习分类器能学好任务内决策边界，但全局Class-IL决策很差；小回放缓冲区因样本被反复优化而掩盖了该问题，需要显式区分任务内判别力与跨任务分数可比性。
AI.method: 形式化定义route accuracy（由全局类argmax直接计算），将失效诊断为ETF分类器下跨块分数不可比导致的路由漂移；提出Reliability-Calibrated Routing(RCR)：保留全局ETF框架，将标准化ETF对齐与围绕NC收缩类代表点的径向合理性证据组合，作为轻量后置分类器，无需重训表示。
AI.result: 在三数据集、两档固定回放预算共六个设置中，Class-IL FAA有五个最佳，六个设置Class-IL遗忘全部下降；相对参考最高+6.75 FAA，配对评估中最高+8.03 FAA与+8.62最终路由准确率，同时保持Task-IL性能。
AI.conclusion: 路由漂移是ETF类持续学习可度量的失效模式，基于可靠性校准的类证据能在不重训表示的前提下部分修复全局路由；但属分类器层面修补，非表征层面解决。

title: Where Demand Meets Supply: Spatial Elastic Consensus for Low-Bandwidth Collaborative Perception
comment: 10 pages
summary: Occlusions and limited sensor range make ego-only 3D perception insufficient for safe driving. Collaborative perception addresses this by enabling connected vehicles to share complementary observations, yet it remains constrained by tight vehicular communication budgets. While spatial selection is more flexible than fixed-rate feature compression, existing selectors remain largely sender-driven and waste scarce bandwidth on ego-visible targets. Furthermore, applying convolutions after masking spreads isolated tokens into their neighborhoods, silently violating low-bandwidth constraints. To address this, we propose Spatial Elastic Consensus (SEC), a bandwidth-adaptive framework centered on bilateral demand-supply consensus. Instead of unilateral token selection, the ego vehicle formulates a content-aware demand prior while each collaborator evaluates its local supply. This single-round consensus allocates the token budget to critical ego-missed evidence rather than ego-visible redundancy, without transmitting dense maps. To guarantee exact budget compliance, an anti-dilation refine-before-mask pipeline refines features prior to discrete token selection, preventing receptive-field leakage. A lightweight deformable sampler then aggregates these sparse messages with learned local offsets, compensating for the spatial context lost to token selection and mitigating inter-agent pose drift. Evaluated at a stringent 64KiB budget, SEC consistently achieves the best AP@0.7 on the simulated OPV2V and V2XSet datasets and the real-world DAIR-V2X dataset. These results demonstrate that combining bilateral consensus with budget-exact transmission is key to efficient low-bandwidth collaborative perception.

AI.tldr: SEC：面向车路协同感知的双边需求-供给共识带宽自适应框架，通过"先细化后掩码"保证64KiB预算精确合规，并以可变形采样器补偿稀疏化损失。
AI.motivation: 单车3D感知受遮挡与传感距离限制；现有协作感知的空间选择器多为发送端主导，将有限带宽浪费在自车已可见目标上；且掩码后使用卷积会因感受野扩散导致实际传输量超出低带宽约束。
AI.method: 提出Spatial Elastic Consensus (SEC)：1) 双边共识——自车生成内容感知的需求先验，各协作者评估本地供给，单轮协商后将token预算分配给自车遗漏的关键证据；2) anti-dilation refine-before-mask流水线，先细化特征再离散选token，避免卷积感受野泄漏；3) 轻量可变形采样器以学习到的局部偏移聚合稀疏消息，补偿空间上下文并缓解位姿漂移。
AI.result: 在严格64KiB通信预算下，于仿真数据集OPV2V、V2XSet及真实数据集DAIR-V2X上均取得最佳AP@0.7。
AI.conclusion: 双边共识与预算精确传输的结合是高效低带宽协作感知的关键，验证了需求驱动token分配相对发送端贪心选择的优势。

title: The shape of individual differences in judgment: shared axes, personal weights, and when their spread crosses the consensus
summary: People differ in how they judge faces, artworks, photographs and jokes. Previous work measured the size of these differences; we ask what shape they take. We wrote three candidate shapes as nested generative models (same-sign reweighting of shared dimensions, a linear transform that allows reversal, and stimulus-specific offsets) and compared how well they predict people unseen in training, using ten public datasets (about 20,000 raters). The models recovered a person's judgment space from 10-20 judgments and predicted judgments of unseen stimuli. For faces, reweighting was sufficient, and weights opposing the population were not statistically detected. For artworks, weights spread continuously along the shared abstract-figurative direction, and 28 percent of raters fell on the opposite side from the population. This tail was much smaller when a different rater sample judged the same artworks. Individual differences thus differ in shape as well as size, and the shape depends on domain and raters.

AI.tldr: 研究把"个体审美/面孔判断差异"建模为三种嵌套生成形状（同号重加权、可反向的线性变换、刺激特异性偏移），在10个公开数据集约2万人上比较跨被试预测能力。
AI.motivation: 以往工作只量化个体差异的大小，未刻画差异的"形状"（是否允许符号翻转、是否为刺激特异偏移等），需要弄清人如何偏离群体共识。
AI.method: 将三种候选形状写成嵌套生成模型：（1）共享维度上的同号重加权；（2）允许反向的线性变换；（3）刺激特异性偏移；用10-20条判断恢复个体判断空间，并对训练外被试、未见刺激做预测比较。
AI.result: 面孔任务中重加权已足够，未统计检测到与群体反向的权重；艺术画任务中权重沿共享的抽象—具象方向连续分布，约28%被试落在群体相反一侧；更换被试样本后该尾部显著缩小。
AI.conclusion: 个体差异不仅在大小上不同，在形状上也不同，且形状随领域与被试群体而变化。

title: Autonomous Track Racing with a Commercially Available Humanoid: System Design and Real-World Deployment
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Practice. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Learning-based methods now let humanoids run robustly, and they have begun to compete in athletic events. Yet few reports describe a complete autonomous humanoid running system in an actual race, where the robot must follow a lane at a new venue, pace itself within hardware limits, and finish without intervention. We report such a system deployed on the Unitree G1, a commercially available general-purpose humanoid, in the 100 m, 400 m, and 1500 m events of the World Humanoid Robot Games 2026. The system integrates vision-based lane perception, path tracking, and a running policy trained by reinforcement learning with a human motion prior. To address the challenges of humanoid running, we stabilize head-camera images against body motion and use IMU-assisted leg odometry to bridge flight phases. To manage motor heating, we penalize hip-pitch torque during training, add heat-dissipation plates, and apply temperature-based speed limiting with event-specific pacing. The robot placed 13th of 74 in the 100 m, 10th of 44 in the 400 m first round before falling in the semifinal, and seventh of 35 in the 1500 m. In this deployment, thermal margin set the pace in every event, and the semifinal fall followed a lane-detection error.

AI.tldr: Unitree G1 人形机器人在 2026 世界人形机器人运动会 100m/400m/1500m 赛事中完整自主跑完全程的部署系统报告，核心为视觉车道感知+IMU辅助腿部里程计+带人类运动先验的 RL 跑步策略，并以热约束决定配速。
AI.motivation: 学习型方法已能让足式机器人稳健奔跑，但缺少在真实赛事、陌生场地中"自主完成"的完整系统级报告：需保持车道、在硬件（尤其电机发热）限制内自定配速、全程无人干预。
AI.method: 系统集成三部分：(1) 视觉车道线感知与路径跟踪，并对头部相机图像做身体运动补偿稳像；(2) IMU 辅助腿部里程计，在腾空相（flight phase）中桥接位姿；(3) 以人类运动先验 + 强化学习训练的跑步策略。热管理上采用训练时惩罚髋俯仰力矩、加装散热板、基于温度的限速，并按赛事距离定制配速。
AI.result: 100m 第 13/74，400m 预赛第 10/44（半决赛摔倒），1500m 第 7/35。作者指出各项目配速均由热裕度决定，半决赛摔倒源于一次车道检测错误。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出少见的真实赛事级人形机器人跑步全栈部署证据，显示热管理而非运动能力是当前配速瓶颈，感知鲁棒性（车道检测）是主要失效模式；属于系统集成+工程权衡报告，方法新颖度有限但实测证据扎实。

title: As Student Rollouts Continue, Visual Backdoors Keep Growing
summary: Conventional knowledge distillation can facilitate the propagation of backdoors from teacher models to student models. However, how this risk manifests in On-Policy Distillation (OPD) remains insufficiently studied. OPD has recently emerged as an important post-training paradigm for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Unlike traditional offline distillation, OPD does not require teacher-generated responses. Instead, it uses the teacher's probability distributions to supervise response trajectories generated online by the student. Since the initial student model typically generates benign responses and receives no explicit supervision from malicious target responses, OPD appears to offer some inherent resistance to backdoor propagation. In this paper, we challenge this intuition and reveal a more subtle risk of visual backdoor propagation in OPD. Through experiments across multiple model families and datasets, together with theoretical analysis, we identify three main findings. First, unlike the relatively gradual propagation observed in traditional offline distillation, backdoors rarely emerge in OPD at low poisoning ratios. However, the attack success rate rapidly approaches 100% once a critical threshold is exceeded. Second, backdoor propagation does not depend on explicit malicious responses. Instead, it is driven by the continuous accumulation of anomalous probability mass assigned by the teacher. Finally, based on these findings, we propose a novel trigger design that enables visual backdoor propagation with zero explicit trigger injection. These findings further reveal an overlooked mechanism of backdoor propagation in OPD and highlight its potential security risks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示视觉语言模型在线蒸馏（OPD）中视觉后门传播的隐蔽风险：低中毒率下后门几乎不出现，但超过临界阈值后攻击成功率骤升至近100%，其机制是教师分配异常概率质量的持续累积，而非显式恶意响应；据此提出零显式触发器注入的触发器设计。
AI.motivation: 传统离线蒸馏中教师后门可传给学生，而OPD不依赖教师生成响应、学生初始输出良性、也缺乏对恶意目标响应的显式监督，故直觉上似乎具备抗后门传播性。作者要检验这一直觉是否成立，并刻画OPD下后门传播的真实机制与安全风险。
AI.method: 在多模型族与多数据集上开展后门攻击实验，并结合理论分析：对学生在线上生成的响应轨迹用教师概率分布进行监督，分析中毒比例与攻击成功率的关系、异常概率质量累积的作用，并据此设计一种无需显式触发注入的触发器方案。
AI.result: 三项发现：(1) OPD 呈现阈值型传播，低中毒率下后门极少出现，越过临界阈值后攻击成功率迅速接近100%，与离线蒸馏的渐进式传播不同；(2) 传播不依赖显式恶意响应，而由教师持续累积的异常概率质量驱动；(3) 零显式触发器注入的新触发器设计即可实现视觉后门传播。
AI.conclusion: OPD 并非天然抗后门，反而存在被忽视的后门传播机制，构成 VLMs 后训练范式的潜在安全风险，提示需针对在线蒸馏的概率级监督重新设计防御。

title: COAST: Safe Flight Corridor Planner for Fast and Robust Snap Minimized Trajectories
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC 2027)
summary: Current B-Spline trajectory planners face a critical trade-off: they either sacrifice computational speed to maintain strict Safe Flight Corridor (SFC) guarantees, or they abandon hard safety bounds in favor of soft-constraint penalties to achieve real-time performance. We present COAST (Corridor-Optimized Aerially-Safe Trajectories), a B-Spline based, online trajectory planner capable of formulating snap minimized trajectories with SFC guarantees. COAST divides the problem into two stages: an A* based front-end that generates geometrically simple SFCs (represented as a chain of rectangular prisms), and a quadratic programming back-end for control point optimization. To handle the non-convexity of SFC intersections, we leverage the finite support property of B-Splines, to ensure the spline never exits SFC boundaries. The control point optimization incorporates MINVO transforms for kinodynamic bounding, allowing COAST to design non-conservative, dynamically feasible trajectories, while a snap minimization matrix calculation provides flight smoothness. This formulation provides a formal geometric containment guarantee, while ensuring mean trajectory computation times under 5 ms for real-time deployment. We validate our results through high-fidelity simulation experiments. The source code can be found at: this https URL

AI.tldr: COAST：基于B样条的两阶段（A*前端生成矩形棱柱链式安全飞行走廊 + QP后端控制点优化）在线轨迹规划器，利用B样条有限支撑性保证样条不越出SFC，结合MINVO变换实现动力学约束与非保守轨迹，snap最小化矩阵保证平滑，平均计算时间<5 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有B样条轨迹规划器存在关键权衡：要么牺牲计算速度以维持严格的Safe Flight Corridor (SFC)硬约束保证，要么放弃硬安全边界、改用软约束惩罚换取实时性。作者希望在保持SFC形式化保证的同时达到实时在线计算性能。
AI.method: 将问题分为两阶段：(1) 前端A*生成几何简单的SFC，表示为矩形棱柱链；(2) 后端二次规划优化控制点。针对SFC交集处的非凸性，利用B样条的有限支撑（local support）性质确保样条不越出走廊边界；控制点优化引入MINVO基变换施加kinodynamic边界约束，以获得非保守且动态可行的轨迹；并通过snap最小化矩阵计算实现飞行平滑。该形式化给出严格的几何包含（geometric containment）保证。
AI.result: 平均轨迹计算时间低于5 ms，满足实时部署要求；轨迹snap最小化且满足动力学可行性；通过高保真仿真实验验证，并开源代码。
AI.conclusion: COAST在B样条轨迹规划中同时实现了SFC硬安全保证与毫秒级实时性，缓解了速度与安全性之间的传统权衡。局限在于仅在仿真中验证，缺少真实平台部署或与现有规划器的定量对比。

title: MedImgAnnotator: batch wise medical image annotation and preprocessing tool
summary: The curation of large cohort datasets for developing deep learning models demands annotating or editing over the AI-predicted labels. However, openly available annotation tools are time-consuming, as they involve complex navigational steps and do not support batch processing. This study aimed to develop a simple, fast, semiautomated batch-annotation tool named MedImgAnnotator. The tool was created by integrating editing tools, image mask pair matching logic, preprocessing functions, object detection tool, and a plugin management system. Its performance was evaluated in terms of active annotation time and ease of use by the developer and 12 users using open-source MR and CT scans. Additionally, the tool had been used by the MICCAI 2026 CARE Challenge liver segmentation best performance winner to annotate liver masks from 6412 MRI volumes. The evaluation results showed that MedImgAnnotator reduced active annotation time from 206.5+/-32.87 (average active annotation time of openly available tools) seconds to 59 seconds. The Wilcoxon signed-rank test of 12 users evaluation results recorded P values of 0.032 and 0.008 for the active annotation time and higher ease of use rating metrics, respectively, indicating that the current tool significantly reduces annotation time and enhances ease of use. Moreover, the tool utilization for annotating different regions of interest from different modality scans and body regions shows its usability across modalities and areas of interest. MedImgAnnotator, which significantly reduces active annotation time for large imaging cohorts, is available as an executable file and as a Python script. Access link: this https URL

AI.tldr: MedImgAnnotator：面向大影像队列深度学习标注的简易半自动批处理标注工具，将单个病例的主动标注时间从约206.5s降至59s，并显著提升易用性。
AI.motivation: 大队列数据集的标注/修订（含对AI预测标签的编辑）是深度学习模型开发的关键瓶颈；现有开源标注工具导航步骤复杂、不支持批处理，耗时严重。
AI.method: 集成编辑工具、图像-掩膜配对逻辑、预处理函数、目标检测工具与插件管理系统，构建半自动批处理标注流程；据称可通过插件管理扩展标注类别，并以可执行文件与Python脚本形式发布。评估：开发者与12名用户基于开源MR/CT数据测量主动标注时间与易用性评分（Wilcoxon符号秩检验）；另用于6412例MRI肝脏掩膜标注（MICCAI 2026 CARE Challenge肝脏分割最佳方案）。
AI.result: 主动标注时间由206.5±32.87 s降至59 s；12名用户评估中标注时间与更高易用性评分的P值分别为0.032与0.008，差异显著；跨模态、跨身体部位与不同ROI的标注使用表明其泛化可用性；已支撑6412例MRI肝脏掩膜标注。
AI.conclusion: 该工具以批处理+半自动方式显著压缩大影像队列的主动标注时间并提升易用性，作为开源可执行工具对医学影像数据标注流水线具有实用价值；但缺乏与机器人/3D重建/世界模型等核心方向的直接方法贡献。

title: VoxelSBFL: Voxel-Level Spectrum-Based Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action generation to control robots. Testing these systems produces trajectories and task outcomes, but existing approaches provide limited guidance on using these recorded trajectories to assess subsequent executions or inform policy repair. We conjecture that, for a given policy and task, traversing certain workspace regions is associated with a higher likelihood of failure. To investigate this conjecture, we propose VoxelSBFL, a black-box adaptation of Spectrum-Based Fault Localization (SBFL) in which workspace voxels replace program elements as units of analysis. Recorded tool-center-point (TCP) trajectories provide binary voxel coverage, which is combined with execution outcomes to construct suspiciousness maps using established SBFL formulas. These maps identify failure-associated regions and score unseen trajectories without requiring internal model access. We evaluate 34 spectrum-based techniques across four VLA models using 96,000 Pick-Up trajectories in simulation and compare the leading techniques against eight action- and trajectory-based metrics. VoxelSBFL obtains an overall macro ROC-AUC of 0.704, significantly outperforming state-of-the art baselines. Sensitivity analyses show that performance varies with spatial granularity and training-set size. These findings support spatial spectra for VLA execution assessment and motivate future research on runtime monitoring, self-healing and targeted policy improvement.

AI.tldr: 将SBFL思想迁移到VLA测试：以工作空间体素为分析单元，用TCP轨迹的二值覆盖谱+执行结果构建可疑度图，实现黑盒失败定位与未见轨迹失败预测。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA测试只产出轨迹与任务结果，缺乏对"记录轨迹→评估后续执行/指导策略修复"的指导；作者猜想特定工作空间区域与更高失败概率相关。
AI.method: VoxelSBFL：SBFL的纯黑盒改造，体素替代程序元素；工具中心点轨迹离散化为体素覆盖，结合执行通过/失败结果，套用34种SBFL可疑度公式生成可疑度图，无需模型内部访问即可给未见轨迹打分。
AI.result: 4个VLA模型、96,000条仿真Pick-Up轨迹；整体macro ROC-AUC 0.704，显著优于8个动作/轨迹类基线；敏感性分析显示性能随空间粒度与训练集规模变化。
AI.conclusion: 空间谱可作为VLA执行评估的有效信号，指向运行时监控、自愈与定向策略改进。局限：仅仿真、单任务族、相关非因果、依赖历史轨迹量。

title: Sample-Aligned Decoders for Latent Generative Models
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: Latent generative models synthesize images by decoding generated latents, yet their decoder is trained only to reconstruct encoder latents and never sees the latents it decodes at test time, so the residual errors of the generator are rendered directly into the final image. Existing remedies retrain the generator, add cost at every sampling step, or make the decoder robust to perturbed real latents, assuming that generator errors resemble such perturbations. We find that they do not. Generated latents lie on the encoder latent manifold as closely as real ones, yet follow a different distribution. The decoder should therefore be adapted to the distribution of generated latents, which raises two challenges: (1) unpaired supervision, since a generated latent has no ground-truth image, and (2) latent-space drift, since a decoder freed from paired targets forgets the latent space it must decode. We propose Sample-Aligned Decoders (SAD), a post-training framework that fine-tunes only the decoder of a frozen generator at no inference cost. Generated-Sample Distribution Alignment matches decoded generated latents to unpaired real images in a frozen foundation-model feature space, and Encoder Anchor Preservation keeps the decoder close to the original one on encoder latents. Our analysis shows that the alignment is effective only on generated latents, where it corrects each sample in proportion to how much more often the generator produces such latents than the encoder; on encoder latents it can only work against the anchor. SAD improves four state-of-the-art ImageNet generators across three tokenizers, e.g., FID-50K from 1.15 to 0.98 for REPA-E, complements discriminator guidance, and extends to text-to-image generation. Our code and models are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SAD提出一种仅微调解码器的后训练框架：冻结生成器与编码器，通过生成样本分布对齐（用冻结基础模型特征匹配无配对真实图像）与编码器锚定保持，使解码器适配生成隐变量分布，推理零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 潜空间生成模型的解码器只见过编码器隐变量，测试时却解码生成隐变量，导致生成器残差被直接渲染进图像。现有方案（重训生成器、每步增加采样代价、让解码器对扰动真实隐变量鲁棒）均基于"生成误差近似扰动"的假设，而作者发现生成隐变量虽贴合编码器流形却服从不同分布，故应直接适配解码器到生成分布。这带来两个难点：无配对监督（生成隐变量无真值图像）与隐空间漂移（失去配对目标后解码器遗忘原隐空间）。
AI.method: 后训练框架，只微调冻结生成器下的解码器：(1) Generated-Sample Distribution Alignment——在冻结基础模型特征空间中将解码生成隐变量的结果与无配对真实图像对齐；(2) Encoder Anchor Preservation——在编码器隐变量上约束解码器贴近原始解码器，防止漂移。理论分析表面对齐仅在生成隐变量上有效，修正幅度与生成器产生该隐变量的富余频率成正比；在编码器隐变量上只会与锚定项冲突。
AI.result: 在四种SOTA ImageNet生成器、三种tokenizer上均有提升，如REPA-E的FID-50K从1.15降至0.98；与discriminator guidance互补，并可扩展至文生图。推理零额外成本。
AI.conclusion: 解码器失配是潜生成模型残差的独立可修环节，无需重训生成器或在采样时加开销；分布对齐+锚定正则构成通用、即插即用的后训练方法。

title: MAVE: Reconstructing Editable 3D Blockouts from Film Shots
comment: this https URL
summary: Animated 3D blockouts support previsualization and provide structural conditions for video generation, but manually reconstructing them from reference videos is costly. This limits both their use by creators and the production of paired training data. We introduce MAVEBench, a benchmark of 50 film shots and 416 keyframes for evaluating camera motion, spatial layout, and character blocking. We propose MAVE, a video-to-blockout framework combining Metric observation, Agentic modeling, and evidence-based VErification. It first recovers cameras, human motion, and geometric evidence in a shared metric coordinate system. An agent then constructs an editable environment under constraints from these observations, while programmatic checks report inconsistencies to guide refinement. The outputs are editable Blender scenes and frame-aligned blockout videos. On MAVEBench, MAVE improves overall scores by 27.5-41.1 points across three agents over their corresponding vanilla baselines. With DeepSeek-1017, it achieves a score of 73.2 at an average API cost of only USD 0.054 per shot, outperforming the strongest vanilla baseline while reducing total reconstruction time by 53%. We also construct MAVEData-3K, a dataset of 3,000 blockout-video pairs for model training, and will release it publicly. Creators can change viewpoints and character paths, then render the edited scenes to condition video generation. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 MAVEBench（50 个电影镜头、416 关键帧的视频到 3D 走位蓝图评测基准）与 MAVE 框架：度量观测—智能体建模—证据校验，从视频重建可编辑 Blender 场景与逐帧对齐的动画 3D blockout。
AI.motivation: 动画 3D blockout 是预可视化的核心，也为视频生成提供结构条件，但从参考视频手工重建成本高昂，既阻碍创作者使用，也限制配对训练数据的生产。
AI.method: MAVE 分三阶段：先在共享度量坐标系统中恢复相机、人体运动与几何证据；再由 LLM 智能体在观测约束下构建可编辑环境（规划+工具调用）；最后用程序化检查报告不一致并迭代精修。基准覆盖相机运动、空间布局、角色走位三个维度。
AI.result: 在 MAVEBench 上，三个智能体分别较对应 vanilla 基线提升 27.5–41.1 分；使用 DeepSeek-1017 时得 73.2 分，平均 API 成本仅 0.054 美元/镜头，耗时减少 53%，超过最强 vanilla 基线。同时构建并公开 3000 对 blockout-视频训练数据集 MAVEData-3K。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"智能体多步规划+物理几何证据校验"引入视频到 3D 场景/走位重建，产出可编辑场景，可用于视角与角色路径编辑后条件化视频生成；但面向影视预可视化与合成数据，非机器人交互场景。

title: Disagree to Prune: Reallocating Visual Tokens Where a Small VLM Dissents
comment: 45 pages, 8 in the main text. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Visual token pruning speeds up large vision-language models (VLMs) by keeping only a part of their visual tokens. Most existing methods improve the ranking of the tokens and then answer every question once with the same budget. With strong rankings, pruning hurts only a few questions, and signals computed on the kept tokens see little of what it removed. We find that, on most of these questions, a small VLM given the full image disagrees with the pruned answer, since it still sees the missing evidence. We propose PRUDENT, which first answers with about half the budget and spends the saved tokens on re-answering the disagreeing questions at twice the budget. We show when such re-answering pays and why the small VLM should read the full image. On 18 benchmarks, PRUDENT outperforms eight existing pruning methods at the same average budget of visual tokens. Its lead widens as the budget tightens, and holds across five InternVL sizes. PRUDENT also has the highest average in two more model families. The disagreement of the small VLM flags most pruning failures of all eight methods, and re-answering on it also improves the two strongest with their own rankings. Other checkers give similar gains, and the extra tokens go where the first pass hurts the answer. These results suggest that identifying which pruned answers are trustworthy provides an additional lever for visual token pruning beyond the ranking of tokens. Code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PRUDENT：先用约一半视觉token预算作答，再用小VLM看完整图像检测"分歧问题"，将省下的token以双倍预算重答这些题目，在18个benchmark上同平均预算下优于8种剪枝方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法只关注token排序，全问题共用同一预算；被剪掉的信息不会回到保留token的评分信号中。作者发现：让一个小VLM看完整图像时，它常在多数问题上与剪枝答案不一致，提示存在被剪掉的证据。因此需要一种"判别哪些剪枝答案可信"的额外杠杆。
AI.method: 两阶段自适应预算分配：第一阶段以约50%token预算回答所有问题；同时用一个小VLM在完整图像上作答，通过与其答案的分歧作为"可靠性检查器"标记需要重答的问题；第二阶段把这些题目以2倍预算重答。文中还从理论上给出重答何时划算的条件，并解释为何检查器应读取完整图像。检查器可替换（其他checker同样有效），也可与已有排序方法（含最强两种）结合使用。
AI.result: 在18个benchmark、相同平均视觉token预算下超过8种现有剪枝方法；预算越紧优势越大；在5个InternVL规模及另外两个模型家族中均取得最高平均成绩。小VLM的分歧信号可标记八种方法的大多数剪枝失败案例，额外token被分配到首轮出错的位置。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token剪枝的性能提升不仅来自token排序，还来自对剪枝答案可信度的判别与预算的再分配；该方法即插即用、模型无关，是排序之外的额外改进来源。

title: LeViT-UNet++: Towards Balanced Fine-Grained Details and Context for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
comment: 24 pages, 5 figure
summary: Efficient medical image segmentation is essential for clinical applications requiring fast and accurate delineation, such as surgical navigation, radiation therapy, and real-time image-guided intervention. Despite substantial advances in convolutional neural networks and Transformers, attaining high accuracy under limited computational resources remains difficult, because reducing model complexity often sacrifices fine-grained structural details and global context modeling, yielding an unfavorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. To address this, we propose LeViT-UNet++, an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that better balances local detail preservation and global context modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale Downsampling (HWMD) module that decomposes feature representations into low- and high-frequency components to extract multi-scale structural information, thereby mitigating detail loss during downsampling. We further develop a depthwise convolution-based decoder that integrates multi-scale global representations from Transformer blocks with local spatial features, enabling progressive feature refinement while reducing computational overhead. Evaluated on four benchmarks (Synapse, ACDC, LA2018, and MSD Heart) under both 2D and 3D settings, LeViT-UNet++ achieves competitive accuracy with a compact parameter footprint and fast inference. On Synapse, for instance, it attains a DSC of 76.57% with only 8.025M parameters and 241.72 FPS, confirming a favorable accuracy-efficiency balance. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining wavelet-based multi-scale feature extraction with lightweight local-global feature fusion for efficient medical segmentation. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出LeViT-UNet++编码器-解码器架构，用Haar小波多尺度下采样(HWMD)与深度可分离卷积解码器平衡局部细节与全局上下文，实现高效医学图像分割。
AI.motivation: 临床实时分割需要在有限算力下兼顾精度：CNN/Transformer降采样常丢失细粒度结构并削弱全局建模，形成不利的精度-效率权衡。
AI.method: HWMD模块通过Haar小波将特征分解为低频/高频分量以提取多尺度结构信息，缓解降采样细节损失；解码器基于深度可分离卷积，融合Transformer块的多尺度全局表示与局部空间特征，渐进精化并降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在Synapse、ACDC、LA2018、MSD Heart四个基准(2D与3D)上取得有竞争力精度：Synapse DSC 76.57%，仅8.025M参数，241.72 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 小波多尺度特征提取与轻量局部-全局融合的组合可有效实现高效医学分割，但属医学影像领域工作，与具身智能/3D重建核心方向关联弱。

title: Manufacturing Differential Sparsity: Planner-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient World Model Planning
comment: 14 pages, 11 figures
summary: JEPA-style latent world models let embodied agents plan toward new goals with model predictive control, but they are still too slow for real-life embodied control: sampling-based MPC repeats predictor inference tens of thousands of times per plan, and even on high-end GPUs one planning step can take tens of seconds. We observe substantial latent locality in this repeated-inference workload: the predictor maps close actions to close latents, and inside a quantized predictor this closeness takes a form that hardware can exploit, differential bit-level sparsity. Unlike an input stream, whose temporal similarity is given, a planner itself decides which candidates it evaluates together, so the planner can choose its own references and, with reference forest sampling, manufacture more sparsity: it couples the sampled action sequences of each group to a shared root, with competitive planning quality. We build the accelerator on the insights of the rich line of bit-level sparsity accelerators and design it and the planner tightly coupled as a single co-design: the planner increases sparsity and exposes structure for hardware scheduling, and the bit-exact hardware effectively uses the sparsity that the planner creates. On three JEPA world models, our co-design is 1.28-1.80x faster than a dense accelerator and uses 38-52% less energy, and it is 1.22-1.58x faster than prior bit-sparse design and uses 16-36% less energy, with the same area. To our knowledge, our planner is the first planner that manufactures differential bit-level sparsity across its candidates and exposes its structure for hardware scheduling, and our co-design is the first algorithm-hardware co-design for JEPA-style world-model planning.

AI.tldr: 针对JEPA式潜空间世界模型MPC规划中重复预测推理过慢的问题，作者发现量化预测器内部的"差分位级稀疏性"可被硬件利用，并提出"参考森林采样"规划器主动制造稀疏性与硬件协同设计，实现1.28-1.80x加速、38-52%节能。
AI.motivation: 基于采样的MPC需要对预测器进行上万次重复推理，即便高端GPU上一次规划也需数十秒，无法满足真实具身控制所需的实时性；而现有工作未挖掘该重复推理负载中的潜空间局部性（相近动作→相近潜变量，量化为位级差分稀疏）。
AI.method: （1）观察并刻画量化预测器中相近潜变量对应动作之间的差分位级稀疏性；（2）提出"参考森林采样"：将每组采样动作序列耦合到共享根节点，使规划器主动提高候选间的相似度，从而人为制造更多稀疏性，同时保持有竞争力的规划质量；（3）基于既有位级稀疏加速器经验，设计位精确的稀疏加速器，并与规划器紧耦合，使规划器暴露的结构直接服务于硬件调度，硬件实际利用规划器产生的稀疏性。
AI.result: 在三个JEPA世界模型上：相比稠密加速器快1.28-1.80x、能耗降低38-52%；相比此前的位稀疏设计快1.22-1.58x、能耗降低16-36%，且面积相同。
AI.conclusion: 首个在候选中制造差分位级稀疏并暴露其结构用于硬件调度的规划器，也是首个面向JEPA式世界模型规划的算法-硬件协同设计；为潜空间世界模型的实时具身规划提供了可行路径。

title: Progress Predicts Policy
summary: A task specifies how the world should change, while a policy specifies what the robot should do. We introduce Progress Predicts Policy (PPP), which learns a language-conditioned scalar field through the commands induced by its differential. We obtain action conditioning by composing a latent progress field with a shared world model and read its action gradient at a fixed reference command. Continuous commands scale this gradient by a learned positive gain, while discrete commands use finite differences of the same scalar. This yields a hybrid policy without a separate action head or iterative search. Fitting demonstration progress values alone does not ensure that action gradients align with expert commands. PPP trains the induced commands by imitation and uses double backpropagation for the continuous gradient readout to shape the field's local control geometry. Demonstration timing calibrates field values on observed states without additional annotation. The continuous readout remains learnable without progress labels but these timing-derived targets support progress monitoring during execution. Experiments in simulated and real robot manipulation show that PPP outperforms behavioral cloning under a shared architecture.

AI.tldr: PPP（Progress Predicts Policy）通过组合隐式进度标量场与共享世界模型，在固定参考指令处读取动作梯度，实现无独立动作头、无迭代搜索的混合（连续/离散）语言条件策略，并在仿真与真机操作上超越行为克隆。
AI.motivation: 任务说明世界应如何改变，策略说明机器人应如何动作。现有多数做法将二者分离（如行为克隆直接回归动作、或采样搜索），缺乏对"进度场—动作"内在联系的一致性约束。作者希望利用进度场的微分所诱导的指令来统一表示策略，并解决"仅拟合示范进度值并不能保证动作梯度与专家指令对齐"这一关键问题。
AI.method: 1) 学习语言条件的标量进度场 V(s, cmd)（cmd 为参考指令）；2) 在固定参考指令处通过共同的世界模型读出场对动作的梯度，并施加动作条件化；3) 连续指令用学习到的正增益缩放梯度，离散指令用同一标量的有限差分——构成混合策略，无独立动作头、无迭代规划；4) 用双反向传播（double backpropagation）对连续梯度读出进行训练，以模仿损失塑造场的局部控制几何，使诱导指令与专家指令对齐；5) 利用示范中的时间信息在观测状态上校准场值作为进度监督，无需额外标注，并用于执行期进度监控。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人操作实验中，PPP 在共享架构下优于行为克隆（behavioral cloning）；消融表明仅拟合进度值不足以使梯度对齐专家指令，而诱导指令的模仿训练与双反传是关键；时间导出的进度目标可用于执行期进度监测。
AI.conclusion: 将策略表述为进度场的动作梯度并经模仿训练诱导指令，是一种简洁且有效的替代方案：既保持单一标量场与共享世界模型的结构简洁性，又获得可解释的进度信号与混合动作接口。局限在于实验规模与任务多样性有限，未展示长程、多任务或大规模真实部署下的泛化。

title: Fast and Strong Image Protection against Diffusion Personalization
summary: Personalized text-to-image diffusion models can reproduce a person from a handful of photographs. Image protection perturbs each image before publication so that fine-tuning on it fails, but it optimizes every perturbation from scratch, so its cost grows with the number of images. We present the protective diffusion model (PDM), which is trained once and samples the perturbation of a new image over many denoising steps. PDM distills an iterative teacher and is then post-trained with the target residual projection (TRP) loss as a reward, a stronger objective than existing ones. PDM outperforms nine baselines on faces and artworks and nearly matches its teacher at a tenth of the cost.

AI.tldr: PDM：一次训练即可为新图采样保护扰动的扩散模型，在蒸馏迭代教师后以TRP（target residual projection）损失为奖励做后训练，用于阻止个性化文生图模型微调复现人物。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化文生图扩散模型能用少量照片复现个人，带来隐私风险。现有图像保护方法对每张图从头优化扰动，成本随图片数量线性增长，且目标函数较弱。
AI.method: 提出保护扩散模型（PDM）：先蒸馏一个迭代式教师优化器，再以目标残差投影（TRP）损失作为奖励进行后训练，从而通过多步去噪直接为新图像采样保护扰动，无需逐图从零优化。
AI.result: 在人脸与艺术作品上优于九个基线方法，并以约十分之一的成本接近其教师的保护效果。
AI.conclusion: 学习式、摊销（amortized）的扰动生成可替代逐图优化，实现低成本且强效的个性化扩散模型图像保护，属于隐私/安全防护方向。

title: Motion-Aware Reward Modeling for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
summary: Reward models for instruction-guided video editing can favor temporal consistency at the expense of motion. We study this failure, termed \emph{motion collapse}, using controlled motion-suppression variants of real edits. On VE-Bench, the evaluated composite reward prefers a motion-suppressed candidate in $97\%$ of cases. Learned video rewards and a VLM judge also struggle with mild suppression, while latent optimization and reward-guided fine-tuning exploit this weakness to increase reward as motion declines. A linear probe of our base reward backbone performs near chance on mild suppression, motivating an explicit inter-frame dynamics input. We propose a motion-aware reward model that combines an RGB frame-difference stream with preference training against motion-suppressed and fabricated-motion negatives. A distillation anchor preserves alignment with human quality judgments. On the VE-Bench motion ladder, our model reduces the rate of selecting motion-suppressed candidates to $0\%$ while achieving a Spearman correlation of $0.57$ with human quality ratings. It also detects unseen suppression variants and preserves motion during reward-guided fine-tuning on two editing pipelines. These results support explicitly modeling motion in rewards for video editing.

AI.tldr: 分析指令引导视频编辑奖励模型的"运动坍缩"失效，并提出显式建模帧间动态的运动感知奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型在视频编辑偏好学习中倾向于以牺牲运动为代价换取时间一致性，该失效会误导潜空间优化与奖励引导微调，使模型主动降低运动量。
AI.method: 构造受控的运动抑制与伪造运动负样本，在VE-Bench上量化奖励模型、学习式视频奖励与VLM判官的运动偏好偏差；基于线性探针定位基础骨干对轻度抑制近乎随机的问题，提出结合RGB帧差流与偏好训练的显式运动感知奖励模型，并加入蒸馏锚点保持与人类质量判断的对齐。
AI.result: 复合奖励在97%情形下偏好运动抑制候选；新模型在VE-Bench运动阶梯上将被选抑制候选比例降至0%，与人类评分Spearman相关达0.57，可检测未见过的抑制变体，并在两种编辑流水线的奖励引导微调中保持运动。
AI.conclusion: 视频编辑奖励模型需显式建模帧间运动动态，否则易被奖励黑客利用产生运动坍缩；引入帧差流与对比负样本可有效缓解该问题。

title: Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation of 3D Abdominal Vision-Language Model for Institution-Specific HCC Classification via Full Fine-Tuning and PEFT
comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables, including appendices. Corrected author revision of the MIDL 2026 paper. Revised preprocessing yields lower HCC classification performance; the main findings on temperature initialization and better VerSe performance retention with PEFT remain supported
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) capture cross-modal relationships between image and text, yet their adaptation to institution-specific clinical tasks remains underexplored. In this study, we fine-tuned a pretrained 3D medical VLM for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) classification using paired abdominal CT scans and radiology reports from a different institution with acquisition characteristics that differ from the model's original pretraining corpus. We compared two adaptation strategies: full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), motivated by the common use of PEFT to reduce computational cost and enable adaptation under limited-data constraints. Both approaches achieve strong downstream HCC classification performance despite the cross-institutional domain shift, with PEFT reaching an AUC of 0.79 and F1 of 0.70, and full fine-tuning achieving an AUC of 0.82 and F1 of 0.71. Although these results remain below the performance reported by supervised HCC classification approaches, our method achieves improvements over the pretrained model through CT-report contrastive learning without requiring lesion-level annotations or HCC classification labels as training targets. Full fine-tuning converges rapidly but overfits within a few epochs, whereas PEFT (ConvLoRA for the image encoder and LoRA for the text encoder) attains comparable performance while updating approximately 1% of the model parameters, although requiring more training steps. We also examine the role of contrastive temperature, observing that temperature initialization significantly affects classification performance. This study demonstrates that a 3D medical VLM can be efficiently adapted to institution-specific HCC classification using self-supervised CT-report contrastive learning, while highlighting the practical trade-offs between full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 微调预训练3D医学视觉语言模型做HCC分类：全量微调(AUC 0.82/F1 0.71)与PEFT(ConvLoRA+LoRA，约1%参数，AUC 0.79/F1 0.70)在跨机构域偏移下效果接近；对比学习温度初始化显著影响性能。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM虽能建模图文跨模态关系，但其向特定机构临床任务的适配（尤其跨机构采集域偏移下的低成本适配）尚未被充分研究；同时需比较全量微调与参数高效微调的实际权衡。
AI.method: 用配对腹部CT与放射报告，在异机构数据上以CT-报告自监督对比学习微调预训练3D医学VLM；对比全量微调与PEFT（图像编码器ConvLoRA、文本编码器LoRA），无需病灶级标注或HCC分类标签；并分析对比温度初始化的影响。
AI.result: PEFT：AUC 0.79、F1 0.70，仅更新约1%参数但需更多训练步；全量微调：AUC 0.82、F1 0.71，收敛快但数个epoch内过拟合。两者均优于预训练基线，但低于有监督HCC分类方法。
AI.conclusion: 3D医学VLM可通过自监督CT-报告对比学习高效适配机构特异的HCC分类任务，无需病灶标注；实践中需在快速收敛/过拟合的全量微调与省参数但慢收敛的PEFT之间权衡，温度初始化需谨慎调。

title: EfficientVPR: Toward Efficient Visual Place Recognition via Scene-Aware Prompt Tuning and Adaptive Feature Enhancement
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, accepted at CVPR 2026
summary: Visual place recognition (VPR) faces critical challenges in handling extreme environmental variations while meeting the computational constraints of practical applications. Current methods predominantly address these challenges by either scaling up model capacity or employing computationally intensive reranking stages, creating a significant efficiency bottleneck. To overcome this limitation, we propose EfficientVPR, a lightweight one-stage framework that achieves speed-accuracy trade-offs through two key innovations: i) a scene-aware visual prompt tuning method which adapts pretrained features with less parameters while dynamically adjusting to sample-specific characteristics, and ii) an instance-dependent key local feature enhancement module that further reinforces discriminative regions. Comprehensive evaluations on Pitts250k, MSLS, Eynsham, AmsterTime and SVOX demonstrate that our method establishes a new SOTA for DINOv2-small models by outperforming all same-scale competitors, and delivers a $73\times$ speedup with 60\% lower-dimensional features while maintaining competitive (within 2.5% average R@1 gap) against the SOTA DINOv2-large-based two-stage method. Our code will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EfficientVPR: a lightweight one-stage visual place recognition framework using scene-aware visual prompt tuning and instance-dependent key local feature enhancement on DINOv2-small, achieving 73× speedup and 60% lower-dimensional features at near-SOTA accuracy.
AI.motivation: Existing VPR methods cope with extreme environmental variation by enlarging model capacity or adding costly reranking stages, creating efficiency bottlenecks unsuited to practical deployment.
AI.method: Two innovations: (i) scene-aware visual prompt tuning that adapts pretrained DINOv2 features with few parameters and dynamically adjusts to sample-specific characteristics; (ii) an instance-dependent key local feature enhancement module that reinforces discriminative regions.
AI.result: On Pitts250k, MSLS, Eynsham, AmsterTime and SVOX, sets a new SOTA for DINOv2-small scale, with 73× speedup and 60% lower feature dimensionality, staying within 2.5% average R@1 of a DINOv2-large two-stage SOTA.
AI.conclusion: Lightweight prompt tuning plus local feature enhancement can replace scaling and reranking in VPR, yielding strong efficiency-accuracy trade-offs for practical navigation/relocalization use.

title: Reliability-Driven Feature Correction for Hyperspectral and LiDAR Classification
summary: Hyperspectral image (HSI) and LiDAR data provide complementary spectral and elevation information for land-cover classification. However, the spatially varying class-discriminative reliability of modality features is rarely modeled explicitly, allowing weak or ambiguous features to adversely affect cross-modal interaction and fusion. To address this issue, we propose ReDF, a reliability-driven framework that quantifies the reliability of each modality's features at each spatial location through the strength of class-related evidence they provide, and uses it to guide feature correction and fusion. Specifically, a Reliability-Guided Feature Correction module introduces a class prototype bank for each modality and converts feature-prototype similarities into class evidence for reliability estimation. The estimated reliabilities are used to construct a reliability-weighted shared representation and to guide bidirectional cross-modal feature correction based on neighborhood agreement, refining modality features with weak class evidence through information from the other modality. Building on these outputs, a Reliability-Guided Feature Reweighting module conditions a low-rank modulation on the estimated reliabilities and the cross-modal disagreement, and applies it to the corrected modality-specific descriptors to adaptively rescale each modality's contribution to the fused representation used for final classification. Experiments on three public HSI-LiDAR datasets show higher mean overall accuracy and Kappa than the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性驱动的ReDF框架，用类证据强度量化每个模态在各空间位置的特征可靠性，并据此引导跨模态特征纠正与加权融合，用于HSI-LiDAR地物分类。
AI.motivation: HSI与LiDAR的谱-高程信息互补，但模态特征在空间上分类判别可靠性差异显著，现有方法很少显式建模，导致弱/歧义特征干扰跨模态交互与融合。
AI.method: 为每个模态构建类原型库，将特征-原型相似度转为类证据以估计可靠性；可靠性加权共享表示结合邻域一致性引导双向跨模态特征纠正；再用可靠性与跨模态不一致性条件化低秩调制，对纠正后的模态描述子重加权后融合分类。
AI.result: 在三个公开HSI-LiDAR数据集上平均总体精度与Kappa系数优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模空间变化的模态特征可靠性可有效抑制弱特征干扰，提升多源遥感融合分类性能；思路可迁移至其他多模态融合场景。

title: ATS: Anti-Aliased Triangle Splatting with Exact Per-Primitive Integrals
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables
summary: Triangle Splatting represents scenes using semi-transparent triangles, but it evaluates each triangle at the pixel center and culls any triangle with an inradius smaller than one pixel. The former causes severe aliasing, while the latter culls most of the scene at lower resolutions. We show that the integral of the Triangle Splatting window over a pixel admits an exact closed-form solution. The angle bisectors split the triangle into three sub-triangles, in each of which the window is a power of the distance to one edge. Each piece therefore has a closed-form antiderivative, and Green's theorem reduces the integral and its gradients to one term per side of the sub-triangle clipped against the pixel. The integral over the whole triangle, which we show has a closed form, then allows conservative culling, removing only triangles that cannot meet the renderer's alpha cutoff at any pixel. This exact formulation anti-aliases existing models without retraining, exhibits less temporal aliasing than 2x2 supersampling, and enables multi-scale training, matching or outperforming supersampled training at reduced resolutions.

AI.tldr: 提出Triangle Splatting窗口在像素上积分的精确闭式解：用角平分线将三角形分成三个子三角形，子三角形内窗口是到某条边的距离的幂，结合Green定理把积分与梯度化为每条子三角形边裁剪像素后的单项贡献，从而实现无需重训的抗锯齿、保守裁剪与多尺度训练。
AI.motivation: Triangle Splatting以半透明三角形表示场景，但仅在像素中心求值导致严重走样，且以内切圆半径小于一像素进行裁剪，使低分辨率下大量几何被误裁。
AI.method: 推导窗口函数在像素区域的精确闭式积分：以角平分线剖分三角形为三个子三角形，每块窗口为到该边距离的幂，逐块求闭式原函数；用Green定理将面积分及其梯度化为子三角形与像素裁剪后各边上的单项；并给出整三角形积分的闭式用于保守裁剪，仅剔除在任何像素都无法达到alpha阈值的三角形。
AI.result: 无需重训练即可对现有模型抗锯齿；时间走样低于2x2超采样；支持多尺度训练，在降采样分辨率下匹配或超越超采样训练。
AI.conclusion: 基于精确积分的三角形splatting消除了中心采样走样与不安全的像素级裁剪，是即插即用、计算高效的改进，具备实用价值。

title: The Multivariate Feedback Particle Filter for State-dependent Multiplicative Noises and Its Application to Attitude and Pose Estimations
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Nonlinear filtering with state-dependent multiplicative measurement noise poses a notable challenge for spacecraft attitude determination and robotic pose estimation. This work develops the FPF-DM, a decomposition scheme for feedback particle filters tailored to this family of filtering problems. Extending prior decomposition techniques for additive noise and polynomial measurement models, the proposed method resolves the key difficulty that state-dependent multiplicative noise breaks the polynomial assumption and prevents Hermite spectral backward recursion for the weighted Poisson's equation. By measure transformation and importance reweighting, we incorporate the inverse measurement covariance into particle weights and rescale the feedback gain to restore the polynomial-form Poisson's equation, with the decomposition generalized to non-uniformly weighted mixtures for closed-form gain computation. This general FPF-DM is instantiated on quaternion and dual-quaternion manifolds for attitude tracking and point-cloud registration. Simulations on 4D attitude tracking and 8D point-cloud registration verify that the instantiated filters using only 10 particles achieve superior accuracy and computational performance relative to baseline filters.

AI.tldr: FPF-DM：针对状态相关乘性测量噪声的反馈粒子滤波分解方案，通过测度变换与重要性重加权恢复多项式型Poisson方程，并在四元数/对偶四元数流形上实例化，10粒子即可实现高精度姿态跟踪与点云配准。
AI.motivation: 航天器姿态确定与机器人位姿估计中，状态相关乘性测量噪声使原有基于加性噪声与多项式测量模型的FPF分解技术失效，Hermite谱后向递推无法进行。
AI.method: 采用测度变换与重要性重加权，将逆测量协方差并入粒子权重并对反馈增益重新缩放，使Poisson方程恢复多项式形式；将分解推广至非均匀加权混合分布以获得闭式增益；在四元数与对偶四元数流形上实例化，用于姿态跟踪与点云配准。
AI.result: 在4维姿态跟踪与8维点云配准仿真中，仅用10个粒子的实例化滤波器在精度与计算性能上优于基线滤波器。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将FPF分解推广至乘性噪声情形，为流形上的非线性滤波提供高效闭式解，但验证仅为仿真，缺少真实平台实验。

title: DGF-Asym: Adaptive Peer Weighting for Collective Estimation under Noisy and Faulty Sensing
summary: Collective estimation under unreliable sensing requires robots to adaptively balance personal observations and social information from peers. We propose DGF-Asym, a decentralized collective estimation method extending the DeGroot-Friedkin model with asymmetric peer weighting based on retrospective predictive performance. The method supports consensus formation without prior sensor-noise statistics or explicit fault models while keeping inter-robot communication asynchronous. We evaluate DGF-Asym in simulated collective navigation under noisy observations and time-varying sensor faults. Compared with three baselines, it produces more stable estimates and more reliably sustains the decision criterion, at the cost of longer decision times. However, overall performance depends on fault ratio, group size, and influence-threshold selection. Our results demonstrate the potential of adaptive peer weighting for stable model-free collective estimation under unreliable sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出DGF-Asym：基于回溯预测表现的非对称同伴权重，扩展DeGroot-Friedkin模型，实现无先验噪声统计、无显式故障模型的去中心化群体估计。
AI.motivation: 传感不可靠时，机器人需在自身观测与同伴社会信息间自适应权衡；现有方法通常依赖传感器噪声统计或显式故障模型，且需同步通信。
AI.method: 扩展DeGroot-Friedkin共识模型，按各同伴历史预测精度分配非对称权重；保持异步机器人间通信；无需先验噪声统计与故障模型。
AI.result: 在含噪声观测与时变传感器故障的仿真群体导航中，较三个基线估计更稳定、更可靠地满足决策判据，但决策时间更长；整体性能受故障比例、群体规模与影响阈值影响。
AI.conclusion: 自适应同伴加权可用于不可靠传感下稳定、无模型的群体估计，但仅在仿真中验证且依赖超参数选择。

title: From Perception to Simulation: Unveiling and Empowering Mental Spatial Dynamics in MLLMs
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental component of world understanding for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing research has advanced the perception of spatial relations in static scenes, the domain of dynamic spatial simulation remains relatively unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MentalGrid, a benchmark focused on spatial reasoning tasks that require models to simulate evolving spatial states without intermediate visual feedback. Extensive evaluation on our benchmark reveals a significant deficiency in the spatial simulation capabilities of existing models. Specifically, we find that performance is constrained by perceptual limitations in simple simulation scenarios and hindered by inadequate multi-step reasoning as complexity increases. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage curriculum learning framework utilizing 16k specialized spatial reasoning samples. This approach yields SpatialWalker, which achieves a 33.8% average improvement over its base model, surpassing proprietary models like Gemini-3-Flash in spatial simulation. Furthermore, SpatialWalker demonstrates robust generalization, maintaining a 4.9% average gain on out-of-domain benchmarks, demonstrating the pivotal role of spatial simulation as a fundamental building block for broader spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出 MentalGrid 动态空间模拟基准，并给出三阶段课程学习框架训练 SpatialWalker 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型已能感知静态场景中的空间关系，但缺乏在无中间视觉反馈下模拟空间状态演化的能力，该方向几乎未被探索。
AI.method: 构建 MentalGrid 基准，评估模型在动态空间模拟中的表现；基于错误分析（简单场景受感知限制、复杂场景受多步推理限制），使用 16k 专门空间推理样本进行三阶段课程学习。
AI.result: SpatialWalker 较基座模型平均提升 33.8%，在空间模拟上超过 Gemini-3-Flash 等闭源模型；跨域基准上仍保持 4.9% 平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 空间模拟是更广泛空间智能的基础构件，课程学习可显著增强 MLLM 的动态空间推理与泛化能力。

title: JointGV: Structure-Aware Correction of Visual World Models with Parallel Graph Dynamics for Long-Horizon Modeling
summary: Visual world models predict future visual states conditioned on actions, but recursive errors in entity poses and spatial relations limit their long-horizon prediction for robot planning and control. We ask whether a separately predicted relational state can correct this drift without restructuring the visual model. This is challenging because graph nodes and visual states share neither elements nor a feature space. We propose Joint Graph--Visual Dynamics Correction (JointGV), a plug-in based on a cross-granularity dynamics hypothesis: despite their different representations, graph-node and visual-state changes describe the same physical transition. JointGV rolls out a task-conditioned scene graph alongside the visual world model, couples their predicted changes, and combines the resulting graph-motion context with graph-predicted node positions to compute a bounded residual. Graph-learning and correction gradients do not propagate into the original visual dynamics. We attach JointGV to DINO-WM (spatial tokens) and DreamerV3 (a global latent state), evaluating both on DMC Cheetah Run and Walker Walk across three seeds and extending the evaluation to contact-rich manipulation with DMC Finger Turn Hard. Across 32-step rollouts, JointGV improves structural and visual-prediction accuracy, reducing joint-position error by 11--28\%. For spatial tokens, learned graph--visual change coupling gives lower error than broadcasting the same mean graph-motion context to every token, particularly when non-adjacent parts appear close together in the image. On real-robot inverted-pendulum sequences, JointGV reduces DINO-WM's 32-step pole-angle error from $12.56^\circ$ to $6.69^\circ$ and improves DreamerV3 and LeWorldModel as well. In simulated inverted-pendulum control, an actor trained with JointGV-corrected rollouts completes 46 of 50 episodes, compared with none using the original rollouts.

AI.tldr: JointGV: 以跨粒度动力学假设为插件，将任务条件场景图的节点/关系变化与视觉世界模型的视觉状态变化耦合，计算有界残差修正长期rollout漂移，且梯度不回传原视觉模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型在长时域递归预测中，实体位姿与空间关系误差累积导致漂移，限制机器人规划与控制。作者探究：在不重构视觉模型的前提下，能否用单独预测的关系状态来纠正该漂移。难点在于图节点与视觉状态既无共享元素也无共享特征空间。
AI.method: 提出JointGV插件，基于跨粒度动力学假设（图节点变化与视觉状态变化描述同一物理转移）。与视觉世界模型并行rollout任务条件场景图，耦合二者预测的变化，将图-运动上下文与图预测节点位置结合计算有界残差修正视觉预测；图学习与修正梯度不进入原始视觉动力学。分别挂载到DINO-WM（空间token）与DreamerV3（全局隐状态）。
AI.result: 在DMC Cheetah Run、Walker Walk（3个随机种子）及接触丰富任务DMC Finger Turn Hard上，32步rollout的结构与视觉预测精度提升，关节位置误差降低11–28%。空间token场景下，学习式图-视觉变化耦合优于将均值图-运动上下文广播到所有token，尤其在图像中非相邻部件相互靠近时。真实机器人倒立摆序列上，DINO-WM的32步杆角误差由12.56°降至6.69°，DreamerV3与LeWorldModel亦有改善。仿真倒立摆控制中，用JointGV修正rollout训练的actor完成46/50回合，原始rollout为0/50。
AI.conclusion: 关系状态预测可作为模块化、梯度隔离的插件有效抑制视觉世界模型的长期漂移，跨粒度耦合优于粗略的平均上下文广播，并能实质改善下游控制成功率；具备真实机器人验证。

title: Fast Training-Free Low-Light Video Enhancement with a Frozen Image Diffusion Prior
comment: 15 pages, 12 tables, 4 figures
summary: Pretrained image diffusion models can enhance low-light video without low-light training data and without retraining for a new camera. ZVRD, the only published training-free method for low-light video, is too slow to use: our implementation needs over a minute per $256 \times 256$ frame. We present a causal, training-free pipeline that adds two temporal components to a frozen MR. Illuminate image prior. Temporal input fusion recursively averages motion-compensated low-light frames before diffusion inversion. Late-start offset propagation runs the full sampling trajectory only on key frames. Each non-key frame inverts the low-noise part of its own trajectory and adds an enhancement offset warped from the latest key frame. At ZVRD's own resolution the pipeline is $261\times$ faster than ZVRD and scores better on all five metrics we report. On 13 held-out SDSD clips at $1280 \times 720$, it improves on framewise eight-step processing by 0.55 dB in PSNR and 0.034 in LPIPS and halves the warping error, in 10% less time. Measurements inside the model show why, and a linear-Gaussian model of inversion explains them. Fusion removes frame-to-frame noise before inversion amplifies it. A flow error perturbs the transported offset ten times less than it perturbs a transported state. The perceptual gain does not transfer to low resolution: at $346 \times 260$, LPIPS is worse by 0.028. At 0.65 frames per second, the pipeline is an offline method.

AI.tldr: 提出因果式免训练低光视频增强流水线，在冻结的MR. Illuminate图像先验上增加时间输入融合（扩散反演前对运动补偿帧递归平均）与延迟起始偏移传播（全采样轨迹仅在关键帧执行，非关键帧只反演自身轨迹低噪声段并叠加从最近关键帧扭曲传递的增强偏移），取得261倍加速且指标全面更优。
AI.motivation: 现有唯一公开的免训练低光视频方法ZVRD速度过慢（256×256单帧需一分多钟），无法实用；作者希望在无需低光训练数据、无需针对新相机重训的前提下，利用预训练图像扩散模型实现高效的因果低光视频增强。
AI.method: 因果、免训练流水线，基于冻结的图像扩散先验（MR. Illuminate）加两个时间组件：(1) 时间输入融合——在扩散反演前递归平均经运动补偿的低光帧，压制帧间噪声以避免反演放大；(2) 延迟起始偏移传播——仅在关键帧上运行完整采样轨迹，非关键帧仅反演自身轨迹的低噪声部分，并叠加从最近关键帧经光流扭曲得到的增强偏移。另用线性高斯反演模型解释其有效性。
AI.result: 在ZVRD自身分辨率下比ZVRD快261倍，并在报告的五项指标上全部更优；在13个留出的SDSD 1280×720片段上，相比逐帧八步处理PSNR提升0.55 dB、LPIPS提升0.034、扭曲误差减半，耗时还少10%。感知增益不迁移到低分辨率：346×260下LPIPS反而差0.028。吞吐约0.65 fps，属离线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过"预反演前置去噪"与"偏移而非状态传播"两个设计，把扩散反演的时间一致性与计算成本解耦，得到显著加速与一致性提升；但方法仍为离线级速度，且感知收益依赖分辨率。

title: Strong Fused Performance Can Mask Branch Collapse in a Dual-View Heart-Sound Classifier: A Three-Part Diagnostic Protocol
summary: Fusion models are usually judged by their fused score, a practice that assumes that every branch has learned something useful. We show that this assumption can fail silently in dual-view heart-sound classification. In AudioFuse, which fuses a spectrogram transformer with a waveform CNN, the spectrogram branch is unused despite strong fused performance when both branches are trained from scratch. We introduce a three-part diagnostic for branch collapse: whether deleting a branch changes the fused score, whether a linear probe on its features beats an untrained copy of the same branch, and whether the branch can learn its view when trained alone. Deleting the branch has negligible effect, and probing its features shows little improvement over an identically initialised, untrained copy. Yet the same architecture trained alone exceeds 0.9 AUC, so its view is learnable, while the jointly trained model is near chance when it must rely on this branch. Update statistics and an initialisation experiment point to an early optimisation imbalance. Moving a strong artificial label cue from one input to the other can switch which branch the model relies on, even though the branch architectures stay the same. We observe branch collapse on PhysioNet, but the full diagnostic is not met on ICBHI or CirCor. Fused performance alone therefore cannot establish that every branch learned a meaningful representation, and we recommend reporting branch deletion and an untrained-control probe alongside it.

AI.tldr: 音频双分支融合模型存在"分支坍塌"：融合分数高但其中一个分支实际未被使用，作者提出三分支诊断法（删分支/未训练对照探针/单独训练）揭示早期优化失衡。
AI.motivation: 多分支/多模态融合模型通常只以融合后的分数评价，隐含假设每个分支都学到了有用表征。作者怀疑这一假设在双视角心音分类中会"静默失效"。
AI.method: 以AudioFuse（频谱图Transformer + 波形CNN）为对象，设计三项诊断：(1) 删除某分支是否影响融合分数；(2) 在该分支特征上做线性探针，是否优于同结构未训练副本；(3) 该分支单独训练时能否学会自己的视角。辅以更新统计与初始化实验定位早期优化失衡，并做人工标签线索迁移实验。
AI.result: 从零联合训练时频谱分支几乎未用：删除它融合分数几乎不变，探针相对未训练副本提升很小；但同结构单独训练时AUC>0.9，说明视角可学、联合训练时该分支近乎随机。把强人工线索从一路输入移到另一路可切换模型依赖的分支（结构不变）。该坍塌在PhysioNet上出现，而ICBHI/CirCor上未满足完整诊断。
AI.conclusion: 融合性能本身不能证明各分支学到了有意义表征；建议在报告融合指标的同时报告分支删除效应与"未训练对照"探针。

title: Plausible Videos Can Lead to Poor Decisions: Diagnosing and CURE-ing World Models for Planning
summary: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as world models for planning, yet a world model that makes plausible, realistic-looking videos that are consistent with the training data can produce poor decisions. We address two key questions: (1) when can we trust a world model for planning, and (2) what should we do when we cannot? We introduce CURE (Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore), a certificate-guided technique that assesses whether a world model can be trusted for planning and determines what to do next: whether to upweight the training data to debias the model; roll out more samples at test time; or explore by collecting new data where support (how well the training data cover the planner's decisions) is missing. We deploy CURE across multiple domains, spanning simulated physics based on PhyWorld, MuJoCo arm control, and Language-Table pushing in simulation and on real videos. The decisions our certificate trusts have lower regret than those it does not (e.g., 0.06 vs. 0.38 on Language-Table sim and 0.07 vs. 0.38 on MuJoCo contact), whereas video perceptual quality does not identify good decisions.
