By focusing on decision quality rather than perceptual quality, CURE lowers regret over the best pessimistic decision rule by 10-25% across support levels, and over world-action models, search and policy learning by 41-64%, given the same data.

AI.tldr: 提出 CURE（Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore）证书引导框架，判断以动作为条件的世界模型何时可用于规划，并据此选择去偏重加权、测试时多次 rollout 或主动采集缺失支持集数据，从而降低决策后悔值。
AI.motivation: 动作条件世界模型常被用于规划，但视频看起来逼真、与训练数据一致并不代表能做出好决策；需要回答"何时可信任世界模型做规划"与"不可信任时怎么办"两个问题。
AI.method: 以训练数据对规划器决策的支撑度（support）为核心构造可验证证书，评估某决策是否可信；依据证书结果分流处理：对训练数据加权去偏、在测试时增加采样 rollout、或在支撑缺失处探索采集新数据。
AI.result: 在 PhyWorld 仿真物理、MuJoCo 机械臂控制、Language-Table 推挤（仿真与真实视频）上验证：证书信任的决策后悔值显著更低（Language-Table 仿真 0.06 vs 0.38，MuJoCo 接触 0.07 vs 0.38），而视频感知质量无法识别好决策；相较最优悲观决策规则降低后悔 10–25%，相较世界-动作模型、搜索与策略学习在同等数据下降低 41–64%。
AI.conclusion: 应以决策质量而非感知质量评价世界模型；证书式可信度评估配合相应补救策略，可在同等数据下显著提升规划可靠性，为世界模型的可部署性提供可操作准则。

title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services. For individuals and small companies, bringing this work in-house also requires computational resources they can afford. We introduce CADMAGEDDON, an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes and can run locally on single-GPU systems and current-generation laptops. The method decomposes this complex task into a chain of simple visual decisions about what to construct and what to correct. Geometric tools support precise construction, allowing the agent to focus on visual reasoning. Using the mid-sized Qwen3.8-27B model, CADMAGEDDON outperforms prior approaches, including systems based on frontier models, in reconstruction quality on all the main benchmarks. CADMAGEDDON integrates with FreeCAD, bringing its reconstructions into practitioners' existing CAD workflows. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: CADMAGEDDON 是一个开源单 GPU 可本地运行的智能体系统，通过将"网格→可编辑 CAD"分解为一系列简单视觉决策，并借助几何工具完成精确构造，从而实现高质量 CAD 重建。
AI.motivation: CAD 从业者的专有零件不愿外包给外部服务，个人与小公司又受限于算力，因此需要可本地部署、隐私友好的逆向 CAD 重建方案。
AI.method: 将复杂的网格到参数化 CAD 重建任务分解为链式视觉判断（决定构建什么、修正什么）；由几何工具负责精确几何构造，让智能体专注视觉推理；选用中等规模 Qwen3.8-27B 作为推理骨干；并与 FreeCAD 集成输出可编辑模型。
AI.result: 在所有主要基准上，重建质量超越此前方法，包括基于前沿大模型的系统，且仅需单卡/当代笔记本算力。
AI.conclusion: 中等规模模型的智能体 + 几何工具组合可在本地资源约束下达到领先的逆向 CAD 重建效果，并可直接嵌入现有 CAD 工作流；代码开源。

title: Lost in Read-out: Locating the Image Quality Gap in Vision-Language Models with a Closed-Form Edit
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are widely used as zero-shot image quality assessors, yet their good-vs-poor answers agree only moderately with human opinion. We ask whether these models fail to see quality or fail to say it. Layer-wise probes on five VLMs point to the second: quality is linearly decodable from the vision encoder and still from the last language layer, far better than the answer reveals, and about a hundred labels recover most of it. The loss lies mainly in the final read-out, which partly reads something else: relative to human opinion, it over-rewards colorfulness and under-rewards sharpness on all five models. We test this by intervention: if the read-out is at fault, a closed-form edit of a single last-layer neuron, fitted to many prompts at once, should close the gap and no more. Both hold. Under prompts never used for fitting, the edit recovers 86--100\% of what a ridge head on the last-layer state, fitted under the same prompts, finds beyond the answer on KonIQ. Where that gap is small, it gains little, too little for our transfer criterion on the two largest models; where the head itself is below the answer, it lowers the score; and it works only when written from the middle of the language model on. Unlike unconstrained fine-tuning, the edit leaves perception question answering intact. It does not carry over to yes-or-no or rating questions, and it reverses the good--poor contrast after sentiment-laden sentences. Code will be made available.

AI.tldr: 对五个VLM做逐层探针分析，发现图像质量在视觉编码器与末层语言状态中线性可解码，误差主要来自最终读出；通过闭式编辑单个末层神经元可修正约86–100%的可修正差距，且不破坏感知问答能力。
AI.motivation: VLM作为零样本图像质量评估器时与人类主观意见仅中等一致，需要辨明模型是"看不见"质量还是"说不出"质量，从而定位失效环节。
AI.method: 对5个VLM做逐层线性探针，比较视觉编码器、中间层与末层语言状态中质量信息的可解码性及所需标注量；用岭回归头估计"末层状态相对答案的增益上限"，再以一次性拟合多提示的闭式方法编辑单个末层神经元，并在未参与拟合的提示上做干预验证；对照无约束微调与情感句干扰实验。
AI.result: 质量在编码器与末层语言层均线性可解码且显著优于回答表现，约百个标签即可恢复大部分信息；神经编辑在KonIQ上于新提示下恢复86–100%的潜在增益；增益较小时改善有限（两最大模型未达迁移判据），头部本身劣于答案时会降分；编辑仅在语言模型中段之后生效；保留感知问答能力，但不迁移到是/否或评分式提问，且在情感句后反转好坏对比。读出相对人类意见系统性高估色彩、低估锐度。
AI.conclusion: VLM质量评估的瓶颈主要在末层读出而非感知表征，可用极低成本的单神经元闭式编辑部分修复，但存在提示形式与上下文的强依赖，说明读出头存在结构性偏置而非简单缺失。

title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification. Given a boundary-representation part, stock, and material, a locally hosted, mid-sized open model proposes operations and cutting parameters for indexed three-axis machining. A geometric harness generates toolpaths, simulates material removal, and returns feedback for plan refinement. Setup planning accounts for what the available cutters can physically reach, rather than visibility alone. We evaluate the resulting programs by the fraction of the target surface area within the specified tolerance after simulated machining. With Qwen3.8-27B, MillBill outperforms frontier-model approaches that construct their own geometry and toolpath workflows on the evaluated machining tasks. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: MillBill将数控加工任务中的工艺决策与几何执行解耦：本地中型开源模型只提出工序与切削参数，几何测试台负责生成刀路、仿真去料并反馈迭代，装夹规划基于刀具实际可达性而非可见性。
AI.motivation: 让语言模型直接写几何与刀路代码，会把数值执行（几何正确性、可达性、精度）变成模型自身任务，难以保证可加工性与公差；因此需要把"工艺决策"与"几何执行/验证"分离。
AI.method: 输入B-rep零件、毛坯与材料；由本地中型开源模型（Qwen3.8-27B）输出索引式三轴加工的工序与切削参数；几何测试台自动生成刀路、做材料去除仿真并返回反馈用于计划精修；装夹规划考虑刀具物理可达性。
AI.result: 以仿真加工后落在公差内的目标表面积占比为指标评估；在评测的加工任务上，MillBill（配Qwen3.8-27B）优于自行构建几何与刀路工作流的前沿模型方案。
AI.conclusion: 将数值执行外置为确定性的几何工具、由模型只做高层工艺规划，可在中型本地模型上超过前沿模型端到端生成方案，体现了"智能体+工具+仿真反馈"在物理制造任务中的有效性。

title: Semantic-Guided Geometric Decoding for Token-Efficient Visual Grounding
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a unified interface for language-conditioned visual perception. In pixel-to-sequence grounding, autoregressive coordinate generation requires multiple sequential decoding steps per box, increasing inference cost with the number of instances. Pixel-to-embedding methods reduce this overhead but lack explicit spatial encoding when using a shared special token. We introduce SemGeo, a token-efficient visual grounding framework that represents each instance with a single grid token for coarse localization. A geometric decoder reuses visual features and hidden states to recover precise discrete box coordinates in parallel. To train proposal generation and box localization together, we introduce Gaussian soft labels that encode coordinate distances during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Reinforcement post-training further combines box-set rewards with coordinate supervision on model-generated proposals. This stage trains the language model and geometric decoder on their own predictions to mitigate the mismatch between teacher-forced training and inference. Across eight benchmarks spanning object detection, referring object detection, and document layout grounding, SemGeo achieves the highest F1@mIou among compared MLLMs on six benchmarks. It also delivers $2.07\times$ and $1.25\times$ the mean box-generation throughput of representative grounding baselines under vLLM and Transformers, respectively, while achieving higher accuracy in both comparisons.

AI.tldr: SemGeo 用单个网格 token 做粗定位，配合并行几何解码器恢复精确框坐标，并提出 Gaussian 软标签与强化后训练，实现高效视觉定位。
AI.motivation: 逐像素到序列的自回归坐标生成每框需多步解码，推理开销随实例数线性增长；而共享特殊 token 的 pixel-to-embedding 方法缺乏显式空间编码，精度受限。目标是兼顾 token 效率与定位精度。
AI.method: 将每个实例压缩为一个网格 token 表示粗位置；几何解码器复用视觉特征与隐藏状态，并行回归离散框坐标；SFT 阶段用 Gaussian 软标签编码坐标距离以联合训练候选生成与框定位；强化后训练阶段结合框集合奖励与坐标监督，在模型自生成候选上训练以缓解 teacher forcing 与推理的失配。
AI.result: 在覆盖目标检测、指代目标检测、文档版面定位的 8 个基准中，6 个取得对比 MLLM 中最高的 F1@mIoU；框生成吞吐量在 vLLM 与 Transformers 下分别为代表性 baseline 的 2.07× 与 1.25×，且精度均更高。
AI.conclusion: 单 token 粗定位 + 并行几何解码是替代逐框自回归解码的有效方案，软标签与自生成候选上的强化训练可进一步提升精度-效率帕累托前沿。

title: InteractVLA: Turning VLAs into Interactive Tools for Agentic Robotic Manipulation
summary: Existing agentic manipulation systems treat pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies as opaque, language-only primitives: when a policy call fails under unfamiliar instructions or scene perturbations, the agent cannot steer its behavior and is forced into futile retries or costly manual takeover. We present InteractVLA, a framework that turns pretrained flow-based VLAs into geometrically steerable and inspectable tools through a bidirectional geometric interface with vision-language agents. In the forward direction, test-time geometric guidance translates an agent-specified end-effector target into input gradients through the action expert via a differentiable command-to-pose mapping, while soft-time target alignment treats arrival time as a latent execution index to match the target pose without distorting the policy's approach motion. In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory. Making the VLA controllable not only boosts online agentic tool use, but also unlocks effective recursive self-improvement (RSI), achieving state-of-the-art performance of 99.4\% on LIBERO-Plus, 48.62\% on RoboDojo, and 89.4\% on RoboCasa365. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: InteractVLA 通过双向几何接口将预训练 flow-based VLA 变为可几何引导、可检查的工具：前向用测试时几何引导（可微 command-to-pose 映射+软时间目标对齐）把末端目标转为输入梯度，反向将动作块与标定相机重投影回传给智能体以诊断与局部修正。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic 操作系统把预训练 VLA 策略当作不可解释的“语言+黑箱基元”，遇到陌生指令或场景扰动时失败后无法引导其行为，只能无效重试或人工接管。
AI.method: 双向几何接口：1) 前向——测试时几何引导，将智能体指定的末端执行器目标经可微 command-to-pose 映射反传为经 action expert 的输入梯度；软时间目标对齐把到达时刻作为潜执行索引以匹配目标位姿而不扭曲接近轨迹。2) 反向——action-informed agentic refinement，向智能体暴露生成的 action chunk 与标定相机重投影，用于诊断空间偏差、修订目标、或局部调整动作段。
AI.result: LIBERO-Plus 99.4%，RoboDojo 48.62%，RoboCasa365 89.4%，并解锁有效的递归自我改进（RSI）。
AI.conclusion: 使 VLA 可控既提升在线 agentic 工具使用能力，又带来递归自我改进收益，取得多个操作基准上的 SOTA。

title: PACT: Plan-Action Consistency Training by Preserving Correct Plans and Repairing Actions in GUI Agents
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material
summary: GUI agents can formulate a correct immediate plan in their reasoning yet emit an action that fails to execute it, creating an execution gap. This recurring mismatch undermines reliable task completion, as a single execution error can derail a multi-step workflow. In outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, broadcasting a negative response-level advantage across all generated tokens risks penalizing valid planning together with erroneous execution. To address this credit-assignment conflict, we introduce PACT (Plan-Action Consistency Training), a training framework that combines reference-aligned plan protection and plan-aligned action repair without altering the original scalar action reward. Using annotated reference actions to identify execution gaps, PACT protects the verified plan by masking negative policy-gradient contributions across its token span. Keeping the generated reasoning unchanged as context, it then favors the reference action over the emitted erroneous action through a preference surrogate with stop-gradient pair weights. Compared with the outcome-only baseline, PACT raises AndroidWorld task success from 60.34% to 68.97% (+8.63 pp), while improving rule-based plan-action consistency on AndroidControl High from 83.71% to 89.74% (+6.03 pp). Adapting PACT to desktop agents also improves task success from 40.92% to 44.17% (+3.25 pp) on the full 369-task OSWorld benchmark. Together, these results establish PACT as an effective credit-assignment framework for bridging execution gaps and improving task completion across mobile and desktop GUI environments.

AI.tldr: PACT：用参考动作检测"计划-执行不一致"，屏蔽对已验证计划的负向策略梯度，并对错误动作施加偏好修复，提升GUI智能体任务成功率。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体常在推理中得到正确的即时计划，却输出无法执行该计划的动作，形成"执行鸿沟"。单步执行错误会毁掉多步任务。在结果监督RL中，把负的response级优势广播到所有token，会把有效规划与错误执行一起惩罚，导致信用分配冲突。
AI.method: 提出PACT训练框架，不改动原始标量动作奖励：1) 用标注的参考动作定位执行鸿沟；2) 对已验证的计划token区间掩码负策略梯度贡献（计划保护）；3) 保持生成的推理不变作为上下文，通过带stop-gradient成对权重的偏好代理目标，让参考动作优于已输出的错误动作（动作修复）。
AI.result: AndroidWorld任务成功率由60.34%提升至68.97%（+8.63pp）；AndroidControl High基于规则的规划-动作一致性由83.71%升至89.74%（+6.03pp）；迁移到桌面智能体，OSWorld完整369任务成功率由40.92%升至44.17%（+3.25pp）。
AI.conclusion: PACT通过细粒度信用分配弥合计划-执行鸿沟，在移动与桌面GUI环境中均提升任务完成率，可作为通用智能体训练框架推广。

title: Distilling World Action Models for Efficient Bimanual Manipulation via Anchored Path Matching
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative denoising. Few-step distillation reduces the number of model evaluations, but its coarse updates can move the student away from the teacher's trajectory. We propose Anchored Path Matching (APM), which supervises endpoint and short-transition predictions from states reached by the student. From each state, we continue the teacher to zero noise and use its endpoint and first intermediate state as targets. Modality-routed adapters learn to match both targets from the same starting state. When the two gradients conflict, anchor-priority updates preserve the endpoint gradient and remove the opposing component of the local gradient within each modality. One checkpoint supports 1-, 2-, and 4-step joint generation. The sampling budget can be chosen at deployment without retraining or teacher queries. On RoboTwin 2.0, we train only on Clean demonstrations and evaluate directly on the domain-randomized Random setting. At one step, APM improves closed-loop success over continued base distillation at matched inference budgets by 2.0 percentage points on Clean and 1.4 on Random. Video peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) rises from 30.169 to 32.317 dB, with gains in structural similarity (SSIM) and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS). On two real-robot tasks, APM improves success over the one-step teacher and reduces control-cycle latency by $21.3\times$ relative to the eight-step this http URL page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 Anchored Path Matching (APM)，通过在学生实际到达状态上以教师端点与首个中间状态为锚点监督短程转移，并用模态路由适配器与"锚点优先"梯度冲突消解实现 WAM 少步联合生成蒸馏，单一权重支持 1/2/4 步采样。
AI.motivation: World Action Models 通过迭代去噪联合生成视频与动作，推理昂贵；少步蒸馏虽减少评估次数，但粗粒度更新会使学生偏离教师轨迹，导致端点误差与方法偏差累积。
AI.method: APM：从学生的实际中间状态出发，继续运行教师至零噪声，取教师端点与首个中间状态作为双重监督目标；模态路由适配器（视频/动作分别）从同一状态匹配两类目标；当端点梯度与局部梯度冲突时，锚点优先更新保留端点梯度并去除局部梯度的对立分量（按模态分别投影）。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0 仅在 Clean 演示训练、直接评测 Random 域随机化设置：1 步时闭环成功率较匹配预算的基线蒸馏提升 2.0 个百分点（Clean）与 1.4 个百分点（Random）；视频 PSNR 由 30.169 升至 32.317 dB，SSIM 与 LPIPS 同步改善。两项真机任务上成功率优于 1 步教师，控制周期时延较 8 步降低 21.3×。
AI.conclusion: 以学生可达状态为锚点对齐教师路径的双目标蒸馏，可在不重训、不查询教师的前提下部署时灵活选择 1/2/4 步预算，兼顾生成质量与实时控制。

title: Propose with the Gradient, Accept with the Loss: One Hedged Attack for Pixel-Sparse Robustness
comment: 22 pages, 13 tables, 4 figures
summary: A pixel-sparse adversary may change a few pixels of an image to any value. Robustness to such attacks is currently measured with an ensemble, sparse-AutoAttack (sAA), because its members fail in different places: sparse projected gradient descent (sPGD) trusts a first-order model that a full pixel change breaks, and sparse random search (Sparse-RS) ignores the gradient even where it is informative. We show that both attacks are local searches, each a proposal distribution plus an acceptance rule, and ask what such a search can learn from the gradient. A Taylor bound says what to measure, and measurements at the states the search visits give five rules. The sign of the gradient is its most reliable use at a single pixel and sets a new pixel's value. Its ranking of candidate pixels should be followed loosely, and its ranking of the pixels to remove, which is often more reliable, can be followed more closely. A pixel should not be proposed twice before a move is accepted, and acceptance should be decided by the loss alone. These rules define Gradient-guided Random Search (GRS), which runs once and costs one forward and one backward pass per step. On 13 CIFAR-10 configurations and 5 ImageNet models, GRS matches or beats the best single member of sAA and is within one point of sAA itself or stronger on 17 of 18 settings, and it is significantly stronger than sAA on 8. It uses 3 instead of up to 7 forward-pass units, and on CIFAR-10 it runs 3.7 to 5.0 times faster than the members of sAA run in full.

AI.tldr: 将稀疏像素攻击(sPGD与Sparse-RS)统一为"提议分布+接受规则"的局部搜索，基于泰勒界导出梯度使用的五条准则，提出梯度引导随机搜索GRS，单次运行即可在多数设置上媲美或超过sAA集成。
AI.motivation: 像素稀疏对抗鲁棒性评测依赖sAA集成，因其成员各自失效：sPGD依赖的一阶模型被整像素替换打破，Sparse-RS在梯度有效处却不用梯度。作者希望厘清局部搜索究竟能从梯度中获取何种信息，从而以单一高效攻击替代集成。
AI.method: 把两类攻击抽象为局部搜索，用泰勒界确定应度量何种量，并在搜索实际访问的状态上做测量，得出五条规则：单像素上梯度符号最可靠并用于设定新像素值；候选像素排序应宽松跟随；待移除像素（像素置零/还原）排序更可靠可紧密跟随；未接受移动前不重复提议同一像素；接受准则仅由损失决定。据此构成GRS，每步一次前向+一次反向。
AI.result: 在13个CIFAR-10配置与5个ImageNet模型上，GRS与sAA最佳单成员持平或更优，18个设置中17个与sAA本体差距在1个点以内，8个设置为显著更强；仅消耗3个前向单元（sAA至多7个），CIFAR-10上比sAA成员完整运行快3.7–5.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 梯度在稀疏攻击中的正确用法是"部分信任、分类使用"：符号强、排序弱、删像素排序较强。统一视角下的单次搜索即可替代昂贵集成，为对抗鲁棒性评测提供更快的基准。

title: PlaceTally: A Test-Time Memory Model for Constructing Place Graphs
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code, data and supplementary material: this https URL
summary: Counting distinct objects in a video is hard when the camera returns to places it has seen. A vision-language model that reads the whole video answers with a few small numbers, and one that reads it in parts counts an object again in every part that shows it. Object trackers need the category before the video is read, or a fixed vocabulary. We observe that a memory for counting does not need to know what it is looking for, only where it has been: objects rarely leave a room between visits, so parts of a video grouped by place share almost no objects, and a place can be recognised before any question is asked. Building on this, we introduce PlaceTally, a question-blind test-time memory model that constructs a place graph for each video. Each video fragment joins the place of its best earlier match or opens a new place, because a strong match is rarely wrong while a true return often matches weakly. A frozen vision-language model counts each place once from at most 128 of its frames, so every read has a bounded input and the memory grows with the number of places; the graph is built 15 times faster than real time. On RevisitCount, our benchmark of real room re-recordings, it scores 62.5% mean relative accuracy on test rooms and 61.2% on held-out rooms, against 51.2% and 44.3% for the same model reading the whole video. It stays level as rooms return more or less often, while a fixed correction of summed visits moves from 38.5% to 61.4%.

AI.tldr: PlaceTally：问题无关的测试时记忆模型，为视频构建"地点图"，每个片段匹配到最佳历史地点或开新地点，再用冻结VLM在每个地点≤128帧上计数一次，实现跨片段去重的物体计数。
AI.motivation: 视频中相机回到已看过的地方时，物体计数困难：整体读视频的VLM只能给出粗略小数，分片段读会在每个片段重复计数；目标跟踪器又需要预先知道类别或固定词表。作者观察到计数记忆只需知道"去过哪里"而非"找什么"：物体很少在两次访问间离开房间，因此按地点分组的片段几乎不共享物体，且地点可在提问前识别。
AI.method: PlaceTally 在推理时、无需问题输入即为每个视频构建地点图：每个视频片段与其最佳历史匹配的地点合并，若无强匹配则新建地点（强匹配很少出错，真实回访往往匹配较弱）。随后用冻结VLM对每个地点（最多128帧）计数一次，使每次读取输入有界，记忆规模随地点数增长；图构建速度比实时快15倍。同时构建 RevisitCount 基准，由真实房间重录视频组成。
AI.result: 在 RevisitCount 上，测试房间平均相对准确率 62.5%，留出房间 61.2%，而同一模型整段读视频分别为 51.2% 与 44.3%；性能随房间回访频率变化保持稳定，而固定修正的求和访问策略从 38.5% 变到 61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 以"地点记忆"替代类别先验与目标跟踪，是一种免训练、有界输入、可扩展的测试时计数框架，显著优于整体读视频的VLM且对回访频率鲁棒；但核心是具身/视频物体计数的VLM记忆机制，与VLA、世界模型、3D重建等核心方向关联较弱。

title: Task Convergent Flow Matching for Generative Robotics
comment: Submitted to L4DC 2027
summary: Successful manipulation requires the manipulated objects to progress toward a desired task outcome. Generative policies can produce plausible robot motions without ensuring this progress, allowing successive action chunks to stall or undo earlier changes to the scene. We introduce a task-centric inference-time refinement framework for flow matching policies that evaluates candidate action chunks through parallel physics-based rollouts and searches for motions satisfying sufficient conditions for task convergence. Task-level performance funnels bound temporary regressions while requiring net progress over each chunk. We establish sufficient conditions under which repeated funnel satisfaction yields convergence throughout execution, and use interval-wise Lipschitz bounds to verify continuous-time funnel satisfaction from sampled rollouts. To accommodate contact-rich hybrid dynamics, we refine the flow's source seeds using derivative-free Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES), constrained to radial quantile bands of the source distribution to help retain the learned motion prior. This formulation supports both Euclidean and pose-valued Riemannian Flow Matching (RMFM) policies. On PushT and three-cube stacking, refinement raises success from 31.3% to 88.5% and from 77.0% to 86.0%. On PushT, whose coverage score responds continuously to the motion of the block, a learned funnel lowers the average maximum loss of achieved progress by 19% relative to constraining the endpoint of each chunk alone, at a similar success rate. With the radial band, 11.3% of the executed motion windows are out of distribution, a rate within the range of held-out demonstrations, compared with 34.1% for an unconstrained search.

AI.tldr: 提出以任务为中心的推理时精炼框架，通过并行物理仿真rollout评估候选动作块，并用任务级"漏斗"约束保证任务收敛性；用无导数CMA-ES在源分布径向分位带内搜索流匹配源种子，支持欧氏与Riemannian流匹配策略。PushT成功率31.3%→88.5%，三块堆叠77.0%→86.0%。
AI.motivation: 生成式策略（flow matching）能产生可行的机器人运动，但缺乏任务进度保证，连续动作块之间可能停滞或逆转先前对场景的改变。需要在不重训练策略的前提下，于推理时引入任务级目标，使操纵对象真正朝期望结果推进。
AI.method: 1) 任务级性能漏斗（performance funnel）：对每个候选动作块要求净进度、并界定临时回退幅度；2) 通过并行物理仿真rollout评估候选块，形成基于采样的搜索；3) 给出重复满足漏斗即保证执行全程收敛的充分条件，并用区间Lipschitz界从离散采样rollout验证连续时间漏斗满足性；4) 面向接触丰富的混合动力学，对flow的源种子做无导数CMA-ES优化，并限制在源分布的径向分位带内以保留学习到的运动先验；5) 可同时用于欧氏与SE(3)位姿上的Riemannian Flow Matching策略。
AI.result: PushT成功率由31.3%升至88.5%，三块堆叠由77.0%升至86.0%。在PushT上，相比仅约束块端点，学习到的漏斗在相近成功率下将平均最大进度损失降低19%。径向带约束使越界运动窗口占11.3%（处于留出示教范围内），而无约束搜索为34.1%。
AI.conclusion: 推理时以物理rollout+任务漏斗引导的源种子搜索，能在保持运动先验分布性的同时为生成式流匹配策略提供可证明的任务收敛保证，且适用于接触丰富的刚体操纵与位姿空间策略，无需额外训练。

title: VLM-guided Grounding Expert for Generalised Referring Expression Comprehension
comment: 13 pages, 5 tables, 5 figures
summary: Generalised referring expression comprehension (GREC) aims to identify and localise the zero, one or multiple objects referred to by a language expression. In robotic manipulation, grounding also needs to remain accurate when requests for the same objects are paraphrased or embedded in additional context in robotics. However, grounding expert models are sensitive to instruction variation, while generative vision--language models (VLMs) struggle with complete target recovery and rejection of absent targets. These complementary limitations motivate combining the contextual representations of VLMs with the direct spatial prediction capabilities of grounding experts. We therefore introduce VLM-guided Grounding Expert (VGE), which combines a frozen VLM with a trainable grounding expert through layerwise joint attention and text-conditioned instance scoring. These interfaces leverage multimodal understanding of the VLM to guide object-query refinement and candidate selection while retaining direct bounding-box prediction. Across three datasets, VGE achieves the highest averaged F1 score among the evaluated methods on all five test splits, with differences of at most 1.2 percentage points across instruction conditions within each split. On the dataset with robotic scenes, VGE also achieves the highest F1 across instruction variants and no-target, single-target and multiple-target cases. VGE provides a $5.3$--$13.0\times$ inference speedup over the baseline with the same VLM base model. These results support combining VLM context with specialised spatial prediction to address both grounding challenges, with particularly strong performance in robotic scenes. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: VGE结合冻结VLM与可训练grounding expert，通过逐层联合注意力和文本条件实例打分提升通用指代表达理解（zero/one/multi目标）的鲁棒性与速度。
AI.motivation: 通用指代表达理解（GREC）需处理零/单/多目标，且机器人场景下请求常被改写或加长上下文。专家式grounding模型对指令变化敏感，而生成式VLM难以完整恢复目标并拒识不存在目标；两类模型局限互补，故将VLM的上下文表征与专家的直接空间预测结合。
AI.method: 提出VGE：冻结VLM + 可训练grounding expert，通过逐层联合注意力（layerwise joint attention）注入VLM多模态表征以细化object query，并用文本条件实例打分（text-conditioned instance scoring）筛候选目标，同时保留直接边界框回归头。
AI.result: 三个数据集五个测试划分上平均F1均为最高；各划分内不同指令条件下F1差异≤1.2个百分点；机器人场景数据集中在各指令变体及无目标/单目标/多目标情形下F1最高；相比同VLM底座基线推理加速5.3–13.0倍。
AI.conclusion: VLM上下文理解与专用空间预测的结合能同时缓解指令敏感性与目标恢复/拒识问题，在机器人场景尤具优势；代码将随论文发布。

title: Sub-Meter Canopy Height Synthesis from Sentinel-2 via Anchored Residual Flow
comment: 30 pages, including appendices
summary: Canopy height models (CHMs) - per-pixel maps of vegetation top height - are essential for forest carbon accounting, wildfire fuel mapping, and tree-level ecology, yet sub-meter CHMs require airborne LiDAR refreshed on multi-year national cycles. We produce 0.5 m CHMs from free 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery, a 20$\times$ cross-modal super-resolution task where optical reflectance must predict geometric height it does not directly observe. Motivated by the perception-distortion trade-off, we derive two operating points with shared conditioning. A deterministic regressor (Anchor) targets low distortion; a conditional flow matching model, trained on the Anchor's residual in a learned CHM latent space (AR-flow), targets perceptual fidelity. Trained on 197k LiDAR-paired tiles spanning 69 ecoregions across the contiguous United States and evaluated on 2,530 held-out tiles against eight baselines, the Anchor achieves 2.83 m MAE using only free satellite input. The AR-flow reduces sliced Wasserstein distance from the Anchor's 1.13 to 0.208, at a higher MAE of 3.68 m. Crown-scale statistics improve, but strict individual-tree detection remains weak: generated sub-pixel detail represents plausible structure rather than measured individual trees. Quarterly continental refresh becomes tractable, letting satellite monitoring inform timing and extent for more expensive data acquisitions.

AI.tldr: 使用免费 Sentinel-2 10 m 影像生成 0.5 m 冠层高度模型(CHM)，基于感知-失真权衡给出两个操作点：确定性回归器 Anchor（低失真）与在学习到的 CHM 潜空间中拟合 Anchor 残差的条件流匹配模型 AR-flow（高感知保真）。
AI.motivation: 亚米级 CHM 对森林碳核算、野火燃料制图与单木生态至关重要，但需依赖多年更新周期的机载 LiDAR；本文探索能否用免费、高频的卫星光学影像替代，从而把刷新周期推向季度。
AI.method: 跨模态 20× 超分辨率任务（光学反射率→几何高度）。构建 0.5 m CHM 生成框架：Anchor 为确定性回归器以降低失真；AR-flow 为以 Anchor 残差为目标、在学到的 CHM 潜空间中训练的条件流匹配模型以提升感知保真度，两者共享条件输入。训练 197k LiDAR 配对瓦片、覆盖美国本土 69 个生态区，另留 2530 瓦片对 8 个基线做评测。
AI.result: Anchor 仅用免费卫星输入即达 2.83 m MAE；AR-flow 把 sliced Wasserstein 距离由 1.13 降至 0.208，但 MAE 升至 3.68 m。冠层尺度统计改善，严格单木检测仍弱——生成的亚像元细节是"合理的结构"而非实测单木。
AI.conclusion: 相位式"确定性+生成式"双操作点设计可在大范围上以免费数据实现亚米级 CHM，使大陆尺度季度刷新可行，并可用卫星监测指导昂贵机载数据的采集时机与范围；但生成式细节不可作为单木级实测真值使用。

title: OVET-Consensus: Rank-Preserving Counterfactual Event Verification for Video Moment Grounding
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 17 tables
summary: Modern video moment retrieval systems often propose windows that overlap the target event, yet still select the wrong one. We study this scorer bottleneck on QVHighlights with a fixed QD-DETR-derived temporal expert: the parent-aware temporal expert reaches 64.71 R1@0.5, while diagnostic oracles over the same candidate family reach 75.68 R1@0.5 within the parent-reranked pool and 94.97 R1@0.5 over the full 100-candidate evidence pool. We introduce OVET-Consensus, a rank-preserving counterfactual event verification layer that keeps the temporal expert's ranked list as the default and permits only high-confidence rank-1 overrides from a policy calibrated on held-out training videos. The verifier uses parent-aware interval evidence, structured Qwen3-VL event judgments, VideoLLaMA3 pairwise temporal signals, and dense temporal evidence, but never lets those signals freely reorder the top-K list. On QVHighlights validation, OVET-Consensus improves the parent-aware temporal expert from 64.71 to 65.35 R1@0.5 with a positive paired-bootstrap interval, while mAP is largely unchanged, from 42.67 to 42.74; it makes 20 overrides, with 15 helpful corrections and 3 harmful corrections. The results point to a practical constraint on verifier design: semantic compatibility is useful evidence, but temporal grounding still requires deciding where the event starts, changes, and ends inside a visually compatible scene.

AI.tldr: OVET-Consensus：在固定QD-DETR时序专家上，用父窗口感知区间证据+Qwen3-VL事件判断+VideoLLaMA3成对时序信号构建保序反事实验证层，仅允许高置信度的rank-1覆盖，QVHighlights R1@0.5 64.71→65.35。
AI.motivation: 视频时刻检索系统常提出与目标事件重叠的候选窗口却选错目标，说明瓶颈在打分/选择环节而非候选生成；作者用诊断性oracle量化该"scorer bottleneck"（同族候选池75.68 vs 全池94.97），并希望在不破坏已有时序排序的前提下引入VLM语义验证。
AI.method: 固定父窗口感知时序专家（QD-DETR派生）作为默认排序；构建保序反事实验证层，融合父窗区间证据、Qwen3-VL结构化事件判断、VideoLLaMA3成对时序信号与稠密时序证据；在留出训练视频上校准策略，仅允许高置信度对rank-1的覆盖，禁止对top-K自由重排。
AI.result: QVHighlights验证集R1@0.5由64.71提升至65.35（配对bootstrap区间为正），mAP 42.67→42.74基本持平；共20次覆盖，其中15次有益、3次有害；oracle显示剩余提升空间主要在时序定位（起止/变化点），而非语义匹配。
AI.conclusion: 语义兼容性只是必要条件，时序grounding仍取决于在视觉兼容场景内判定事件的开始、变化与结束；受限的保序覆盖式重排是比自由重排更稳健、更可解释的验证器设计，但当前增益幅度小、上界差距大。

title: REVEAL: Reconstructing Video Amodal Content via Language and Flow Guidance
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Amodal perception enables humans to perceive entire objects even when parts are occluded, a remarkable cognitive skill that artificial intelligence struggles to replicate. Recent diffusion-based methods have extended amodal completion from images to videos, yet they lack auxiliary priors to guide the reconstruction of heavily occluded content and to maintain temporal consistency over long sequences. We present REVEAL (REconstructing VidEo Amodal content via Language and flow guidance), a unified diffusion-based framework that integrates complementary motion and semantic priors for video amodal completion. A user-provided text query serves a dual role: it drives open-vocabulary video segmentation to obtain visible masks, and it provides semantic guidance for texture reconstruction. For amodal segmentation, we introduce optical flow guidance: by warping visible masks from previous frames to the current frame, the flow-warped mask propagates visible content into occluded regions and approximates the object's current shape, providing a strong shape prior even under simultaneous deformation and occlusion. For texture completion, text guidance constrains the reconstruction of occluded appearance while providing a stable semantic reference that helps maintain visual coherence throughout the reconstruction. We also contribute LAVAT, a new benchmark featuring long video sequences paired with text descriptions, enabling evaluation of text-guided video amodal completion under heavy occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REVEAL achieves state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks while maintaining high-quality temporal consistency over extended sequences. The project page is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: REVEAL：用文本查询+光流先验引导扩散模型完成视频的非模态补全，并开源长视频文本配对基准 LAVAT。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式视频非模态补全缺少辅助先验，难以重建重度遮挡区域，且长序列时序一致性差。
AI.method: 统一扩散框架：用户文本查询既驱动开放词汇视频分割得到可见掩码，又为纹理重建提供语义引导；分割阶段用光流把前帧可见掩码 warp 到当前帧，将可见内容传播进遮挡区以近似物体当前形状，作为形变+遮挡下的形状先验；纹理阶段用文本约束遮挡外观重建并维持时序语义一致。另构建 LAVAT 长视频+文本描述基准。
AI.result: 在现有基准上取得 SOTA，并在长序列上保持高质量时序一致性；LAVAT 支持重遮挡下文本引导视频非模态补全评测。
AI.conclusion: 语言语义先验与光流运动先验互补，可有效提升视频非模态补全的形状精度与长时一致性；该类"遮挡区域重建+动态单目视频"工作对具身感知与物体级三维重建有直接迁移价值。

title: Must You See Fakes to Catch Fakes? Language Says What to Look For, Real Images What to Ignore
summary: Must a detector see generated images in order to catch them? Detection of AI-generated images has long faced two problems. The cues a detector learns from the few generators in its training set carry traces specific to those generators and transfer poorly to new ones, which limits generalization. The real and generated training images also differ in format and content, so the detector takes these differences as evidence of authenticity, and its decisions change with factors that have nothing to do with authenticity, which harms robustness as well as generalization. Both problems stem from training on generated images. A detector never trained on them can largely avoid both at the source. Vision foundation models have already learned the concept of "AI-generated" during pretraining, and text can point to it directly. Building on this, we propose SaySee, a training-free detector: Say builds a generation direction from sets of paired descriptions that differ only in authenticity and scores an image by the projection of its embedding onto it, and See uses real images to correct the score offsets caused by format, image type and content. On 24 evaluation sets that span standard benchmarks, in-the-wild data and the latest generators, SaySee reaches a mean AUC of 98.2% with MoE-ViE, 4.2 points above the best existing detector. When format is decoupled from authenticity, it remains the best of all methods. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练AI生成图像检测器SaySee：用配对文本描述在视觉基础模型嵌入空间中构造"生成方向"并投影打分，再用真实图像集校正格式/类型/内容导致的分数偏移，24个评测集平均AUC 98.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器存在两大缺陷：从训练集中少量生成器学到的线索具有生成器特异性，难以泛化到新生成器；真实与生成训练图像在格式、内容上的差异被检测器误当作真实性证据，导致对与真实性无关的因素敏感，损害鲁棒性与泛化性。作者指出两问题的根源都在于"用生成图像训练"，因此试图完全回避在生成图像上训练。
AI.method: SaySee为完全免训练方法：(1) Say——利用视觉基础模型预训练中已习得的"AI生成"概念，由仅在真实性上不同的成对描述文本在嵌入空间中构造生成方向，图像得分取其嵌入在该方向上的投影；(2) See——使用真实图像集合估计并校正由图像格式、图像类型和内容引起的分数量级偏移。评测使用MoE-ViE等基础模型骨干。
AI.result: 在覆盖标准基准、in-the-wild数据与最新生成器的24个评测集上，平均AUC达98.2%，比最佳现有检测器高4.2个百分点；在将格式与真实性解耦的设定下仍为所有方法中最优。
AI.conclusion: 检测器无需"见过"生成图像也能有效识别：借助视觉基础模型的语义先验与文本引导，可将真实性建模为嵌入空间中的线性方向，并用真实图像做偏置校正，从而实现强泛化与鲁棒性；方法为免训练范式，代码将开源。

title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have excelled in Western medical imaging, yet their potential in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis remains systematically unevaluated. Tongue diagnosis requires sophisticated global and local perception, serving as a rigorous touchstone for assessing the visual understanding depth of MLLMs. However, existing datasets are limited by single dimensions, coarse granularity, and ambiguous labels, hindering the evaluation of authentic clinical capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniTongue, the first comprehensive, fine-grained Visual Question Answering benchmark for TCM tongue diagnosis. This benchmark integrates 1,351 expert-validated images and 21,616 instruction pairs. Its core design features 16 clinical dimensions for multidimensional evaluation, region-specific annotations for pathological localization, and 66 fine-grained labels for precise diagnostic representation. Extensive evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant performance gaps, demonstrating that medical-specific models lack domain advantages, while universally poor Macro-F1 scores expose a reliance on statistical shortcuts rather than genuine understanding of tongue pathology. These findings not only highlight the current limitations of MLLMs in interpreting regional medical features but also underscore OmniTongue's significance for developing robust automated tongue diagnosis models. The code and dataset will be made publicly available in a future release.

AI.tldr: OmniTongue：首个面向中医舌诊的多模态大模型细粒度VQA基准，含1,351张专家验证图像、21,616指令对、16个临床维度、区域级标注与66个细粒度标签。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在中西医影像已有进展，但中医舌诊能力缺乏系统评估；已有数据集维度单一、粒度粗糙、标签模糊，无法反映真实临床能力。
AI.method: 构建专家验证的舌诊图像—指令对数据集；设计16个临床维度进行多维评测、区域级标注实现病灶定位、66个细粒度标签做精确诊断表征，并对现有通用与医学专用MLLM进行大规模评测（含Macro-F1分析）。
AI.result: 现有MLLM存在显著性能差距；医学专用模型未表现出领域优势；普遍偏低的Macro-F1表明模型依赖统计捷径而非真正的舌象病理理解。
AI.conclusion: OmniTongue揭示了MLLM在区域化医学特征理解上的局限，为鲁棒自动化舌诊模型提供了评测基础；代码与数据将后续公开。

title: Risk Density RRT$^*$: Planning in the Space of Probability
comment: Accepted for publication in The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR)
summary: Planning under uncertainty is a fundamental problem in robotics. While much of the literature seeks minimum-cost paths subject to probabilistic constraints, this paper instead considers collision probability, or risk classically defined as probability times severity, directly as the planning objective. We propose Risk Density RRT$^*$ (RD-RRT$^*$), an extension of RRT$^*$ for high-level planning in environments with deterministic and uncertain obstacles. RD-RRT$^*$ builds on Risk Density, a functional that evaluates a continuous path as a whole and provides a tractable approximation of its collision probability. The framework also supports severity-weighted risk and a hybrid variant that adds a path-length penalty, balancing risk and geometric efficiency while regularizing exploration in low-density regions. We validate the method across a wide range of scenarios. The results show that RD-RRT$^*$ consistently finds paths with lower estimated collision probability by optimizing a global risk-based objective. We further demonstrate the fidelity of the underlying approximation through Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we discuss how the topological structure induced by Risk Density may provide a useful representation of the environment and offer insights into risk-aware planning.

AI.tldr: 提出 RD-RRT*，将碰撞概率（风险）直接作为规划目标，通过 Risk Density 泛函对整条路径的碰撞概率做可计算近似，并支持严重度加权与混合变体（加路径长度惩罚）。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人规划多求解"概率约束下的最小代价路径"，而非直接优化碰撞概率本身；本文希望把风险（概率×严重度）直接作为目标函数进行全局优化。
AI.method: 基于 RRT* 扩展：定义 Risk Density 这一作用于连续路径整体的泛函，提供碰撞概率的易处理近似；支持严重度加权风险形式，以及加入路径长度惩罚的混合变体以平衡风险与几何效率并在低密度区域正则化探索；并以 Risk Density 诱导的拓扑结构刻画环境。
AI.result: 在多类场景中验证，RD-RRT* 通过优化全局风险目标稳定找到估计碰撞概率更低的路径；蒙特卡洛仿真验证了近似方法的保真度。
AI.conclusion: 以风险密度为全局目标可有效降低路径碰撞概率，Risk Density 诱导的拓扑结构为风险感知规划提供了有用的环境表示与分析视角。

title: Unified Residual Translation for Paired Image Restoration
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures
summary: Paired image restoration spans changes in imaging contrast, sensor modality, and spatial resolution. These settings differ in their input channels and target grids, raising the question of how much of the prediction pipeline must be specialized to each task. We present the Unified Residual Translator (URT), which separates fixed channel and scale mapping from learned residual prediction. A deterministic reference uses channel averaging, replication, or bicubic interpolation to match the target dimensions, while a NAFNet encoder-decoder predicts an additive correction from the complete input. Separately trained instances share the prediction rule, $\ell_1$ objective, and optimizer across MRI contrast synthesis, visible-to-infrared translation, SAR-to-optical translation, and real-camera super-resolution. Across six task and scale settings, URT achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM among the evaluated baselines on IXI, SEN1-2, and RealSR $\times3$ and $\times4$. It reaches 30.774dB on IXI and 13.478dB on SEN1-2, with luminance PSNR of 33.596, 28.742, and 27.342dB at the three RealSR scales. On LLVIP, it ranks second in PSNR and SSIM. A study of four spectral alternatives identifies complementary benefits of fitted references and bandwise residual gains. Together, these results support explicit dimensional alignment and learned residual correction as a common formulation for heterogeneous paired imaging tasks.

AI.tldr: URT将"通道/尺度映射"与"残差预测"解耦：先用确定性参考（通道平均、复制、bicubic）对齐到目标维度，再用NAFNet编解码器预测加性残差，统一处理MRI对比度合成、可见光→红外、SAR→光学、真实相机超分。
AI.motivation: 成对图像复原任务（对比度/模态/分辨率变化）的输入通道与目标网格各异，通常需要为每个任务单独设计预测流程；作者希望考察多少专用化是必要的，并提出一种跨异构任务的通用公式。
AI.method: 确定性参考映射（通道平均/复制/bicubic）负责维度对齐，NAFNet编解码器从完整输入预测加性修正；各任务实例独立训练但共享预测规则、ℓ1目标与优化器。另比较四种光谱替代方案，分析拟合参考与分带残差增益的互补性。
AI.result: 在六个任务-尺度设定中，于IXI、SEN1-2、RealSR ×3/×4上取得最高PSNR/SSIM：IXI 30.774dB，SEN1-2 13.478dB，RealSR三尺度亮度PSNR为33.596/28.742/27.342dB；LLVIP上PSNR与SSIM排名第二。光谱消融表明拟合参考与分带残差增益互补。
AI.conclusion: 显式维度对齐加学习式残差修正可作为异构成对成像任务的统一形式，说明任务专用化可大幅降低，仅共享朴素接口即可获得竞争力性能。

title: SpatialCast: Reading the 3D World via Cast Shadows
comment: 10 pages (main paper), 7 pages (supplementary material), 5 figures and 6 tables in the main paper
summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance toward understanding and interacting with the physical world, spatial reasoning becomes essential for understanding scene structure and anticipating the effects of physical changes. Existing spatial benchmarks have made substantial progress in evaluating spatial relations, memory, and viewpoint reasoning, but less systematically assess how models connect physical scene conditions with visual observations. We introduce SpatialCast, a benchmark that uses cast shadows to evaluate this ability. Cast shadows provide observable evidence of a 3D scene. Their image appearance depends on object geometry and pose, illumination, and viewpoint. We examine this relationship through three complementary tasks that assess scene-projection consistency, predict intervention-induced changes, and infer the physical changes behind visual transitions. The benchmark contains 21,000 synthetic questions with separate scene and geometry test partitions, complemented by 200 SpatialCast-Real questions from 20 photographed scenes. Evaluations show that closed-source MLLMs outperform general-purpose open-weight MLLMs and MLLMs designed for spatial reasoning, which remain near chance on the synthetic benchmark, while even strong closed-source models struggle with shadow-length and light-height judgments. We also use SpatialCast training data for GRPO post-training, improving open-weight MLLM performance on the benchmark. Further evaluations show improvements on several external spatial benchmarks, suggesting transfer of the learned capabilities. These experiments support SpatialCast as a controlled resource for diagnosing spatial reasoning capabilities and studying their learning and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialCast 基准，用投影阴影（cast shadow）作为可观测物理证据，通过三个互补任务系统评测多模态大模型的场景—投影一致性、干预效应预测与物理变化反推能力；含 21k 合成题 + 200 真实场景题，并验证 GRPO 后训练可提升开源模型并外溢到其他空间基准。
AI.motivation: 现有空间基准多聚焦空间关系、记忆与视角推理，较少系统评测"物理场景条件—视觉观测"之间的因果关联能力。投影阴影同时受物体几何、位姿、光照与视角调制，可作为检验模型是否真正建模三维场景结构的天然探针。
AI.method: 构建 SpatialCast：21,000 道合成问答，划分 scene / geometry 两个测试分区，另附 20 个实拍场景的 200 道 SpatialCast-Real 题。设计三类互补任务：(1) 场景—投影一致性判断；(2) 预测干预（物体形变/位姿/光照改变）引起的阴影变化；(3) 由视觉变化反推背后的物理变化。评测闭源、通用开源与空间专用 MLLM，并用 SpatialCast 训练数据做 GRPO 后训练。
AI.result: 闭源 MLLM 显著优于通用开源模型和空间推理专用 MLLM，后者在合成集上接近随机水平；即使强闭源模型在阴影长度与光源高度判断上仍明显吃力。GRPO 后训练提升开源模型在本基准上的表现，并在若干外部空间基准上也有提升，提示能力可迁移。
AI.conclusion: SpatialCast 提供了可控的诊断资源，用于揭示并改进 MLLM 的物理—几何一致性推理，可用于研究该类能力的习得与泛化；同时说明当前模型更多依赖表观线索而非显式三维物理建模。

title: VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Preprint
summary: Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. Speculative decoding makes this possible: a lightweight draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the VLA verifies them in a single pass, accepting only those that match its own predictions, so decoding remains lossless. The speedup, however, is limited in robot control, where many different tokens encode nearly the same motion and a draft close to the correct action is still rejected. To address this, our approach, VSpark, is built upon three design choices: (i) rollouts collected with calibrated action noise, which expose the draft to a wider range of robot states; (ii) feature alignment, which trains the draft to match the VLA's hidden features rather than its output tokens alone; and (iii) continuation reuse, which keeps the predictions the VLA has already computed along rejected drafts as candidates for the next verification step, instead of discarding them. On four VLAs with different action tokenizers and four manipulation benchmarks, VSpark achieves 1.28x to 2.10x speedup while keeping the VLA's decoding lossless.

AI.tldr: VSpark 通过"标定动作噪声轨迹采集 + 隐特征对齐训练草稿模型 + 拒绝草稿的续算复用"三项设计，改进 VLA 的推测解码，在四个 VLA/四个操作基准上实现 1.28–2.10× 无损加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归 VLA 逐 token 生成动作，推理开销大；推测解码可无损加速，但机器人控制中多个不同 token 编码近似相同运动，导致"接近正确"的草稿仍被严格匹配规则拒绝，实际加速比受限。
AI.method: 1) 以标定(calibrated)动作噪声采集 rollout，覆盖更广的机器人状态分布，提升草稿泛化；2) 特征对齐：训练草稿模型拟合 VLA 的隐层特征而非仅输出 token；3) continuation reuse：不丢弃被拒草稿之后的 VLA 已算预测，将其作为下一轮验证的候选，提高接受率。
AI.result: 在 4 种不同动作分词器(action tokenizer)的 VLA 与 4 个操作基准上，取得 1.28×–2.10× 加速，且保持 VLA 解码无损（lossless）。
AI.conclusion: 针对动作多模态/近等价 token 造成的低接受率问题，从数据采集、训练目标与解码缓存复用三方面协同优化推测解码，可在不损失动作精度的前提下显著降低 VLA 推理延迟。

title: Let Samples Sing in Chorus: Mitigating Spurious Correlations via Cross-view Consensus
comment: Under Review
summary: Deep models often rely on spurious correlations that fail on underrepresented groups. Existing methods either correct human-specified bias attributes or infer unknown biases from the learned representation space. However, annotated attributes may differ from the shortcuts actually used by a model, while a single representation provides incomplete and potentially noisy evidence. Our key insight is that a bias obscured in one feature space may be clearer in another. In this work, we propose CHORD (Cross-view Harmonic Outlier Reversal for Debiasing), a multi-view framework that allows samples to "sing in chorus" across diverse representation spaces to achieve robust cross-view consensus. CHORD aggregates aggregates within-class partitions in each view, which is a proxy for specifying candidate biases, to debias the target representation and classifier without bias supervision. Experiments on seven benchmarks across vision, language, speech, and medical imaging show consistent improvements in worst-group accuracy. Code and checkpoints are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CHORD: a multi-view (multi-representation) debiasing framework that aggregates within-class partitions across diverse feature spaces to form cross-view consensus pseudo-bias labels, then reverses/removes them without bias supervision.
AI.motivation: Deep models rely on spurious correlations that break on underrepresented groups. Human-annotated bias attributes may not match the shortcuts a model actually uses, and a single representation gives incomplete, noisy evidence for bias inference.
AI.method: Key insight: a bias obscured in one feature space may be evident in another. CHORD treats multiple representation spaces as views, clusters/partitions samples within each class per view (a proxy for candidate bias annotations), and aggregates these partitions into a robust cross-view consensus used to debias the target representation and classifier, with no bias supervision.
AI.result: Consistent worst-group accuracy gains on seven benchmarks spanning vision, language, speech, and medical imaging; code and checkpoints released.
AI.conclusion: Multi-view consensus over within-class partitions is a practical substitute for bias supervision, improving worst-group robustness across modalities; broader validation on foundation-model-scale backbones remains open.

title: Beyond the Camera: A Tri-Modal Driving World Model for Future RGB, Thermal, and LiDAR Forecasting in Adverse Weather
summary: Driving world models forecast what a vehicle's sensors will record next. Most forecast camera video and some add LiDAR, but thermal cameras, which still see in darkness and some adverse weather, are rarely a forecast target, and to our knowledge no world model forecasts all three sensors. We study joint forecasting of RGB, thermal, and LiDAR on real adverse-weather sequences of the DSERT-RoLL dataset. We post-train a pretrained video world model for each sensor and represent LiDAR as a depth video aligned with the RGB camera, with densification and encoding chosen by what the model's video tokenizer can reconstruct. A tri-sensor model sees all three sensors as one video. We score LiDAR in meters against measured returns and compare against persistence baselines passed through the same tokenizer as the model. With this matching, an apparent loss of the thermal model to persistence in fog disappears. On all 58 validation sequences in six weather conditions, post-trained RGB and thermal forecasts beat compression-matched persistence. Joint training lowers the LiDAR error at 2s by 2.1m at a small cost in camera fidelity, and only the tri-sensor model's LiDAR forecasts beat persistence in mean error. Blanking one sensor degrades the forecasts of the others more in snow than in fog.

AI.tldr: 该文研究RGB、热红外与LiDAR三传感器联合预测驱动的驾驶世界模型：将LiDAR表示为与RGB对齐的深度视频，在各传感器上后训练预训练视频世界模型，并比较单/三传感器联合训练。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型多预测相机视频、部分加入LiDAR，热红外相机（在黑暗与恶劣天气下仍可用）几乎不作为预测目标，且据作者所知尚无从同时预测三种传感器的世界模型。
AI.method: 在DSERT-RoLL真实恶劣天气序列上，对每个传感器后训练预训练视频世界模型；LiDAR以与RGB相机对齐的深度视频表示，稠密化与编码方式依据视频tokenizer的重建能力选择；三传感器模型将三者视为单一视频联合预测；LiDAR以米为单位对照实测回波评分，并与经同一tokenizer处理的persistence基线对比。
AI.result: 在压缩匹配条件下，热红外模型在雾天相对persistence的表面劣势消失；全部58条验证序列、六种天气下，后训练RGB与热红外预测均优于压缩匹配persistence；联合训练在相机保真度小幅下降的代价下将2s处LiDAR误差降低2.1m，且仅三传感器模型的LiDAR预测在平均误差上优于persistence；遮蔽单一传感器时，雪的天气条件下对其他传感器预测的退化大于雾。
AI.conclusion: 在公平的压缩匹配评测下，多传感器联合世界模型可同时优于persistence基线，联合训练带来跨传感器收益，传感器间依赖强度随天气而变；但绝对精度仍有限（如2s处2.1m改进后仅三传感器模型在平均误差上胜过persistence）。

title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments across public and complex multi-event benchmarks with the strongest video models to date, demonstrating that FVSCORE outperforms holistic and agent-based evaluators in human correlation while providing highly accurate and interpretable feedback.

AI.tldr: FVSCORE：神经-符号框架，将视频编译为显式/隐式命题，用专用感知工具grounding，并以软时序算子(受LTL启发)+显著性感知校准产出带时间戳与证据的可解释评估报告。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评估器依赖MLLM整体打分或视觉-语言指标，与人类判断对齐不足，且无法将分数追溯到具体时序违反点。
AI.method: 神经-符号评估框架：把提示需求编译为显式命题，并挖掘未明示的物理、时序、跨模态隐式命题；用专用感知工具对每条命题做grounding得到置信度轨迹；用受线性时序逻辑启发的软时序算子进行时序聚合评估；最后经Significance-Aware Calibration只保留感知显著的违反，输出带时间戳和证据的报告。
AI.result: 在公开及复杂多事件基准上，与当前最强视频生成模型对比实验，FVSCORE在人类相关性上优于整体式与agent式评估器，并提供高准确度、可解释的反馈。
AI.conclusion: 规格驱动的神经-符号评估可同时提升与人类判断的一致性和可解释性，为视频生成评估提供可追溯的时序违反诊断。

title: Classification of Tissues on MALDI-MSI Image Modality for Pancreatic Cancer Studies
summary: Mass Spectrometry Imaging (MSI) spatially maps molecular distributions in tissue sections. Despite the availability of preprocessing tools for MSI data, building end-to-end workflows suitable for deep learning remains challenging. We have developed a fully automated pipeline for transformation of raw Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Mass Spectrometry imaging (MALDI-MSI) data into deep-learning-ready image patches for binary pancreatic tissue classification (tumoral vs non-tumoral) and built individual models for recognition of tumoral regions in spectral images. Images resulting from the proposed pipeline and from reference interactive workflow are very close in terms of image quality metric mean squared error (MSE). The proposed pipeline computational time is of 20 min in average compared to a full working day of the reference interactive workflow. The models achieved 0.94 accuracy on high-resolution spectra and a mean accuracy of 0.59 on lower-resolution spectra.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动 MALDI-MSI 原始数据到深度学习可用图像块的转换流水线，用于胰腺组织肿瘤/非肿瘤二分类。
AI.motivation: MSI 可空间定位分子分布，但缺少端到端、可直接供深度学习使用的预处理流程，现有交互式工作流耗时且依赖人工。
AI.method: 构建自动化 MALDI-MSI 预处理与图像块生成流水线，并与参考交互式流程做图像质量（MSE）对比、统计耗时；在此基础上训练分类模型识别肿瘤区域。
AI.result: 流水线输出与参考流程图像质量接近（MSE 很小）；平均耗时约 20 分钟，而参考流程需约一整天；高分辨率谱模型准确率 0.94，低分辨率谱平均准确率 0.59。
AI.conclusion: 自动化流水线可大幅降低 MSI 深度学习预处理成本，但对低分辨率数据的分类性能仍有限，属医学影像领域的工具型工作。

title: CascadeJEPA: Enhancing 3D Geometric Representations via Spatially Coupled Cascaded Prediction
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for predictive visual representation learning. However, our analysis of I-JEPA reveals a growing discrepancy between semantic and geometric learning: improved semantic recognition during pretraining is accompanied by degraded 3D geometric representations. We hypothesize that this partly stems from predicting highly abstract latent representations with incomplete spatial context, favoring semantic regularities over fine-grained geometric information. To address this issue, we introduce CascadeJEPA, a spatially coupled cascaded prediction framework that promotes richer patch-level interactions through full-grid context encoding and cross-attention between prediction stages, while largely preserving the original I-JEPA architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over I-JEPA across multiple 3D geometric tasks while maintaining strong semantic recognition performance. Furthermore, its advantages extend to future feature forecasting and world model planning, highlighting the potential of enhanced geometric representations to support predictive world modeling.

AI.tldr: CascadeJEPA 指出 I-JEPA 在预训练过程中语义识别提升但 3D 几何表征退化，原因是基于不完整空间上下文预测高度抽象隐表征；为此提出空间耦合级联预测框架，通过全网格上下文编码与阶段间交叉注意力增强 patch 级交互，在保持原架构的前提下显著提升多项 3D 几何任务，并保持语义识别性能。
AI.motivation: I-JEPA 类联合嵌入预测架构在视觉预训练中存在语义与几何学习失衡：语义识别变好而 3D 几何表征变差。作者推测根源在于用不完整的空间上下文去预测高度抽象的隐表征，使模型偏向语义规律而牺牲细粒度几何信息。
AI.method: CascadeJEPA：空间耦合的级联预测框架。采用全网格（full-grid）上下文编码替代稀疏上下文，提供完整空间信息；在多个预测阶段之间引入交叉注意力，实现更丰富的 patch 级交互；整体尽量保留 I-JEPA 原始架构，改动代价低。
AI.result: 在多项 3D 几何任务上相对 I-JEPA 取得显著提升，同时保持较强的语义识别性能；优势还延伸到未来特征预测（future feature forecasting）与世界模型规划（planning）任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过补全空间上下文与级联跨注意力交互，可缓解 JEPA 预训练中语义-几何失衡问题，获得更强的几何表征，并提升其作为预测式世界模型基础的表征质量。

title: Making the World React Realistically: A Closed-Loop Interactive World Model for Autonomous Driving
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures
summary: World models (WMs) generate driving scenarios beyond recorded logs, enabling the training and evaluation of autonomous driving systems in unseen interactions. However, existing WMs struggle to ensure both behavioral realism and visual fidelity, since they overlook the relationship between vehicle interactions and the ego visual observations. We propose a closed-loop interactive WM that couples behavior modeling and visual rendering. First, imitation-learned background-vehicle (BV) policies are fine-tuned with multi-agent reinforcement learning in the closed loop against an end-to-end ego planner that reacts to the rendered images, so that their interaction behaviors match those in real logs. Second, the viewpoints exposed by these interactions guide a per-Gaussian diagnosis of each 3D Gaussian vehicle asset, which attenuates view-dependent colors on under-observed Gaussians and fills never-observed surfaces with generated Gaussians, while preserving the observed appearance. Third, signal lights are rendered according to the driving intentions of the vehicles, by an editor that learns the light states unobserved for a vehicle through counterfactual fine-tuning with a light-state classifier. On long-tail closed-loop scenarios, our method reduces the divergence from real-world interaction behaviors by 85% and improves novel-view vehicle PSNR by 2.0dB over the state-of-the-art WM. The significance of BV light signaling in WMs is shown, as the rendered signal lights conveying BV driving intentions indirectly impact ego driving behaviors in a quarter of the scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环交互式世界模型，将背景车辆行为建模与视觉渲染耦合：用多智能体RL在与端到端自车规划器的闭环中微调行为策略，并据此对各3D高斯车辆资产做视角诊断修补，同时按驾驶意图渲染信号灯。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型忽视车辆交互行为与自车视觉观测之间的关系，难以同时保证行为真实性与视觉保真度，导致生成场景与真实日志的交互分布偏离，无法有效支撑闭环训练与评测。
AI.method: 1) 模仿学习的背景车策略在闭环中与对渲染图像作出反应的端到端自车规划器进行多智能体强化学习微调；2) 由交互暴露的视角驱动对每个3D高斯车辆资产做逐高斯诊断，衰减欠观测高斯的视角相关颜色、用生成高斯补全从未观测表面，并保留已观测外观；3) 用带光态分类器的反事实微调学习车辆未观测到的灯态，按驾驶意图渲染信号灯。
AI.result: 在长尾闭环场景中，与真实交互行为的偏离降低85%，新视角车辆PSNR较SOTA世界模型提升2.0dB；背景车信号灯在四分之一场景中间接影响自车驾驶行为，验证了灯号建模的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 行为建模与视觉渲染的闭环耦合能同时提升交互真实性与视觉保真度；逐高斯视角诊断式修补与意图驱动信号灯渲染是有效手段，背景车信号语义对闭环自车行为具有不可忽略的因果影响。

title: Learning Accurate End-Effector Trajectory Tracking with Inertial Feedback for a Quadruped Manipulator
summary: Accurate end-effector trajectory tracking on quadruped manipulators is challenging because uncertainties in actuators, foot-ground contact, and geometric errors are propagated through the leg-arm kinematic chain. Detecting such errors requires sensing beyond joint encoders that can capture the effects of these uncertainties on the robot's motion, since joint encoders only provide measurements at the actuated joints and cannot fully observe mechanical errors such as backlash, dimensional inaccuracies, or structural deformation. This work addresses these challenges using a reinforcement learning framework with end-effector (EE) inertial feedback, targeting local high-accuracy manipulation while maintaining a nominal body pose and support configuration without intentional body motion or foot repositioning. The learned policy uses EE inertial measurements to compensate for tracking errors induced by uncertainties throughout the leg-arm system that cannot be fully inferred from proprioception alone. Simulation and real-world experiments on continuous EE trajectory tracking show overall improvements relative to nominal and proprioception-only baselines. In real-world experiments, the proposed policy reduces the MoCap-based RMSE by 17.3% and 28.0% relative to the nominal baseline under the two in-distribution (ID) command conditions, respectively, and by an additional 12.6% and 15.9% relative to the proprioception-only baseline. Furthermore, the trajectory-wise RMSE between FK-reconstructed and motion-capture-measured end-effector positions averaged 12.61+-2.15mm (mean+-standard deviation) across 24 controller-trajectory combinations, revealing a substantial discrepancy between nominal kinematic reconstruction and measured end-effector motion.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于末端执行器惯性反馈的强化学习框架，用于四足机械臂在不移动身体/不调整足底的前提下实现局部高精度末端轨迹跟踪，并补偿关节编码器无法观测的机械误差（回差、尺寸误差、结构形变）。
AI.motivation: 足式机械臂的末端轨迹跟踪受执行器不确定性、足-地接触不确定性和几何误差影响，这些误差沿腿-臂运动链传播；关节编码器只能给出驱动关节处的测量，无法完全观测回差、尺寸偏差与结构变形等机械误差，因此需要超出本体感知的外部感知反馈。
AI.method: 以末端执行器处加装的惯性测量单元（IMU）提供的末端惯性反馈作为策略观测，采用强化学习训练跟踪策略；任务设定为保持标称机体位姿与支撑构型（不做有意躯干运动、不重规划落足）下的局部高精度操作。与标称基线（名义运动学）和仅本体感知基线进行对比，仿真与真实机器人实验并行。
AI.result: 在连续末端轨迹跟踪任务上整体优于两类基线。真机实验中，在两种同分布（ID）指令条件下相对标称基线将 MoCap 测得的 RMSE 分别降低 17.3% 与 28.0%，相对仅本体感知基线进一步降低 12.6% 与 15.9%。此外，在 24 组控制器-轨迹组合上，正运动学（FK）重建末端位置与动捕实测末端位置的轨迹级 RMSE 平均为 12.61±2.15 mm，说明名义运动学重建与真实末端运动之间存在显著偏差。
AI.conclusion: 末端惯性反馈能为跨腿-臂链的不可观机械误差提供有效补偿信号，显著提升四足机械臂局部末端跟踪精度；同时量化揭示了仅依赖 FK/编码器进行精度评估的不足，说明需要外部传感闭环。

title: TANGO: Real-World Unregistered RGB-Guided Hyperspectral Super-Resolution with Two-Camera Acquisitions
comment: 18 pages, 11 Figures, 10 tables. Submitted to CVPR 2027
summary: Unregistered hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to recover a high-resolution HSI from a low-resolution hyperspectral observation and an unregistered high-resolution RGB reference. Although recent methods have begun to address the geometric misalignment between the two modalities, their evaluation is still constrained by the lack of a large-scale public benchmark based on real two-camera RGB--HSI acquisitions with a high-resolution HSI reference. To address this gap, we introduce DUET, the first large-scale public dataset for unregistered RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution, comprising 403 indoor and outdoor scenes captured with two separate RGB and hyperspectral cameras. We further propose TANGO (Two-camera AligNment with Gated Occlusions), which first compensates for the dominant cross-camera displacement through end-to-end global alignment and then refines the remaining inconsistencies with a coarse-to-fine local feature alignment. A learned gating mechanism further attenuates the RGB guidance where the two views cannot be consistently matched. Experimental results show that TANGO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both DUET and REAL across all evaluated scale factors, outperforming the strongest competitor on DUET by up to 2.29 dB in PSNR while requiring 2.5$\times$ fewer FLOPs. The code and dataset will be available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出首个大规模公开的未配准RGB引导高光谱超分数据集DUET（403个室内外双相机场景，带高分辨率HSI真值），并给出TANGO方法：全局对齐补偿主位移＋由粗到细局部特征对齐＋门控机制抑制不一致区域RGB引导，在DUET与REAL上全尺度达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有未配准RGB-HSI超分方法虽开始处理跨模态几何失配，但评测受限于缺乏基于真实双相机采集、且具有高分辨率HSI参考的大规模公开基准。
AI.method: 1）构建DUET数据集，用独立RGB与高光谱相机采集403个室内外场景；2）TANGO框架：端到端全局对齐补偿主导的跨相机位移，再由粗到细的局部特征对齐细化残余不一致；3）学习式门控机制在两视图无法一致匹配处衰减RGB引导强度。
AI.result: 在DUET与REAL数据集上所有评估放大倍数均取得SOTA；在DUET上PSNR最高超出最强对手2.29 dB，同时FLOPs降低2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 真实双相机数据与显式全局-局部对齐加门控的组合能有效提升未配准RGB引导HSI超分性能与效率，DUET为该任务提供可复现的公开评测平台。

title: Social Signal Bench: Evidence-Weighted Evaluation of Co-occurring Social Signals in Video and Audio
comment: 25 pages, including appendix
summary: Recognizing social signals such as interest and hesitation requires interpreting context-dependent behaviors that may co-occur in conversation. Existing affective computing benchmarks rarely evaluate such co-occurring signals, and conventional multi-label F1 overlooks semantic relationships and annotator disagreement. We introduce Social Signal Bench, a 47-hour densely annotated benchmark for the evaluation of social signal recognition and engagement, comprising two datasets: Social Signal Bench Video (25 hours), covering ten social signals in audiovisual recordings, and Social Signal Bench Audio (22 hours), covering six signals in audio-only recordings. Each dataset pairs a public training set of online conversational video, of which 10 hours are expert-annotated and the remainder pseudo-labeled, with a private expert-labeled test set spanning four conversational domains. We also propose Evidence-Weighted F1 (EW-F1), which weights reference labels by annotator evidence and assigns graded credit to semantically related predictions through optimal per-clip matching. Controlled perturbations demonstrate that EW-F1 distinguishes semantically related errors from unrelated ones, unlike conventional F1. Under a shared evaluation protocol, 7B open models post-trained on Social Signal Bench outperform general-purpose frontier models on video and match them on audio.

AI.tldr: 提出Social Signal Bench：47小时（视频25h/音频22h）密集标注的社交信号识别与参与度评测基准，并提出按标注者证据加权、对语义相关预测给予分级得分的Evidence-Weighted F1（EW-F1）。
AI.motivation: 兴趣、犹豫等社交信号在对话中共现且依赖上下文，现有情感计算基准很少评测共现信号；传统多标签F1忽略标签语义关系与标注者分歧。
AI.method: 构建两个数据集：视频集（10类信号，25h）与音频集（6类信号，22h）；公开训练集由在线对话视频组成（10h专家标注+其余伪标注），私有测试集为四类对话领域专家标注。EW-F1以标注者证据加权参考标签，并通过逐片段最优匹配对语义相关预测给予分级分数。
AI.result: 受控扰动实验显示EW-F1能区分语义相关错误与无关错误，而常规F1不能；在统一协议下，基于该基准后训练的7B开源模型在视频上优于通用前沿模型，音频上持平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为共现社交信号与参与度提供了密集标注基准与更贴合语义的评价指标，并表明小规模开源模型经领域后训练可具竞争力。

title: Know When to Zoom: How Small Is Too Small for Vision-Language Models?
comment: Accepted to the SENSE workshop at WACV 2027. 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Code, data and a plain-language walkthrough: this https URL
summary: Online vision-language models often miss small details in large images, because the service shrinks the image, or rejects it, before the model ever sees it. A car 20 pixels wide in an 8000 by 6000 drone photo reaches Claude about 6 pixels wide, and OpenAI's default rejects the photo outright. We measure how much detail survives for seven models from four vendors, using an eye exam of printed codes and 601 questions about small objects in real photos. The smallest text a model reads half the time grows from 6 pixels or less on a small image to a predicted 10 to 13 pixels on a 7680 by 4320 photo at default settings. Zooming wins much of the detail back. Splitting each photo into up to nine tiles raises accuracy by 11.1 to 14.5 percentage points for Claude and Gemini, and by avoiding rejections it lifts GPT-6.1 Sol from 50.7% to 83.7%. A two-step zoom, in which the model first names the region it needs, matches or beats tiles on Gemini and comes within 2.5 points of them on Claude, with about 40% of their image tokens. When a detail is lost, Claude and Gemini both say they cannot tell about half the time, but they fail differently in the rest: Gemini gives a confident wrong answer in 43% to 48% of these cases, Claude in only 5% to 9%. A check based on detail size, run before the call, misses most of the gain from tiles on Claude and Gemini, but Claude's own reply is a reliable trigger: tiling only after an unsure reply comes within 1.4 points of always tiling with 62% to 70% of the image tokens. We turn these findings into five rules for when an agent should zoom, and release the eye exam, every model answer and code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 论文系统测量了在线视觉语言模型（Claude、Gemini、GPT 等 7 个模型）在大分辨率图像上的细节丢失程度，并提出分块（tiling）与两步缩放（two-step zoom）策略恢复细节，同时给出利用模型"不确定"回复作为触发条件的自适应放大规则。
AI.motivation: 在线 VLM 服务会在模型看到图像前对图像做缩放或直接拒收，导致大图（如 8000×6000 无人机照片）中小目标（约 20 像素的车辆）细节严重丢失。作者希望定量刻画细节保留程度，并寻找可操作的补救办法。
AI.method: 1）构造"视力检查表"：印刷码识别 + 601 个真实照片小目标问答，测量半正确阈值像素尺寸；2）对比默认缩放、最多 9 块分块、模型自选区域的两步缩放三种策略的准确率与 token 消耗；3）分析丢失细节时 Claude 与 Gemini 的"承认不确定"与"自信错误"比例；4）测试调用前的细节尺寸检查 vs. 基于模型不确定回复的 tiling 触发条件。
AI.result: 半正确阈值随图像变大从 ≤6 像素升至默认设置下 7680×4320 图的 10–13 像素；分块使 Claude/Gemini 准确率提升 11.1–14.5 个百分点，GPT-6.1 Sol 从 50.7% 升至 83.7%（主要靠避免拒答）；两步缩放以约 40% 图像 token 达到或接近分块效果；丢失细节时 Gemini 43–48% 给出自信错误答案，Claude 仅 5–9%；仅靠细节尺寸预检作为触发条件收益有限，而"回答不确定后再分块"可接近全量分块（差距 ≤1.4 点），token 用量仅为 62–70%。
AI.conclusion: 总结出 agent 何时应放大的五条规则，并开源视力检查基准、全部模型回答与代码。核心结论：分块是恢复细节的有效手段，但更高效的做法是用模型自身的不确定性作为放大触发信号；不同厂商模型在细节缺失下的失败模式（自信幻觉 vs. 拒答）差异显著。

title: Body Schema Policy: Body as the Vision-Action Interface for Efficient Robot Loco-Manipulation
summary: Currently, robots can learn whole-body loco-manipulation through scale: the strongest policies have billions of parameters and still need task-specific fine-tuning. Humans have limited processing capacity, yet learn and act efficiently through a body schema that organizes what they see and how they move. We introduce Body Schema Policy (BSP), an imitation learning policy that builds such a schema into the vision-action interface. Its latent body schema places joint and link tokens on the robot's kinematic tree, where learned screw motions carry features between links. Through body-queried vision, each body part retrieves its own visual evidence, which conditions the denoising of its actions. With this inductive bias, BSP returns an action chunk faster than any policy we compare. Compact, body-specific visual readouts also emerge without spatial supervision: manipulation commands depend strongly on task objects, while locomotion commands respond more broadly to the scene. On nine simulated Unitree G1 whole-body tasks, BSP matches the $\Psi_0$ humanoid foundation model with $75\times$ fewer parameters and nearly doubles Diffusion Policy's success. The same holds on a real G1 and a Fetch mobile manipulator.

AI.tldr: 提出 Body Schema Policy (BSP)，将"身体图式"作为归纳偏置嵌入视觉-动作接口：在运动学树上布置关节/连杆 token，用螺旋运动传递特征，并通过 body-queried vision 让每个身体部位检索自身视觉证据以条件化动作去噪。仅用 Ψ₀ 参数的 1/75 便在 9 项 G1 全身任务上持平，成功率近两倍于 Diffusion Policy，并在真机 G1 与 Fetch 上复现。
AI.motivation: 现有全身 loco-manipulation 策略依赖规模扩展（数十亿参数、任务特定微调），效率低下；人类感知计算资源有限，却依靠身体图式（body schema）高效组织视觉与运动。作者希望把这种结构化躯体先验注入策略网络，替代"堆参数"路线。
AI.method: 模仿学习策略 BSP：隐式 body schema 把 joint/link token 显式锚定在机器人运动学树上，token 间特征传递由可学习的螺旋运动（screw motion）参数化；body-queried vision 中每个身体部位从视觉特征中检索自身相关的视觉证据，用于条件化其动作 chunk 的去噪生成；无需空间监督即涌现出部位特异、任务分化的紧凑视觉读出（操作依赖物体，移动依赖全景）。
AI.result: 在 9 个 Unitree G1 仿真全身任务上，参数量比 Ψ₀ 人形基础模型少 75× 而性能持平，成功率约为 Diffusion Policy 的 2 倍；推理生成动作 chunk 快于所有对比策略；真机 G1 与 Fetch 移动操作平台结果一致；可视化显示无需空间监督即形成部位特异的视觉读出。
AI.conclusion: 结构化躯体归纳偏置（运动学树 + 螺旋运动 + 部位查询视觉）可显著替代参数规模，实现高效、可泛化的全身 loco-manipulation，并为轻量化人形基础策略提供可行路径。

title: PCRG: Training-Free Pruning and Caching of Reference Tokens for Video Generation
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures
summary: Reference-to-video diffusion transformers pack the variational autoencoder (VAE) latents of all references and the generated tokens into one full-attention sequence, in which reference tokens make up about half. Because attention cost grows quadratically with sequence length, these tokens take up an even larger share of the attention computation, yet most of them are static, smooth or irrelevant to the output. To accelerate reference-conditioned generation, we propose pruning and caching of reference tokens for video generation (PCRG), a training-free, plug-and-play method that uses two signals the model already computes to assign each reference token to one of three tiers, namely pruned, cached or kept. The first is a low-level redundancy r from VAE latents, since a token whose latent barely changes over time or across its neighbors adds little new content. The second is a high-level importance g from the vision-language-model (VLM) conditioner, where the attention that the prompt and any first or last frames pay to a token tells whether the output needs to read it. Tokens that are not redundant are kept, and redundant tokens are cached if important and pruned otherwise. Pruned tokens leave the sequence before the first step with all rotary position embedding positions unchanged. Cached tokens have their keys and values computed once and reused, and kept tokens are processed as usual. On MiniMax-H3, already distilled to 8 timesteps and quantized to int8, PCRG is 1.57x faster end to end on our V2V-Bench and 1.49x faster on the public VACE-Benchmark, while the quality of VBench drops by only 0.24% and 0.17%, respectively. PCRG shortens the sequence rather than changing how attention is computed or which steps are run, so it also stacks on step caching and sparse attention. On V2V-Bench it reaches 1.86x with TeaCache, 1.82x with Spark at nearly unchanged fidelity and 2.15x with Veda.

AI.tldr: PCRG：面向参考图/视频条件的视频扩散Transformer，利用VAE低层冗余度r与VLM条件器的高层重要性g将参考token分为剪枝/缓存/保留三层，在首个去噪步前移除剪枝token（保持RoPE位置不变），缓存token仅计算一次K/V，实现无需训练、即插即用的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 参考到视频扩散Transformer将参考与生成token打包进全注意力序列，参考token约占一半且多为静态、平滑或与输出无关，但因注意力开销随序列长度二次增长而占用更大比例算力，亟需加速。
AI.method: 训练无关、即插即用：双信号分层。低层冗余度r来自VAE latent 的时间/近邻变化幅度；高层重要性g来自VLM conditioner中prompt及首尾帧对token的注意力。非冗余token保留；冗余但重要者缓存K/V复用；冗余且不重要者剪枝并从序列中移除，RoPE位置保持不变。因只缩短序列而不改变注意力计算方式与步数，可与step caching、稀疏注意力叠加。
AI.result: MiniMax-H3（已蒸馏至8步、int8量化）上端到端加速1.57x（V2V-Bench）与1.49x（VACE-Benchmark），VBench质量仅下降0.24%/0.17%；与TeaCache组合达1.86x，与Spark达1.82x，与Veda达2.15x，保真度基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型既有信号的参考token三层剪枝/缓存可显著降低参考条件视频生成的注意力开销，且与现有步缓存与稀疏注意力正交可叠加，为V2V/VACE类流水线提供低成本加速方案。

title: Practice in Text, Act in Pixels: Correcting Where Perception Fails
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 19 tables. Code: this https URL ; aligned reader: this https URL
summary: GUI agents can learn cheaply from a text view of an interface and act on screenshots through a vision-language screen reader. Yet on a simulated mobile platform with a low-cost reader, policies that complete most tasks in text fail on many of the same tasks on screenshots. We ask where a small budget of real screenshots is best spent to close this gap. We find that the reader's misreads are systematic and recur on the same interface elements. Noise matched to the reader's error rates, a natural sim-to-real remedy, misses this structure, and in a pre-specified comparison it did not beat training the policy directly on screenshots. We therefore correct the misreads at their source with reader alignment, which fine-tunes the reader on screenshots paired with their text views. The reader learns to output each screen's text view, as in text practice, and the policy stays unchanged. Spent on the reader, the screenshot budget gives 80.9% full-task success on new task instances, against 55.6% when spent on training the policy. Given the same labeled screenshots, adapting the reader also beats adapting the policy, and a single aligned reader improves every text-trained policy we tried without retraining any of them.

AI.tldr: 提出 reader alignment 方法：用少量真实截图微调 GUI 视觉屏幕阅读器，使其输出与文本视图一致的文本，从而在源头上纠正系统性误读；文本训练的策略无需改动即可在截图环境大幅提升成功率。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体可从界面文本视图中廉价学习，但低成本视觉阅读器在模拟移动平台上会系统性误读截图，导致同一任务在截图上失败。若按常规 sim-to-real 思路用噪声匹配错误率，忽略了误读的结构性，效果不及直接用截图训练策略。作者追问有限真实截图预算应投在哪里。
AI.method: 先分析阅读器误读的规律：错误是系统性的、在相同界面元素上反复出现。预注册对比显示噪声匹配未优于直接用截图训练策略。据此提出 reader alignment：用截图-文本视图配对数据微调阅读器，使其在每个屏幕上输出对应文本视图，策略端保持不变；并对比"同量标注截图用于适配阅读器 vs 适配策略"。
AI.result: 截图预算用于阅读器时，新任务实例上全任务成功率 80.9%，用于训练策略仅 55.6%；在相同标注截图下，适配阅读器优于适配策略；单个对齐后的阅读器无需重训练即可提升所有测试过的文本训练策略。
AI.conclusion: sim-to-real 差距的根源在感知接口而非策略本身；把稀缺真实截图预算投入感官（阅读器）对齐，比投入策略训练或噪声匹配更高效，且具有跨策略的可迁移性。

title: ConserveEdit: Source-Anchored Transactions for Drift-Bounded Iterative Image Editing
comment: 28 pages, 15 figures, 16 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Instruction-driven image editors produce convincing local edits in one pass, but inside an iterative refinement loop every accepted output becomes the next input, so unintended changes outside the requested region accumulate. We present ConserveEdit, an editor-agnostic controller that treats each refinement step as a transaction against a contract compiled once from the source image. The contract separates what may change (the authorized region of each target, with a bounded halo for shadows and reflections) from what must survive (protected content with explicit tolerances). Candidates from a frozen editor are composed through a source-anchored mask and committed only if target progress, drift on protected content, and image quality pass as separate tests; otherwise the step is rolled back and repaired. For any editor, this keeps every pixel outside the authorized region bit-exact and bounds drift independently of the number of iterations, whereas no fixed scalar trade-off reproduces the separate tests. On all 1053 MagicBrush test edits with a frozen Qwen-Image-Edit, masking is necessary but not sufficient. A direct call already alters the rest of the image (12.1 dB PSNR outside the mask); composed through the source-anchored mask, it stays bit-exact there and its DINO similarity to the ground truth rises from 0.67 to 0.85, matching ConserveEdit, so this gain comes from the mask. Next to automatic masks, however, masked direct editing changes a protected face or text on 48% of turns, and masked scalar selection avoids this mostly by abstaining (23% constrained success). Because its drift test names the violated entity, ConserveEdit shrinks the support instead (2% violations, 53% constrained success); in a simulator with known ground truth it raises constrained success from 55.0% to 61.8%. Automatic grounding remains the main bottleneck. Code and logs will be released.

AI.tldr: ConserveEdit 提出编辑器无关的迭代图像编辑控制器：将每次细化视为对"源图编译的契约"的事务提交，通过源锚定掩码与三重独立检验（目标进度/受保护内容漂移/图像质量）保证授权区外逐像素 bit-exact，漂移与迭代次数无关。
AI.motivation: 指令驱动图像编辑器单次编辑局部可控，但在迭代细化循环中每次接受的输出成为下一输入，授权区域外的非预期改动会累积漂移；且固定的标量权衡无法同时满足"该改的改、不该改的不改"。
AI.method: 1) 对源图一次性编译"契约"：授权可改区域（含阴影/反射的有界 halo）与须保护的受容忍度约束内容；2) 冻结编辑器产生候选经源锚定掩码合成；3) 以三个独立测试判定提交（目标进度、受保护内容漂移、图像质量），失败则回滚并修复；4) 漂移测试能指出被违反的实体，从而收缩支持域而非弃答。
AI.result: 在 1053 条 MagicBrush 测试编辑 + 冻结 Qwen-Image-Edit 上：掩码是必要非充分条件；直接调用掩码外 PSNR 仅 12.1 dB，经源锚定掩码后掩码外 bit-exact，与真值 DINO 相似度由 0.67 升至 0.85；掩码直接编辑有 48% 回合破坏人脸/文字，掩码标量选择靠 23% 弃答回避；ConserveEdit 将违例降至 2%、受限成功率 53%；已知真值模拟器中受限成功率 55.0%→61.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该契约式事务控制器可保证授权区外像素完全不变并使漂移上界与迭代次数无关，验证独立多测试优于固定标量权衡；自动 grounding（定位）仍是主要瓶颈，代码与日志将开源。

title: SlopeGuard: Towards Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection via Radial Spectral Slope Guidance
summary: AI-generated image detectors often overfit to generator-specific artifacts, hindering generalization to unseen synthesis pipelines. Existing frequency-based methods usually learn high-dimensional spectral patterns that may preserve generator-dependent variations. We explore Radial Spectral Slope, a compact descriptor of global spectral decay that captures transferable spectral trends while suppressing fine-grained variations. Our analysis shows that real and generated images exhibit systematic but generator-dependent slope differences, indicating that slope provides useful forensic evidence but is insufficient as a standalone decision criterion. This motivates combining spectral slope with semantic representations for more robust detection. Based on this insight, we propose SlopeGuard, which couples slope-aware data processing with slope guided feature learning to construct informative patch-based views, integrate Radial Spectral Slope with semantic features, and adapt prior preservation according to spectral atypicality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SlopeGuard achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracies of 97.5% on AIGCDetectBench, 97.8% on GenImage, and 85.1% on AIGIBench, while maintaining competitive performance under blur, cropping, JPEG compression, and additive noise.

AI.tldr: 提出SlopeGuard：将径向频谱斜率（Radial Spectral Slope）这一紧凑的全局频谱衰减描述子与语义特征结合，用于AI生成图像检测，提升对未见生成器的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器易过拟合到特定生成器的伪影，频率域方法学习的高维频谱模式仍保留生成器相关变化，跨合成管线的泛化能力差。作者希望找到一种能捕获可迁移频谱趋势、抑制细粒度变化的紧凑描述子。
AI.method: 先分析径向频谱斜率：真实与生成图像存在系统性但依赖生成器的斜率差异，说明其可作为取证证据但不足以单独决策。据此提出SlopeGuard，包含斜率感知的数据处理与斜率引导的特征学习，构造信息量高的patch视图，融合径向频谱斜率与语义特征，并按频谱非典型性自适应调整先验保持强度。
AI.result: 在AIGCDetectBench上平均准确率97.5%，GenImage 97.8%，AIGIBench 85.1%，达到SOTA；在模糊、裁剪、JPEG压缩和加性噪声下保持有竞争力性能。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的全局频谱描述子（斜率）与语义表征互补，可显著提升生成图像检测的跨生成器泛化与鲁棒性，为频率域取证提供了轻量化、可解释的新视角。

title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 10 figures
summary: Looped vision-language models (VLMs) deepen computation by reusing shared layers, approaching larger models' capabilities with fewer parameters and easing the storage and deployment burden of stacking independent layers. However, repeatedly processing long visual sequences still incurs substantial compute and GPU memory costs. Visual token compression reduces these costs by shortening sequences. Existing methods mainly select original tokens directly or combine selection with aggregation. In looped models, the former may overlook changing token importance across calls and discard information needed later; the latter lack joint consideration of output changes across calls, limiting information preservation. We propose LoopZip, a training-free visual token compression algorithm addressing both issues. Visual aggregation builds a compact candidate pool before the looped backbone, and cross-invocation selection averages instruction attention from the first two existing calls of the same shared attention layer to retain tokens needed by both states. Weight-tied value correction then jointly fits shared visual-value adjustments to both pre-selection layer outputs, reducing output deviations across states. To validate LoopZip's effectiveness, we conduct extensive experiments covering two open-source looped VLMs, eleven benchmarks, and three pruning ratios. On LoopVL-1B, LoopZip retains 97.16% of the original model's performance at 50% pruning ratio and exceeds the strongest baseline by 5.36% at 87.5% pruning ratio.
