Across Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang, LoopVL-1B with LoopZip reduces peak allocated GPU memory by 58.36%-58.98% and achieves 2.01-2.47x end-to-end speedups over the original model.

AI.tldr: LoopZip：针对循环式 VLM（共享层复用）的免训练视觉 token 压缩方法，通过循环骨干前的视觉聚合构建紧凑候选池、跨调用指令注意力平均选择、以及权重共享的 value 校正，兼顾不同循环状态下的 token 重要性变化与输出漂移。
AI.motivation: 循环 VLM 通过复用共享层降低参数与部署成本，但重复处理长视觉序列仍带来大量计算与显存开销。现有视觉 token 压缩方法（直接选择原始 token 或选择+聚合）未考虑循环多次调用间 token 重要性的动态变化，也缺乏对多次调用输出变化的联合约束，导致信息丢失。
AI.method: 免训练视觉 token 压缩算法：(1) Visual aggregation 在循环骨干之前构建紧凑候选池；(2) Cross-invocation selection 对同一共享注意力层前两次调用得到的指令注意力取平均，以保留两种状态都需要的 token；(3) Weight-tied value correction 联合拟合共享视觉 value 调整量，对选择前层的两个状态输出同时校正，减小跨状态输出偏差。
AI.result: 覆盖 2 个开源循环 VLM、11 个基准、3 种剪枝率。LoopVL-1B 在 50% 剪枝率下保留原模型 97.16% 性能；87.5% 剪枝率下超出最强基线 5.36%。在 Hugging Face Transformers、vLLM、SGLang 上峰值显存降低 58.36%–58.98%，端到端加速 2.01–2.47 倍。
AI.conclusion: LoopZip 表明在循环式 VLM 中显式建模跨调用状态变化对 token 压缩至关重要，可在高剪枝率下保持精度，并带来显著的显存与推理效率收益，具备实际部署价值。

title: Evolve in Panorama, Render in View: Panoramic World State Evolution for Video World Models
summary: Video world models should maintain a world that keeps evolving as the viewpoint changes. Yet when the camera turns away and returns, current models often freeze the unobserved scene, lose objects, or change their appearance, because content outside the view has no representation that keeps changing. We present PanoEvo, which uses a Panoramic Evolver to evolve the world state in the latent space of a panoramic video diffusion model, where every viewing direction is present at every time step, so the scene evolves whether or not it is observed. Existing panoramic video models are not trained to evolve a scene from a single image or the objects within it, so we build PanoEvo-Data, an event-centric dataset from real 360° videos, and train the Panoramic Evolver coarse-to-fine as an image-to-panoramic-video model. Since each view covers only a small part of the low-resolution panorama, directly projected views are blurry and often show low-quality details or structural errors. A Perspective Renderer, built on a perspective video diffusion model, reads this state via latent-space projection and direction-restricted cross-attention to render sharp, high-quality views. PanoEvo achieves the best overall score among 23 publicly evaluated models on WRBench and the highest total score on STEVO-Bench. Code, models, and data will be released.

AI.tldr: PanoEvo 用全景视频扩散模型的潜空间作为持续演化的世界状态（Panoramic Evolver），并配以基于透视视频扩散模型的 Perspective Renderer，通过潜空间投影与方向受限交叉注意力渲染高清视角，解决相机移开后场景被"冻结"的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前视频世界模型在视角离开后会把未观测区域冻结、物体丢失或外观漂移，原因是视野外内容缺乏持续演化的表示。
AI.method: 1) 以 360° 全景视频扩散模型的潜空间作为世界状态，每个时间步都包含所有观察方向，从而实现"是否被观测都在演化"；2) 构建 PanoEvo-Data 事件中心的真实 360° 视频数据集，并粗到细训练 Panoramic Evolver 为单图到全景视频模型；3) 透视渲染器基于透视视频扩散模型，通过潜空间投影 + 方向受限 cross-attention 从低分辨率全景状态中提取清晰视角。
AI.result: 在 WRBench 上取得 23 个公开评测模型中的最佳综合分数，在 STEVO-Bench 上取得最高总分。
AI.conclusion: 全景潜空间作为持久世界表示可有效支持视角往返一致的长时场景演化，配合潜空间投影的透视渲染可弥补分辨率损失，代码/模型/数据将开源。

title: RefCloth: Transferable Adversarial Tablecloths for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Closed-loop vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely continuously on multi-view cameras, yet existing visual attacks typically hijack sensor streams with 2D patches or alter target object meshes that require retraining when manipulation objects change. We introduce RefCloth, a framework that optimizes one persistent adversarial tablecloth on a frozen source policy and deploys it zero-shot across unseen tasks and target models without modifying task objects or cameras. Throughout manipulation, static third-person and moving wrist views observe this shared world-bound texture under evolving occlusions. To generalize across shifting surface views while bridging the gap between differentiable and native renderers, RefCloth combines bounded texture parameterization with shared surface UV transformations and a same-path clean reference that removes static rendering offsets at initialization. Across four LIBERO suites in native simulation, one frozen texture transfers from OpenVLA-OFT to $\pi_0$ and $\pi_{0.5}$, reducing success relative to an unoptimized cloth by 62.50 and 43.75 percentage points on average and far exceeding amplitude- and variation-matched random controls. Dual-view audits and target closed-loop camera interventions show that moving wrist exposure drives over twice the standalone drop of the main view with strong synergy, while ablations confirm the roles of UV diversification and path calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出RefCloth：在冻结的VLA策略上优化一块持久的世界绑定对抗桌布纹理，无需改动任务物体或相机即可零样本迁移到未见任务与目标模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA视觉攻击依赖2D贴片劫持传感器流或修改目标物体网格，当操作物体变化时需重新训练，缺乏可跨任务、跨模型复用的物理可实现攻击载体。
AI.method: 优化单一持续存在的桌面布料纹理；结合有界纹理参数化、共享表面UV变换以覆盖静态第三人称与运动腕部视角的遮挡变化；引入同路径干净参考消除初始化时的渲染静态偏移以弥合可微与原生渲染器差异；并在冻结源策略上训练以保持零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在原生仿真LIBERO四个套件上，单一冻结纹理从OpenVLA-OFT迁移至π0与π0.5，相较未优化桌布平均成功率分别下降62.50与43.75个百分点，显著超过幅度与变化匹配的随机对照组；双视角审计与闭环相机干预显示腕部视角移动曝光造成的单独性能下降是主视角的两倍以上且协同效应强；消融验证UV多样化与路径校准的作用。
AI.conclusion: 世界绑定的持久纹理可作为可迁移、免重训的VLA对抗载体，多视角（尤其运动腕部视角）暴露是攻击关键因素，为VLA鲁棒性评测提供新范式。

title: GaussianMamba: Geometric and Relational State Space Scanning of 3D Gaussian Primitives
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction requires representing complex spatial structures and modeling contextual relationships across a scene. 3D Gaussian primitives provide a sparse and adaptive representation of scene geometry and semantics, while Mamba offers efficient sequence modeling for capturing dependencies among primitives. However, Gaussian primitives are irregular and unordered, making sequence construction challenging, as conventional spatial ordering may overlook their anisotropic geometry and feature-semantic relationships. In this paper, we present GaussianMamba, a dual-branch Mamba framework that explicitly incorporates Gaussian-specific geometric and feature-semantic relationships into complementary scanning strategies. The first branch refines a locality-preserving traversal using anisotropic Gaussian support derived from primitive scale and orientation. The second branch reorders spatially organized groups according to feature-semantic affinity and adjusts local features using geometry-weighted semantic differences. The resulting sequences are processed by separate Mamba modules, and their features are fused through a support-aware mechanism that incorporates local feature discrepancies arising from the distinct scanning paths. Experiments on nuScenes-SurroundOcc and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate consistent improvements over GaussianFormer and GaussianFormer-2 in both IoU and mIoU.

AI.tldr: GaussianMamba：双分支Mamba框架，用各向异性高斯支撑构建保局部扫描序列、用特征-语义亲和重排序，并用支撑感知融合，提升3D语义占据预测。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯原语是稀疏自适应的场景几何/语义表示，Mamba适合高效序列建模，但高斯原语不规则且无序，常规空间排序难以兼顾各向异性几何与特征-语义关系，序列构建成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 双分支Mamba：分支一基于原语尺度与朝向推导的各向异性高斯支撑，构造保局部的遍历顺序；分支二按特征-语义亲和度重排空间分组，并用几何加权的语义差分调整局部特征；两条序列分别送入独立Mamba模块，再以支撑感知机制（融合不同扫描路径带来的局部特征差异）进行特征融合。
AI.result: 在nuScenes-SurroundOcc与SSCBench-KITTI-360上，IoU和mIoU均稳定优于GaussianFormer与GaussianFormer-2。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 将高斯几何各向异性与特征-语义关系显式编码进扫描顺序，是提升高斯占据预测序列建模有效性的可行方向；属感知层面增量改进，泛化性与效率证据尚不充分。

title: Stochastic Diversity Windows: Diagnosing Noise Influence in Robotic Diffusion Sampling
comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly adopted in robotics and control due to their capability to express multiple feasible solutions to a given task. However, the role of stochasticity in the diffusion model-sampler across denoising remains poorly understood. We introduce a per-timestep counterfactual diagnostic that tests how changing the sampled noise affects the final output. Across five model-sampler configurations spanning three robotics benchmarks, diverse architectures, domains, and conditioning mechanisms, we reveal highly varied temporal sensitivity profiles, where noise-induced deviations can amplify, partially contract, or undergo near-total attenuation downstream. From these profiles, we define stochastic diversity windows (SDWs): compact intervals that identify where sampler stochasticity has the strongest measured influence on the final output. Guided by these windows, we apply two heuristic interventions: targeted stochastic amplification, which increases sample diversity exploration of the solution space, and an SDW-hybrid sampler, which replaces DDPM steps with DDIM skips in low-impact regions, resulting in network evaluation reductions of up to 40-60% and wall-clock time by up to 85%, with no consistent changes detected in feasibility, cost, or diversity across held-out tasks.

AI.tldr: 通过逐时间步的反事实诊断刻画扩散采样器随机性在去噪过程中的敏感度分布，定义"随机多样性窗口"(SDW)，并据此做定向随机放大与SDW混合采样器以加速推理。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在机器人与控制中可表达多解，但采样器随机性在各去噪步中的作用机制不清楚，缺乏对"何时注入噪声才真正影响最终输出"的定量理解。
AI.method: per-timestep counterfactual 诊断：改变某一步的采样噪声，测量其导致的最终输出偏差；在 5 种模型-采样器组合、3 个机器人基准上绘制时间敏感度曲线，提取 SDW；据此施加两种启发式干预：窗口内随机放大以提升多样性探索，以及在低影响区间用 DDIM 跳步替换 DDPM 步的混合采样器。
AI.result: 发现高度异质的时间敏感度剖面（噪声扰动可被放大、部分收缩或近乎完全衰减）；SDW 混合采样器将网络评估次数降低 40–60%、墙钟时间最多降低 85%，且在留出任务上可行性、成本与多样性未检测到一致性变化。
AI.conclusion: 采样随机性对最终输出的影响高度非均匀且可被定位，逐步反事实诊断可作为采样器设计与加速的诊断工具；但干预为启发式，效果以计算效率为主，缺乏真实机器人部署验证。

title: Teaching What to Look For: Privileged Perception Questions for Agentic On-Policy Distillation in Video Captioning
summary: Detailed video captioning requires comprehensive and faithful descriptions of objects, actions, and temporal events. Fixed-frame sampling, however, can miss brief motions, small objects, and other fine-grained evidence, motivating captioning agents that actively seek relevant moments and inspect local regions. Training such behavior is challenging because, unlike video question answering, generic captioning instructions do not specify what visual evidence should be acquired. We propose Perception-Question On-Policy Distillation (PQ-OPD), which uses training-only Perception Questions (PQs) to guide active video perception. PQs specify what should be inspected without revealing the corresponding answers, encouraging the teacher to explore the video more comprehensively and focus on relevant visual evidence. Along trajectories generated by the student, on-policy distillation transfers this guidance to the student's reasoning, tool calls, and captions; no PQs are required at inference. Across three detailed-captioning and two caption-to-QA benchmarks, PQ-OPD consistently improves the corresponding untrained agents across teacher-student scales and input-frame budgets. Under our evaluation protocol, PQ-OPD achieves the strongest primary-metric results among the compared open-source models on DREAM-1K, CaReBench, ShortVidBench, MotionBench, and VidCapBench-AE. Our ablations, together with analysis of temporal coverage and answer leakage, further indicates that the student internalizes the training-time guidance as a more effective video exploration policy.

AI.tldr: PQ-OPD 用“仅训练时可用”的感知问题（Perception Questions）引导教师模型在视频中主动定位关键片段与局部区域，再通过学生自生成轨迹上的 on-policy 蒸馏，把这种主动感知策略内化进学生的推理、工具调用与字幕生成中，推理阶段无需 PQs。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视频字幕需要忠实描述对象、动作与时间事件，但固定帧采样容易漏掉短暂动作、小目标等细粒度证据。理想方案是让字幕智能体主动寻找相关时刻并检查局部区域；然而与视频问答不同，通用字幕指令不指明应获取哪些视觉证据，导致这类主动行为难以训练。
AI.method: 提出 PQ-OPD：(1) 构造训练专用 Perception Questions，仅指明“应检查什么”而不泄露答案，从而引导教师模型更全面地探索视频并聚焦相关视觉证据；(2) 在学生的 on-policy 轨迹上做蒸馏，将教师的探索指导迁移到学生的推理链、工具调用与最终字幕；(3) 推理时不使用 PQs，学生以自主动机完成勘探。
AI.result: 在 3 个细粒度字幕与 2 个 caption-to-QA 基准上，PQ-OPD 在多种师生规模与输入帧预算下均稳定优于未训练的对应智能体；按其评测协议，在 DREAM-1K、CaReBench、ShortVidBench、MotionBench、VidCapBench-AE 上取得对比开源模型中最优的主指标结果。消融及时间覆盖率、答案泄露分析显示学生确实将训练期指导内化为更有效的视频探索策略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明“隐式证据指路 + on-policy 蒸馏”可在无推理期额外监督的情况下习得主动视频感知策略，为视频理解智能体的工具化探索训练提供了可迁移范式；局限在于聚焦视频字幕域，未涉及 3D/机器人场景与实机验证。

title: Network-Exposed Configuration Attacks on LLM-Controlled Social Robots
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in embodied robots create security dependencies beyond inference. We investigate a network-exposed configuration attack on the Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini Lite, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to replace personality settings and the cloud LLM's system prompt through a management interface, without adversarial conversational input. Eleven prompt-injection attempts across five categories were reported as resisted, whereas both configuration-layer attack paths produced observable behavioural changes on physical hardware. We demonstrate local and network-adjacent access, mapping the weakness to CWE-306 (Missing Authentication for a Critical Function) and CWE-1327 (Binding to an Unrestricted IP Address), with a reported CVSS v3.1 score of 6.5 (Medium). A configuration endpoint also accepts cross-origin requests without a CORS preflight (CWE-352; 6.5 Medium), while the persistent-memory sink stores content without enforcing its stated restrictions. A source review of 59 public repositories identifies missing authentication in 10 of 11 source-verifiable genuine applications, or 11 of 11 including a framework-default case. These findings indicate recurrence within the sampled repositories, not prevalence in commercial products. We characterise a deployment gap between developer-oriented network assumptions and consumer-facing embodied AI security: inference-layer refusal cannot prevent unauthorised changes to model instructions. Potential consequences include surveillance through onboard cameras and microphones and social engineering of nearby users. Proof-of-concept code, evidence and the survey are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini Lite，揭示绕过推理层拒答的网络暴露配置层攻击：未认证即可替换人格设定与云端LLM系统提示词，并将漏洞映射至CWE-306/CWE-1327/CWE-352，同时通过59个公开仓库源码审查说明问题复发率。
AI.motivation: 现有具身LLM安全研究集中于推理层（对话提示注入）的拒答能力，忽视部署与配置层：当机器人管理接口网络暴露、缺乏认证时，攻击者可绕过对话输入直接改写模型指令，从而形成"推理层拒答无法防护"的安全缺口。
AI.method: 在Reachy Mini Lite实机上开展黑盒与源码分析：执行5类共11次提示注入测试作对照，再经本地与网络邻接路径实施配置层攻击（替换人格设置、云端LLM系统提示词、持久化记忆写入、无预检的跨域请求）；对漏洞做CWE分类与CVSS v3.1评分；并对59个公开仓库做源码审查统计缺失认证的复发率。
AI.result: 11次提示注入均被拒答，而两条配置层攻击路径在物理硬件上均产生可观测行为改变；漏洞对应CWE-306与CWE-1327（CVSS 6.5，Medium），配置端点接受无CORS预检的跨域请求（CWE-352，6.5 Medium），持久记忆写入未强制既定限制；11个可源码验证的真实应用中10个缺失认证，含框架默认情形则为11/11。
AI.conclusion: 提出"开发者网络假设与消费级具身AI安全之间的部署落差"这一概念，指出防护重心应从推理层拒答转向配置与暴露面治理；潜在后果包括经机载摄像头/麦克风的监视及对周边用户的社会工程诱导。作者亦明确其结果仅反映样本仓库内的复发而非商业产品普遍性。

title: Levio: Smart Actuated Back-Exoskeleton via Retrofit of a Commercial Passive Device
summary: Passive back exoskeletons show promising benefits for reducing occupational musculoskeletal disorders. However, their assistance cannot be modulated towards the task requirements. Active exoskeletons offer opportunities for pose-specific assistance, but, developing these systems from scratch for research can be time consuming. Therefore, here, we present an accelerated design pipeline that retrofits a Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) passive back exoskeleton, Laevo Flex, with COTS actuation (CubeMars AK10-9) and sensing (IMUs and load-cell) paradigms. Levio was able to provide assistance based on the user's pose. Nine participants performed stoop lifting with the original Laevo and the retrofit Levio system, in transparent and assisted modes. Compared to Laevo, Levio modulated the assistance provided between the bending and lifting phases of the stoop task. The passive assistance offered by Laevo was $25.2 \pm 4.3$ Nm and $30.6 \pm 9.5$ Nm respectively during the bending and lifting phases of the stoop tasks. Levio reduced the resistive torque during bending to $17.9 \pm 4.6$ Nm and offered increased assistance of $37.7 \pm 6.4$ Nm during lifting. Moreover, participants reported higher usability scores and lowest mean global discomfort score while using the Levio when compared to Laevo. These benefits demonstrates retrofitting passive exoskeletons is a viable direction for rapid prototyping of wearable exoskeletons for lifting.

AI.tldr: 通过用商用执行器与传感器（CubeMars AK10-9、IMU、力传感器）改造商用被动背部外骨骼 Laevo Flex，获得可按姿态调节助力/阻尼的主动外骨骼 Levio，并在弯腰搬运任务中验证其相较原被动外骨骼降低了弯曲阶段的阻力矩、提升了举升阶段的助力，并改善了可用性与舒适度评分。
AI.motivation: 被动背部外骨骼助力不可随任务阶段调节，而主动外骨骼虽可提供姿态相关助力，但从零搭建研究平台耗时费力，因此需要一条快速原型化路径。
AI.method: 提出加速设计流程：在商用被动外骨骼 Laevo Flex 上集成商用执行器（CubeMars AK10-9）与传感（IMU、力传感器）进行改造；Levio 依据用户姿态在透明模式与助力模式下调节力矩。9 名被试完成 stoop 弯腰搬运任务，对比原始 Laevo 与 Levio。
AI.result: Laevo 在弯曲/举升阶段分别提供 25.2±4.3 Nm 与 30.6±9.5 Nm 的恒定被动助力；Levio 将弯曲阶段阻力矩降至 17.9±4.6 Nm，并将举升阶段助力提高至 37.7±6.4 Nm。被试报告 Levio 的可用性评分更高、整体不适感均值最低。
AI.conclusion: 改造商用被动外骨骼是快速原型化助力搬运可穿戴外骨骼的可行方向；姿态相关力矩调节可提升助力适配性与用户体验。

title: ForceBody: Force-Paired Parametric Body Motion with Torque Uncertainty
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Forces and torques drive human motion, central to biomechanics, robotics, and physics-aware animation, yet they are often absent from learning-based motion pipelines for body reconstruction and generation. Some motion datasets provide force annotations, but the paired motion sequences are incompatible with the parametric body models used in modern learning pipelines. In addition, existing datasets typically obtain joint torques through inverse dynamics, which is inherently sensitive to the quality of the input kinematics; however, they do not quantify the reliability of these torque estimates. We close this gap with ForceBody, the first dataset to bring ground truth force supervision into a parametric body representation, shipped with per-sample torque uncertainty. ForceBody pairs the SKEL body model with ground reaction forces and inverse-dynamics joint torques across 10,386 motion trials (9.7M frames, 26.9 hours) from 140 subjects. Each torque label is paired with a per-frame, per-joint uncertainty annotation obtained by Monte Carlo sampling through the inverse dynamics pipeline. We benchmark six architectures (MLP, Conv1D, LSTM, GRU, Mamba2, Transformer) on ground reaction force and joint torque prediction from SKEL motion. As one example use of the released uncertainty, finetuning a Transformer with per-sample uncertainty weighting reduces the MAE of joint torque estimation by 5%. Code and data are at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ForceBody：首个将地面反作用力与逆动力学关节力矩真值监督引入参数化人体模型（SKEL）的数据集，含逐样本逐关节力矩不确定性标注，并给出六种架构基准与不确定性加权训练示例。
AI.motivation: 学习式动作重建与生成管线普遍缺失力/力矩监督；现有带力标注的数据集骨架与参数化人体模型不兼容，且逆动力学力矩未量化可靠性。
AI.method: 将SKEL参数化人体与GRF、逆动力学关节力矩配对，覆盖140名受试者、10,386段试次（9.7M帧、26.9小时）；通过蒙特卡洛采样穿越逆动力学管线，得到逐帧逐关节不确定性标注；在此数据上基准MLP、Conv1D、LSTM、GRU、Mamba2、Transformer六种架构。
AI.result: 建立GRF与关节力矩预测基准；以逐样本不确定性加权微调Transformer，使关节力矩估计MAE降低5%。
AI.conclusion: 力感知人体运动数据集把力矩真值与可靠性度量纳入参数化人体表示，为物理感知的动作重建与生成提供监督信号及可用的不确定性先验。

title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
comment: 25 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.

AI.tldr: NexSight 提出可验证任务构建流程 SightForge，从 108 个长视频生成 310 个证据可追溯任务（SightLine），并以共享多尺度 harness SightLoop 评测与训练 agentic 长视频理解模型；Sight-35B 仅用不足 6K 样本即将交互准确率从 21.29% 提升到 42.26%。
AI.motivation: 长视频细粒度问题（次数、顺序、状态变化时刻）需要跨数小时视频定位零散证据片段；稀疏证据只能证明"发生过"而非"总数"，且仅答案监督不会显式监督证据搜索过程；该能力既难测量也难学习。
AI.method: SightForge 数据流水线：任务仅在接受"盲于草稿答案的验证器"能从原始视频密集重获取的证据中重建答案、且反例检查无法反驳时才通过；SightLoop 为统一多尺度评测 harness，支持时序探索、局部细察、证据整合与回访并记录观测；在互斥视频上，求解轨迹转为步级观测决策监督，微调得到 Sight-35B。
AI.result: SightLine 含 310 个可追溯任务；最强模型仅达 54.52%，给定标注证据时升至 79.35%（说明瓶颈在证据检索而非推理）；Sight-35B 交互准确率 21.29%→42.26%，超过同族 397B 模型，后训练后自发使用显式空间细察（基座模型从不使用），并在两个外部长视频基准上提升 8 点以上。
AI.conclusion: "可验证任务生成 + 多尺度 agentic harness + 步级观测监督"是提升长视频 agent 检索式理解的有效范式，证据可追溯性是可训练监督的关键前提。

title: Zero-Shot Compositional Generalization for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: Robot demonstrations are collected on different embodiments, leaving many robot-skill combinations unobserved. Pooling these data shares visual knowledge, while joint labels remain tied to the demonstrating kinematic chain. We propose a geometry-supervised training framework for zero-shot composition of familiar robots and skills. The central insight is that a demonstrated command provides a tool-space target for every robot that can realize it. Calibrated forward kinematics supplies this supervision to foreign native action interfaces without their joint labels for that skill. Native reconstruction retains demonstrated configurations, and positive reachability checks select targets for cross-robot supervision. A visual policy learns to predict shared actions and executes through the target robot's native decoder. During policy learning, one prediction receives geometric supervision through both source and foreign native realizations. Matched supervision controls, repeated policy training and evaluations across three backbones and two simulators demonstrate improved transfer to missing robot-task combinations.

AI.tldr: 提出几何监督训练框架，利用校准正运动学为零样本跨机器人技能组合提供工具空间目标监督，使视觉策略经各机器人原生解码器执行未见机器人-技能组合。
AI.motivation: 机器人示范数据分散在不同本体上，大量机器人-技能组合缺失；联合标签又与示范的运动链绑定，直接汇总数据会丢失跨本体可迁移性。
AI.method: 以示范指令对应的工具空间目标作为几何监督信号：由标定的前向运动学为外来机器人的原生动作接口生成监督，无需其在该技能上的关节标签；通过原生重建保留示范配置，并用正可达性检查筛选跨机器人监督目标；视觉策略预测共享动作，经目标机器人原生解码器执行，同一预测同时受源与本体的几何监督（matched supervision 控制）。
AI.result: 在三种骨干网络与两个仿真器上重复训练与评测，配合匹配监督对照实验，显示向缺失机器人-任务组合的迁移性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 几何一致性监督可有效解耦数据中的"运动链标签"，实现熟悉机器人与技能的零样本组合；方法仅在仿真中验证，真实机器人迁移尚待检验。

title: Visual Harness Scales General VLMs to Medical Images
summary: We show that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general vision-language models (VLMs) across diverse medical imaging tasks. We introduce \ours, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. With \ours, general VLMs interactively explore medical images and progressively acquire diagnostic evidence, which is preserved in a lossless memory for subsequent retrieval and use. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives an assessment of potential omissions and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further image inspection and measurement, followed by answer revision in an iterative agentic loop until sufficient evidence is obtained. Across 11 tasks and four imaging modalities, \ours improves performance on all tasks with Qwen3.8-27B, with notable gains in spleen measurement (63.3\% to 98.3\%), renal search (57.5\% to 71.2\%), and pulmonary nodule detection (0.0\% to 28.2\%). High-capability API-based VLMs achieve even higher performance with \ours. For example, GPT-6.1 Sol improves pulmonary nodule detection from 10.8\% to 69.2\% with \ours, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger model capabilities and an effective medical visual harness. Our results highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new paradigm for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出医学视觉"harness"（\ours）：为通用VLM配备交互式视觉工具与无损诊断证据记忆，在初始作答后由评估模块反馈遗漏与证据可靠性，驱动迭代式图像检查、测量与答案修订，从而在11个医学影像任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 通用VLM在医学影像上表现不佳，而专用医学模型泛化性差；作者希望不改模型权重，仅通过"工具+证据管理+迭代反思"的代理式框架，把通用VLM的能力有效迁移到多模态医学诊断任务。
AI.method: 构建代理式循环：VLM用交互式视觉工具探索图像并逐步积累诊断证据；证据存入无损记忆供后续检索复用；提交初答后获得"潜在遗漏+已发现病灶可信度"的评估，据此指导再检查与测量，直至证据充分再修订答案。
AI.result: 在4种成像模态、11个任务上，Qwen3.8-27B全部提升（脾脏测量63.3%→98.3%，肾脏搜索57.5%→71.2%，肺结节检测0.0%→28.2%）；GPT-6.1 Sol肺结节检测10.8%→69.2%，显示强模型与harness的互补增益。
AI.conclusion: "视觉harness"可作为将通用VLM扩展至医学影像的新范式，其收益来自工具交互、证据记忆与迭代反思的协同，而非领域微调。

title: Pixel is All You Need
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Text, images, audio, touch, and even robot actions can, in principle, all be rendered onto a single canvas, suggesting an ambitious goal of unifying all modalities within vision. Language provides the natural first test. To subsume it, a visual model must reason directly over text in pixels. Across a wide range of image, video, and unified multimodal generators, however, we find that their visual generation modules cannot perform symbolic reasoning over text on the canvas. They succeed only when an underlying text module or prompt rewriter already supplies the answer, effectively reducing the generator to a mere renderer, a limitation that post-training does little to resolve. To test whether this failure stems from pixels themselves or from current training paradigms, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. With images as their sole input and output, these models read questions, write intermediate steps, and produce answers directly on the canvas. Remarkably, they exhibit hallmark behaviors of large language models. Performance improves predictably with scale following a power law. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame answering, echoing chain-of-thought, while reinforcement-learning post-training further strengthens reasoning. Moreover, sharing one canvas allows the same model to reason across modalities, a capability that text-only language models lack. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.

AI.tldr: 纯像素空间生成模型（无文本通路）可在画布上直接读题、写中间推理步骤并作答，呈现幂律缩放、逐帧"思维链"增益与强化学习后训练收益，并天然支持跨模态推理。
AI.motivation: 现有图像/视频/统一多模态生成器的视觉生成模块无法在像素上对文本做符号推理，只充当渲染器（答案由底层文本模块或提示重写器提供），后训练也难以解决。作者希望判断该失败源于像素表示本身还是当前训练范式。
AI.method: 从零训练一族纯像素空间生成模型，移除任何文本通路，仅以图像为输入输出，在统一画布上直接读题、书写中间步骤并输出答案；比较单帧作答与逐帧书写中间步骤，并进行强化学习后训练；考察随规模变化的缩放行为。
AI.result: 性能随规模可预测提升并遵循幂律；逐帧生成中间步骤显著优于单帧直接作答（类思维链）；RL 后训练进一步增强推理；共享画布使同一模型可跨模态推理，这是纯文本 LLM 不具备的能力。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间本身可支撑符号化推理，先前失败主要归因于训练范式而非像素表示；这是首个在无文本 token 的纯像素生成模型中系统研究上述现象的��作。

title: A tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude open-water search and rescue
summary: Large aerial platforms often operate above 1.5 km to improve the efficiency of open water search and rescue (OW-SAR). However, long imaging distances, wide fields of view, and limited sensor resolution reduce objects to a few pixels, increasing their susceptibility to environmental interference and making detection harder than for conventional small objects. To our knowledge, existing datasets focus on low-altitude scenarios and do not support automatic detection at 1.5-2.0 km. We therefore present TinyWOD, a tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude OW-SAR using lifebuoys as detection targets. It comprises 11,359 manually annotated images and 19,505 annotated instances spanning diverse environments, lighting conditions, water colors, and surface ripples. Compared with existing datasets, TinyWOD contains much smaller objects and a substantially higher proportion of tiny instances; its average equivalent side length (ESL) is 12.7 pixels, with 76.96% of in stances having ESLs below 15 pixels, reflecting actual high-altitude water-rescue imaging conditions. We define APtiny, a tiny object detection metric, and benchmark mainstream and state-of-the-art networks using this and conventional metrics. All evaluated networks effectively detect tiny waterborne objects, demonstrating TinyWOD's reusability and utility. We expect this dataset to support research on tiny object detection in high-altitude OW-SAR.

AI.tldr: 提出 TinyWOD——面向 1.5–2.0 km 高空开阔水域搜救（OW-SAR）的微小目标检测数据集，含 11,359 张人工标注图像、19,505 个实例，并提出 APtiny 指标与基线评测。
AI.motivation: 高空平台（>1.5 km）可提升开阔水域搜救效率，但成像距离远、视场宽、传感器分辨率有限，使目标仅数个像素，易受环境干扰，检测难度远超常规小目标；现有数据集集中于低空场景，无法支撑 1.5–2.0 km 高度下的自动检测研究。
AI.method: 以救生圈为检测目标构建 TinyWOD 数据集，覆盖多环境、多光照、多水色与水面波纹条件的 11,359 张标注图像与 19,505 个实例；定义微小目标检测指标 APtiny；并在该数据集上用该指标与常规指标对主流及 SOTA 检测网络进行基准测试。
AI.result: TinyWOD 的平均等效边长（ESL）仅 12.7 像素，76.96% 实例的 ESL 低于 15 像素，显著小于现有数据集且微小实例占比更高；所评测网络均能有效检测水面微小目标，验证了数据集的可用性与可复用性。
AI.conclusion: TinyWOD 填补了高空 OW-SAR 微小目标检测数据的空白，可为高空水面搜救的微小目标检测研究提供基准支撑；但工作聚焦数据集与评测，未提出新的检测方法。

title: Kolibri: Color Finds the Place, Refinement Sets the Pose for RGB-D Localization in Colored Point Clouds
summary: An agent or robot in a scanned building must locate its camera in rooms that no model saw during training. Point cloud registration methods can align each RGB-D frame with the building's colored point cloud, accurately but at a high cost. We observe that geometric refinement brings nearby initial poses to the same final pose, so the learned component only needs to find the place. Kolibri does this with a graph network of 55,712 parameters that describes 10 cm cubes of points, called cells, by their color, local shape and neighbors. With the same refinement, it matches GeDi on 96 unseen ScanNet rooms (81.4% against 80.3% within 5 cm and 5°) and on a held-out test of 10 further rooms, in 82 ms per frame on an RTX 2080 Ti. The saved time allows for search without a room label. In one point cloud of 100 rooms, Kolibri loses 1.3 points against knowing the room, while retrieving the room first loses 56.0. In a hospital emergency department scene from a real scan, it localizes 86.5% of the frames rendered from the scan in 384 ms each, where GeDi needs 91 minutes per frame on cubes of the scan for a similar recall. The method needs colors that agree between the frame and the point cloud. On gray frames and across cameras with different color responses, point cloud registration methods keep the lead.

AI.tldr: Kolibri：55.7K参数的图网络把建筑彩色点云切分成10cm cell并描述颜色/局部形状/邻接，仅用于提供配准初值，再由几何精化统一收敛到同一最终位姿，实现82ms/帧的免房间标签定位。
AI.motivation: 在扫描建筑中，机器人需要在训练时从未被模型见过的房间内定位相机。点云配准（如GeDi）精度高但每帧代价巨大，无法支持无房间先验的全局搜索。
AI.method: 观察到只要初值落在附近，几何精化就能把不同初值收敛到相同最终位姿，因此学习部分只需"找地方"而非精确对齐。用55,712参数的图神经网络对10cm体素cell的颜色、局部形状及邻接关系编码，输出配准初值，后接统一的几何精化；开销小到可在100房间的单一全局点云上做无标签搜索（无需先检索房间）。
AI.result: 96间未见ScanNet房间上达81.4%（5cm/5°内），超过GeDi的80.3%；另10间留出测试集持平；82ms/帧（RTX 2080 Ti）。100房间点云中相比已知房间仅损失1.3点，先做房间检索则损失56.0点。真实医院急诊科扫描场景中，对渲染帧定位成功率86.5%，每帧384ms，而GeDi在整室cube上需91分钟/帧才达相近召回。
AI.conclusion: 将"精确定位"交给几何精化、把学习容量压缩到"粗定位"是有效且高效的设计；但方法依赖帧与点云颜色一致，在灰度帧或跨相机色彩响应不同时，传统点云配准仍占优。

title: Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Balance on Dynamically Responsive Supports
summary: Conventional balance formulations often assume a rigid, stationary support, decoupling body stabilization from support motion. This assumption becomes inadequate on mechanically responsive supports, creating a coupled control challenge: corrective body motions intended to restore equilibrium can also excite support motion. We formulate sustained balance as a coupled regulation problem that coordinates equilibrium restoration with suppression of motion induced by the robot's own corrections. We introduce LISST (Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Stabilization), a learning framework that accounts for how earlier actions shape the conditions for subsequent corrections. It uses recent observations to support immediate adjustments and longer histories to characterize persistent motion, with physical supervision relating the learned representation to robot-support behavior. To evaluate corrective actions, LISST uses coupled dynamics to assess both imbalance and the direction of motion. A Lyapunov-inspired criterion measures progress over finite windows, accommodating the transients required to restore balance. This physical evaluation guides joint-level policy learning through backpropagation through differentiable model rollouts. Privileged guidance focuses training on difficult states reached by the deployment policy and is transferred through distillation. The resulting policy operates using only onboard proprioception. Real-world experiments demonstrate that LISST maintains balance while limiting residual oscillations during continuous interaction with a dynamically responsive support. Video: this http URL .

AI.tldr: LISST：将“在动态响应支撑面上维持平衡”建模为耦合调节问题，用Lyapunov启发的有限窗口判据与可微模型滚动指导关节级策略学习，并通过特权蒸馏得到仅用本体感知的策略，在真实机器人上抑制残余振荡。
AI.motivation: 传统平衡方法假设支撑面刚性静止，将身体稳定与支撑运动解耦；在机械可响应的支撑上该假设失效——用于恢复平衡的矫正动作会反过来激励支撑运动，形成耦合控制难题。
AI.method: 1) 将持续平衡形式化为耦合调节问题，同时协调平衡恢复与对自身矫正所诱发运动的抑制；2) LISST框架利用近期观测支持即时调整、较长历史刻画持续运动，并以物理监督将学到的表征与机器-支撑行为关联；3) 用耦合动力学评估不平衡量与运动方向；4) Lyapunov启发判据在有限窗口内度量进展，容纳恢复平衡所需瞬态；5) 该物理评估通过可微模型rollout的反向传播指导关节级策略学习；6) 特权引导聚焦部署策略到达的困难状态，并经蒸馏迁移，最终策略仅用本体感知在线运行。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明，在动态响应支撑上的连续交互中，LISST能维持平衡并限制残余振荡。
AI.conclusion: 以耦合动力学与Lyapunov式有限窗口评估替代刚性支撑假设，可将平衡控制从“瞬时纠偏”转为“持续调节”，且在仅有本体感知的部署条件下有效。

title: Pelorus: Resource-Aware Lidar-Inertial Odometry
summary: Lidar-inertial odometry (LIO) has an efficiency problem. High-resolution lidars produce millions of points per second that must be processed online on the resource-constrained hardware of robots, cars, or drones, yet most LIO methods neither bound their memory nor report their compute footprint. We introduce Pelorus, a resource-aware LIO with a fixed-capacity multiresolution map of voxelized normal distributions and an iterated equivariant state estimator. A relevance-based eviction keeps the map memory bounded, and a maturity-weighted map update suppresses inconsistent observations. The pipeline runs in parallel on CPUs and GPUs. On five sequences from three public datasets, Pelorus achieves the lowest relative pose error in seven of ten metrics with a small, bounded memory footprint and, with GPU offloading, the lowest CPU load of all compared methods. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, it processes a 128-beam lidar at 10 Hz. Pelorus is open source with CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal backends.

AI.tldr: Pelorus：资源感知的 LiDAR-惯性里程计，采用固定容量多分辨率体素化法向分布地图、相关性驱逐机制与成熟度加权地图更新，支持 CPU/GPU 并行与 CUDA/Vulkan/Metal 后端。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率激光雷达每秒产生百万级点云，需在机器人/车辆/无人机等资源受限硬件上在线处理，但现有 LIO 方法普遍既不界定内存上界，也不报告计算开销。
AI.method: (1) 固定容量的多分辨率体素化法向分布地图；(2) 迭代等变状态估计器；(3) 基于相关性(relevance)的驱逐策略保证地图内存有界；(4) 成熟度加权的建图更新抑制不一致观测；(5) CPU/GPU 并行流水线，提供 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 后端。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集共五个序列上，十个指标中有七个取得最低相对位姿误差，内存占用小且有界；GPU 卸载时 CPU 负载为所有对比方法中最低；在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上以 10 Hz 实时处理 128 线激光雷达。
AI.conclusion: Pelorus 证明了将内存与计算预算显式纳入设计的资源感知 LIO 可在嵌入式平台上实现 SOTA 精度与实时性能，并以开源形式提供多图形后端实现。

title: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
comment: 25 pages, 22 figures, 4 tables. Technical report of Team Auriga's 2025 mobile manipulator (@Work) platform (Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Shahid Beheshti University)
summary: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.

AI.tldr: 面向工业场景的移动操作平台 @Work Robot：Mecanum 四轮全向底盘 + 5 自由度机械臂 + 3D 打印夹爪，ESP32 自制 PCB + Jetson Orin NX，软件栈为 Hector SLAM、A* 与 YOLO，实现导航、避障与抓取任务。
AI.motivation: 提升工业重复性或危险性作业的效率，构建软硬件集成的移动操作机器人系统。
AI.method: 硬件：4 轮 Mecanum 全向驱动、5-DoF 机械臂、3D 打印夹爪；电子：基于 ESP32 的自制 PCB + NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 负责高层计算与实时控制。软件：Hector SLAM 建图定位、A* 路径规划、YOLO 实时目标检测，融合多传感器数据实现导航与避障。
AI.result: 在类工业环境下表现出较稳定的自主导航、物体抓取与任务执行性能，验证了软硬件集成有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该平台属于工程系统集成型工作，方法均为成熟组件组合，缺少新算法或量化对比评估。

title: Keeping Parts Honest: Isolated Part Graphs for Faithful Vision Transformer Explanations
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Supplementary material will be added in a later version
summary: Part and prototype-based explanations for Vision Transformers (ViTs) present a decision as evidence from individual image regions. However, self-attention mixes information across patches, so part-level features absorb context from the whole image and consequently fail to faithfully reflect the decision. We show that existing interpretable ViT classifiers depend heavily on this leakage: when each explained region is encoded in isolation, their accuracy collapses, and retraining them under isolation recovers only part of the lost accuracy. We propose a classifier that represents each image as a graph of isolated parts. Each part is encoded only from its own patches by a ViT whose last blocks are fine-tuned under isolation, preventing evidence leakage from elsewhere in the image. Parts are discovered without annotation and refined hierarchically through their sub-parts, making them more consistent and stable across images than those of competing methods. Each edge is computed from part pairs, and recovers evidence that attention previously shared across the object without affecting the parts. Matching the image graph to a learned prototype graph per class makes the prediction a direct combination of node and edge similarities, each computed only from the patches it is credited to, so every explanation is faithful by construction. Across 11 fine-grained and general-object benchmarks, our method exceeds the accuracy of existing explainable methods that rely on leakage, while providing explanations that reflect what the model actually uses.

AI.tldr: 提出基于“孤立部件图+原型图”的可解释ViT分类器，通过隔离编码阻止注意力跨块泄漏，使解释自构造起即为忠实。
AI.motivation: 现有ViT部件/原型级解释以局部区域为证据，但自注意力在各patch间混合信息，导致部件特征吸收整图上下文，解释不能忠实反映决策依据；实验证明现有可解释ViT依赖这种泄漏（隔离编码后精度崩塌，隔离重训仅部分恢复）。
AI.method: 将图像表示为孤立部件的图：每个部件仅由其自身patch经ViT编码（末段block在隔离条件下微调），杜绝证据泄漏；部件无标注自动发现并按子部件层级细化；边由部件对计算，恢复注意力原先跨物体共享的证据；将图像图与每类学习到的原型图匹配，预测为节点与边相似度的直接组合，每个相似度仅由其所归属patch计算。
AI.result: 11个细粒度与通用物体基准上，精度超过依赖泄漏的既有可解释方法，且解释反映模型真实使用的证据。
AI.conclusion: 以“隔离编码+图原型匹配”实现构造性忠实的ViT解释，在提升可解释性的同时不牺牲甚至超越精度，说明泄漏是既有可解释ViT的根本缺陷。

title: CaFe: Causally Faithful Conditional Traffic Scenario Generation
summary: Language-conditioned traffic simulation enables scalable test scenarios steered by natural language. The goal is to control selected agents while surrounding traffic reacts to their observed behaviour. For example, a vehicle instructed to cut in late should cause the following vehicle to brake only when the manoeuvre becomes observable. Yet simulators can leak private instructions across agents, causing surrounding vehicles to react before the instructed behaviour becomes observable. Such premature reactions defuse desired events and alter the ensuing closed-loop scenario. Existing benchmarks measure what agents do, not what they could have known, leaving this failure unmeasured. We formalise it as intent leakage and address it through evaluation, data and modelling. Our paired intervention test holds an instructed agent's executed trajectory fixed while varying its private instruction, isolating leakage-induced changes in surrounding agents. We also construct WOMD-PACT, an automatically generated, verifiable dataset of 531,099 WOMD scenes with timed behaviour tags with reaction episodes identified through a counterfactual ghost test and grounded private instructions. Finally, we introduce CaFe, a dual-stream diffusion-forcing simulator fine-tuned in closed loop that restricts inter-agent interactions to public beliefs, preserving legitimate anticipation without leaking private intent. Our evaluation reveals that existing conditioning designs displace 23-83% of nearby uninstructed agents through private-intent leakage, even when the instructed agent's executed motion is held fixed. CaFe eliminates measurable leakage while maintaining comparable WOSAC realism (0.763), demonstrating that causal faithfulness can be enforced without sacrificing measured simulation realism.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"意图泄漏"（intent leakage）问题：语言条件交通仿真中，私有指令会跨智能体泄漏，导致周围车辆在指令行为可观测之前就提前反应，破坏闭环场景。作者用配对干预测试量化泄漏，构建可验证数据集WOMD-PACT（531,099场景），并提出双流扩散强制仿真器CaFe，仅让智能体交互依赖公开信念，在保持WOSAC真实度0.763的同时消除可测泄漏。
AI.motivation: 语言条件交通仿真的目标是控制选定智能体、让周围交通对可观测行为作出反应；但现有仿真器会泄漏私有指令，使周围车辆提前反应，从而"拆解"期望的交互事件并改变闭环动态。现有基准只衡量智能体做了什么，而不衡量它们本可以知道什么，因而无法测出这一失效模式。
AI.method: 形式化"意图泄漏"问题并从评测、数据、建模三方面应对：(1) 配对干预测试——固定被指令智能体的实际执行轨迹，仅改变其私有指令，从而隔离出泄漏引起的周围智能体变化；(2) 构建WOMD-PACT自动生成可验证数据集，含531,099个WOMD场景，带时序行为标签、由反事实"幽灵测试"识别出的反应片段及有依据的私有指令；(3) 提出CaFe，双流diffusion-forcing仿真器，闭环微调，将智能体间交互限制在公开信念上，保留合理预判而不泄漏私有意图。
AI.result: 评测显示现有条件化设计即使在被指令智能体执行轨迹固定时，仍会因私有意图泄漏使23%-83%的附近未受指令智能体发生位移；CaFe消除可测泄漏，同时保持相当的WOSAC真实度（0.763）。
AI.conclusion: 因果忠实的语言条件交通仿真可以在不牺牲仿真真实度的前提下实现；评测需关注"智能体本可以知道什么"而非仅行为结果，数据集与公开信念建模是实现该目标的有效路径。

title: Propose & Verify: Fast Reflection Symmetry Detection via Harmonic Fields
summary: Detecting multiple reflection symmetries in 3D shapes requires aggregating geometric evidence over a large space of candidate planes, making traditional voting approaches computationally expensive. We introduce the Fourier Accelerated Symmetry Transform (FAST), a training-free framework that combines geometric pair voting with efficient spectral computation. Exploiting the fact that global reflection planes pass through the shape centroid, we reduce the search to plane orientations, while geometric consistency filtering and independent witnesses suppress unreliable pair hypotheses. Our key insight is to represent these votes as a signal over plane orientations and efficiently compute a continuous, smoothed symmetry field in the spherical-harmonic domain. Specifically, we exploit the Funk-Hecke theorem, the spherical counterpart of the Fourier convolution theorem for rotationally symmetric kernels, to transform Gaussian smoothing into multiplication of harmonic coefficients. This enables efficient field evaluation, from which symmetry candidates are extracted, refined, and geometrically verified. Across two benchmarks, including a new benchmark of highly symmetric shapes, FAST achieves the highest clean multi-plane detection $F_1$ scores among evaluated methods (0.861 and 0.947), with GPU inference below 4 ms per shape: over $100\times$ faster than the next-fastest evaluated multi-plane GPU baseline. FAST also demonstrates strong robustness to geometric noise and competitive single-plane detection, achieving 94.9% success on clean single-plane shapes.

AI.tldr: FAST：将质心约束下的平面对偶投票表示为平面朝向信号，利用Funk-Hecke定理在球谐域把高斯平滑转为系数乘，实现免训练、<4ms的多反射对称面检测。
AI.motivation: 3D形状多反射对称检测需在巨大候选平面空间中聚合几何证据，传统投票方法计算代价高，难以扩展到多平面连续搜索。
AI.method: 利用全局反射平面过形状质心，将搜索降维到平面朝向空间；用几何一致性过滤与独立witness抑制不可靠对偶假设；将投票视作球面朝向信号，借助Funk-Hecke定理把各向同性高斯核卷积变为球谐系数逐项相乘，高效计算连续平滑的对称场，再从中提取候选、精化并几何验证。
AI.result: 两个基准（含新的高对称形状基准）上干净多平面检测F1最高（0.861与0.947），GPU推理<4ms/形状，比次快的多平面GPU基线快100倍以上；对几何噪声鲁棒，单平面干净形状成功率94.9%。
AI.conclusion: 球谐域卷积是加速几何投票的有效范式，FAST以训练-free方式实现实时、高精度的多反射对称检测，可作为形状分析/建模流程的高效前置模块。

title: Beyond Co-Generation: Rethinking Jointness in Joint Audio-Video Generation
comment: Preprint
summary: Our aim is to advance the understanding of genuine audio-visual coordination in joint text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation, with particular emphasis on semantic consistency. Evaluating audio-visual consistency in T2AV generation is nontrivial, as detailed text prompts obscure whether such consistency stems from genuine cross-modal coordination or merely from independent text following. To isolate the former, we introduce intrinsic jointness: the ability of audio and video to produce the same realization for details left underspecified by the prompt. Using semantically underspecified prompts (e.g., "musical instrument playing" rather than "electric guitar playing"), we investigate four recent models and reveal their limited intrinsic jointness. To address this limitation, we propose JointREPA, a simple representation alignment-based post-training method to facilitate cross-modal coordination. Since existing benchmarks use semantically detailed prompts, we introduce UNSAIDBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate intrinsic jointness under semantic underspecification. Experiments across two distinct models and three benchmarks, including UNSAIDBench, demonstrate that JointREPA consistently improves semantic consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出"内在联合性"(intrinsic jointness)概念，用语义欠指定提示词隔离出T2AV真正的跨模态协调能力；提出表示对齐后训练方法JointREPA并构建UNSAIDBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有T2AV生成的音视频一致性评估被详细文本提示污染：无法判断一致性来自真正的跨模态协调，还是各自独立地跟随文本。需要一种只依赖提示中未指定细节的评测方式来剥离文本信息泄漏。
AI.method: 用语义欠指定提示（如"乐器演奏"而非"电吉他演奏"）定义内在联合性——音视频对未被指定细节给出相同具体化。据此评测四个近期模型，发现内在联合性有限；提出JointREPA，一种基于表示对齐的简单后训练方法，促使音视频模态表征协调；并构建UNSAIDBench基准用于评测欠指定条件下的内在联合性。
AI.result: 在四个模型上显示内在联合性不足；在两个不同模型、三个基准（含UNSAIDBench）上，JointREPA一致提升语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: "内在联合性"为T2AV跨模态协调提供了不受文本细节污染的评测视角，表示对齐式后训练(JointREPA)能稳定改善语义一致性，UNSAIDBench补齐了欠指定评测的空白。

title: LOCUS: Causal Support Windows for Attribute Control in Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Unified autoregressive (AR) image generators struggle to satisfy multiple attribute constraints in a single prompt. Although these attributes are decodable from image-token latents, editing those latents at test time remains difficult. Adding a fixed attribute direction to the prefix can reinforce a requested attribute but rarely overrides a conflicting one, such as turning a car red when the prompt specifies blue. We investigate how the effect of an intervention depends on where it acts in the image-token sequence. We introduce the causal support profile, which measures, for each attribute, how often patching image-token states within a given window flips the rendered attribute. Structural attributes (count and position) are most responsive in early, narrow windows, while appearance attributes (color, size, and material) respond over later, broader windows. A budget-matched comparison of early and middle windows shows that the effect of window location depends on the target attribute, and two-dimensional support maps show that the responsive regions track spatial content. Based on these profiles, we propose LOCUS (Latent Optimization in Causal Support windows), which diagnoses which attribute failed and routes test-time latent optimization to its corresponding support window. With the generator, optimizer, reward, verifier, and token budget held fixed, support-routed windows outperform late windows by 23.6 percentage points in GenEval++ macro accuracy. With the generator frozen, LOCUS raises Janus-Pro's GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8% overall and from 19.5% to 40.5% on multi-attribute tags. On GenEval, LOCUS repairs 48.1% of failed generations in one rollout, compared with 37.4% for prefix optimization, and needs 14% fewer rounds on average to succeed.

AI.tldr: 分析统一自回归图像生成器在单提示多属性约束下的失效机制，提出"因果支持剖面"定位各属性敏感的图像token窗口，并用LOCUS将测试时潜变量优化路由到对应窗口，显著提升GenEval++和GenEval准确率。
AI.motivation: 统一AR图像生成器难以在单个prompt中同时满足多个属性约束；虽然属性信息可从图像token潜变量中解码，但测试时编辑这些潜变量很困难——对前缀施加固定的属性方向只能"加强"而不能"覆盖"冲突属性。作者希望弄清干预效果与干预位置（在token序列中的位置）之间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 1) 提出causal support profile：对每个属性，统计在给定窗口内patch图像token状态时渲染属性被翻转的频率；2) 发现结构属性（数量、位置）在早期窄窗口最敏感，外观属性（颜色、尺寸、材质）在较晚更宽窗口响应；用预算匹配的早/中窗口对比与二维support map验证窗口效应依赖属性、响应区域跟踪空间内容；3) 基于剖面提出LOCUS：诊断失败属性，并把测试时潜变量优化路由到其对应的support窗口。
AI.result: 在生成器、优化器、reward、verifier与token预算均固定的条件下，support路由窗口比late窗口在GenEval++宏平均准确率上高23.6个百分点；冻结生成器时LOCUS把Janus-Pro的GenEval++总体准确率从24.6%提升到46.8%，多属性标签从19.5%提升到40.5%；在GenEval上单次rollout修复48.1%的失败生成（前缀优化为37.4%），平均成功所需轮数少14%。
AI.conclusion: 干预效果强依赖其在图像token序列中的作用位置，且这种因果支持结构可按属性类型刻画；据此设计的支持窗口路由式潜变量优化是免训练、即插即用的，能有效提升多属性可控生成，并与现有前缀级优化互补。

title: Harnessing Image Diffusion Prior for Photo-Realistic Video Restoration
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Recent image generation models produce photo-realistic results with rich details, but transferring their powerful priors to video restoration remains difficult due to temporal inconsistency from stochastic detail synthesis. Existing video restoration methods improve temporal coherence but often sacrifice visual fidelity, leaving a gap between image-level quality and video-level stability. We propose a generative video restoration method that bridges this gap by enabling temporally consistent detail synthesis from image generation priors. Our method combines noise energy rebalancing to suppress structure-disturbing low-frequency stochasticity, motion-aligned noise warping to propagate details along object motion, a self-supervised denoising encoder to mitigate encoder-induced temporal uncertainty, and decoupled temporal attention to model cross-frame dependencies. Together, these components preserve fidelity, enhance fine-grained realism, and maintain temporal consistency. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially outperforms existing video restoration approaches in visual quality, detail richness, and temporal stability.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式视频复原方法，利用图像生成先验实现时间一致的细节合成，通过噪声能量重平衡、运动对齐噪声扭曲、自监督去噪编码器和解耦时间注意力四个组件兼顾保真度与时间稳定性。
AI.motivation: 图像生成模型细节丰富但直接迁移到视频复原会产生随机细节合成导致的时间不一致；现有视频复原方法提升时间连贯性却牺牲视觉保真度，图像级质量与视频级稳定性之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 噪声能量重平衡抑制扰动结构的低频随机性；运动对齐噪声扭曲沿物体运动传播细节；自监督去噪编码器缓解编码器引入的时间不确定性；解耦时间注意力建模跨帧依赖。
AI.result: 大量实验表明方法在视觉质量、细节丰富度和时间稳定性上显著优于现有视频复原方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过从图像先验中提取时间一致的细节合成，可弥合图像级保真与视频级稳定之间的差距，为生成先验向视频复原迁移提供可行路径。

title: SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Whole-slide visual question answering (VQA) offers a natural-language interface to pathology, allowing diagnostic and phenotypic questions to be answered directly from tissue slides. However, current vision-language models (VLMs) rely heavily on linguistic priors: their answers are sensitive to the order of the candidate answers, and can be reached through shortcuts that bypass the tissue evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce SlideJev, a framework that separately verifies candidate answers against the slide and learns to ground these judgments in tissue evidence. To connect parallel candidate evaluation with visual evidence learning, we adopt Jev and score each candidate by the difference between support and rejection log-likelihoods from the original language-model head. We compute these scores in parallel using separate prompts with the same format and no option-position labels, then normalize them for answer selection. To ground these scores in tissue evidence, candidate-conditioned reading and comparison guide gated updates to visual tokens across decoder layers. With the backbone frozen, we train these visual modules through the same scores using question-answer and paired-image supervision. Across three whole-slide pathology VQA benchmarks, SlideJev achieves the highest mean overall accuracy and 100% answer consistency across four option orders. Image-control experiments further show that SlideJev achieves the largest average accuracy gains from correct images over mismatched and image-free inputs across the three datasets. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出SlideJev框架，用Jev（support与rejection对数似然之差）并行打分为每个候选答案独立打分，并通过候选条件化的视觉token门控更新使判断落地于组织证据，解决全切片病理VQA中位置偏置与语言先验捷径问题。
AI.motivation: 现有病理全切片VQA的视觉语言模型高度依赖语言先验：答案对候选顺序敏感，且可绕过组织证据通过捷径得出结论，缺乏对视觉证据的真实依赖。
AI.method: 对每个候选采用同格式、无选项位置标签的独立prompt并行计算Jev分数（原LM头下support与rejection对数似然之差），归一化后选答案；在解码层通过候选条件化读取与比较引导视觉token的门控更新；冻结主干，仅以同分数为目标，用QA与配对图像监督训练视觉模块。
AI.result: 在三个全切片病理VQA基准上取得最高平均总体准确率，四种选项顺序下答案一致性达100%；图像控制实验显示三项数据集上正确图像相对错配/无图像输入的平均准确率增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 解耦候选独立验证与证据落地可有效去偏并提升病理VQA的视觉证据依赖，但属医学领域CV工作，对核心Physical AI/机器人方向迁移价值有限。

title: Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. This introduces a significant performance bottleneck. An important question thus arises: what world state should a world VLA model reason over to support planning beyond pixel-level prediction? We argue that planning-oriented world modeling should focus on a compact and structured agent-centric latent state that captures the interactions between objects in the driving scene over time. As such, we introduce AgentWorld, an agent-centric VLA world model that uses discrete agent tokens jointly for reasoning and trajectory planning. Each token is dynamically grounded to a surrounding agent associated with its object's state, such as semantic identity, 3D geometry, motion, and interaction context. AgentWorld learns these tokens through three key processes: explicit geometric grounding, reasoning-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and agent-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop experiments under diverse driving scenarios show that AgentWorld enhances planning capabilities, fully exploits visual evidence and agent dynamics, and yields interpretable agent-centric world states.

AI.tldr: AgentWorld：以智能体为中心潜状态的VLA世界模型，用离散agent token联合推理与轨迹规划，替代像素级未来帧预测。
AI.motivation: 现有world VLA多以像素级稠密视觉token生成未来帧，外观细节冗余，仅少量token编码几何、运动、交互等规划关键因素，构成性能瓶颈。作者主张面向规划的世界建模应聚焦紧凑、结构化的agent-centric潜状态。
AI.method: 将离散agent token动态绑定到周围交通参与者，token携带语义身份、3D几何、运动与交互上下文；通过显式几何grounding、面向推理的监督微调、agent-oriented强化学习三阶段训练，使同一套token同时服务于世界状态推理与轨迹规划。
AI.result: 多场景开环与闭环实验显示规划能力提升，能更充分利用视觉证据与agent动力学，并给出可解释的agent-centric世界状态（摘要未报告具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 面向规划的世界模型不必依赖像素级预测，紧凑结构化的agent级潜表示是可行且更有效的替代范式，兼顾性能与可解释性。局限在于缺乏数值对比与真实车端部署验证。

title: Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Natural language-guided UAV navigation enables intuitive human-robot interaction and flexible autonomous flight in complex environments. However, reliable navigation requires accurate instruction following, continuous task progress tracking, and safe obstacle avoidance, which remain challenging for existing world-action models that primarily focus on action prediction. To address these limitations, we propose a world-action learning framework that integrates three complementary mechanisms: a language-conditioned action interface with targeted post-training for instruction-responsive motion, recurrent instruction-consumption prediction to track task progress and determine termination, and Gaussian-scene post-training to enhance obstacle avoidance through trajectory imitation and differentiable geometric feedback. Closed-loop evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate improvements in sequential task completion, safe goal reaching, and timely termination. Furthermore, direct one-step denoising reduces inference overhead, and real-world indoor and outdoor flights validate the framework's effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出语言引导无人机导航的世界-动作学习框架，融合语言条件动作接口+定向后训练、循环指令消耗预测、高斯场景后训练三项机制，提升指令跟随、任务进度跟踪与避障安全，并支持一步去噪加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型偏重动作预测，缺乏准确的指令跟随、连续任务进度跟踪与安全避障能力，难以支撑自然语言引导的无人机复杂环境自主飞行。
AI.method: 三机制组合：(1) 语言条件动作接口并做指令响应性定向后训练；(2) 循环式"指令消耗"预测以跟踪任务进度并判定终止；(3) 高斯场景后训练，通过轨迹模仿+可微几何反馈增强避障。另采用一步去噪降低推理开销。
AI.result: 闭环评估与消融显示在顺序任务完成率、安全到达目标、及时终止方面均有提升；一步去噪降低推理开销；室内外真实飞行验证了框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: 模块化世界-动作后训练可有效补齐指令跟随、进度跟踪与避障短板，并在真实无人机上可行，为语言引导具身导航提供实用方案。

title: RoadAnnoter: An AI-Assisted Desktop Tool for Semantic Segmentation Annotation of Road-Scene Images
comment: 33 Pages
summary: Accurate semantic segmentation of road-scene images is essential for road safety research; however, polygon-level annotation remains labor-intensive and limits labelled dataset development. This study presents RoadAnnoter v1.0, an open-source desktop application integrating six human-in-the-loop annotation modes: manual polygon delineation, SAM Prompt, Smart Select, Edge Fill, pretrained semantic segmentation using Cityscapes-trained SegFormer models, and task-specific segmentation using TinySegNet, a lightweight MobileNetV3-Small-based network trained with accumulated annotator-generated labels. SAM-based modes use promptable segmentation with SAM and MobileSAM, while Edge Fill combines Canny edge detection with colour-similarity-based flood filling in CIELAB colour space. SegFormer generates suggestions for common road-scene categories, whereas TinySegNet supports adaptation to project-specific features through iterative training. All six modes use a shared mask-to-polygon pipeline comprising morphological processing, Gaussian smoothing, contour extraction, and Douglas-Peucker simplification; annotations are exported in YOLO segmentation format. RoadAnnoter was used to annotate Google Street View images from recorded road accident locations in Bangladesh for a vision-language model-based investigation of free-flow speed estimation. Qualitative assessment across representative scenes demonstrated the complementary applicability of the annotation modes to diverse feature geometries. Visual comparison with Roboflow indicated similar qualitative boundary characteristics for principal road-scene regions, although no quantitative accuracy assessment was conducted. RoadAnnoter provides a locally operated framework for developing road-scene segmentation datasets for transportation engineering and road safety research.

AI.tldr: RoadAnnoter v1.0：开源桌面标注工具，集成6种human-in-the-loop道路场景多边形分割标注模式（手工/SAM Prompt/Smart Select/Edge Fill/SegFormer预训练/TinySegNet自训练），共享mask-to-polygon流水线并导出YOLO分割格式。
AI.motivation: 道路场景语义分割对道路安全研究重要，但多边形级标注成本高，限制了带标签数据集的建设，需要高效的人机协同标注工具。
AI.method: 桌面应用集成六种标注模式：手工多边形、SAM Prompt、Smart Select、Edge Fill（Canny边缘+CIELAB颜色相似度漫水填充）、Cityscapes训练的SegFormer预训练分割、基于MobileNetV3-Small的轻量TinySegNet迭代自训练；SAM/MobileSAM提供可提示分割；统一mask→polygon流程（形态学处理、高斯平滑、轮廓提取、Douglas-Peucker简化），导出YOLO格式。
AI.result: 在孟加拉国事故地点Google Street View图像上完成标注以支持VLM自由流速度估计研究；定性显示各模式适用于不同特征几何；与Roboflow视觉对比边界特性相近，但未做定量精度评估。
AI.conclusion: RoadAnnoter为交通工程与道路安全研究提供了本地化的道路场景分割数据集构建框架，属于工程化标注工具，缺乏定量验证与通用方法创新。

title: Wear and Go: Calibration Free Sparse Inertial Motion Capture via Online Sensor Setup Estimation
summary: Sparse inertial motion capture typically assumes that each sensor's anatomical identity and mounting orientation are known. We present MOSAIC (Motion-based Sensor Assignment and Inertial Calibration), a framework that recovers this setup from ordinary motion without a calibration pose. Our central insight is that body pose changes continuously while the sensor setup persists, allowing movements that are individually ambiguous to provide complementary evidence over time. A setup network processes unordered sensor streams with temporal and cross-sensor attention, then accumulates assignment and rotation evidence into a session-level estimate. The recovered setup canonicalizes measurements for frozen pretrained pose estimators, separating sensor configuration from motion reconstruction. For sensors worn at prescribed body sites, evaluation on real inertial recordings with randomized setups shows near-calibrated pose accuracy for bounded offsets and substantial benefits from accumulation under arbitrary orientations. Transfer across pose networks supports setup recovery as a reusable interface between interchangeable sensors and pretrained pose models.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC 框架无需标定姿态即可从日常动作中自动恢复稀疏惯性传感器的身体部位归属与安装朝向，使冻结的预训练姿态估计器可直接使用。
AI.motivation: 稀疏惯性动捕通常假设每个 IMU 的解剖位置与佩戴朝向已知，实际部署时这一假设难以满足；现有标定依赖特定标定姿态，限制可用性。
AI.method: 核心洞察是传感器配置在会话内持续不变、而身体姿态连续变化，故单帧歧义的运动可随时间累积互补证据。用 setup network 处理无序传感器流（时序注意力 + 跨传感器注意力），将分配与旋转证据累积为会话级估计；恢复的配置用于对测量做规范化，从而把"传感器配置"与"运动重建"解耦，复用冻结的预训练姿态估计器。
AI.result: 在真实惯性记录、随机化配置下，对规定身体部位的传感器，有界偏移时接近已标定精度；任意朝向时随时间累积带来显著提升；且可跨不同姿态网络迁移，说明配置恢复可作为可复用接口。
AI.conclusion: 无标定姿态的会话级传感器配置恢复是可行且可复用的接口设计，能解耦传感器与预训练姿态模型，提升稀疏惯性动捕的实际可部署性。

title: Impact of Pretraining Length, Model Size, and Annotation Budget on Downstream Clinical Tasks of Foundation Models in Radiotherapy
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary Material included
summary: Cone-beam CT (CBCT) scans acquired during radiotherapy capture changes such as tumor shrinkage and radiation-induced tissue changes, offering great potential for foundation models that help monitor individual treatment responses. However, to our knowledge, no large-scale pretrained models for radiotherapy CBCT exist, and evaluating modeling choices is difficult since downstream tasks are not known in advance. We examine how pretraining length, model size, and finetuning strategy relate to downstream clinical performance, and how metrics tracked during pretraining correlate with it. We pretrain vision transformer encoders with masked image modeling on about 150,000 raw 3D radiotherapy CBCT scans, tracking representation quality via validation loss, effective rank, and linear probing. Downstream tasks are classification of feeding tube presence ($n=51,135$ CBCTs, $1,562$ patients) and clinical characteristics (T-, N-stage, sex, age, tumor site; $n=1,278$ patients) in head and neck cancer. We compare low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and full finetuning against no pretraining, varying annotated dataset size. Pretext validation loss was the most consistent predictor of downstream performance; effective rank and linear probing were also associated, but not consistently across model sizes and finetuning methods. LoRA performed comparably to full finetuning while training only 0.5-2.5% of the parameters. Fully finetuned models consistently outperformed models without pretraining across all sizes, with AUROC 0.91-0.97 vs. 0.58-0.85 for feeding tube classification and 0.99-1.00 vs. 0.71-0.97 for sex classification. Model size had only a small, inconsistent effect, suggesting smaller models suffice at lower computational cost. Code and pretrained models (non-commercial license): this https URL

AI.tldr: 在约15万例放疗锥形束CT（CBCT）上以掩码图像重建预训练ViT编码器，系统考察预训练时长、模型规模、微调策略与下游临床性能的关系，并发现预文本验证损失是最稳定的性能预测指标。
AI.motivation: 放疗期间采集的CBCT可反映肿瘤缩小与放射诱导组织变化，具备建立个体化治疗响应监测基础模型的潜力；但目前尚无大规模放疗CBCT预训练模型，且下游任务未知导致建模选择（预训练时长、模型规模、微调方式）难以评估。
AI.method: 在约150,000例原始3D放疗CBCT上以掩码图像建模（MIM）预训练ViT编码器；用验证损失、有效秩（effective rank）和线性探针跟踪表征质量；下游任务包括头颈癌喂养管存在分类（51,135例CBCT、1,562名患者）与临床特征分类（T/N分期、性别、年龄、肿瘤部位；1,278名患者）；对比LoRA与全量微调及无预训练基线，并变化标注数据规模。
AI.result: 预文本验证损失与下游性能关联最一致，有效秩和线性探针仅在部分模型规模与微调方式下相关；LoRA仅训练0.5–2.5%参数即可达到与全量微调相当的效果；全量微调在各规模下均优于无预训练（喂养管AUROC 0.91–0.97 vs 0.58–0.85；性别 0.99–1.00 vs 0.71–0.97）；模型规模影响小且不一致，较小模型在更低算力下即可。
AI.conclusion: 放疗CBCT大规模自监督预训练显著提升下游临床任务表现，验证损失可作为实用的预训练监控信号，LoRA提供高效微调方案，小模型即可满足需求；但工作限于医学影像域，属领域CV与预训练实证研究，非物理AI/具身智能核心方向。

title: You Only Encode Once: Sub-Pixel-Shifted Frames for Arbitrary-Scale Remote Sensing Super-Resolution with 2D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) of remote sensing images remains challenging due to the limited high-frequency information in a single low-resolution (LR) observation. While multi-frame SR can exploit complementary sub-pixel information, existing approaches often require real multi-frame training sequences and repeated feature encoding, increasing data acquisition demands and computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose SPS-GS (Sub-Pixel-Shifted Gaussian Splatting), an encode-once framework that learns from multi-phase LR observations synthesized from individual high-resolution images, without requiring real multi-frame training sequences. Specifically, Phase-Coherent Aliasing Demodulation (PCAD) exploits shift-dependent aliasing through Fourier-based alignment, phase-aware residual fusion, and least-squares aliasing estimation, enabling multi-frame information to be integrated before a single deep encoding pass. Gaussian Projection Alignment (GPA) then iteratively refines Gaussian centers and colors using multi-observation back-projection to promote observation consistency. The refined Gaussians support continuous rendering at arbitrary scales. Extensive experiments on five remote sensing datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction performance against single-image and multi-frame SR baselines, while maintaining competitive inference efficiency at common scales. The code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: SPS-GS：面向遥感图像的任意尺度超分框架，用单张HR图像合成多相位LR观测训练，通过相位相干混叠解调（PCAD）在单次深度编码前融合多帧信息，并用高斯投影对齐（GPA）迭代精化高斯基元以支持任意尺度连续渲染。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像任意尺度超分（ASSR）受限于单张LR观测的高频信息不足；多帧SR虽可利用亚像素互补信息，但通常需要真实多帧训练序列并重复编码，带来数据采集与计算开销。
AI.method: 提出encode-once的SPS-GS框架。1) PCAD：从单张高分辨率图像合成多相位LR观测，利用基于傅里叶的配准、相位感知残差融合与最小二乘混叠估计，在单次深度编码前完成多帧信息整合；2) GPA：利用多观测反投影迭代优化高斯中心与颜色，提升观测一致性；3) 精化后的高斯支持任意尺度连续渲染。
AI.result: 在五个遥感数据集上，相较单图与多帧SR基线取得较强重建性能，在常见尺度下保持有竞争力的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过合成多相位观测与解调式前置融合，可在不依赖真实多帧序列的前提下获得多帧SR增益，并以2D高斯泼溅实现任意尺度连续表示；方法局限在于面向遥感静态影像，未涉及动态场景或真实多帧传感器数据。

title: BRepA: Graph-Based B-Rep Pretraining for Unified CAD Understanding and Generation
summary: Boundary representation (B-Rep) of CAD models encodes geometric primitives and their relations as a graph structure, enabling efficient shape modeling within CAD software. Learning on B-Reps for downstream tasks, such as segmentation and novel shape generation, requires specialized neural network designs. Moreover, performance improvements and accelerated training can be achieved with effective pretraining strategies, which is particularly important for tasks with limited labeled B-Rep data. In this paper, we introduce BRepA, a unified self-supervised pretraining framework that explicitly reconstructs both the geometry and topology of B-Rep objects via graph-based modeling. By learning from large-scale unlabeled CAD data only once, BRepA produces representations that generalize across tasks and significantly enhance both discriminative and generative learning. On segmentation tasks, BRepA demonstrates remarkable data efficiency. For instance, with only 1% labeled samples, BRepA pretraining improves mIoU by 32.52% compared to models trained from scratch. On generative tasks, aligning diffusion model representations with pretrained BRepA features substantially accelerates convergence, achieving nearly 2 times faster training while improving generation quality under the same computational budget, despite the diffusion model being roughly 20 times larger than BRepA. Overall, our results show that geometry- and topology-aware B-Rep pretraining provides a powerful foundation for both understanding and generating CAD structures, serving as a versatile representation backbone for diverse downstream applications. We will release the code to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: BRepA: 面向CAD边界表示(B-Rep)的统一自监督预训练框架，通过图神经网络同时重建几何与拓扑，预训练一次即可泛化到分割与生成任务。
AI.motivation: B-Rep数据标注稀缺且结构特殊（几何基元+拓扑关系图），需要专用网络设计与高效预训练策略；现有方法缺少同时建模几何与拓扑的自监督预训练范式。
AI.method: 构建基于图的B-Rep编码器，设计自监督代理任务：显式重建几何（基元参数/点坐标）与拓扑（图连接关系），在无标注大规模CAD数据上一次性预训练，得到可迁移表示；下游将扩散模型表示与预训练特征对齐以加速生成任务。
AI.result: 分割任务数据高效：仅1%标注样本时相较从零训练mIoU提升32.52%；生成任务中与BRepA特征对齐使扩散模型收敛速度近2倍提升，并在相同算力预算下改善生成质量，尽管扩散模型约为BRepA的20倍大。
AI.conclusion: 几何+拓扑感知的B-Rep预训练可为CAD结构的理解与生成提供通用表示骨干，适用于多种下游应用。

title: Arboreus: A Realistic Boreal Forest Simulator with Topographic Terrain and Satellite-Informed Parametric Tree Distributions
summary: This work presents Arboreus, a realistic Boreal forest simulator, developed to support statistical validation of robotic autonomy algorithms in Boreal forest environments. Arboreus presents an automated methodology for synthesizing large-scale, data-informed, plausible forest worlds from parametric trees, height-variant terrain, and satellite-informed tree density distributions. The parametric generation of dominant Boreal tree species such as Birch, Spruce, and Pine is guided by trunk, canopy, and foliage parameters, extracted from growth studies in the Nordic areas. Tree distribution in an area of interest is guided by the Copernicus satellite dataset, which provides tree cover density and dominant species type at up to 10m raster resolution. The forest floor generation is guided by topographic data from the Swedish cadastral agency to produce realistic data-informed terrains. Given coordinates and extents of forested areas of interest, Arboreus synthesizes data-informed plausible forests, while offering flexibility to inject user observations of real forests (detail, age, dimensionality and tree count), which is critical for realistic synthetic data generation and for the testing of feature-sensitive autonomy algorithms. The applicability of Arboreus for benchmarking and validation of robot autonomy for different robot mobilities is demonstrated in Gazebosim, Unreal Engine, and Isaac Sim physics engines. The applicability of Arboreus as a source of synthetic forest data and its potential to support downstream forest resource mapping research (volume estimation, tree instance segmentation and stem attribute estimation) is also demonstrated. Arboreus has been open-sourced along with a dataset comprising 25 Boreal forest worlds of size 1000m2 corresponding to three real forest sites.

AI.tldr: Arboreus：基于参数化树木、卫星树冠密度与地形数据自动合成大规模北方森林仿真世界，并在 Gazebo/UE/Isaac Sim 中用于机器人自主性算法基准验证，开源并发布 25 个 1000m² 森林世界数据集。
AI.motivation: 北方森林环境缺乏真实、数据驱动且可规模化生成的仿真场景，导致机器人自主算法（尤其对植被/地形等特征敏感的算法）难以进行统计意义下的验证；同时森林资源调查类下游任务也缺少合成数据源。
AI.method: 以桦、云杉、松等北欧树种生长研究提取的树干、冠层、枝叶参数做参数化生成；用 Copernicus 卫星数据（≤10m 栅格的树冠密度与优势树种）约束分布；用瑞典地籍局地形数据生成森林地表；给定坐标与范围自动合成，并支持注入用户对真实林分的观测（细节、林龄、维度、株数）。
AI.result: 在 Gazebosim、Unreal Engine、Isaac Sim 三个物理引擎中演示了对不同移动能力机器人的自主性基准与验证；展示了作为合成森林数据源支持材积估计、单木实例分割、树干属性估计等下游研究的能力；开源并发布 3 个真实林址对应的 25 个 1000m² 森林世界。
AI.conclusion: Arboreus 提供了可复现、数据驱动且可调参的大规模北方森林合成流程，兼具机器人仿真验证与森林遥感/资源制图双用途，但物理与感知真实度仍需在更多真实部署中量化验证。

title: SWIR-cGAN: Synthesizing SWIR Bands Using VNIR Imagery from CBERS and AMAZONIA-1
comment: Available on: this https URL . Early Access
summary: Spectral band synthesis is an important research topic in remote sensing. The Brazilian satellites CBERS-4, CBERS-4A, and AMAZONIA-1 provide high temporal resolution (1-3 days) visible and near-infrared (VNIR) imagery through the Wide-Field Imager (WFI), but lack short-wave infrared (SWIR) bands. Recent deep learning methods have shown promising results for spectral synthesis, but challenges remain for cross-satellite generalization and spectrally distant bands. This paper presents a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) with an attention-enhanced U-net generator and a multi-loss objective to synthesize Sentinel-2/MSI SWIR bands 11 (SWIR-1) and 12 (SWIR-2) from WFI VNIR inputs. Experiments used 4,125 patches for training and cross-validation and 1,026 unseen patches for testing, with hyperparameters optimized using a subset of the training data. On SWIR-1, the model achieved SSIM of 0.900, PSNR of 31.44 dB, and MAE of 0.019 in TOA reflectance. On SWIR-2, it achieved SSIM of 0.917, PSNR of 33.35 dB, and MAE of 0.015. Benchmarking was performed on the test dataset, with each model optimized separately prior to evaluation. SWIR-cGAN outperformed the baselines, particularly for SWIR-2. The ablation study identified the multi-loss as the main performance contributor, while the attention and residual modules provided additional improvements. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of synthesizing SWIR bands from WFI imagery. The SWIR-cGAN is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SWIR-cGAN：以注意力增强 U-Net 为生成器的条件 GAN，结合多损失目标，将巴西 WFI 卫星的可见光—近红外（VNIR）影像合成出 Sentinel-2/MSI 的 SWIR-1（B11）与 SWIR-2（B12）波段；SWIR-1 达 SSIM 0.900 / PSNR 31.44 dB / MAE 0.019，SWIR-2 达 SSIM 0.917 / PSNR 33.35 dB / MAE 0.015，优于基线。
AI.motivation: CBERS-4/4A 与 AMAZONIA-1 通过 WFI 提供 1–3 天高时间分辨率的 VNIR 影像，但缺少 SWIR 波段；SWIR 对云识别、湿度与地表成分分析至关重要。现有深度学习光谱合成方法在跨卫星泛化和光谱跨度大的波段（VNIR→SWIR）上仍表现不佳。
AI.method: 条件 GAN 框架：生成器为注意力增强 U-Net（引入 attention 与残差模块），以 WFI 的 VNIR 输入为条件；训练目标采用多损失组合（对抗损失+内容/像素+结构相似性等）。数据：4,125 个 patch 用于训练与交叉验证，1,026 个未见过 patch 用于测试，超参在训练子集上调优；各基线单独调优后在同一测试集上基准比较，并做消融实验。
AI.result: SWIR-1：SSIM 0.900、PSNR 31.44 dB、MAE 0.019（TOA 反射率）；SWIR-2：SSIM 0.917、PSNR 33.35 dB、MAE 0.015。SWIR-cGAN 优于全部基线，在 SWIR-2 上优势更明显。消融显示多损失是主要性能来源，注意力与残差模块带来额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 验证了从 WFI VNIR 影像合成 SWIR 波段的可行性，可在缺少 SWIR 传感器的巴西卫星与 Sentinel-2 之间实现光谱一致性互补；代码开源。局限在于仍为像素级指标评估、跨卫星跨传感器泛化与下游任务（如云掩膜、分类）验证不足。

title: Code World Model 2.0: Towards Infinite Controllable Video Generation
comment: Project Page: this https URL
summary: Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry depending on the interaction, and streaming inference must operate in a few causal steps without accumulating drift across self-generated history. We present Invoker-Render, pairing a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model under a shared conditioning interface over structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language. Trained on an aligned approximately 200-hour multi-granularity corpus, Invoker-Render honors fine geometric constraints when supplied while synthesizing plausible local motion under coarse proxies, enabling runtime selection of input detail. To bridge bidirectional creation and real-time streaming without compounding step compression and rollout drift, we introduce Progressive Forcing (ProForcing). ProForcing first trains a causal predictor and distills it into a four-step renderer using histories derived from training videos. Training then shifts to continuous self-generated rollouts. A pipelined serving stack supports efficient streaming inference. Experiments show versatile control across proxy families, granularities, and camera paths, consistent gains over recent streaming baselines, and stable 30-minute racing rollouts that preserve scene and subject appearance.

AI.tldr: Invoker-Render：以结构代理（layout/articulated geometry）、外观参考与语言为统一条件接口，将双向创作模型与因果四步流式模型配对，并用 ProForcing 缓解步数压缩与自回归漂移，实现实时可交互视频渲染。
AI.motivation: 视觉代理将显式世界状态模拟与真实感视频合成解耦，可作为下游场景的控制接口；但实际渲染器需同时应对上游代理粒度差异（粗布局到精细关节几何）与少步因果流式推理不累积漂移两大挑战。
AI.method: 1) 统一条件接口：结构代理 + 外观参考 + 语言；2) 约200小时对齐的多粒度语料训练；3) 双向创作模型 + 因果四步流式模型双分支；4) Progressive Forcing：先训练因果预测器并借助训练视频历史蒸馏为四步渲染器，再切换到持续自生成 rollout 训练；5) 流水线服务栈支持高效流式推理。
AI.result: 在代理族、粒度与相机轨迹上实现通用控制；相较近期流式基线取得一致提升；支持30分钟赛车场景长时 rollout，场景与主体外观保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一的代理条件接口与 ProForcing 训练策略，可在保持细粒度几何约束的同时实现实时、低漂移的交互式视频世界模型渲染。

title: Sideslip-Conditioned Drift Trajectory Planning with Flow Matching and Control Barrier Functions
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Under review. Demonstration video: this https URL
summary: Drifting, the deliberate control of a vehicle at large sideslip angles, is relevant to both motorsport and recovery from unexpected oversteer. Existing autonomous drifting methods typically determine drift intensity through predefined reference trajectories, optimization objectives, or learned policy rewards, rather than accepting a desired sideslip angle as an explicit input. We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first generative drift trajectory planner explicitly conditioned on a requested peak sideslip angle. A conditional flow matching model is trained on demonstrated drift laps with hindsight-derived sideslip labels and refined through reinforcement fine-tuning. A control barrier function (CBF) correction is then applied to satisfy model-based road, tire friction, and actuator constraints at the planning waypoints. In closed-loop experiments in the racing simulator Assetto Corsa, a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks the generated plans for six requested sideslip angles from 20 deg to 45 deg, with 30 laps (approximately 75 km) per request. The median peak sideslip angle measured across drift-corner passes follows the requested angle, with a mean absolute error of 1.2 deg across the six conditions. Ablation experiments show that reinforcement fine-tuning improves conditioning accuracy, while CBF correction substantially reduces off-road and spin events.

AI.tldr: 提出首个以目标峰值侧滑角为显式条件的生成式漂移轨迹规划器：条件流匹配模型在专家漂移圈上训练（侧滑标签由后见法获得），再经强化微调提升条件精度，并对规划路点施加CBF修正以满足道路、轮胎摩擦与执行器约束；在Assetto Corsa中用NMPC闭环跟踪20°–45°六个请求角，峰值侧滑角平均绝对误差1.2°；消融显示RL微调改善条件精度，CBF显著减少出界与打转。
AI.motivation: 现有自主漂移方法通过预定义参考轨迹、优化目标或学习策略的奖励来间接确定漂移强度，无法把"期望侧滑角"作为显式输入；同时漂移规划需满足道路、轮胎摩擦与执行器约束，纯学习方案易失效。作者希望实现可指定漂移强度（峰值侧滑角）的可控生成式漂移规划。
AI.method: 1) 在示范漂移圈上训练条件流匹配（flow matching）轨迹规划模型，条件是请求峰值侧滑角，标签由后见法（hindsight）从示范数据中推导；2) 类RL/偏好式微调（"reinforcement fine-tuning"）优化条件对齐；3) 对生成路点施加控制障碍函数（CBF）修正，满足道路边界、轮胎摩擦与执行器约束；4) 闭环中由非线性MPC跟踪生成轨迹。
AI.result: Assetto Corsa闭环实验中，六个请求侧滑角（20°–45°）各跑30圈（约75 km），实测漂移过弯峰值侧滑角中位数随请求值变化，平均绝对误差1.2°。消融：强化微调提升条件精度；CBF修正显著降低出界和打转事件。
AI.conclusion: 生成式轨迹规划+条件下强化微调+约束修正的组合能在真实车辆动力学仿真中实现可指定强度的漂移，为高动态车辆控制提供了可控生成的范式；但验证限于单一赛车仿真器，缺乏实车与跨平台泛化证据。

title: A high-dimensional spatial-physical coupling operator for generalizable super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulent flows
summary: Accurate representation of turbulent flows requires simultaneously capturing multi-scale spatial structures and the complex, nonlinear coupling between distinct physical quantities (\textit{e.g.}, velocity components and density). In practice, however, turbulent data are often constrained by low spatial resolution due to hardware limitations and computational costs. While current data-driven super-resolution methods have shown promise by learning mappings via convolutional neural networks (CNNs), they typically treat physical variables as independent channels. This simplified approach neglects intrinsic cross-variable correlations, causing models to struggle with high-fidelity reconstruction, particularly under extremely sparse conditions or in out-of-distribution regimes. To bridge this gap, we propose an architecture-agnostic spatial-physical coupling operator that extends the standard convolution into a joint spatial-variable dimension. Unlike conventional linear channel mixing, our framework constructs a unified spatial-physical representation within CNNs to explicitly capture local inter-variable interactions. By lifting features into a higher-dimensional manifold, this operator significantly enhances the model's representation capacity. Experiments demonstrate that this approach enables strong reconstruction performance and zero-shot generalization, offering a physics-aware inductive bias for super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulence. More broadly, this work suggests that high-dimensional operators offer a promising avenue for modeling intricate multi-scale turbulent flows.

AI.tldr: 提出架构无关的“空间-物理耦合算子”，将标准卷积扩展到空间-变量联合维度，显式建模湍流多物理量之间的局部交互，用于三维湍流数据的超分辨率重建。
