AI.motivation: 湍流数据常受硬件与计算成本限制而空间分辨率低；现有CNN超分方法将速度分量、密度等物理量当作独立通道处理，忽略跨变量内禀相关性，导致在极稀疏采样与分布外场景下重建质量差。
AI.method: 设计空间-物理耦合算子：把特征提升到空间×变量联合的高维流形，将卷积从仅空间维扩展到空间-变量联合维，替代传统线性通道混合，从而在CNN内部构造统一的空间-物理表示并捕获局部跨变量交互；该算子与具体网络架构无关，可即插即用。
AI.result: 实验表明该算子带来强重建性能与零样本泛化能力，为三维湍流超分提供了物理感知的归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: 高维算子为建模复杂多尺度湍流提供了一条有前景的路径，跨变量耦合是提升物理场重建保真度的关键。

title: Fiberpose: state-of-the-art fiber morphometry and instance segmentation with a distance-transform neural network
summary: Analysis of fibrous structures in SEM images is a routine task in biomedical engineering and materials science. However, most available methods for fiber quantification still rely on classical image binarization followed by simple post-processing. These approaches often produce unreliable results in images with weak boundaries, heterogeneous contrast, and densely packed fibers. Here, we introduce Fiberpose, a framework that reformulates fiber analysis as direct regression of a smooth distance-transform (DT) field, together with a novel set of geometry-based algorithms specifically adapted to this representation. The predicted field directly encodes fiber geometry, while the accompanying algorithms enable instance reconstruction and measurement of diameter and orientation within a unified workflow. The framework is implemented as a standalone Python desktop application and a web tool this https URL . On an independent dataset of fibrous SEM images, Fiberpose achieved state-of-the-art instance-segmentation accuracy in comparison with SAM2 and Cellpose-SAM, and more accurate diameter measurements than DiameterJ, Fibar and GIFT. The method remains effective in dense and weakly contrasted regions and shows qualitative generalization across microscopy modalities not represented in the training data. Fiberpose therefore provides an interpretable geometric representation and an automated pipeline for reproducible quantitative characterization of fibrous materials.

AI.tldr: Fiberpose将纤维分析重构为平滑距离变换(DT)场回归，并配套几何算法实现实例重建与直径/取向测量
AI.motivation: 传统纤维量化依赖图像二值化+后处理，在弱边界、对比度不均、纤维密集的SEM图像上不可靠
AI.method: 端到端回归平滑距离变换场，场直接编码纤维几何；设计基于几何的算法从DT场重建纤维实例并测直径与取向；封装为Python桌面应用与Web工具
AI.result: 在独立SEM纤维数据集上实例分割精度优于SAM2与Cellpose-SAM，直径测量优于DiameterJ、Fibar、GIFT；密集与弱对比区域仍有效，对未见显微模态有定性泛化
AI.conclusion: 提供可解释的几何表示与自动化流程，实现纤维材料可复现的定量表征

title: Sim2CBF: From Forward Simulations to Implicit Control Barrier Function Safety Filtering without Model Derivatives
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures
summary: Failure avoidance in complex robot-environment interactions is challenging because the underlying dynamics are difficult to model accurately, and available predictive models may not provide reliable derivatives. We present Sim2CBF, a failure-avoidance framework that solves the Control Barrier Function (CBF)-Safety Filter (SF) optimization problem using only forward-model evaluations, thereby avoiding differentiation of the predictive model. Specifically, we approximate the CBF constraint using finite differences and local linear interpolation over sampled control inputs while preserving failure-avoidance guarantees. The underlying CBF is implicit and constructed from backup-policy rollouts, enabling the use of expressive predictive models such as physics-based simulators and learned world models. Compared with purely sampling-based SFs, our formulation requires fewer control samples and yields less conservative behavior than direct nominal-backup blending. We evaluate Sim2CBF in simulation, hardware box-toppling, and vision-based control tasks, demonstrating its applicability to contact-rich and learned dynamics, as well as its adaptability to changes in the predictive model.

AI.tldr: Sim2CBF仅用前向模型评估求解CBF安全滤波问题：通过有限差分与局部线性插值近似CBF约束，隐式CBF由备份策略rollout构建，无需对预测模型求导，在仿真、实物箱体推倒与视觉控制任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 复杂机器人-环境交互中失效规避困难：动力学难以精确建模，可用预测模型（物理模拟器、学习世界模型）往往不可微或导数不可靠，且采样频繁导致安全隐患。
AI.method: 建立隐式CBF（基于备份策略rollout），在采样控制输入上用有限差分+局部线性插值近似CBF约束，将安全滤波转化为仅需前向评估的优化问题并保持失效规避保证；相比纯采样SF需更少控制样本，比名义-备份直接混合更少保守性。
AI.result: 在仿真、硬件箱体推倒（contact-rich）与视觉控制任务中验证有效性；适用于接触丰富与学习动力学，并展现对预测模型变化的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 提供免梯度、可对接任意前向预测模型的安全滤波器范式，兼顾样本效率与保守性，适合sim-to-real安全部署。

title: Is model self-assessment enough for diverse LVLM ensembles?
summary: Ensembles of diverse Large Vision Language Models have demonstrated performance beyond that of single models across multiple datasets and tasks. However, the necessary aggregation process usually relies on training, parameter fitting, or complex task-specific pipelines. Furthermore, evaluation is limited, making a fair comparison difficult. We create a unified pipeline where we perform candidate response selection: we build an ensemble by selecting the best answer from a set provided by different models. We comprehensively evaluate across 34 different means of confidence estimation, 24 ensemble configurations, 20 datasets, and two prompt specifications. We show that simple training and parameter-free approaches can be sufficient, even for ensembles of different architectures. These simple self-assessment approaches rely solely on each constituent model's confidence, without explicit calibration, yet are able to perform better than said constituent models. They are also competitive with more involved alternatives on standard metrics such as accuracy, including on open-ended problems. However, we also discover that dataset, ensemble composition, and prompt wording are key confounding variables insufficiently explored by prior work that significantly affect ensemble performance, such that the ensemble can perform worse than its best constituent model. These must be optimized for to get the most out of ensembles, at the cost of limiting their generalizability. We recommend that practitioners consider training-free ensembles only if deployment conditions can be precisely characterized, with Best-of-N configurations of strong models being a good starting point.

AI.tldr: 对34种置信度估计方法、24种集成配置、20个数据集和2种提示进行统一的无训练集成评估，发现仅依赖成员模型自评置信度选取最佳回答即可超越单模型，但数据集、集成构成与提示措辞是显著混淆变量。
AI.motivation: 多LVLM集成虽有增益，但聚合过程常依赖训练、参数拟合或任务特定流程，且评估不统一、难以公平比较；作者希望建立一个统一流程并系统性地厘清哪些集成因素真正起作用。
AI.method: 构建候选回答选择式（Best-of-N / candidate selection）集成流水线，用各成员模型给出的回答集合中挑选最佳答案；系统性评测34种置信度估计方式、24种集成配置、20个数据集、2种提示规格，对比训练型与免训练/免参数的自评估策略。
AI.result: 免训练、免参数的自评置信度方法（无需显式校准）即可优于各成员模型，在accuracy等标准指标（含开放式问题）上与更复杂的替代方案相当；但数据集、集成构成和提示措辞作为关键混淆变量会显著影响性能，甚至使集成劣于最佳单体。
AI.conclusion: 只有在部署条件可被精确刻画时才推荐使用免训练集成，并以强模型的Best-of-N配置作为起点；泛化性与最优性能之间存在权衡，需针对具体场景调优。

title: Hierarchical Diffusion Transformer for End-to-End Image Generation
comment: Under Review
summary: Pixel-space diffusion learns visual representations and image generation jointly in a single end-to-end training stage, without a separately pretrained visual encoder. However, plain pixel-space Transformers still trail leading two-stage latent diffusion models in generation quality and training efficiency. We hypothesize that part of this gap arises from retaining one token per patch throughout the backbone, which does not explicitly encourage a visual hierarchy that summarizes related content at progressively coarser levels. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers (HiT), which progressively group related tokens and represent each group with a single token. The main Transformer bottleneck processes these compact group tokens, and ungrouping restores features to their original image positions. A compression budget regulates the average compression ratio across the batch, allowing group memberships and counts to vary across images and diffusion timesteps during both training and generation. The model exhibits emergent semantic structure, learning to group coherent objects and object parts without segmentation labels. In text-to-image generation, HiT further learns to group caption words with image patches depicting the same concepts, without region annotations. HiT achieves 1.48 FID on ImageNet $256\times256$ and reaches comparable generation quality to JiT using approximately 40\% of its cumulative training FLOPs. For text-to-image generation, HiT exceeds UniLiP's average score across five benchmarks with roughly $6\times$ fewer denoiser parameters and $3\times$ fewer forward FLOPs. These results suggest that learning a visual hierarchy within the generator breaks down the barrier to stronger image generation without external visual pretraining.

AI.tldr: HiT（Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers）在像素空间扩散 Transformer 中引入分层 token 聚合机制：将相关 patch token 分组并以单一 group token 表示，主干网络仅处理压缩后的 group token，再 ungroup 还原到原图像位置，从而在生成器内部形成视觉层级结构，无需外部视觉预训练。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散可端到端联合学习表征与生成，但每个 patch 始终保持一个 token，缺乏渐进式粗化的视觉层级，导致生成质量与训练效率落后于两阶段潜空间扩散模型。
AI.method: 提出 HiT：在 backbone 中按内容相关性将 token 分组（group），每组用单个 group token 表征，主 Transformer 瓶颈只处理这些紧凑 group token，随后 ungroup 恢复至原图像位置；引入"压缩预算"约束 batch 平均压缩比，使分组归属与数量可随图像及扩散时间步动态变化（训练与生成阶段皆然）。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 上 FID 达 1.48；达到与 JiT 相当的生成质量仅需约 40% 累计训练 FLOPs。文本到图像任务中，在 5 个基准上的平均分超过 UniLiP，同时去噪器参数约少 6×、前向 FLOPs 约少 3×。
AI.conclusion: 在生成器内部学习视觉层级结构可打破无外部视觉预训练条件下强图像生成的瓶颈；模型在无分割/区域标注下自发涌现语义分组能力（物体、部件及文本词-图像块对应）。

title: Training-Free Building Change Detection with Example-Induced Discriminants
summary: Building change detection (BCD) relies on dense annotations that are costly to collect across regions. A few annotated examples offer a more economical way to specify the target, but change maps provide incomplete building supervision: they label only changed buildings and leave the building-containing date unspecified. Our key observation is that these annotations nevertheless reveal features that recognize buildings in other images, including unchanged ones. We present Linear INduced Discriminants (LIND), a training-free framework that turns regional feature contrasts into a reusable linear building classifier. Using a single frozen vision transformer, it unifies building recognition and temporal comparison in the same feature space. This approach requires neither text prompts nor an auxiliary segmentation model. Only one parameter is tuned on a single validation dataset and then kept fixed across datasets and shot settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong detection accuracy, cross-dataset transfer, and efficient inference, with extensions to other semantic classes and broader land-cover changes. Change annotations thus provide a compact visual specification for detection in new scenes. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: LIND：无需训练的框架，将少样本变化标注转化为可复用的线性建筑判别器，统一建筑识别与时相比较。
AI.motivation: 建筑变化检测（BCD）依赖昂贵的密集标注。少样本变化图标注成本低，但监督不完整：只标注变化建筑，"含建筑的那一期"未指明。作者观察到这些标注仍蕴含可迁移的建筑特征。
AI.method: 使用单个冻结的视觉Transformer，在同一特征空间内完成建筑识别与时相比较。将区域级特征对比构造为线性判别器（Linear INduced Discriminants），无需文本提示、无需辅助分割模型，仅在单一验证集上调一个参数后跨数据集/跨样本数固定。
AI.result: 大量实验显示较强的检测精度、跨数据集迁移能力与高效推理，并可扩展到其他语义类别及更宽泛的地表覆盖变化。
AI.conclusion: 变化标注可作为紧凑的视觉规约，用于新场景的检测，显著降低标注成本。

title: CodeReel: Accelerating Code-to-Video Agents with Exact Frame Reuse and Blocking-Aware Scheduling
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables
summary: Coding agents make videos by writing and refining programs in a build--inspect--edit loop. A finished film costs a median of $2.85 in model calls and 11 minutes, over a third of that time in builds that block the agent. We find that much of this time is avoidable, for two reasons. First, 37.5% of the frames of a session's later films were drawn before, many shifted in time or inside an edited scene. Second, half of the builds stop at a check, where the agent needs only the verdict, but which builds stop is unknown until the checks finish. We present CodeReel, a training-free execution layer behind agents' existing commands. Exact frame reuse keys each frame by its drawing commands, regardless of its position in time, and reuses each frame whose key recurs. Blocking-aware scheduling runs the checks first and starts the render alongside them, at idle priority, unless the session's recent builds make a pass unlikely. Scheduling spends CPU to answer sooner and reuse returns it; exact keys let later versions use frames rendered for a failed one as the agent thinks. We introduce EditLoop, a benchmark of replayable agent sessions whose films are checked against renders from scratch. On it, CodeReel cuts the agent's wait by 36.3% against Rebuild, a warm pipeline with parallel rendering, and by 57.9% against Sequential, today's step-by-step pipeline. On time-shifting edits its reuse renders 43.9%, close to the 43.0% whose pixels are new, while Manim-style caching renders 99.8%. With real agents, the median wait per build is 0.62x Rebuild's in Claude Code, on topics never used in development, and 0.67x in Codex CLI. The gain holds for five models and two frameworks.

AI.tldr: CodeReel 是无训练的执行层，通过"按绘制命令精确匹配帧"复用与"阻塞感知调度"（先跑检查、并行渲染）缩短编码智能体制作视频的等待时间：相对 Rebuild 减 36.3%、相对 Sequential 减 57.9%，Claude Code 中单次构建中位等待为 0.62x。
AI.motivation: 编码智能机制作视频（build-inspect-edit 循环）成本高：中位 2.85 美元、11 分钟，其中超三分之一时间阻塞在构建上。作者发现两类可避免的浪费：会话后续影片 37.5% 的帧此前已渲染过（但因时间平移或镜头编辑而未被识别复用）；一半的构建停在检查环节，但哪次会失败需等检查结束才知。
AI.method: 1) 精确帧复用：以"绘制命令"为键（与时间位置无关），键重复即复用已渲染帧，且失败版本渲染出的帧可被后续版本复用；2) 阻塞感知调度：先执行检查，同时以空闲优先级启动渲染，若会话近期构建通过率低则跳过并行；3) 提出 EditLoop 基准，为可重放智能体会话，影片与从头渲染结果比对校验。
AI.result: 等待时间相对 Rebuild（并行渲染的热流水线）减少 36.3%，相对 Sequential（逐步流水线）减少 57.9%。时间平移类编辑上复用覆盖 43.9%，接近真实新像素比例 43.0%，而 Manim 式缓存命中 99.8%（即大多数无效渲染）。真实智能体部署：Claude Code 中每次构建中位等待为 Rebuild 的 0.62x（未见过的题目），Codex CLI 为 0.67x；增益在 5 个模型、2 个框架上保持。
AI.conclusion: 帧级精确复用 + 阻塞感知调度可在不训练、不改智能体接口的前提下显著降低视频生成式智能体的实际等待成本，并具备跨模型、跨框架的稳健性。

title: MI-Hyper: Generating Multiple Instance Models for Weight Space Transfer Learning in Histopathology via Mixed Tasks Pretrained HyperNetwork
summary: Zero-shot whole-slide image (WSI) prediction aims to generalize to new pathology tasks without parameter updates at deployment. MI-Zero makes these predictions by pooling patch-text similarities. Conditional weight generation, combined with supervision from diverse pathology tasks, offers an alternative: learning to construct predictive rules from task descriptions. We introduce MI-Hyper, a hypernetwork pretrained across mixed tasks to generate the aggregation and classification weights of multiple instance learning (MIL) models. We first train the generator and a shared MIL basis jointly using source labels. We then freeze the basis and refine the generator. The generated task weights are reused across cases. Across 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, MI-Hyper improves mean AUC, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 over MI-Zero by 1.85, 1.17 and 0.57 percentage points, respectively. On some molecular prediction tasks, both AUC and balanced accuracy improve by more than 20 points. These results support task-conditioned weight generation as a promising approach to weight-space transfer for long-sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: MI-Hyper用超网络从任务描述生成MIL聚合与分类权重，在52个数据集308个任务上超越MI-Zero的零样本WSI预测，属于权重空间迁移思路。
AI.motivation: 零样本全切片图像（WSI）预测需要在部署时不更新参数即泛化到新病理任务。现有MI-Zero依赖patch-text相似度池化，本文试图改为从任务描述直接构造预测规则，即在权重空间做任务条件化迁移。
AI.method: 超网络（hypernetwork）在混合任务上预训练，生成MIL模型的聚合权重与分类权重。两阶段训练：先用源标签联合训练生成器与共享MIL基座，然后冻结基座、精化生成器；生成的各任务权重可在不同case间复用。
AI.result: 在52个病理数据集共308个任务上，相对MI-Zero平均AUC提升1.85个百分点、平衡准确率提升1.17、macro-F1提升0.57；部分分子预测任务AUC与平衡准确率提升超过20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 任务条件化的权重生成是长序列建模中权重空间迁移的一种有前景方案；但验证局限于病理WSI领域，未涉及物理AI/具身等核心场景。

title: Rescaling OLS-Merged Adapters To Improve Personalized Image Generation
summary: Merging multiple adapters into a single image generation model reduces deployment costs while preserving diverse task capabilities or personalization modes. State-of-the-art methods such as RegMean, Mix-of-Show, and Subspace Routing fit the outputs of the merged model to those of the individual adapters using ordinary least squares (OLS). We show that this reconstruction objective systematically shrinks task-specific signals whenever the activation distributions of different tasks overlap, producing a merged adapter that is too weak for downstream use. We derive a decomposition that quantifies this shrinkage and propose rescaling the merged update to restore signal strength. On multi-subject personalization with up to 30 merged adapters, rescaling substantially improves subject fidelity over unscaled baselines. Our approach also improves results on style transfer, concept erasure, image classification, and LLM-based text classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，基于OLS输出重建的adapter合并方法（RegMean、Mix-of-Show、Subspace Routing）在任务激活分布重叠时会系统性削弱任务特定信号，并据此提出对合并后的更新量进行重缩放以恢复信号强度。
AI.motivation: 多adapter合并可降低部署成本并保留多样化能力，但现有SOTA合并方法以最小二乘拟合各adapter的输出，会隐性损害合并后的任务能力，需要诊断并修正这一偏差。
AI.method: 推导一个分解式，量化OLS重建目标带来的任务信号收缩（shrinkage）效应，并据此对合并后的参数更新施加重缩放（rescaling）以恢复原有信号强度；方法为通用后处理，可即插即用于RegMean、Mix-of-Show、Subspace Routing等。
AI.result: 在最多30个adapter的多主体个性化合并中，重缩放显著优于未缩放基线的主体保真度；在风格迁移、概念擦除、图像分类及基于LLM的文本分类上同样取得提升。
AI.conclusion: OLS式输出重建在激活重叠时会导致合并adapter欠强；解析重缩放是低成本、通用的修正手段，适用于图像生成与分类等多类adapter合并场景。

title: SpikWM: Efficient End-to-End Spiking World Modeling for Visual Planning
summary: Goal-conditioned planning with image observations and goals requires predictions that distinguish visual states and action consequences. Spiking neural networks offer sparse computation, but single-step spikes can obscure motion cues and merge actions with different physical outcomes. We propose the Spiking Latent World Model (SpikWM), an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) with one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. Spiking Regional Encoding retains spatial cues through regional pooling. Bi-Spike Action Encoding combines positive and negative binary responses, while Causal Membrane Prediction carries subthreshold evidence across the latent history with learned group-wise time constants. The encoder and predictor are trained jointly on reward-free image--action trajectories using next-embedding prediction and SIGReg. With a common planner, SpikWM achieves mean success rates of $88.67\%$, $97.33\%$, $99.33\%$, and $86.67\%$ on Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube, respectively, outperforming two spiking baselines. Push-T ablations support each module, and controlled replays examine responses to appearance and physical state changes. Under a matched planning budget, SpikWM reduces estimated arithmetic energy by $75.6\%$ relative to LeWM. Code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SpikWM：面向图像目标条件规划的脉冲神经网络JEPA世界模型，单步脉冲仿真、区域池化编码、双脉冲动作编码与因果膜预测，在Push-T等四个任务上超越脉冲基线并降低约75.6%计算能耗。
AI.motivation: 图像观测与目标条件下的规划需要能区分视觉状态与动作后果的预测模型；脉冲神经网络计算稀疏，但单步脉冲会丢失运动线索并混淆具有不同物理结果的动作。作者希望在保持脉冲网络能效优势的同时获得可用的潜在世界模型。
AI.method: 提出SpikWM，端到端联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）：每帧图像仅一步仿真、每个潜在位置一次神经更新。包含三个模块：脉冲区域编码（Spiking Regional Encoding）通过区域池化保留空间线索；双脉冲动作编码（Bi-Spike Action Encoding）用正负二值响应组合表达动作；因果膜预测（Causal Membrane Prediction）以可学习的分组时间常数在潜在历史中传递阈值下证据。编码器与预测器在无奖励的图像—动作轨迹上以next-embedding预测与SIGReg联合训练，下游使用通用规划器。
AI.result: 在Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher、OGBench-Cube上平均成功率分别为88.67%、97.33%、99.33%、86.67%，优于两个脉冲基线；Push-T消融验证各模块有效性，受控回放检验了对表观与物理状态变化的响应；在匹配规划预算下相对LeWM降低约75.6%估计算术能耗。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲计算与JEPA潜在世界模型可有效结合，在低能耗下实现有竞争力的目标条件规划性能，但验证限于仿真基准，尚缺真实机器人部署证据。

title: Physics-Informed Tactile-based Shape Estimation of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: Accurate shape estimation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation, often hindered by visual occlusions and the high-dimensional configuration space of flexible materials. While Force/Torque (F/T) and vision-centric methods have been proposed, they frequently struggle with grasp-site ambiguities and environmental interference. In this letter, we investigate the hypothesis that global shape estimation can be achieved through tactile sensing and proprioception, without any visual perception. We contend that dense, high-resolution tactile imprints capture critical boundary conditions and contact gradients that are sufficient to resolve the high-dimensional configuration of the DLO. To prove this, we introduce a Physics-Informed Vision Transformer (ViT) framework that maps tactile images to a 3D vertex chain. By leveraging self-attention mechanisms and a physics-weighted loss function, our model enforces structural priors to ensure that the predicted geometry adheres to the object's physical manifold. Experimental results demonstrate that our tactile-based approach achieves superior reconstruction accuracy across Euclidean and Chamfer metrics. Furthermore, we demonstrate the efficiency of this modality, achieving model transfer to novel DLO materials and geometries. Our findings suggest that tactile feedback provides a robust and computationally efficient alternative for DLO state estimation in visually degraded or occluded environments.

AI.tldr: 仅用触觉图像与本体感知，通过物理约束的ViT回归DLO全局3D形状。
AI.motivation: 柔性线性物体(DLO)形状估计受视觉遮挡与高维构型空间困扰；力矩与视觉方法存在抓取位歧义和环境干扰。本文假设密集高分辨率触觉印痕可提供边界条件与接触梯度，足以确定DLO高维构型。
AI.method: 提出Physics-Informed Vision Transformer框架：将触觉图像映射为3D顶点链；用自注意力机制建模全局依赖，并引入物理加权损失函数以施加结构先验，使预测几何贴合物体物理流形。全程不使用视觉感知。
AI.result: 在欧氏距离与Chamfer距离指标上均取得更优重建精度，优于对比方法；模型可迁移至新DLO材料与几何形态，计算效率较高。
AI.conclusion: 触觉反馈为视觉退化或遮挡环境下的DLO状态估计提供了鲁棒且计算高效的替代方案，验证无需视觉的全局形状估计可行性。

title: Making Future-Predictive Representations Actionable
comment: 15 pages, 6 main figures, including supplementary material
summary: Recent world action models (WAMs) drop future prediction at inference, assuming that representations learned through auxiliary future supervision still benefit action generation. However, our layerwise analysis of Fast-WAM reveals a depth-dependent mismatch: while probes decode future state transitions more accurately from deeper visual layers, the gradients and visual focuses of the future and action objectives increasingly diverge with depth, leaving much of this predictive information unused by the action pathway. To address this issue, we introduce RelayWAM, which adds an explicit transition space between the video and action backbones. Conditioned on the task instruction, robot state, and current action estimate, recurrent transition layers extract step-relevant predictive cues across depth and relay them directly into the action attention, without generating future frames at inference. Experiments show that RelayWAM substantially amplifies the benefit of future supervision, translating into stronger generalization under distribution shifts in both simulation and real-world robot tasks. On LIBERO-Plus, RelayWAM achieves 72.03% mean success, compared to 56.42% without future supervision and 51.50% for Fast-WAM.

AI.tldr: RelayWAM在视频骨干与动作骨干之间插入显式"转移空间"，用循环转移层按深度提取步相关预测线索并直接中继到动作注意力，缓解未来预测与动作目标随深度发散的问题，推理时无需生成未来帧。
AI.motivation: Fast-WAM等世界动作模型推理时丢弃未来预测，假设辅助未来监督学到的表征仍有益于动作生成。但作者的分层探针分析发现深度依赖的错配：深层视觉层可更准确解码未来状态转移，而未来目标与动作目标的梯度及视觉关注随深度愈发分歧，导致大量预测信息未被动作通路利用。
AI.method: 在视频与动作骨干之间引入显式过渡空间；以任务指令、机器人状态和当前动作估计为条件，用循环过渡层跨深度提取与当前步相关的预测线索，并将其直接中继注入动作注意力；推理阶段不生成未来帧。
AI.result: 未来监督的收益被显著放大，在仿真与真实机器人任务的分布偏移下泛化更强；LIBERO-Plus上平均成功率72.03%，无未来监督为56.42%，Fast-WAM为51.50%。
AI.conclusion: 问题定位准确（深度依赖的未来—动作表征错配），解法轻量且推理高效（无未来帧生成），在分布偏移泛化上获得明确增益；局限在于真实机器人评测规模与基线覆盖披露不足，未见代码/项目链接。

title: CAST: Calibrating Correspondences for Training-Free Biomedical In-Context Segmentation
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: Biomedical image segmentation must keep up with new anatomical structures, subjects, imaging modalities, and acquisition protocols, yet dense expert annotations are scarce and models trained on one cohort often struggle to transfer. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers a way out: a new structure is specified by a few annotated exemplars at inference time. However, reliable correspondence remains challenging in biomedical images, where adjacent structures often share similar appearances, and variations across subjects and imaging conditions further obscure their distinctions. We introduce CAST, a training-free framework built on a frozen DINOv3 backbone to calibrate fine-grained correspondences. Its stability test improves feature reliability at both global and patch-specific levels, while its coherence test assesses whether candidate correspondences are supported by consistent local structural context. Together, these tests enable more reliable correspondence across diverse anatomical structures and imaging conditions. Across eight biomedical benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D segmentation, cross-subject, and cross-modality transfer, CAST outperforms the strongest overall baseline by 12.34 percentage points in Dice and ranks first across all six volumetric settings. The versatility of CAST further opens up opportunities for challenging biomedical applications, including 2D-to-3D segmentation and atlas label transfer.

AI.tldr: CAST：基于冻结 DINOv3 的无训练 in-context 生物医学图像分割框架，通过稳定性测试与一致性测试校准细粒度特征对应。
AI.motivation: 生物医学图像标注稀缺、跨队列迁移差，in-context 分割（少样本给定结构样例）有前景，但相邻结构外观相似、跨被试与成像条件差异导致可靠对应难以建立。
AI.method: 训练无关框架，冻结 DINOv3 backbone；稳定性测试在全局与 patch 级提升特征可靠性；一致性测试评估候选对应是否被一致的局部结构上下文支持；两者联合提升对应可靠性。
AI.result: 在八个 2D/3D、跨被试、跨模态基准上，Dice 超过最强整体基线 12.34 个百分点，并在全部六个 3D 体积设置中排名第一；可扩展到 2D→3D 分割与 atlas 标签迁移。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的特征对应校准即可显著提升生物医学 in-context 分割的跨域泛化，且具备向跨维度与图谱迁移等任务的延展性。

title: The Rhythm of Generated Video: Latent Chunking Leaves Periodic Traces in Compressed Bitstreams
comment: Manuscript, 9 pages, Computer vision, AI-generated video detection, compressed-domain analysis, video coding,
summary: Most AI-generated video detectors analyze decoded pixels and overlook how videos are produced. We show that causal video autoencoders leave an architecture-specific rhythm in compressed bitstreams: their temporal stride concentrates unpredictable content at latent-chunk boundaries, so rate-distortion optimized encoders allocate bits periodically. Without decoding pixels, we observe four-frame pulses in CogVideoX and Wan2.2 and eight-frame pulses in LTX-Video, which are absent from content-matched camera footage. Passing camera footage through a generator's autoencoder alone induces the pulse, supporting its proposed origin. A training-free peak-ratio statistic separates generated from camera video (AUC 0.84-0.94) and persists across tested quantization settings and H.264/H.265 encoding. Frame-size traces also identify four commercial generators, with 89.2%, 84.1%, and 83.0% accuracy under H.264, H.265, and AV1, beating the pixel-based UnivFD baseline (72.7-73.6%). Our results directly link generative architecture to measurable coding demand.

AI.tldr: 提出无解码的生成视频检测方法：因果视频自编码器的时间步幅会在压缩比特流中留下周期性“脉冲”指纹（CogVideoX/Wan2.2为4帧、LTX-Video为8帧），用免训练的峰值比统计量可实现AUC 0.84–0.94的生成/真实视频鉴别，并能以83–89%准确率识别四个商业生成器，优于像素级UnivFD基线。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成视频检测器仅分析解码后的像素，忽略了视频的生成与压缩生产流程；作者希望证明生成架构本身会在码流层面留下可测量的痕迹，从而得到更廉价、更鲁棒的取证信号。
AI.method: 从码率-失真优化编码的比特分配出发，论证因果视频自编码器的时间步幅会把不可预测内容集中到latent chunk边界，导致周期性比特分配；在不解码像素的条件下分析帧大小/码率轨迹，用免训练的峰值比统计量做二分类，并用帧大小轨迹做生成器溯源；辅以“将真实相机视频单独过一遍生成器自编码器即诱发脉冲”的对照实验。
AI.result: 观测到CogVideoX与Wan2.2的四帧周期、LTX-Video的八帧周期，内容匹配的真实相机视频中不存在；生成/真实鉴别AUC 0.84–0.94，且跨测试的量化设置与H.264/H.265编码保持稳定；四个商业生成器溯源准确率在H.264/H.265/AV1下分别为89.2%/84.1%/83.0%，超过像素基线UnivFD（72.7–73.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 建立了生成架构与可测量编码需求之间的直接因果联系，提出一种轻量、免训练、跨编解码器鲁棒的码流级视频取证范式；局限在于结论主要基于特定开源/商业模型，面对抗性重编码与未来架构变化的泛化性仍需验证。

title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures
summary: In automated driving, world models provide future scene predictions for evaluating candidate trajectories, but fixed selection rules may not capture scene-dependent trade-offs. We propose a residual-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework for lightweight trajectory selection with a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The framework uses proximal policy optimization (PPO) to fine-tune a joint policy over candidate selection and bounded trajectory residuals. A context-conditioned ranking network learns candidate preferences from feedback obtained by evaluating local perturbations of the selected trajectories. At inference, the selector combines learned preference and predicted risk ranks using fixed weights and returns the selected candidate trajectory without modification. Fine-tuning updates 16,106 parameters across the actor and critic, while the deployed selector retains only the 11,725-parameter ranking network, with the residual branch and critic used exclusively during training. In open-loop evaluation on the nuScenes validation set, the method reduces average Euclidean trajectory error (L2) by 3.99% relative to the RiskWorld model baseline without RL-based selection. Under matched budgets for feedback accesses and actor updates, residual exploration reduces L2 by 0.83% relative to the categorical PPO variant trained without residuals. The method also maintains lower L2 than RiskWorld when risk features are removed or shuffled.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的RiskWorld世界模型与固定候选轨迹库上，用PPO微调"候选选择+有界轨迹残差"的联合策略；部署时仅保留11,725参数的上下文条件排序网络。nuScenes验证集开环L2较RiskWorld基线降低3.99%，同预算下残差探索较纯分类PPO再降0.83%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶世界模型为候选轨迹提供未来场景预测，但固定选择规则难以适应场景相关的权衡；同时在部署端需要极轻量、低计算开销的选择器。
AI.method: 冻结世界模型+固定候选库；PPO联合优化候选选择与有界轨迹残差（actor+critic共16,106参数）。上下文条件排序网络从"对所选轨迹做局部扰动后评估得到"的反馈中学习候选偏好；推理时以固定权重融合学习到的偏好与预测风险排序，并原样返回所选候选轨迹（不使用残差、不用critic）。
AI.result: nuScenes val开环平均L2较RiskWorld基线降3.99%；在反馈访问与actor更新预算匹配下，含残差探索较无残差的分类PPO变体再降0.83%；去除或打乱风险特征时仍保持低于RiskWorld的L2。
AI.conclusion: 残差引导RL可作为一种轻量、可插拔的候选轨迹选择微调方案，提升冻结世界模型的规划质量且部署开销极小；但证据仅限开环离线指标，缺乏闭环仿真与实车验证。

title: Tracking Ethological Behaviors of Broiler Chickens Through Computer Vision (YoloV11) Using an Android Mobile Device
summary: This study developed and evaluated a computer vision model for automated ethological behavior classification of broiler chickens in climate-controlled poultry houses. Using publicly available videos preprocessed and manually annotated into three classes (sitting, standing, and feeding), the YOLOv11 model was trained and deployed on an Android application via TFLite conversion. Exploratory analysis ensured dataset consistency and visual quality, while evaluation showed class-dependent performance: higher robustness for static postures (sitting, AP=0.531; precision=100%) and lower accuracy for dynamic behaviors (feeding, AP=0.292; recall=0.20). Tests with unseen images demonstrated significant improvements, achieving accuracies of 98.04% for sitting, 83.33% for standing, and 67.65% for feeding. The model showed effective generalization in real farm environments, supporting its potential for continuous behavioral monitoring, early welfare assessments, and decision-making in precision poultry farming. These findings establish a technical foundation for future mobile-based applications at commercial scale, reinforcing the role of computer vision in automated animal welfare evaluation.

AI.tldr: YOLOv11+TFLite 肉鸡行为分类（坐/站/采食）及其 Android 部署。
AI.motivation: 面向精准养殖的肉鸡行为自动监测需求，用计算机视觉替代人工观察以支持福利评估与决策。
AI.method: 公开视频预处理+人工标注三类；探索性分析保证数据一致性；训练 YOLOv11，经 TFLite 转换部署到 Android；区分静态与动态行为的评估。
AI.result: 静态姿态更稳（坐 AP=0.531、precision=100%），动态采食差（AP=0.292、recall=0.20）；未见图像上坐 98.04%、站 83.33%、采食 67.65%。
AI.conclusion: 模型在真实农场具泛化能力，可支撑连续行为监测与早期福利评估，为商业化移动应用奠定技术基础；但动态行为识别仍为瓶颈。

title: Satisfiability Modulo Theories for Robust Synthesis of Signal Temporal Logic Specifications
comment: Submitted to American Control Conference
summary: Signal Temporal Logic is a popular framework for describing a robotic system's goals. Once described using a temporal logic framework, synthesis turns the goals into actual steps for the robots to follow. Currently, the state of the art for sound and complete synthesis is using Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), which struggles on long time horizons and large environments, preventing the construction of guaranteed safe plans for long deployments. This paper introduces a new synthesis method using Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) which scales better for long deployments and adapts to environmental changes more quickly. We do this by introducing an encoding method for STL into SMT constraints, and an encoding method for discrete-time dynamical systems modeled as a transition system. We then conduct an empirical comparison of our SMT based methods against the state of the art MILP based methods. Results show that for this class of problems, SMT is an effective encoding strategy that performs the best on long time horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出用SMT（可满足性模理论）对信号时序逻辑（STL）任务与离散时间转移系统动力学进行编码，实现比MILP更可扩展的可靠完备任务综合，在长时域任务上表现最优。
AI.motivation: 现有可靠完备的STL综合方法基于混合整数线性规划（MILP），在长时间跨度和大规模环境下难以扩展，无法为长期部署构建有安全保证的规划。
AI.method: 1）提出将STL规范编码为SMT约束的方法；2）提出将离散时间动力系统建模为转移系统并编码进SMT的方法；3）与SOTA的MILP方法进行实证对比。
AI.result: 实验表明SMT编码在此类问题上有效，在长时域任务上性能优于MILP基线，并能更快适应环境变化。
AI.conclusion: SMT可作为STL任务综合的高效替代编码策略，尤其适合长时间跨度的部署场景。

title: When a Larger Guidance Scale Repairs Text-to-Video Failures and When It Does Not
comment: 29 pages, 15 figures
summary: When a text-to-video diffusion model ignores part of a prompt, the usual first fix is to raise the classifier-free guidance scale. This paper is a measurement study of when that fix works. On Mochi, the same increase repairs failures on rare compositions ("a snowy beach") beyond what generating again does, does not repair negations ("a highway with no vehicles"), where it fixes fewer failures than generating again does, and changes nothing for events that must happen late in a clip ("a sandcastle that a wave washes flat"). Which of these happens can be known in advance, from the prompt and one inexpensive score. The score, which we call demand, measures how strongly the denoiser reacts to the part of the prompt that the failed video leaves out, and it is read from the first quarter of denoising, before any video exists. Our main finding is a condition: raising the scale is effective only when the prompt contains no negation and no event tied to a specific time, and when demand is sufficiently high, with recovery clearly higher above a fitted threshold than below it. Published corrections for the three failure types, used as fixed probes, behave as this account predicts. A short decision rule follows: before generating again, a user can tell whether the most common fix is worth trying, and what to use when it is not.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于文生视频扩散模型中"提高CFG尺度"何时有效、何时无效的测量研究：通过一个从去噪前四分之一读出的"demand"分数，配合提示词是否含否定与时间绑定事件，可预先判断提尺度能否修复失败。
AI.motivation: 用户遇到提示词被忽略时通常第一反应是提高classifier-free guidance（CFG）尺度，但这一"默认修复手段"并不总是有效，且事前无从判断。作者希望建立一个可预测、可先验判断的条件性结论，使用户在重生成或换手段前做出决策。
AI.method: 在Mochi上进行测量型实验，将失败分为三类：罕见组合（如"snowy beach"）、否定（"highway with no vehicles"）、晚期事件（"a sandcastle that a wave washes flat"）。对比"提高CFG"与"重新生成"两种修复方式。提出"demand"分数：衡量去噪器对提示词中被失败视频遗漏部分的响应强度，且仅从去噪前四分之一（尚无视频时）读取一个廉价score。以三类失败类型的公开修正方法作为固定探针，检验该条件是否相符。
AI.result: 提高尺度能修复罕见组合失败，优于重新生成；对否定类失败几乎无效，修复率低于重新生成；对晚期事件无任何改变。主要发现是一个条件：提尺度仅在提示词不含否定、不含绑定特定时间的事件，且demand足够高时有效；在拟合阈值上下恢复率差异明显。三类失败的固定探针表现与该解释一致。
AI.conclusion: 给出简短决策规则：用户在"再次生成"之前即可判断最常见的修复手段（提CFG）是否值得尝试，以及不适用时应改用何种方法。这为扩散采样期的提示遵循干预提供了可预测的先验判据。

title: Check Your Blind Spots: Decision-Guided Perception by Probing the Planner with Hypothetical Objects
summary: Not every perception error changes the planner's action. Yet adaptive-resolution perception chooses where to spend high-resolution computation from image cues, which can neither reliably point to an object that low resolution missed nor tell which objects matter to the planner. We observe that the planner can say where an object would matter before anything is seen: inserting a hypothetical object at a location tests whether its action would change. Decision-Guided Speculative Perception (DGSP) treats the low-resolution scene and its action as a draft and probes the planner in this way to obtain a decision-sensitivity field, the locations where an unseen object would change the action. Only this field and the support, the detections on which the current action rests, are verified at high resolution, repeatedly until the action is stable. For two planner classes, we prove that DGSP returns exactly the action of whole-frame high-resolution perception if crop detections match whole-frame ones and the crops cover the field, conditions that real images meet approximately. On three driving datasets, it reproduces this action on about 98% of frames with about a quarter of the pixels. At the pixel cost of uniform downscaling, it repairs more of the draft's disagreements with this action, brakes falsely less often, and recovers many more of the decision-relevant objects that the draft misses.

AI.tldr: DGSP：以低分辨率感知+规划动作为草稿，向规划器插入假设目标探询"决策敏感场"，仅对敏感场与当前动作支撑区域进行高分辨率验证并迭代至动作稳定。
AI.motivation: 自适应分辨率感知依赖图像线索决定高分辨率计算位置，但图像线索既无法可靠指示低分辨率漏检的目标，也无法判断目标对规划是否重要；而多数感知误差并不改变规划动作。
AI.method: 将低分辨率场景与其动作视为草稿（draft）；在候选位置插入假设目标并查询规划器，得到"决策敏感场"（会改变动作的位置）；结合当前动作的支撑集（support，即检测结果）进行高分辨率裁剪验证，迭代直到动作稳定。针对两类规划器给出定理：若裁剪检测与全帧检测一致且裁剪覆盖敏感场，则DGSP返回与全帧高分辨率感知完全相同的动作。
AI.result: 三个驾驶数据集上，约98%帧复现全帧高分辨率动作，仅用约四分之一像素；在与均匀降采样同等像素代价下，修复更多草稿与目标动作的分歧，误刹车更少，恢复更多决策相关漏检目标。
AI.conclusion: 以规划器决策灵敏度引导感知计算分配，可在保证动作等价性的理论条件下大幅降低感知像素开销并提升决策相关目标的召回。

title: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and training one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), directly or after an SFT warm-up, and distilling the teachers into one student with MOPD. We evaluate on 21 image STEM, image perception, and video reasoning benchmarks after we decontaminate the training data against them. The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: the student closely matches each teacher on its own domain and is on average above the mixed-training baselines on the same prompts. Since MOPD already merges the domain capabilities that MixRL would otherwise have to learn, its student is a stronger starting point for RL, and we ask whether the same data can carry the model further from there: we add MixRL on top of the MOPD student, on the same prompts and with the same settings, which, to our knowledge, no prior VLM recipe has studied. The same prompts still improve the MOPD student, with no collapse, and give our main model, M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. MOPD and MixRL can therefore work as consecutive stages that get more out of the same data. We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.

AI.tldr: 提出M3OPD-Reasoner：面向VLM多领域推理（图像STEM、图像感知、视频）的全开源后训练配方，先按领域用GSPO训练教师，再用多教师on-policy蒸馏（MOPD）合并为单一学生，随后在同一数据上叠加MixRL得到最终模型，并发布数据、代码与各阶段权重。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM后训练多为混合数据训练或分领域训练，缺乏对"多领域能力如何合并"的系统比较，也缺少验证MOPD与RL能否作为连续阶段复用同一数据的完整开源配方。
AI.method: 从Qwen3.5-9B出发，构建M3OPD-SFT-1.35M与M3OPD-RL-193K（可验证奖励RL）；对比MixSFT/MixRL混合训练与"每领域一个GSPO教师（直接或SFT预热后）→ MOPD蒸馏为单学生"两条路线；再在MOPD学生上追加同prompt同设置的MixRL；在21个基准（训练数据已去污染）上评估。
AI.result: MOPD蒸馏GSPO直接训练的教师为最优配方：学生在各领域接近对应教师，并在相同prompt上平均优于混合训练基线；叠加MixRL后MOPD学生继续提升且无能力崩塌，得到M3OPD-Reasoner-9B。
AI.conclusion: 多教师on-policy蒸馏与混合RL可作为两个连续阶段，从同一数据中榨取更多能力；全流程数据、代码、检查点开源，为VLM多域后训练提供可复现基线。

title: Automated Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation for Underwater Litter Detection: A Comparison of Generative Approaches
summary: Underwater object detection is often limited by scarce and imbalanced training data and by strong appearance variations caused by turbidity, lighting, and differences between sensors. Existing data augmentation strategies, such as geometric or color augmentation or fully synthetic image generation with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), either lack semantic realism, fail to respect scene physics, or require additional annotations. In low-data domains like underwater environmental monitoring, the need for additional annotations is often the core bottleneck. Collecting new footage is hard, but labeling this dataset is even more time-consuming and costly, which limits how quickly a usable dataset can be constructed. We propose a unified fully automated zero-annotation pipeline that inserts class-conditioned trash objects into real underwater frames while preserving the original background context. Starting from sampled bounding boxes, each box is converted into an insertion mask and the object is pasted or generated within it, while the same box coordinates are automatically written as the corresponding annotation. Because labels are derived directly from the sampled boxes, the pipeline generates fully labeled training data for low-data settings without any manual annotation. Within this single pipeline we compare three strategies: copy-paste, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation. We evaluate bounding-box faithfulness, visual realism, and the impact of the generated samples on downstream detector performance on the SeaClear underwater debris dataset. Results show that DALL-E improves detection performance in four of five domains, with relative gains of up to 96 percent over the real-only baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动零标注数据增强流水线：将类别条件化的垃圾物体按采样框插入真实水下帧，框坐标自动作为标注，比较copy-paste、SD inpainting、DALL-E三种生成策略，DALL-E在SeaClear五域中四域提升检测性能，最高相对增益96%。
AI.motivation: 水下目标检测受限于训练数据稀缺、类别不均衡，以及浑浊度、光照和传感器差异带来的外观变化；现有几何/颜色增强缺乏语义真实性，GAN全合成不遵守场景物理或需额外标注，而低数据域中标注是最核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 统一零标注流水线：采样边界框→转换为插入掩码→在框内粘贴或生成物体（保持背景上下文），框坐标直接写为标注。在同一框架下对比copy-paste、Stable Diffusion inpainting与DALL-E图像条件生成三种策略，并评估框保真度、视觉真实感及下游检测器性能。
AI.result: 在SeaClear水下碎片数据集上，DALL-E在5个域中的4个提升检测性能，相对real-only基线最高增益约96%；同时给出框忠实度与视觉真实感的对比结论。
AI.conclusion: 零标注、标注自一致的物体插入/生成可有效扩充低数据域训练集，生成模型（尤其图像条件生成）优于传统copy-paste；该范式可推广到其他标注瓶颈型感知任务。

title: When Anchors Shift the Target: Advantage-Gated Adaptation for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Forward-process reinforcement learning adapts diffusion and flow-matching models by re-noising rewarded generations into regression targets. Because negative advantages induce concave updates with unbounded repulsive gradients, existing methods stabilize training using cached predictions from a moving policy copy, yet these anchors also alter what positive feedback teaches the model to fit. We formalize this conflict as anchor coupling: after separating frozen-reference regularizers, affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. We propose Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) to decouple these roles. Positive samples retain standard target fitting, whose self-limiting update vanishes at the observed target independently of the moving anchor. Negative samples instead use the first-order tangent of the concave objective at the moving-policy prediction, preserving the local repulsion direction with a prediction-independent gradient. Within the quadratic-anchor family, these requirements uniquely determine the parameter-free gate $\omega(a)=\max(-a,0)$. Because the moving copy provides local linearization rather than retention, AGA assigns long-horizon behavior preservation to a frozen pretrained reference regularized at its operating classifier-free guidance scale, interpreted through an implicit-reward lens. Across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, our experiments show that displacing positive targets degrades visual quality and heightens sensitivity to policy-copy schedules, whereas AGA consistently improves the reward--quality trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出 Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA)：形式化"锚耦合"冲突——负优势更新需凹化与排斥，而移动锚修改了正样本回归目标；AGA 解耦二者，正样本保持标准目标拟合，负样本用移动策略预测处凹目标的一阶切向（梯度与预测无关），在二次锚族中唯一确定无参门控 ω(a)=max(-a,0)，长期行为保持交由冻结参考模型正则。
AI.motivation: 前向过程强化学习（对扩散/流匹配模型将奖励样本重加噪作回归目标）中，负优势引发无界排斥梯度，现有方法用移动策略副本的缓存预测作锚来稳定训练，但该锚会污染正反馈的回归目标，形成"稳定性 vs. 正样本拟合正确性"的耦合冲突。
AI.method: 先分离冻结参考正则项，证明在仿射移动锚规则下无法同时消除负曲率并保全部正回归目标（锚耦合定理）。据此提出 AGA：正样本走标准回归（更新随残差自限，独立于锚）；负样本取凹目标在移动策略预测处的一阶切线，保留局部排斥方向而梯度不依赖预测。在二次锚族内证明 ω(a)=max(-a,0) 为唯一参数无关门控。长期保真由冻结预训练参考在原始 CFG 尺度上正则，并以隐式奖励视角解释。
AI.result: 在组合式生成、文本渲染与偏好对齐任务上：位移正样本目标会降低视觉质量并放大对策略副本更新节奏（schedule）的敏感性；AGA 在奖励—质量权衡曲线上一致优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 将训练稳定性（负样本排斥）与正样本目标保真解耦是前向过程 RL 微调扩散/流匹配模型的关键；移动锚不应承担长期行为保持职责，无参门控即可实现无偏正拟合与有界排斥梯度。

title: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导的两阶段深度学习框架，从常规CBCT中挖掘颞下颌关节滑液渗出的亚视觉影像信号，实现机会性软组织病变筛查。
AI.motivation: CBCT等常规X线模态针对高对比度矿化组织优化，软组织异常淹没于光子噪声且低于人眼感知阈值，需额外MRI才能诊断非钙化病变，成本高且难普及。
AI.method: 以TMJ为模型系统（N=212配对CBCT-MRI）。第一阶段：冻结的全网格3D掩码自编码器（BertsWin）在6550例无标注CBCT上用GradientConductor优化器与解剖感知目标PhysLoss预训练，将梯度流重定向至[-300,300]HU软组织窗；第二阶段：自动定位髁突顶点进行确定性3D裁剪，消除81%背景骨性方差。采用患者隔离的3×10折分层交叉验证评估。
AI.result: MRI验证的滑液渗出达到ROC AUC=0.793，该亚视觉信号仅在PhysLoss+GCond预训练表示中出现；该设置可捕获真实三维解剖手性（p<0.001）与高患者内结构一致性（0.791）；相同架构使用标准L2损失或非掩码方差分解（MVC）预训练则退化至随机猜测。
AI.conclusion: 常规低对比度X线扫描中蕴含物理保留下来的亚视觉软组织征象，可通过物理引导的自监督预训练与解剖先验裁剪稳定提取，为隐匿性软组织疾病的机会性筛查提供可推广范式。

title: Wall-to-wall maps of canopy height and aboveground carbon across the Atlantic Forest
comment: 56 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables, 2 supplementary tables. Submitted to Scientific Data. Maps and code openly available via Zenodo and GitHub
summary: Global canopy height maps are increasingly used to estimate forest carbon, yet their regional accuracy is rarely tested. We present wall-to-wall maps of canopy height (10~m) and aboveground carbon density (30~m) for the Brazilian Atlantic Forest in 2024. Height was predicted by a deep learning network fusing Sentinel-2 reflectance, Sentinel-1 and ALOS PALSAR backscatter and ALOS elevation, trained on 7{,}179 and tested on 1{,}793 patches (58{,}800~km$^2$) from a statewide airborne LiDAR campaign over São Paulo state, Brazil. On held-out test patches, the root mean square error is 3.05~m at 10~m and 2.58~m at 30~m, and the model was validated at two LiDAR sites outside São Paulo. Over the same pixels, the Meta and World Resources Institute global product has more than twice this error. A power law fitted to 124 inventory plots converted canopy height to above ground carbon density. The remaining forest holds 1{,}944~Tg~C over 28.3~Mha. Global products therefore need local validation before use in carbon accounting.

AI.tldr: 该文用深度学习融合S2/S1/PALSAR反射与ALOS高程，构建巴西大西洋森林2024年10 m冠层高度与30 m地上碳密度制图，RMSE分别为3.05 m和2.58 m，显著优于全球产品（误差一倍以上），并估计剩余森林储碳1,944 Tg C。
AI.motivation: 全球冠层高度/碳储量产品被广泛用于森林碳核算，但其区域精度鲜有验证；作者希望在生物多样性热点巴西大西洋森林给出经本地LiDAR验证的高分辨率、高精度制图，并量化全球产品在该区域的误差风险。
AI.method: 以São Paulo州机载LiDAR航测为标签，构建7,179训练/1,793测试patch（58,800 km²）；深度学习网络融合Sentinel-2反射率、Sentinel-1与ALOS PALSAR后向散射、ALOS高程，预测10 m冠层高度；用124个样地拟合幂律将高度转换为30 m地上碳密度；并在São Paulo之外的2个LiDAR站点做外部验证，同像素对比Meta/WRI全球产品。
AI.result: 留出测试集RMSE为10 m处3.05 m、30 m处2.58 m；跨州两个站点外部验证有效；同像素上Meta与WRI全球产品误差超过其两倍；大西洋森林剩余森林28.3 Mha面积上储碳约1,944 Tg C。
AI.conclusion: 区域化多源遥感+深度学习可显著超越全球产品，全球冠层高度/碳产品在用于碳核算前必须做本地验证；该工作提供了可复用的区域制图流程与外部验证范式。

title: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Project page: this https URL
summary: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出可微分、GPU并行的6D磁悬浮物理仿真器Magflow，纯从仿真物理训练出首个工业级6D磁悬浮神经控制器，零样本迁移至真实硬件并在4 kHz硬实时约束下运行。
AI.motivation: 工业磁悬浮依赖硬件-软件协同设计，用人工近似电磁力模型来保证千赫兹级控制可算，但这严重限制了工作空间与动子拓扑的通用性。作者主张直接从物理计算而非手工近似出发。
AI.method: 构建完全可微分、GPU并行的6D磁悬浮仿真器Magflow，直接计算电磁物理；在此仿真中端到端训练神经网络控制器（梯度经物理模型回传），推理时满足4 kHz实时约束。
AI.result: 神经控制器零样本从仿真迁移到真实工业级硬件，满足4 kHz硬实时；展现出人工控制难以实现的新行为，并能悬浮一个原本无手工解支持的动子拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 证明协同设计并非6D磁悬浮控制的物理必然；从仿真物理学习控制可超越传统控制工程在苛刻工业场景中的解空间。

title: Refin3R: Geometry-Guided Refinement for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision. Recent methods incorporate geometric priors such as camera pose or depth, but use them merely as auxiliary inputs, process each view independently, or refine the geometry only where the priors are available. We present Refin3R, which refines feed-forward point maps with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) points, propagating SfM geometry over the image grid. In its dual-branch architecture, a 2D branch extends SfM geometry beyond its coverage using geometry-aware backbone features, while a 3D branch reasons over the SfM points of all views, capturing multi-view structure that the image grid alone cannot represent. The two branches exchange information bidirectionally to jointly refine each view, yielding dense and accurate point maps. Across ScanNet++, ETH3D, Tanks\&Temples, and out-of-domain human and surgical scenes, Refin3R consistently outperforms feed-forward and geometry-guided methods in point map accuracy while running faster than the strongest geometry-guided baseline.

AI.tldr: Refin3R 用 SfM 点云作为几何先验，通过2D/3D双分支双向交互，将稀疏SfM几何传播到整幅图像网格，从而精化前馈点图，实现稠密且跨视图一致的点图重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型单次前向即可输出稠密点图，但缺乏显式几何约束导致跨视图不一致、细节精度不足；已有引入相机位姿/深度等先验的方法仅将其作为辅助输入、逐视图独立处理，或只在先验覆盖区域做精化，未能充分利用多视图SfM结构。
AI.method: 双分支架构：2D分支借助几何感知的骨干特征，将稀疏SfM几何外推至先验未覆盖区域；3D分支在所有视图的SfM点上进行推理，捕捉图像网格无法表达的多视图结构；两分支双向交换信息，联合精化每个视图，输出稠密精确点图。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++、ETH3D、Tanks&Temples 以及域外的人体与外科场景上，点图精度一致优于前馈方法与几何引导方法，且推理速度快于最强的几何引导基线。
AI.conclusion: 将SfM几何作为可传播的结构先验、并与图像网格特征双向融合，是提升前馈点图一致性与精度的高效途径，具备良好的跨域泛化性与运行效率。

title: ReTouchGS: Ultralight Render-free Aesthetic Color Enhancement and Transfer for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction. Existing 3DGS color transfer and interactive editing methods are guided by reference images and user-specified color adjustments. However, in many applications, users simply want aesthetically guided color enhancement that automatically makes the scene more visually appealing while maintaining consistent colors and tones across viewpoints. We present ReTouchGS, to our knowledge the first framework for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS models. It predicts a scene-level color lookup table (LUT) from the model and its associated camera parameters. ReTouchGS also supports reference-guided color transfer by fitting a scene-level LUT using one edited view of the same scene and its corresponding original render. A shared blend-aware color refinement network with only 44.7K parameters refines an analytic color update to realize either color mapping without rendering. It preserves geometry and delivers standard 3DGS assets in seconds. We also design the ReTouch3D benchmark to support the evaluation of aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer across viewpoints. Experiments demonstrate high color accuracy and strong generalization to unseen scenes in both aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer.

AI.tldr: ReTouchGS：首个面向预训练3DGS模型的免参考美学颜色增强框架，通过从模型与相机参数预测场景级LUT实现跨视角一致的色彩增强，并支持单视角参考图的颜色迁移，44.7K参数网络无需渲染即可细化颜色映射。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS颜色迁移/编辑依赖参考图或用户手工调色，而实际应用中用户往往只需要自动、美观且跨视角一致的色彩增强。同时缺乏评估此类任务的基准。
AI.method: 从3DGS模型及其相机参数预测场景级3D LUT（免参考美学增强）；参考引导模式下，用同一场景的一张编辑视图与其原始渲染拟合场景级LUT；共享的blend-aware颜色细化网络（仅44.7K参数）对解析色彩更新进行残差式精修，整个过程无需重新渲染，可直接保留几何并输出标准3DGS资产。另构建ReTouch3D基准用于跨视角评估。
AI.result: 在美学颜色增强与参考引导颜色迁移两项任务上均取得较高颜色精度，并对未见场景表现出良好泛化能力；处理耗时为秒级，参数开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 无需渲染的场景级LUT方案是3DGS后处理配色的一种高效、轻量且可泛化的解决路径，可直接作用于已有3DGS资产，适合作为3DGS资产色彩后处理的实用工具。

title: FrameRouter: Frame Budget Routing for Long-Video Understanding on Video-MME-v2 and Beyond
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Long-video question answering benchmarks like Video-MME-v2 typically evaluate systems under a uniform frame budget for every question, despite stark variation in the evidence each query actually demands. We analyze this mismatch on Video-MME-v2 and find that different question subsets prefer different frozen frame-budget policies, while uniformly increasing the frame count does not reliably improve all metrics. These findings motivate fixed-mean frame-budget routing, a controlled inference setting in which each question may receive a different frame budget while the average budget matches a uniform reference. We introduce FrameRouter, a training-free test-time framework that combines an evidence-demand router, a budget-constrained allocation rule, and a frozen bank of frame-sampling policies. By controlling how much visual evidence each question receives while leaving the underlying samplers unchanged, FrameRouter is orthogonal to query-aware frame selection. Across Video-MME-v2 and several long-video understanding benchmarks, FrameRouter improves long-video question answering by using the same average visual budget more selectively across questions. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对长视频问答中“统一帧预算”与问题实际证据需求不匹配的问题，提出免训练测试时框架 FrameRouter，在保持平均帧预算不变（fixed-mean）的约束下，按各问题证据需求路由到不同冻结的采样策略与帧数。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答基准（如 Video-MME-v2）对每个问题使用统一帧预算评测，但不同问题所需的视觉证据量差异巨大；实验发现不同问题子集偏好不同的固定帧预算策略，且单纯增加帧数并不能稳定提升所有指标，说明预算分配与证据需求之间存在错配。
AI.method: 提出 fixed-mean frame-budget routing 这一受控推理设定：各问题预算可不同但均值与统一基线一致。FrameRouter 由三部分组成：(1) 证据需求路由器，判断问题需要的证据量；(2) 预算约束下的分配规则，在均值约束下分配帧数；(3) 冻结的帧采样策略库。不训练参数、不改动底层采样器，因此与 query-aware frame selection 正交。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME-v2 及多个长视频理解基准上，FrameRouter 在相同平均视觉预算下通过按问题选择性分配预算，提升了长视频问答性能；消融显示不同问题子集的最优帧预算策略确有差异，均匀增帧不会单调提升所有指标。
AI.conclusion: 帧预算应按问题证据需求非均匀分配，而非全局统一；在固定均值约束下做策略路由即可获得免训练、即插即用的增益，且可与查询感知的帧选择方法叠加。

title: RFW-S: Everyday Deformable Objects with Independent Simulation Verification
comment: 34 pages, 19 figures. Project Page: this https URL
summary: Large-scale robotic simulation requires diverse deformable objects with executable physical properties and realistic interaction behaviors. However, existing 3D asset collections primarily emphasize visual diversity, while scalable physical construction and verification remain challenging. We introduce RFW-S, a large-scale dataset of 83,365 simulation-verified assets spanning 485 everyday categories across five structural families: soft solids, cloth sheets, shells, garments, and bags. We develop an automated pipeline integrating reference-guided 3D generation, structure-aware physical modeling, and LLM-assisted parameter estimation and calibration. To ensure physical reliability, we introduce an independent simulation verification framework that evaluates object behaviors under interactions distinct from those used for parameter calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of independent verification and characterize deformable responses under different physical configurations. We further evaluate robotic grasping in terms of both task success and object integrity, and demonstrate the physical realism of our simulated objects through sim-to-real replay of fragile-object manipulation. RFW-S provides a scalable foundation for physically grounded simulation and embodied robotic learning.

AI.tldr: RFW-S: 83,365个经仿真验证的可变形物体资产数据集（485类、五类结构族），含自动生成管线与独立仿真校验框架，并评测抓取成功与物体完整性及sim-to-real回放。
AI.motivation: 机器人仿真需要大量带可执行物理属性、交互行为真实的可变形物体，但现有3D资产集偏重视觉多样性，缺乏可扩展的物理构建与验证手段。
AI.method: 构建自动化管线：参考引导的3D生成 + 结构感知物理建模 + LLM辅助参数估计与标定；并引入独立仿真验证框架，在与标定交互不同的交互条件下评估物体行为；最后做抓取实验与脆弱物体操作的sim-to-real回放。
AI.result: 大规模实验显示独立验证有效，刻画了不同物理配置下的可变形响应；抓取任务在成功率与物体完整性两方面得到评估，sim-to-real回放体现出物理真实性。
AI.conclusion: RFW-S为物理可信仿真与具身机器人学习提供可扩展的数据基础。

title: PAIR: Bringing Household Robots into the Smart Home
summary: Household robots often need to operate appliances, and smart appliances offer both control panels and device APIs. Existing embodied AI simulation environments, however, model appliances solely as physical objects. We introduce PAIR, a smart-home simulation environment grounded in the Matter protocol~\footnote{ this https URL }, the industry standard for smart-home devices. PAIR provides 84 smart-device assets whose functional control panels and APIs act on a shared device state, with ambient conditions that evolve in response to both. From a survey of 1,443 requests, we construct a benchmark of 40 tasks that all require object manipulation yet remain solvable without API access, with 340 human demonstrations for policy training. Whether run alone, with a high-level planner, or with an API-enabled planner, two fine-tuned VLA policies complete none of the 120 evaluation episodes. Robots rarely get far enough to use the API: even with oracle plans and API access, over 90\% of failed rollouts stall at navigating, grasping, or operating a door. With a perfect oracle in place of the robot's body, the best planner still gets through only 57.3\% of its plan. When choosing between pressing a button and calling an API, several planners go by whether they can read the panel, not by API latency.\footnote{We will release our code and data upon publication.}

AI.tldr: PAIR: a Matter-protocol-grounded smart-home simulation environment with 84 smart devices whose panels and APIs share device state; a 40-task benchmark shows current VLA policies fail all episodes, and API use is gated by the physical bottleneck.
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能仿真环境把家电仅建模为纯物理对象，忽略了智能家电既有控制面板又提供设备API这一现实；而家庭机器人日常需要操作家电，因此缺少能同时刻画物理操作与API调用、并共享同一设备状态的仿真平台。
AI.method: 基于智能家居行业标准Matter协议构建仿真环境PAIR，提供84个智能设备资产，其功能控制面板与API作用于统一的设备状态，环境条件随二者共同演化。从1,443条用户请求调研中构建40个任务的基准（均需物体操作且在不访问API的情况下也可解），并提供340条人类示范用于策略训练；在纯策略、高层规划器、API可用规划器三种设置下评估两个微调VLA策略，并用oracle替代机器人本体做规划器能力上限分析。
AI.result: 两个微调VLA策略在全部120个评估回合中零成功；即使给定oracle计划与API访问权限，超过90%的失败rollout仍卡在导航、抓取或开门环节。用完美oracle替代机器人本体时，最佳规划器也仅完成57.3%的计划。在按按钮与调用API之间选择时，多个规划器依据的是能否读到面板，而非API时延。
AI.conclusion: 物理操作能力是当前具身智能体接入智能家电API的主要瓶颈，而非决策层面；PAIR提供了统一物理-API设备状态的标准化仿真基准，可用于暴露并量化该类瓶颈。

title: UnrealEvent: Synthetic Dataset Generation and Annotation for Event-Based Vision
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Neuromorphic Vision (NeVi), ECCV 2026
summary: Event-based cameras provide high temporal resolution, low power consumption, and a high dynamic range, but progress in event-based object detection remains constrained by the scarcity of annotated training data. To solve this issue, this paper introduces the tool UnrealEvent, a synthetic dataset-generation pipeline implemented in Unreal Engine 5.5. The pipeline combines a V2E-inspired event-frame generator with EasySynth semantic-rendering passes, allowing rendered level sequences to be converted into paired event representations and YOLO-format bounding-box annotations without manual labeling. Events are generated from per-pixel log-luminance differences between consecutive frames, with contrast thresholds sampled independently from a normal distribution to emulate the fabrication-induced threshold mismatch of real sensors. Using this pipeline, we provide a synthetic dataset and evaluate YOLOv8 detectors under synthetic, zero-shot real, and real fine-tuning training on eTraM. The results show strong in-domain synthetic performance but a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, especially for pedestrians. Fine-tuning on a small real subset improves real-domain performance, while the remaining gap highlights the importance of asset diversity and sensor calibration.

AI.tldr: UnrealEvent：基于 UE5.5 的合成事件相机检测数据集生成流水线，融合 V2E 风格事件帧生成与 EasySynth 语义渲染，自动产出事件表示与 YOLO 标注，并评估 YOLOv8 的合成—真实域差距。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率、低功耗、高动态范围优势，但标注训练数据稀缺，制约事件目标检测进展；人工标注事件数据成本高，因此需要自动化合成数据生成方案。
AI.method: 在 Unreal Engine 5.5 中实现合成数据流水线：渲染关卡序列后，用 EasySynth 语义渲染通道获取实例掩码以生成 YOLO 格式框标注；事件由相邻帧逐像素对数亮度差生成，并采用独立从正态分布采样的对比度阈值来模拟真实传感器的阈值失配；最终在 eTraM 上做合成域、零样本真实域与真实小子集微调三组 YOLOv8 评测。
AI.result: 域内合成性能强，但存在显著合成到真实的域差距，行人类别尤为明显；使用少量真实数据微调可提升真实域性能，剩余差距指向资产多样性与传感器标定的重要性。
AI.conclusion: UnrealEvent 提供了可复现的事件检测合成数据工具与基线评测，验证了合成预训练+少量真实微调的可行性，但仿真保真度（资产多样性、传感器标定）仍是缩小 sim-to-real 差距的关键。

title: Transfer Once, Ask Locally: Compact Audio-Visual Memory for On-Device Question Answering
summary: Audio-visual question answering on lightweight user devices requires balancing speed, memory usage, privacy, and communication. One approach is to run audio-visual encoders on a server and a lightweight language decoder on the user device, keeping questions local while offloading media encoding. However, transferring and processing the full multimodal representation remains costly. We propose a training-free, query-agnostic token pruning framework that constructs a compact, reusable memory before transmission. We define video spatio-temporal blocks and aligned audio windows as players and estimate their importance through Monte Carlo Shapley valuation. We use an embedding coverage objective that combines query-independent utility with cross-modal redundancy calibration and rewards unimodal diversity through marginal coverage gains. We retain the original token embeddings of high-scoring players under a limited token budget and transfer the resulting memory once for reuse across subsequent local questions. Experiments on Video-MME, Daily-Omni, and Video-Holmes using video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) and video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B) show that our method achieves the best or tied-best QA accuracy among the compared compression methods across all evaluated settings. On Daily-Omni with video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) at 80\% pruning, our method improves accuracy by 12.86--14.62 percentage points over these methods while achieving the lowest device-side LLM prefill and decoding latency, with up to $1.92\times$ decoding speedup at comparable embedding memory usage.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的、与查询无关的音视频 token 剪枝框架：以时空视频块与对齐音频窗为“player”，用蒙特卡洛 Shapley 估重要性，并按嵌入覆盖目标保留高价值 token，形成可复用紧凑记忆一次传输。
AI.motivation: 轻量设备上的音视频问答需要在速度、内存、隐私与通信间折中；将编码器放服务器、解码器放端侧虽可保护问题隐私，但传输并处理完整多模态表示代价仍高。
AI.method: 定义视频时空块与音频窗为 player，Monte Carlo Shapley 估值重要性；构建“查询无关效用 + 跨模态冗余校准 + 单模态多样性边际覆盖增益”的嵌入覆盖目标，在 token 预算下保留高分 player 的原始嵌入，一次传输后跨多次本地提问复用；全程免训练。
AI.result: Video-MME、Daily-Omni、Video-Holmes 上，基于 video-SALMONN 2+(3B) 与 2 Pro(4B) 的准确率在全部设置下最佳或并列最佳；Daily-Omni(3B) 80% 剪枝下较对比压缩方法提升 12.86–14.62 个百分点，端侧 LLM prefill 与解码延迟最低，解码最高 1.92 倍加速，嵌入内存相当。
AI.conclusion: 与查询无关的可复用记忆压缩可在大幅降低传输与端侧延迟的同时保持或提升音视频问答精度，适合设备-服务器协同推理，但仅验证于基准数据集，未涉及真实部署或具身场景。

title: Event-Based Person Detection for Maritime UAV Search
comment: Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Maritime Computer Vision (MaCVi), WACV 2027
summary: Maritime search and rescue requires locating people in the water quickly, motivating the use of UAVs to survey the search area. During flight, camera motion and the longer exposures used in low light can blur small targets and hinder person detection. Event cameras record brightness changes as they occur, reducing the motion blur associated with longer exposure times. We investigate their use for maritime person detection by generating synthetic events using the v2e event simulator from public MOBDrone rescue videos and retaining the existing annotations. We compare the recurrent vision transformer model RVT-T with YOLOv8n and RT-DETR-R18 trained on exposure-matched images. On 843 test samples from held-out recordings, RVT-T achieves 15.63% person AP50:95, compared with 6.89% for YOLOv8n and 9.44% for RT-DETR-R18 under 100 ms synthetic exposure. Increasing exposure times from 50 to 200 ms progressively reduces frame-based detection accuracy, widening the gap to the event model. To evaluate the feasibility of on-board processing, we deploy our detector on a Jetson Orin Nano platform. The RVT-T model retains its accuracy and requires approximately 136 ms and 2.02 J per sample, allowing real-time processing on the UAV.

AI.tldr: Synthetic event-camera data (v2e from MOBDrone) enables an event-based transformer (RVT-T) to outperform exposure-matched frame detectors on maritime person detection, and runs real-time on Jetson Orin Nano.
AI.motivation: Maritime search-and-rescue UAVs need to detect small persons in water; camera motion and long low-light exposures cause motion blur that degrades frame-based detection. Event cameras record brightness changes asynchronously, avoiding blur from long exposure.
AI.method: Generate synthetic events with the v2e simulator from public MOBDrone rescue videos, reusing existing annotations. Train a recurrent vision transformer (RVT-T) on event representations and compare against YOLOv8n and RT-DETR-R18 trained on exposure-matched (50/100/200 ms) blurred images. Deploy RVT-T on Jetson Orin Nano and measure latency and energy.
AI.result: On 843 held-out test samples, RVT-T reaches 15.63% person AP50:95 vs 6.89% (YOLOv8n) and 9.44% (RT-DETR-R18) at 100 ms synthetic exposure. Frame-based accuracy degrades monotonically as exposure grows from 50 to 200 ms, widening the event-model advantage. On Jetson Orin Nano, RVT-T keeps accuracy at ~136 ms and 2.02 J per sample, i.e., real-time onboard.
AI.conclusion: Simulator-generated events plus a recurrent ViT give a robust, energy-efficient maritime person detector suitable for real-time UAV deployment; simulated data is an acceptable proxy for event-based training in this setting.

title: CADENCE: Learning Acyclic Gaits for Model-Based Quadruped Locomotion
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables
summary: Model-based quadruped controllers usually step on a cyclic gait, which lifts the legs in a fixed order on a fixed period, wherever the safe footholds are. We present CADENCE, a learned step planner with a small action space. Every 40 ms, it picks one of at most 65 discrete choices: no step, or one leg's step to a safe foothold. It also predicts a swing time. We train CADENCE by reinforcement learning on top of a convex model predictive controller (MPC). Nothing prescribes a gait: there is no gait schedule, and the reward has no gait term, only a cost per step. The one structural constraint is that at most two legs may swing at once. The policy we analyzed developed an acyclic gait, with no fixed period or stepping order, yet it still paired diagonal legs. An inverse footstep model (IFM), fitted on a controller's logged steps, turns each foothold into a command. With only the IFM refitted, on fewer than 20,000 steps, CADENCE ran frozen on OCS2's nonlinear MPC. In simulated trials on a range of terrains (26% to 49% voids) and speeds (0.1 m/s and 0.2 m/s), it succeeded in 85.1% (mean of five seeds), against 67.8% for OCS2-Trot, 65.5% for OCS2-Single, and 39.6% in a static walk ablation of CADENCE. At 49% voids, it succeeded in 72.9%, against 43.0% for OCS2-Trot.

AI.tldr: CADENCE是学习型四足步态规划器：每40ms在≤65个离散动作（不迈步或某腿迈向安全落点）中选一，并预测摆动时间；在凸MPC之上用RL训练，无步态调度、奖励无步态项，仅约束至多两腿同时摆动，结果自发涌现出非周期、非固定步序的对角步态。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的四足控制器通常执行固定周期、固定抬腿顺序的循环步态，与安全落点无关，导致在不平地形上鲁棒性不足。作者希望让步态由落脚点安全性驱动而非由时间表驱动，且不依赖人工步态设计。
AI.method: 以小动作空间步进规划器为核心：每40ms输出≤65个离散决策（不步/单腿迈向安全落脚点）及摆动时间预测；在凸MPC（OCS2）之上用强化学习训练，无步态调度项、奖励仅含每步代价，唯一结构约束为最多两腿同时摆动；再用控制器日志拟合逆足步模型（IFM），把落脚点转为指令，使策略冻结后可直接驱动非线性MPC。
AI.result: 策略收敛为无固定周期与步序但成对对角摆动的非周期步态。仅重拟合IFM（<2万步）即可令冻结策略运行于OCS2非线性MPC。仿真中空洞占比26%–49%、速度0.1/0.2 m/s下成功率85.1%（5种子均值），对比OCS2-Trot 67.8%、OCS2-Single 65.5%、CADENCE静态行走消融39.6%；49%空洞时72.9% vs OCS2-Trot 43.0%。
AI.conclusion: 显式循环步态调度并非必要：以落脚点安全为驱动的离散步进规划配RL即可涌现有效非周期步态，并能低成本迁移到非线性MPC，在高空洞率地形上显著优于循环步态基线。局限在于结果均为仿真，缺乏实机验证。

title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
summary: Learned lossless codecs make smaller files than common classical codecs, yet the images we archive and train on still use classical codecs. A main reason is time: a learned codec takes seconds to decode a photo that a classical codec opens in milliseconds, and their faster variants give up most of their gain in size. We argue that much of this time is spent waiting, not computing: the network waits for the values it conditions on, and the arithmetic decoder reads them one at a time. We introduce FMT (Fixed-step Multiscale Tree), a lossless image format whose decoding order and entropy coder are designed together so that neither wait grows with the image. FMT stores an image as a coarse-to-fine tree whose steps hold independent values: a GPU predicts each step at once and decodes it in parallel rANS lanes that carry their states from step to step, so an image of any size decodes in a fixed number of sequential steps. On this tree we build a family of bit-exact codecs, from a rule with no network to large networks, and no codec we ran on the same GPU beats any of them on both size and speed. Without a network, FMT beats NVIDIA's HTJ2K on size and speed; with a large one, it decodes Kodak photos 9 to 61X faster than learned codecs we ran on the same A100, at the same size or smaller.

AI.tldr: FMT（固定步数多尺度树）无损图像格式：联合设计解码顺序与熵编码，使解码等待不随图像尺寸增长；无网络时在体积与速度上胜过 HTJ2K，大网络时比学习型编解码器快 9–61×。
AI.motivation: 学习型无损编解码器压缩率优于经典编解码器，但解码一张照片需数秒（经典仅毫秒级），而更快的变体又损失大部分压缩收益，导致归档与训练数据仍用经典格式。作者认为主要瓶颈是"等待"而非"计算"：网络等待条件值、算术解码器逐符号串行读取。
AI.method: 提出 FMT 树结构：将图像存储为粗到细的树，每步内取值相互独立，因此 GPU 可一次性预测整步；采用并行 rANS 通道（lane）在步与步之间携带状态，实现整步并行解码，使任意尺寸图像都只需固定数量的顺序步骤。在该树上构建从无网络规则到大型网络的位精确（bit-exact）编解码器族。
AI.result: 在同一 GPU 上，所测编解码器无一能在体积与速度两方面同时优于 FMT 系列；无网络版本在压缩率与速度上均超过 NVIDIA HTJ2K；大网络版本在 A100 上解码 Kodak 图像比同类学习型编解码器快 9–61 倍，且体积相当或更小。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同设计解码顺序与熵编码消除串行等待，学习型无损编解码可在保持或超越压缩率的同时获得数量级加速，具备替代经典格式用于归档与训练数据的潜力。

title: Event-Based Dynamic Lip Region Estimation During Speech
summary: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low power consumption, making them promising for speech-related applications. These include automatic lip reading, audiovisual speech analysis, and human-robot interaction, particularly in challenging environments characterized by low illumination or high dynamic range. Event-based lip reading, speaker recognition, and voice activity detection, however, mostly operate on a cropped region of interest (ROI), by hand or by the dataset, and no event-based method supplies that ROI as a spatial region; existing event-based face analysis gives the mouth as landmarks, which presents a mismatch between application and localization. The present work predicts a dense heatmap over the lip region from the full event "frame". Events are encoded as a polarity-separated voxel grid and processed at every location by a two-pathway continuous-time recurrent network (CT-RNN) with learned, log-space bounded time constants acting on the real elapsed time of each bin: a stateless fast pathway and a stateful slow pathway, utilised for refining and anchoring the prediction. The model reaches 69.5% on lips on four unseen speakers and switches target only 2.1 times per second, against 8.9 and 11.0 for convolutional baselines with more parameters. Adding a spatial encoder improves precision but fails on a new face scale. On a real event sensor, trained only on simulated events, the proposed model reaches 58.0% on lips against 43.2% for the CNN, with fewer than half its target switches.

AI.tldr: 基于事件相机全帧的稠密唇部热图预测：极性分离体素网格 + 双通路连续时间RNN（快/慢路径），在未见说话人上达69.5%唇部准确率，目标切换次数显著低于CNN基线。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率与低功耗，适合低照度/高动态范围下的唇读、视听语音分析与人机交互；但现有事件式唇读、说话人识别、VAD多依赖手工或数据集给定的裁剪ROI，而现有事件式人脸分析只输出嘴部关键点，存在"应用需求（空间区域）"与"定位输出（关键点）"之间的不匹配。
AI.method: 将事件流编码为按极性分离的体素网格；在每一空间位置用双通路连续时间循环网络（CT-RNN）处理，时间常数在对数空间有界且可学习，作用于每个bin的真实流逝时间——无状态快速通路负责精化，有状态慢速通路负责锚定；从整帧预测唇区稠密热图（而非关键点）。另加空间编码器可提升精度但在新的人脸尺度上失效。
AI.result: 四位未见说话人上唇部命中率69.5%，目标切换仅2.1次/秒（CNN基线为8.9与11.0，且参数量更多）；真实事件传感器上、仅用仿真事件训练，本方法58.0% vs CNN 43.2%，目标切换次数不到其一半。
AI.conclusion: 用稠密热图替代关键点来桥接事件式人脸定位与应用需求，CT-RNN双通路设计在精度与时间稳定性（低切换率）上均优于CNN，并展现出仿真到真实事件传感器的可迁移性；但空间编码器带来的跨尺度泛化问题仍未解决。

title: LUTBench: Benchmarking Text-Driven Photographic Look Transfer
summary: Photographic color grading shapes the tone and color of a photograph to achieve a desired look. Text-driven photographic look transfer lets users specify these adjustments in natural language, with the goal of reproducing the requested look across photographs while preserving their content. However, prior research on text-driven color grading uses different datasets, text instructions, target definitions, and metrics. These differences make it difficult to compare how faithfully the methods reproduce the same look. To compare methods under a shared protocol, we introduce LUTBench. We collect 91 three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) and define one photographic look per LUT with a specified input conversion. Applying these looks to 5,000 MIT-Adobe FiveK photographs produces 455,000 input-target image pairs with reproducible target images. For each look, we use templates to turn measured tone and color changes on fixed color samples into candidate clauses. We use training image measurements to verify applicable clauses before composing the text description. The evaluation measures target fidelity, tests sensitivity to predefined input conversions, and separates generalization to unseen looks from reproduction of seen looks on new photographs. Across 16 methods, stronger text alignment does not guarantee target fidelity. However, most supervised variants improve fidelity on both seen and unseen looks.

AI.tldr: LUTBench：以91个3D LUT定义的摄影外观为统一协议，构建455,000图文对数据集，系统评测16种文本驱动色彩分级方法的目标保真度、输入转换敏感性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动摄影外观迁移领域此前数据集、文本指令、目标定义与评测指标各异，导致不同方法难以公平比较；需要一个共享协议的基准来揭示"文本对齐"与"目标保真"之间的关系。
AI.method: 收集91个3D LUT，每个LUT配一个明确定义的摄影外观与指定输入转换；应用于5,000张MIT-Adobe FiveK照片生成455,000个可复现的输入-目标图像对；用模板将固定色样上的色调/色彩变化测量转化为候选子句，并用训练图像测量验证子句可用性后组合成文本描述；评测包含目标保真度、对预定义输入转换的敏感性，以及"未见外观泛化"与"已见外观新照片复现"的分离测试。
AI.result: 在16种方法上，更强的文本对齐并不保证更高的目标保真度；但多数有监督变体在已见与未见外观上均提升了保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可复现、可比较的文本驱动色彩分级评测协议，并指出文本-图像对齐指标与外观复现质量之间存在解耦，提示未来方法应直接优化保真度而非仅追求语义匹配。

title: Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures
summary: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person. Nunchi outperforms the strongest existing method by 4.8 percentage points. On SORBET, conversational cues help whereas additional visual cues do not, and the gains hold across three VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on two existing datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 SORBET 多方可视对话注视基准（1,578 片段、3,340 样本，含同步语音/转写/被注视者标签）与 Nunchi 框架：用转写+注视/说话人模型输出构造文本提示，将线索与候选身份对齐，交由 VLM 权衡几何与对话线索判定被注视者。
AI.motivation: 多人场景下仅凭注视几何（视线方向与头部姿态）判定被注视对象会随人数增加而高度歧义；说话人身份与话语内容等对话线索可消解歧义，但现有注视数据集缺少多人场景下的同步语音-转写标注，导致模型无法利用这些异构、需身份关联且可能与几何相冲突的线索。
AI.method: 构建 SORBET 基准：1,578 个片段的 3,340 个样本，带同步语音、转写文本与被注视者（attended person）标签，覆盖的多人场景数超过现有注视数据集。设计 Nunchi：融合转写与注视估计、说话人识别模型输出生成文本提示，通过共享标签将每类线索绑定到对应候选身份，再由视觉语言模型（VLM）对注视几何线索与对话线索进行加权决断，输出被注视者。
AI.result: 相较最强已有方法提升 4.8 个百分点；消融显示对话线索带来增益而额外视觉线索无增益；增益在 3 个不同 VLM 上一致成立，使用自动转写（非人工标注）时仍保持，并在两个已有数据集上可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 对话感知线索是多方可视注视目标识别的有效且可迁移的信号，异构线索的显式身份对齐加 VLM 仲裁优于纯几何方法；该工作偏向视听觉社交感知基准与方法，与机器人/具身导航中的交互目标选择有一定关联，但无实体系统验证，实际可迁移性仍待考察。

title: Auditing a Learned Simulator for Legged Robots: The Robotic World Model on ANYmal D
comment: 39 pages, 13 figures, 20 tables. Code and data: this https URL and this https URL . Extends arXiv:2611.02699 with robot-level experiments
summary: A legged robot can learn to walk inside a learned simulator: a neural network that predicts the robot's next state and is run forward on its own predictions. They are usually trained and checked one step ahead, although a policy uses them for a hundred steps or more. We audit one published system end to end, without a GPU: the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) for the ANYmal D quadruped, and the uncertainty estimate of its follow-up, RWM-U. We rebuilt the model to match the released code's outputs, losses and gradients exactly, measured 101 trained simulators, 200 compressed copies and 38 simulators of three other architectures, and trained policies inside simulators that we tested in a hand-built MuJoCo model of the robot.
